    public string PasswordHash { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public Guid SecurityStamp { get; init; }

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; init; }

    public DateTime? LastSignInAt { get; init; }

    public DateTime? DisabledAt { get; init; }

    public bool IsAdministrator { get; init; }
}

public sealed record NewPerson(string UserName, string DisplayName, string PasswordHash);

public enum CreatePersonResult
{
    Created,
    UserNameTaken,
    SetupAlreadyDone,
}

public sealed class PersonStore(Database database)
{
    private const string Select =
        """
        SELECT p.id, p.user_name, p.display_name, p.password_hash, p.security_stamp, p.created_at,
               p.last_sign_in_at, p.disabled_at,
               EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM site_role r WHERE r.person_id = p.id AND r.role = 'administrator') AS is_administrator
        FROM person p
        """;

    public async Task<bool> HasAdministratorAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<bool>(new CommandDefinition(
            "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM site_role r JOIN person p ON p.id = r.person_id WHERE r.role = 'administrator' AND p.disabled_at IS NULL)",
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<(CreatePersonResult Result, Guid Id)> CreateAsync(NewPerson person, bool firstAdministrator, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(person);
        var id = Guid.CreateVersion7();
        try
        {
            return await database.InTransactionAsync(async (connection, transaction) =>
            {
                if (firstAdministrator)
                {
                    await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition("LOCK TABLE site_role IN EXCLUSIVE MODE", transaction: transaction, cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
                    var exists = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<bool>(new CommandDefinition(
                        "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM site_role WHERE role = 'administrator')", transaction: transaction, cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
                    if (exists)
                    {
                        return (CreatePersonResult.SetupAlreadyDone, Guid.Empty);
                    }
                }

                await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO person (id, user_name, display_name, password_hash, security_stamp)
                    VALUES (@id, @UserName, @DisplayName, @PasswordHash, @stamp)
                    """,
                    new { id, person.UserName, person.DisplayName, person.PasswordHash, stamp = Guid.NewGuid() },
                    transaction,
                    cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
                if (firstAdministrator)
                {
                    await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                        "INSERT INTO site_role (person_id, role, granted_by) VALUES (@id, @role, @id)",
                        new { id, role = SiteRoles.Administrator },
                        transaction,
                        cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
                }

                return (CreatePersonResult.Created, id);
            }, cancellationToken);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (Database.IsUniqueViolation(exception))
        {
            return (CreatePersonResult.UserNameTaken, Guid.Empty);
        }
    }

    public async Task<PersonRecord?> FindByUserNameAsync(string userName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<PersonRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE p.user_name = @userName", new { userName }, cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<PersonRecord?> FindAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<PersonRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE p.id = @id", new { id }, cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<PersonRecord>> ListAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<PersonRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " ORDER BY p.user_name", cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<PersonRecord>> SearchAsync(string text, int limit, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<PersonRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE p.disabled_at IS NULL AND (p.user_name LIKE @pattern OR lower(p.display_name) LIKE @pattern) ORDER BY p.user_name LIMIT @limit",
            new { pattern = "%" + Like(text.ToLowerInvariant()) + "%", limit },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task RecordSignInAsync(Guid id, string? rehashedPassword, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
            "UPDATE person SET last_sign_in_at = now(), password_hash = coalesce(@rehashedPassword, password_hash) WHERE id = @id",
            new { id, rehashedPassword },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<bool> SetAdministratorAsync(Guid id, bool administrator, Guid grantedBy, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        var changed = administrator
            ? await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                "INSERT INTO site_role (person_id, role, granted_by) VALUES (@id, @role, @grantedBy) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING",
                new { id, role = SiteRoles.Administrator, grantedBy },
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken))
            : await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                DELETE FROM site_role WHERE person_id = @id AND role = @role
                AND (SELECT count(*) FROM site_role r JOIN person p ON p.id = r.person_id WHERE r.role = @role AND p.disabled_at IS NULL) > 1
                """,
                new { id, role = SiteRoles.Administrator },
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
        return changed > 0;
    }

    public async Task<bool> SetDisabledAsync(Guid id, bool disabled, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        var changed = disabled
            ? await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                UPDATE person SET disabled_at = now(), security_stamp = gen_random_uuid()
                WHERE id = @id AND disabled_at IS NULL
                AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM site_role WHERE person_id = @id AND role = 'administrator')
                    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM site_role r JOIN person p ON p.id = r.person_id WHERE r.role = 'administrator' AND p.disabled_at IS NULL) <= 1)
                """,
                new { id },
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken))
            : await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                "UPDATE person SET disabled_at = NULL WHERE id = @id AND disabled_at IS NOT NULL",
                new { id },
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
        return changed > 0;
    }

    public async Task UpdatePasswordAsync(Guid id, string passwordHash, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
            "UPDATE person SET password_hash = @passwordHash, security_stamp = gen_random_uuid() WHERE id = @id",
            new { id, passwordHash },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task UpdateDisplayNameAsync(Guid id, string displayName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
            "UPDATE person SET display_name = @displayName WHERE id = @id",
            new { id, displayName },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    internal static string Like(string value) =>
        value.Replace("\\", "\\\\", StringComparison.Ordinal).Replace("%", "\\%", StringComparison.Ordinal).Replace("_", "\\_", StringComparison.Ordinal);

using Dapper;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Audit;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Trash;

public enum Subject
{
    Project,
    Sprint,
    WorkItem,
    Comment,
    Attachment,
    NestEntry,
}

public sealed class TrashRecord
{
    public string Type { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public Guid Id { get; init; }

    public string Title { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public string? ProjectKey { get; init; }

    public DateTime DeletedAt { get; init; }

    public string? DeletedByName { get; init; }

    public Guid? ProjectId { get; init; }

    public Subject Subject => SubjectNames.Parse(Type);
}

public static class SubjectNames
{
    public static string Of(Subject subject) => subject switch
    {
        Subject.Project => "project",
        Subject.Sprint => "sprint",
        Subject.WorkItem => "work_item",
        Subject.Comment => "comment",
        Subject.Attachment => "attachment",
        Subject.NestEntry => "nest_entry",
        _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(subject)),
    };

    public static Subject Parse(string? value) => value switch
    {
        "project" => Subject.Project,
        "sprint" => Subject.Sprint,
        "work_item" => Subject.WorkItem,
        "comment" => Subject.Comment,
        "attachment" => Subject.Attachment,
        "nest_entry" => Subject.NestEntry,
        _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value)),
    };

    public static bool TryParse(string? value, out Subject subject)
    {
        try
        {
            subject = Parse(value);
            return true;
        }
        catch (ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
        {
            subject = default;
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static string Label(Subject subject) => subject switch
    {
        Subject.Project => "Project",
        Subject.Sprint => "Sprint",
        Subject.WorkItem => "Work item",
        Subject.Comment => "Comment",
        Subject.Attachment => "Attachment",
        Subject.NestEntry => "Home entry",
        _ => "Record",
    };

    internal static string Table(Subject subject) => subject switch
    {
        Subject.Project => "project",
        Subject.Sprint => "sprint",
        Subject.WorkItem => "work_item",
        Subject.Comment => "work_item_comment",
        Subject.Attachment => "attachment",
        Subject.NestEntry => "nest_entry",
        _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(subject)),
    };
}

public sealed class Deletions(Database database)
{
    private const string TrashSelect =
        """
        SELECT * FROM (
            SELECT 'project' AS type, p.id, p.key || ' ' || p.name AS title, p.key AS project_key, p.deleted_at, d.display_name AS deleted_by_name, p.id AS project_id
            FROM project p LEFT JOIN person d ON d.id = p.deleted_by WHERE p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'sprint', s.id, s.name, p.key, s.deleted_at, d.display_name, s.project_id
            FROM sprint s JOIN project p ON p.id = s.project_id LEFT JOIN person d ON d.id = s.deleted_by WHERE s.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'work_item', w.id, '#' || w.number || ' ' || w.title, p.key, w.deleted_at, d.display_name, w.project_id
            FROM work_item w JOIN project p ON p.id = w.project_id LEFT JOIN person d ON d.id = w.deleted_by WHERE w.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'comment', c.id, '#' || w.number || ': ' || left(c.body, 80), p.key, c.deleted_at, d.display_name, w.project_id
            FROM work_item_comment c JOIN work_item w ON w.id = c.work_item_id JOIN project p ON p.id = w.project_id
            LEFT JOIN person d ON d.id = c.deleted_by WHERE c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'attachment', f.id, f.file_name, p.key, f.deleted_at, d.display_name, f.project_id
            FROM attachment f JOIN project p ON p.id = f.project_id LEFT JOIN person d ON d.id = f.deleted_by WHERE f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'nest_entry', n.id, n.kind || ': ' || left(coalesce(n.text, n.url, array_to_string(n.keys, ' ')), 80), NULL, n.deleted_at, d.display_name, NULL
            FROM nest_entry n LEFT JOIN person d ON d.id = n.deleted_by WHERE n.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND n.purged_at IS NULL
        ) t
        """;

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<TrashRecord>> ListAsync(Guid? projectId, int limit, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<TrashRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            TrashSelect + " WHERE @projectId::uuid IS NULL OR (t.project_id = @projectId AND t.type <> 'project') ORDER BY t.deleted_at DESC LIMIT @limit",
            new { projectId, limit },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<TrashRecord?> FindAsync(Subject subject, Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<TrashRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            TrashSelect + " WHERE t.type = @type AND t.id = @id",
            new { type = SubjectNames.Of(subject), id },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public Task<bool> SoftDeleteAsync(Subject subject, Guid id, Guid actorId, AuditEntry audit, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        ChangeAsync(
            $"UPDATE {SubjectNames.Table(subject)} SET deleted_at = now(), deleted_by = @actorId WHERE id = @id AND deleted_at IS NULL",
            new { id, actorId },
            audit,
            cancellationToken);

    public Task<bool> RestoreAsync(Subject subject, Guid id, AuditEntry audit, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        ChangeAsync(
            subject == Subject.NestEntry
                ? "UPDATE nest_entry SET deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL WHERE id = @id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND purged_at IS NULL"
                : $"UPDATE {SubjectNames.Table(subject)} SET deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL WHERE id = @id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL",
            new { id },
            audit,
            cancellationToken);

    public Task<bool> HardDeleteAsync(Subject subject, Guid id, AuditEntry audit, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        ChangeAsync(
            subject == Subject.NestEntry
                ? "UPDATE nest_entry SET keys = '{}', url = NULL, fields = NULL, text = NULL, purged_at = now() WHERE id = @id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND purged_at IS NULL"
                : $"DELETE FROM {SubjectNames.Table(subject)} WHERE id = @id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL",
            new { id },
            audit,
            cancellationToken);

    private async Task<bool> ChangeAsync(string sql, object parameters, AuditEntry audit, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(audit);
        return await database.InTransactionAsync(async (connection, transaction) =>
        {
            var changed = await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(sql, parameters, transaction, cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            if (changed == 0)
            {
                return false;
            }

            await AuditLog.WriteAsync(connection, transaction, audit, cancellationToken);
            return true;
        }, cancellationToken);
    }
}

using System.Buffers;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Dapper;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Files;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Work;

public sealed class AttachmentRecord
{
    public Guid Id { get; init; }

    public Guid ProjectId { get; init; }

    public Guid? WorkItemId { get; init; }

    public string FileName { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public string ContentType { get; init; } = "application/octet-stream";

    public long Length { get; init; }

    public string? UploadedByName { get; init; }

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; init; }

    public bool IsImage => ContentType.StartsWith("image/", StringComparison.Ordinal);
}

public sealed record AttachmentUpload(Guid ProjectId, Guid? WorkItemId, Guid UploadedBy, string FileName);

public enum UploadOutcome
{
    Stored,
    Empty,
    TooLarge,
}

public sealed record UploadResult(UploadOutcome Outcome, AttachmentRecord? Attachment = null);

public sealed class AttachmentStore(Database database)
{
    public const int ChunkSize = 1024 * 1024;

    private const string Select =
        """
        SELECT f.id, f.project_id, f.work_item_id, f.file_name, f.content_type, f.length, p.display_name AS uploaded_by_name, f.created_at
        FROM attachment f LEFT JOIN person p ON p.id = f.uploaded_by
        """;

    public async Task<UploadResult> UploadAsync(AttachmentUpload upload, Stream content, long maxBytes, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(upload);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(content);
        var id = Guid.CreateVersion7();
        var buffer = ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(ChunkSize);
        try
        {
            await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
            await using var transaction = await connection.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
            await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                INSERT INTO attachment (id, project_id, work_item_id, uploaded_by, file_name, content_type)
                VALUES (@id, @ProjectId, @WorkItemId, @UploadedBy, @FileName, 'application/octet-stream')
                """,
                new { id, upload.ProjectId, upload.WorkItemId, upload.UploadedBy, upload.FileName },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));

            using var hash = IncrementalHash.CreateHash(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
            long total = 0;
            var sequence = 0;
            string? sniffed = null;
            while (true)
            {
                var filled = await FillAsync(content, buffer, ChunkSize, cancellationToken);
                if (filled == 0)
                {
                    break;
                }

                total += filled;
                if (total > maxBytes)
                {
                    return new UploadResult(UploadOutcome.TooLarge);
                }

                if (sequence == 0)
                {
                    sniffed = FileRules.SniffImage(buffer.AsSpan(0, Math.Min(filled, 16)));
                }

                hash.AppendData(buffer, 0, filled);
                await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                    "INSERT INTO attachment_chunk (attachment_id, sequence, data) VALUES (@id, @sequence, @data)",
                    new { id, sequence, data = buffer.AsSpan(0, filled).ToArray() },
                    transaction,
                    cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
                sequence++;
                if (filled < ChunkSize)
                {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (total == 0)
            {
                return new UploadResult(UploadOutcome.Empty);
            }

            await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                "UPDATE attachment SET length = @total, sha256 = @digest, content_type = @contentType, complete = true WHERE id = @id",
                new { id, total, digest = hash.GetHashAndReset(), contentType = sniffed ?? "application/octet-stream" },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            var record = await connection.QuerySingleAsync<AttachmentRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
                Select + " WHERE f.id = @id", new { id }, transaction, cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
            return new UploadResult(UploadOutcome.Stored, record);
        }
        finally
        {
            ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(buffer);
        }
    }

    public async Task<AttachmentRecord?> FindAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<AttachmentRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE f.id = @id AND f.complete AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND (f.work_item_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_item w WHERE w.id = f.work_item_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL))",
            new { id },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<AttachmentRecord>> ListAsync(Guid itemId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<AttachmentRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE f.work_item_id = @itemId AND f.complete AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.created_at",
            new { itemId },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task CopyToAsync(Guid id, Stream destination, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(destination);
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        for (var sequence = 0; ; sequence++)
        {
            var data = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<byte[]?>(new CommandDefinition(
                "SELECT data FROM attachment_chunk WHERE attachment_id = @id AND sequence = @sequence",
                new { id, sequence },
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            if (data is null)
            {
                return;
            }

            await destination.WriteAsync(data, cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    private static async Task<int> FillAsync(Stream content, byte[] buffer, int size, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var filled = 0;
        while (filled < size)
        {
            var read = await content.ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(filled, size - filled), cancellationToken);
            if (read == 0)
            {
                break;
            }

            filled += read;
        }

        return filled;
    }
}

public sealed class CommentRecord

    public string Body { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; init; }

public sealed class CommentStore(Database database)
{
    private const string Select =
        """
        SELECT c.id, c.work_item_id, c.author_id, p.display_name AS author_name, c.body, c.created_at, c.edited_at
        FROM work_item_comment c LEFT JOIN person p ON p.id = c.author_id
        """;

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<CommentRecord>> ListAsync(Guid itemId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<CommentRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE c.work_item_id = @itemId AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at",
            new { itemId },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<CommentRecord?> FindAsync(Guid itemId, Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<CommentRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE c.work_item_id = @itemId AND c.id = @id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL",
            new { itemId, id },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<Guid> AddAsync(Guid itemId, Guid authorId, string body, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var id = Guid.CreateVersion7();
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
            """
            INSERT INTO work_item_comment (id, work_item_id, author_id, body) VALUES (@id, @itemId, @authorId, @body);
            UPDATE work_item SET updated_at = now() WHERE id = @itemId;
            """,
            new { id, itemId, authorId, body },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
        return id;
    }

    public async Task<bool> EditAsync(Guid itemId, Guid id, string body, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
            "UPDATE work_item_comment SET body = @body, edited_at = now() WHERE id = @id AND work_item_id = @itemId AND deleted_at IS NULL AND body <> @body",
            new { itemId, id, body },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken)) > 0;
    }
}

using Dapper;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Audit;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Access;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Work;

    public string Key { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public string Name { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public string Description { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; init; }

    public DateTime UpdatedAt { get; init; }

    public DateTime? DeletedAt { get; init; }

    public string? Role { get; init; }

    public long OpenItems { get; init; }

    public long MemberCount { get; init; }
}

public sealed class MemberRecord
{
    public Guid PersonId { get; init; }

    public string UserName { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public string DisplayName { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public string Role { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public DateTime AddedAt { get; init; }
}

public enum CreateProjectResult
{
    Created,
    KeyTaken,
}

public enum MemberChange
{
    Changed,
    NotFound,
    LastEditor,
    Unchanged,
}

public sealed class ProjectStore(Database database)
{
    private const string Select =
        """
        SELECT p.id, p.key, p.name, p.description, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at,
               m.role,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM work_item w WHERE w.project_id = p.id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.status <> 'done') AS open_items,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.id) AS member_count
        FROM project p
        LEFT JOIN project_member m ON m.project_id = p.id AND m.person_id = @personId
        """;

    public async Task<(CreateProjectResult Result, Guid Id)> CreateAsync(string key, string name, string description, Guid creatorId, AuditEntry audit, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(audit);
        var id = Guid.CreateVersion7();
        try
        {
            return await database.InTransactionAsync(async (connection, transaction) =>
            {
                await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                    "INSERT INTO project (id, key, name, description, created_by) VALUES (@id, @key, @name, @description, @creatorId)",
                    new { id, key, name, description, creatorId },
                    transaction,
                    cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
                await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                    "INSERT INTO project_member (project_id, person_id, role, added_by) VALUES (@id, @creatorId, @role, @creatorId)",
                    new { id, creatorId, role = PageRoles.Editor },
                    transaction,
                    cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
                await AuditLog.WriteAsync(connection, transaction, audit with { SubjectId = id.ToString() }, cancellationToken);
                return (CreateProjectResult.Created, id);
            }, cancellationToken);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (Database.IsUniqueViolation(exception))
        {
            return (CreateProjectResult.KeyTaken, Guid.Empty);
        }
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ProjectRecord>> ListAsync(Guid personId, bool everything, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<ProjectRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (@everything OR m.person_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.name",
            new { personId, everything },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<ProjectRecord?> FindAsync(string key, Guid personId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<ProjectRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE p.key = @key",
            new { key, personId },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<ProjectRecord?> FindByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid personId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<ProjectRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE p.id = @id",
            new { id, personId },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(Guid id, string name, string description, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
            "UPDATE project SET name = @name, description = @description, updated_at = now() WHERE id = @id",
            new { id, name, description },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<MemberRecord>> MembersAsync(Guid projectId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<MemberRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            """
            SELECT m.person_id, p.user_name, p.display_name, m.role, m.added_at
            FROM project_member m JOIN person p ON p.id = m.person_id
            WHERE m.project_id = @projectId
            ORDER BY m.role, p.display_name
            """,
            new { projectId },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<MemberChange> SetMemberAsync(Guid projectId, string userName, string role, Guid actorId, AuditEntry audit, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(audit);
        return await database.InTransactionAsync(async (connection, transaction) =>
        {
            var personId = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<Guid?>(new CommandDefinition(
                "SELECT id FROM person WHERE user_name = @userName AND disabled_at IS NULL",
                new { userName },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            if (personId is null)
            {
                return MemberChange.NotFound;
            }

            if (role != PageRoles.Editor && await IsLastEditorAsync(connection, transaction, projectId, personId.Value, cancellationToken))
            {
                return MemberChange.LastEditor;
            }

            var changed = await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                INSERT INTO project_member (project_id, person_id, role, added_by) VALUES (@projectId, @personId, @role, @actorId)
                ON CONFLICT (project_id, person_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role
                WHERE project_member.role <> excluded.role
                """,
                new { projectId, personId, role, actorId },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            if (changed == 0)
            {
                return MemberChange.Unchanged;
            }

            await AuditLog.WriteAsync(connection, transaction, audit, cancellationToken);
            return MemberChange.Changed;
        }, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<MemberChange> RemoveMemberAsync(Guid projectId, Guid personId, AuditEntry audit, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(audit);
        return await database.InTransactionAsync(async (connection, transaction) =>
        {
            if (await IsLastEditorAsync(connection, transaction, projectId, personId, cancellationToken))
            {
                return MemberChange.LastEditor;
            }

            var removed = await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                "DELETE FROM project_member WHERE project_id = @projectId AND person_id = @personId",
                new { projectId, personId },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            if (removed == 0)
            {
                return MemberChange.NotFound;
            }

            await AuditLog.WriteAsync(connection, transaction, audit, cancellationToken);
            return MemberChange.Changed;
        }, cancellationToken);
    }

    private static async Task<bool> IsLastEditorAsync(Npgsql.NpgsqlConnection connection, Npgsql.NpgsqlTransaction transaction, Guid projectId, Guid personId, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<bool>(new CommandDefinition(
            """
            SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member WHERE project_id = @projectId AND person_id = @personId AND role = 'editor')
               AND (SELECT count(*) FROM project_member WHERE project_id = @projectId AND role = 'editor') <= 1
            """,
            new { projectId, personId },
            transaction,
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
}

using System.Globalization;
using Dapper;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Work;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Work;

public sealed class SprintRecord
{
    public Guid Id { get; init; }

    public Guid ProjectId { get; init; }

    public string Name { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public string Goal { get; init; } = string.Empty;

    public string? StartsOn { get; init; }

    public string? EndsOn { get; init; }

    public string State { get; init; } = SprintStates.Planned;

    public long ItemCount { get; init; }

    public long DoneCount { get; init; }

    public long Points { get; init; }

    public long DonePoints { get; init; }

    public DateOnly? Starts => Parse(StartsOn);

    public DateOnly? Ends => Parse(EndsOn);

    private static DateOnly? Parse(string? value) =>
        DateOnly.TryParseExact(value, "yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var date) ? date : null;
}

public sealed record SprintDraft(string Name, string Goal, DateOnly? StartsOn, DateOnly? EndsOn);

public enum SprintChange
{
    Changed,
    NotFound,
    AnotherIsActive,
    WrongState,
}

public sealed class SprintStore(Database database)
{
    private const string Select =
        """
        SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.name, s.goal,
               to_char(s.starts_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS starts_on, to_char(s.ends_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ends_on, s.state,
               count(w.id) AS item_count,
               count(w.id) FILTER (WHERE w.status = 'done') AS done_count,
               coalesce(sum(w.points), 0) AS points,
               coalesce(sum(w.points) FILTER (WHERE w.status = 'done'), 0) AS done_points
        FROM sprint s
        LEFT JOIN work_item w ON w.sprint_id = s.id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL
        """;

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<SprintRecord>> ListAsync(Guid projectId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<SprintRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + """
                 WHERE s.project_id = @projectId AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
                GROUP BY s.id
                ORDER BY CASE s.state WHEN 'active' THEN 0 WHEN 'planned' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, s.starts_on NULLS LAST, s.created_at
                """,
            new { projectId },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<SprintRecord?> FindAsync(Guid projectId, Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<SprintRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            Select + " WHERE s.project_id = @projectId AND s.id = @id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY s.id",
            new { projectId, id },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<Guid> CreateAsync(Guid projectId, SprintDraft draft, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(draft);
        var id = Guid.CreateVersion7();
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
            """
            INSERT INTO sprint (id, project_id, name, goal, starts_on, ends_on)
            VALUES (@id, @projectId, @Name, @Goal, @starts::date, @ends::date)
            """,
            new { id, projectId, draft.Name, draft.Goal, starts = Text(draft.StartsOn), ends = Text(draft.EndsOn) },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
        return id;
    }

    public async Task<bool> UpdateAsync(Guid projectId, Guid id, SprintDraft draft, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(draft);
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
            """
            UPDATE sprint SET name = @Name, goal = @Goal, starts_on = @starts::date, ends_on = @ends::date
            WHERE id = @id AND project_id = @projectId AND deleted_at IS NULL
            """,
            new { id, projectId, draft.Name, draft.Goal, starts = Text(draft.StartsOn), ends = Text(draft.EndsOn) },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken)) > 0;
    }

    public async Task<SprintChange> StartAsync(Guid projectId, Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
            var changed = await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                UPDATE sprint SET state = 'active', started_at = now(), starts_on = coalesce(starts_on, current_date)
                WHERE id = @id AND project_id = @projectId AND state = 'planned' AND deleted_at IS NULL
                """,
                new { id, projectId },
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            return changed > 0 ? SprintChange.Changed : SprintChange.WrongState;
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (Database.IsUniqueViolation(exception))
        {
            return SprintChange.AnotherIsActive;
        }
    }

    public async Task<SprintChange> CompleteAsync(Guid projectId, Guid id, Guid? moveOpenTo, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        await database.InTransactionAsync(async (connection, transaction) =>
        {
            var changed = await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                UPDATE sprint SET state = 'completed', completed_at = now(), ends_on = coalesce(ends_on, current_date)
                WHERE id = @id AND project_id = @projectId AND state = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
                """,
                new { id, projectId },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            if (changed == 0)
            {
                return SprintChange.WrongState;
            }

            await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                UPDATE work_item SET sprint_id = (
                    SELECT t.id FROM sprint t WHERE t.id = @moveOpenTo AND t.project_id = @projectId AND t.state = 'planned' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL),
                    status = CASE WHEN @moveOpenTo::uuid IS NULL THEN 'backlog' ELSE status END,
                    updated_at = now()
                WHERE sprint_id = @id AND status <> 'done' AND deleted_at IS NULL
                """,
                new { id, projectId, moveOpenTo },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            return SprintChange.Changed;
        }, cancellationToken);

    private static string? Text(DateOnly? date) => date?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
}

public sealed record WorkItemQuery(
    Guid ProjectId,
    Guid? SprintId = null,
    bool BacklogOnly = false,
    bool IncludeDone = true,
    string? Kind = null,
    Guid? AssigneeId = null,
    string? Text = null,
    int Limit = 500);

public sealed class WorkItemStore(Database database)
{
    private const long RankStep = 1024;

    private const string SummarySelect =
        """
        SELECT w.id, w.project_id, p.key AS project_key, w.number, w.kind, w.title, w.status, w.priority, w.points,
               w.assignee_id, a.display_name AS assignee_name,
               s.id AS sprint_id, s.name AS sprint_name,
               pw.number AS parent_number, pw.title AS parent_title,
               w.rank, w.updated_at,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM work_item_comment c WHERE c.work_item_id = w.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS comment_count,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM attachment f WHERE f.work_item_id = w.id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.complete) AS attachment_count
        FROM work_item w
        JOIN project p ON p.id = w.project_id
        LEFT JOIN person a ON a.id = w.assignee_id
        LEFT JOIN sprint s ON s.id = w.sprint_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
        LEFT JOIN work_item pw ON pw.id = w.parent_id AND pw.deleted_at IS NULL
        """;

    private const string DetailSelect =
        """
        SELECT w.id, w.project_id, w.number, w.kind, w.title, w.description, w.status, w.priority, w.points,
               w.assignee_id, a.display_name AS assignee_name,
               w.reporter_id, r.display_name AS reporter_name,
               s.id AS sprint_id, s.name AS sprint_name,
               pw.id AS parent_id, pw.number AS parent_number, pw.title AS parent_title,
               w.created_at, w.updated_at, w.deleted_at
        FROM work_item w
        LEFT JOIN person a ON a.id = w.assignee_id
        LEFT JOIN person r ON r.id = w.reporter_id
        LEFT JOIN sprint s ON s.id = w.sprint_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
        LEFT JOIN work_item pw ON pw.id = w.parent_id AND pw.deleted_at IS NULL
        """;

    public async Task<(Guid Id, int Number)> CreateAsync(Guid projectId, WorkItemFields fields, Guid reporterId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fields);
        var id = Guid.CreateVersion7();
        return await database.InTransactionAsync(async (connection, transaction) =>
        {
            var number = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(new CommandDefinition(
                "UPDATE project SET next_item_number = next_item_number + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = @projectId RETURNING next_item_number - 1",
                new { projectId },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                INSERT INTO work_item (id, project_id, number, kind, title, description, status, priority, points,
                                       assignee_id, reporter_id, sprint_id, parent_id, rank)
                VALUES (@id, @projectId, @number, @Kind, @Title, @Description, @Status, @Priority, @Points,
                        (SELECT person_id FROM project_member WHERE project_id = @projectId AND person_id = @AssigneeId),
                        @reporterId,
                        (SELECT id FROM sprint WHERE id = @SprintId AND project_id = @projectId AND deleted_at IS NULL AND state <> 'completed'),
                        (SELECT id FROM work_item WHERE id = @ParentId AND project_id = @projectId AND kind = 'epic' AND deleted_at IS NULL),
                        (SELECT coalesce(max(rank), 0) + @step FROM work_item WHERE project_id = @projectId))
                """,
                new
                {
                    id,
                    projectId,
                    number,
                    fields.Kind,
                    fields.Title,
                    fields.Description,
                    fields.Status,
                    fields.Priority,
                    fields.Points,
                    fields.AssigneeId,
                    reporterId,
                    fields.SprintId,
                    ParentId = fields.Kind == WorkItemKinds.Epic ? null : fields.ParentId,
                    step = RankStep,
                },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            await RecordAsync(connection, transaction, id, reporterId, "created", null, $"{WorkItemKinds.Label(fields.Kind)} #{number}", cancellationToken);
            return (id, number);
        }, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<WorkItemRecord?> FindAsync(Guid projectId, int number, bool includeDeleted = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<WorkItemRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            DetailSelect + " WHERE w.project_id = @projectId AND w.number = @number AND (@includeDeleted OR w.deleted_at IS NULL)",
            new { projectId, number, includeDeleted },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<WorkItemSummary>> ListAsync(WorkItemQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(query);
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<WorkItemSummary>(new CommandDefinition(
            SummarySelect + """
                 WHERE w.project_id = @ProjectId AND w.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND (@SprintId::uuid IS NULL OR s.id = @SprintId)
                  AND (NOT @BacklogOnly OR s.id IS NULL)
                  AND (@IncludeDone OR w.status <> 'done')
                  AND (@Kind::text IS NULL OR w.kind = @Kind)
                  AND (@AssigneeId::uuid IS NULL OR w.assignee_id = @AssigneeId)
                  AND (@pattern::text IS NULL OR lower(w.title) LIKE @pattern OR w.number::text = @Text)
                ORDER BY w.rank
                LIMIT @Limit
                """,
            new
            {
                query.ProjectId,
                query.SprintId,
                query.BacklogOnly,
                query.IncludeDone,
                query.Kind,
                query.AssigneeId,
                Text = query.Text?.TrimStart('#'),
                pattern = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.Text) ? null : "%" + People.PersonStore.Like(query.Text.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()) + "%",
                query.Limit,
            },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<WorkItemSummary>> AssignedToAsync(Guid personId, int limit, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<WorkItemSummary>(new CommandDefinition(
            SummarySelect + """
                 WHERE w.assignee_id = @personId AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.status <> 'done'
                  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member m WHERE m.project_id = w.project_id AND m.person_id = @personId)
                ORDER BY w.priority, w.updated_at DESC
                LIMIT @limit
                """,
            new { personId, limit },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<WorkItemSummary>> ChildrenAsync(Guid parentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<WorkItemSummary>(new CommandDefinition(
            SummarySelect + " WHERE w.parent_id = @parentId AND w.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY w.rank",
            new { parentId },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<WorkItemSummary>> EpicsAsync(Guid projectId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<WorkItemSummary>(new CommandDefinition(
            SummarySelect + " WHERE w.project_id = @projectId AND w.kind = 'epic' AND w.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY w.rank",
            new { projectId },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<WorkItemEventRecord>> HistoryAsync(Guid itemId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (await connection.QueryAsync<WorkItemEventRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
            """
            SELECT e.occurred_at, p.display_name AS actor_name, e.field, e.old_value, e.new_value
            FROM work_item_event e LEFT JOIN person p ON p.id = e.actor_id
            WHERE e.work_item_id = @itemId
            ORDER BY e.seq
            """,
            new { itemId },
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken))).AsList();
    }

    public async Task<bool> UpdateAsync(Guid projectId, int number, Func<WorkItemFields, WorkItemFields> change, Guid actorId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(change);
        return await database.InTransactionAsync(async (connection, transaction) =>
        {
            var current = await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<WorkItemRecord>(new CommandDefinition(
                DetailSelect + " WHERE w.project_id = @projectId AND w.number = @number AND w.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF w",
                new { projectId, number },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            if (current is null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            var before = current.Fields;
            var requested = change(before);
            var after = await ResolveAsync(connection, transaction, projectId, current.Id, requested, cancellationToken);
            if (after == before)
            {
                return true;
            }

            await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                UPDATE work_item SET kind = @Kind, title = @Title, description = @Description, status = @Status,
                    priority = @Priority, points = @Points, assignee_id = @AssigneeId, sprint_id = @SprintId,
                    parent_id = @ParentId, updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = @id
                """,
                new
                {
                    id = current.Id,
                    after.Kind,
                    after.Title,
                    after.Description,
                    after.Status,
                    after.Priority,
                    after.Points,
                    after.AssigneeId,
                    after.SprintId,
                    after.ParentId,
                },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));

            var labels = await LabelsAsync(connection, transaction, before, after, cancellationToken);
            foreach (var (field, oldValue, newValue) in Diff(before, after, labels))
            {
                await RecordAsync(connection, transaction, current.Id, actorId, field, oldValue, newValue, cancellationToken);
            }

            return true;
        }, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<bool> MoveAsync(Guid projectId, int number, bool up, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        await database.InTransactionAsync(async (connection, transaction) =>
        {
            var current = await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<(Guid Id, long Rank, Guid? SprintId)>(new CommandDefinition(
                """
                SELECT w.id, w.rank, s.id AS sprint_id FROM work_item w
                LEFT JOIN sprint s ON s.id = w.sprint_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
                WHERE w.project_id = @projectId AND w.number = @number AND w.deleted_at IS NULL
                FOR UPDATE OF w
                """,
                new { projectId, number },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            if (current.Id == Guid.Empty)
            {
                return false;
            }

            var neighbour = await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<(Guid Id, long Rank)>(new CommandDefinition(
                up
                    ? """
                      SELECT w.id, w.rank FROM work_item w LEFT JOIN sprint s ON s.id = w.sprint_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
                      WHERE w.project_id = @projectId AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.rank < @rank
                        AND s.id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @sprintId
                      ORDER BY w.rank DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF w
                      """
                    : """
                      SELECT w.id, w.rank FROM work_item w LEFT JOIN sprint s ON s.id = w.sprint_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
                      WHERE w.project_id = @projectId AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.rank > @rank
                        AND s.id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @sprintId
                      ORDER BY w.rank LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF w
                      """,
                new { projectId, rank = current.Rank, sprintId = current.SprintId },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            if (neighbour.Id == Guid.Empty)
            {
                return false;
            }

            await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
                "UPDATE work_item SET rank = CASE WHEN id = @a THEN @rankB ELSE @rankA END WHERE id IN (@a, @b)",
                new { a = current.Id, b = neighbour.Id, rankA = current.Rank, rankB = neighbour.Rank },
                transaction,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            return true;
        }, cancellationToken);

    private static async Task<WorkItemFields> ResolveAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, NpgsqlTransaction transaction, Guid projectId, Guid itemId, WorkItemFields requested, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var resolved = await connection.QuerySingleAsync<(Guid? AssigneeId, Guid? SprintId, Guid? ParentId)>(new CommandDefinition(
            """
            SELECT (SELECT person_id FROM project_member WHERE project_id = @projectId AND person_id = @AssigneeId) AS assignee_id,
                   (SELECT id FROM sprint WHERE id = @SprintId AND project_id = @projectId AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS sprint_id,
                   (SELECT id FROM work_item WHERE id = @ParentId AND id <> @itemId AND project_id = @projectId AND kind = 'epic' AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS parent_id
            """,
            new { projectId, itemId, requested.AssigneeId, requested.SprintId, requested.ParentId },
            transaction,
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
        return requested with
        {
            AssigneeId = resolved.AssigneeId,
            SprintId = resolved.SprintId,
            ParentId = requested.Kind == WorkItemKinds.Epic ? null : resolved.ParentId,
        };
    }

    private static async Task<Labels> LabelsAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, NpgsqlTransaction transaction, WorkItemFields before, WorkItemFields after, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        await connection.QuerySingleAsync<Labels>(new CommandDefinition(
            """
            SELECT (SELECT display_name FROM person WHERE id = @oldAssignee) AS old_assignee,
                   (SELECT display_name FROM person WHERE id = @newAssignee) AS new_assignee,
                   (SELECT name FROM sprint WHERE id = @oldSprint) AS old_sprint,
                   (SELECT name FROM sprint WHERE id = @newSprint) AS new_sprint,
                   (SELECT '#' || number || ' ' || title FROM work_item WHERE id = @oldParent) AS old_parent,
                   (SELECT '#' || number || ' ' || title FROM work_item WHERE id = @newParent) AS new_parent
            """,
            new
            {
                oldAssignee = before.AssigneeId,
                newAssignee = after.AssigneeId,
                oldSprint = before.SprintId,
                newSprint = after.SprintId,
                oldParent = before.ParentId,
                newParent = after.ParentId,
            },
            transaction,
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));

    private static IEnumerable<(string Field, string? Old, string? New)> Diff(WorkItemFields before, WorkItemFields after, Labels labels)
    {
        if (before.Kind != after.Kind)
        {
            yield return ("kind", WorkItemKinds.Label(before.Kind), WorkItemKinds.Label(after.Kind));
        }

        if (before.Title != after.Title)
        {
            yield return ("title", before.Title, after.Title);
        }

        if (before.Description != after.Description)
        {
            yield return ("description", null, null);
        }

        if (before.Status != after.Status)
        {
            yield return ("status", WorkItemStatuses.Label(before.Status), WorkItemStatuses.Label(after.Status));
        }

        if (before.Priority != after.Priority)
        {
            yield return ("priority", Priorities.Label(before.Priority), Priorities.Label(after.Priority));
        }

        if (before.Points != after.Points)
        {
            yield return ("points", before.Points?.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), after.Points?.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        }

        if (before.AssigneeId != after.AssigneeId)
        {
            yield return ("assignee", labels.OldAssignee, labels.NewAssignee);
        }

        if (before.SprintId != after.SprintId)
        {
            yield return ("sprint", labels.OldSprint, labels.NewSprint);
        }

        if (before.ParentId != after.ParentId)
        {
            yield return ("epic", labels.OldParent, labels.NewParent);
        }
    }

    private static Task RecordAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, NpgsqlTransaction transaction, Guid itemId, Guid actorId, string field, string? oldValue, string? newValue, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(
            """
            INSERT INTO work_item_event (id, work_item_id, actor_id, field, old_value, new_value)
            VALUES (@id, @itemId, @actorId, @field, @oldValue, @newValue)
            """,
            new { id = Guid.CreateVersion7(), itemId, actorId, field, oldValue, newValue },
            transaction,
            cancellationToken: cancellationToken));

    private sealed class Labels
    {
        public string? OldAssignee { get; init; }

        public string? NewAssignee { get; init; }

        public string? OldSprint { get; init; }

        public string? NewSprint { get; init; }

        public string? OldParent { get; init; }

        public string? NewParent { get; init; }
    }
}

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Access;

public static class AccessPolicy
{
    public static bool CanView(Actor? actor, string? pageRole) =>
        actor is not null && (actor.IsAdministrator || PageRoles.IsKnown(pageRole));

    public static bool CanEdit(Actor? actor, string? pageRole) => CanView(actor, pageRole);

    public static bool CanSoftDelete(Actor? actor, string? pageRole) =>
        actor is not null && (actor.IsAdministrator || string.Equals(pageRole, PageRoles.Editor, StringComparison.Ordinal));

    public static bool CanRestore(Actor? actor, string? pageRole) => CanSoftDelete(actor, pageRole);

    public static bool CanHardDelete(Actor? actor) => actor is { IsAdministrator: true };

    public static bool CanManageMembers(Actor? actor, string? pageRole) => CanSoftDelete(actor, pageRole);

    public static bool CanAdminister(Actor? actor) => actor is { IsAdministrator: true };

    public static bool CanEditComment(Actor? actor, string? pageRole, Guid authorId) =>
        actor is not null && (actor.PersonId == authorId || CanSoftDelete(actor, pageRole));
}

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Text;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Accounts;

public static partial class AccountRules
{
    public const int MinUserName = 3;
    public const int MaxUserName = 32;
    public const int MaxDisplayName = 80;
    public const int MinPassword = 12;
    public const int MaxPassword = 256;

    public static string NormalizeUserName(string? userName) => (userName ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

    public static string? UserNameProblem(string? userName)
    {
        var normalized = NormalizeUserName(userName);
        if (normalized.Length is < MinUserName or > MaxUserName)
        {
            return $"User names are {MinUserName} to {MaxUserName} characters.";
        }

        return UserNamePattern().IsMatch(normalized)
            ? null
            : "Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.";
    }

    public static string NormalizeDisplayName(string? displayName, string userName)
    {
        var normalized = PlainText.Line(displayName, MaxDisplayName);
        return normalized.Length == 0 ? NormalizeUserName(userName) : normalized;
    }

    public static string? PasswordProblem(string? password, string? userName)
    {
        if (password is null || password.Length < MinPassword)
        {
            return $"Passwords need at least {MinPassword} characters.";
        }

        if (password.Length > MaxPassword)
        {
            return $"Passwords are at most {MaxPassword} characters.";
        }

        if (string.Equals(password.Trim(), NormalizeUserName(userName), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return "The password cannot be the user name.";
        }

        return password.Distinct().Count() < 4 ? "Use a less repetitive password." : null;
    }

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*\z")]
    private static partial Regex UserNamePattern();
}

using System.Text;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Files;

public static class FileRules
{
    public const int MaxFileName = 180;

    public static string SafeFileName(string? name)
    {
        var raw = Path.GetFileName((name ?? string.Empty).Replace('\\', '/'));
        var builder = new StringBuilder(raw.Length);
        foreach (var c in raw)
        {
            if (char.IsControl(c) || c is '/' or '\\' or ':' or '*' or '?' or '"' or '<' or '>' or '|' or ';')
            {
                builder.Append('_');
            }
            else
            {
                builder.Append(c);
            }
        }

        var cleaned = builder.ToString().Trim().Trim('.');
        if (cleaned.Length == 0)
        {
            cleaned = "file";
        }

        if (cleaned.Length <= MaxFileName)
        {
            return cleaned;
        }

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(cleaned);
        if (extension.Length > 16)
        {
            extension = string.Empty;
        }

        return cleaned[..(MaxFileName - extension.Length)] + extension;
    }

    public static string? SniffImage(ReadOnlySpan<byte> head)
    {
        if (head.Length >= 8 && head[..8].SequenceEqual(new byte[] { 0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A }))
        {
            return "image/png";
        }

        if (head.Length >= 3 && head[0] == 0xFF && head[1] == 0xD8 && head[2] == 0xFF)
        {
            return "image/jpeg";
        }

        if (head.Length >= 6 && (head[..6].SequenceEqual("GIF87a"u8) || head[..6].SequenceEqual("GIF89a"u8)))
        {
            return "image/gif";
        }

        if (head.Length >= 12 && head[..4].SequenceEqual("RIFF"u8) && head[8..12].SequenceEqual("WEBP"u8))
        {
            return "image/webp";
        }

        return null;
    }

    public static string Size(long bytes) => bytes switch
    {
        < 1024 => $"{bytes} B",
        < 1024 * 1024 => $"{bytes / 1024.0:0.#} KB",
        < 1024L * 1024 * 1024 => $"{bytes / (1024.0 * 1024):0.#} MB",
        _ => $"{bytes / (1024.0 * 1024 * 1024):0.##} GB",
    };
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Security;

public enum PasswordCheck
{
    Failed,
    Succeeded,
    SucceededNeedsRehash,
}

public sealed class PasswordHasher(int iterations = PasswordHasher.DefaultIterations)
{
    public const int DefaultIterations = 210_000;
    public const int MinimumIterations = 100_000;
    private const string Algorithm = "pbkdf2-sha512";
    private const int SaltBytes = 16;
    private const int HashBytes = 64;

    public int Iterations { get; } = iterations >= MinimumIterations
        ? iterations
        : throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(iterations), iterations, "Too few iterations.");

    public string Hash(string password)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(password);
        var salt = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(SaltBytes);
        var hash = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, Iterations, HashAlgorithmName.SHA512, HashBytes);
        return string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"{Algorithm}${Iterations}${Convert.ToBase64String(salt)}${Convert.ToBase64String(hash)}");
    }

    public PasswordCheck Verify(string? stored, string? password)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(stored) || password is null)
        {
            return PasswordCheck.Failed;
        }

        var parts = stored.Split('$');
        if (parts.Length != 4
            || !string.Equals(parts[0], Algorithm, StringComparison.Ordinal)
            || !int.TryParse(parts[1], NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var rounds)
            || rounds < MinimumIterations)
        {
            return PasswordCheck.Failed;
        }

        byte[] salt;
        byte[] expected;
        try
        {
            salt = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[2]);
            expected = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[3]);
        }
        catch (FormatException)
        {
            return PasswordCheck.Failed;
        }

        if (expected.Length != HashBytes)
        {
            return PasswordCheck.Failed;
        }

        var actual = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, rounds, HashAlgorithmName.SHA512, HashBytes);
        if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(actual, expected))
        {
            return PasswordCheck.Failed;
        }

        return rounds < Iterations ? PasswordCheck.SucceededNeedsRehash : PasswordCheck.Succeeded;
    }
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Security;

public sealed class SetupCode
{
    private const string Alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
    private readonly byte[] _digest;

    private SetupCode(string value)
    {
        Value = value;
        _digest = SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value));
    }

    public string Value { get; }

    public static SetupCode Create(int groups = 4, int groupLength = 4)
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder();
        for (var g = 0; g < groups; g++)
        {
            if (g > 0)
            {
                builder.Append('-');
            }

            for (var k = 0; k < groupLength; k++)
            {
                builder.Append(Alphabet[RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32(Alphabet.Length)]);
            }
        }

        return new SetupCode(builder.ToString());
    }

    public bool Matches(string? candidate)
    {
        var normalized = new string((candidate ?? string.Empty).Where(c => !char.IsWhiteSpace(c)).ToArray()).ToUpperInvariant();
        var digest = SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(normalized));
        return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(digest, _digest);
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Text;

public static class PlainText
{
    public static string Line(string? value, int maxLength)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var builder = new StringBuilder(value.Length);
        var space = false;
        foreach (var rune in value.EnumerateRunes())
        {
            if (Rune.IsWhiteSpace(rune) || Rune.IsControl(rune))
            {
                space = builder.Length > 0;
                continue;
            }

            if (space)
            {
                builder.Append(' ');
                space = false;
            }

            builder.Append(rune.ToString());
        }

        return Cut(builder.ToString(), maxLength);
    }

    public static string Block(string? value, int maxLength)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var builder = new StringBuilder(value.Length);
        foreach (var rune in value.Replace("\r\n", "\n", StringComparison.Ordinal).Replace('\r', '\n').EnumerateRunes())
        {
            if (rune.Value is '\n' or '\t')
            {
                builder.Append((char)rune.Value);
            }
            else if (!Rune.IsControl(rune))
            {
                builder.Append(rune.ToString());
            }
        }

        var lines = builder.ToString().Split('\n').Select(line => line.TrimEnd());
        var joined = string.Join('\n', lines).Trim('\n');
        while (joined.Contains("\n\n\n\n", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            joined = joined.Replace("\n\n\n\n", "\n\n\n", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }

        return Cut(joined, maxLength);
    }

    public static string Cut(string value, int maxLength)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(value);
        if (value.Length <= maxLength)
        {
            return value;
        }

        var cut = 0;
        var enumerator = StringInfo.GetTextElementEnumerator(value);
        while (enumerator.MoveNext())
        {
            var end = enumerator.ElementIndex + enumerator.GetTextElement().Length;
            if (end > maxLength)
            {
                break;
            }

            cut = end;
        }

        return value[..cut].TrimEnd();
    }
}
