using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Text;

public static partial class RichText
{
    public const int MaxLength = 100_000;
    private const int MaxQuoteDepth = 4;

    public static string ToHtml(string? markdown, Func<int, string?>? itemLink = null)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(markdown))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var text = PlainText.Block(markdown, MaxLength);
        var builder = new StringBuilder(text.Length * 2);
        RenderBlocks(text.Split('\n'), builder, itemLink, 0);
        return builder.ToString();
    }

    public static string Escape(string value)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(value);
        var builder = new StringBuilder(value.Length);
        foreach (var c in value)
        {
            AppendEscaped(builder, c);
        }

        return builder.ToString();
    }

    public static bool IsSafeLink(string url) =>
        IsLocalPath(url)
        || (Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri)
            && (uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps || uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp || uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeMailto));

    public static bool IsLocalPath(string url) =>
        url.Length > 1
        && url[0] == '/'
        && url[1] != '/'
        && !url.Contains('\\', StringComparison.Ordinal)
        && !url.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace)
        && !url.Any(char.IsControl);

    private static void RenderBlocks(IReadOnlyList<string> lines, StringBuilder html, Func<int, string?>? itemLink, int depth)
    {
        var i = 0;
        while (i < lines.Count)
        {
            var line = lines[i];
            if (line.Trim().Length == 0)
            {
                i++;
                continue;
            }

            var trimmed = line.TrimStart();
            if (trimmed.StartsWith("```", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                i = RenderFence(lines, i, html);
                continue;
            }

            var heading = HeadingPattern().Match(line);
            if (heading.Success)
            {
                var level = Math.Min(heading.Groups[1].Length + 2, 6);
                html.Append("<h").Append(level).Append('>');
                RenderInline(heading.Groups[2].Value.Trim().TrimEnd('#').TrimEnd(), html, itemLink, true);
                html.Append("</h").Append(level).Append(">\n");
                i++;
                continue;
            }

            if (RulePattern().IsMatch(line))
            {
                html.Append("<hr>\n");
                i++;
                continue;
            }

            if (trimmed.StartsWith('>'))
            {
                var quoted = new List<string>();
                while (i < lines.Count && lines[i].TrimStart().StartsWith('>'))
                {
                    var content = lines[i].TrimStart()[1..];
                    quoted.Add(content.StartsWith(' ') ? content[1..] : content);
                    i++;
                }

                html.Append("<blockquote>\n");
                if (depth < MaxQuoteDepth)
                {
                    RenderBlocks(quoted, html, itemLink, depth + 1);
                }
                else
                {
                    RenderParagraph(quoted, html, itemLink);
                }

                html.Append("</blockquote>\n");
                continue;
            }

            if (BulletPattern().IsMatch(line) || OrderedPattern().IsMatch(line))
            {
                i = RenderList(lines, i, html, itemLink);
                continue;
            }

            var paragraph = new List<string>();
            while (i < lines.Count && lines[i].Trim().Length > 0 && !StartsBlock(lines[i]))
            {
                paragraph.Add(lines[i]);
                i++;
            }

            if (paragraph.Count == 0)
            {
                paragraph.Add(lines[i]);
                i++;
            }

            RenderParagraph(paragraph, html, itemLink);
        }
    }

    private static bool StartsBlock(string line)
    {
        var trimmed = line.TrimStart();
        return trimmed.StartsWith("```", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            || trimmed.StartsWith('>')
            || HeadingPattern().IsMatch(line)
            || RulePattern().IsMatch(line)
            || BulletPattern().IsMatch(line)
            || OrderedPattern().IsMatch(line);
    }

    private static int RenderFence(IReadOnlyList<string> lines, int start, StringBuilder html)
    {
        var opening = lines[start].TrimStart();
        var language = new string(opening[3..].Trim().TakeWhile(c => char.IsAsciiLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '-' or '+').Take(24).ToArray()).ToLowerInvariant();
        var i = start + 1;
        var code = new List<string>();
        while (i < lines.Count && !lines[i].TrimStart().StartsWith("```", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            code.Add(lines[i]);
            i++;
        }

        html.Append("<pre><code");
        if (language.Length > 0)
        {
            html.Append(" class=\"language-").Append(language).Append('"');
        }

        html.Append('>').Append(Escape(string.Join('\n', code))).Append("</code></pre>\n");
        return Math.Min(i + 1, lines.Count);
    }

    private static int RenderList(IReadOnlyList<string> lines, int start, StringBuilder html, Func<int, string?>? itemLink)
    {
        var ordered = OrderedPattern().IsMatch(lines[start]);
        var items = new List<List<string>>();
        var i = start;
        while (i < lines.Count)
        {
            var line = lines[i];
            var match = ordered ? OrderedPattern().Match(line) : BulletPattern().Match(line);
            if (match.Success)
            {
                items.Add([match.Groups[1].Value]);
                i++;
                continue;
            }

            if (items.Count > 0 && line.Length > 0 && char.IsWhiteSpace(line[0]) && line.Trim().Length > 0
                && !BulletPattern().IsMatch(line) && !OrderedPattern().IsMatch(line))
            {
                items[^1].Add(line.Trim());
                i++;
                continue;
            }

            break;
        }

        var tag = ordered ? "ol" : "ul";
        html.Append('<').Append(tag).Append(">\n");
        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            html.Append("<li>");
            var first = item[0];
            var task = TaskPattern().Match(first);
            if (task.Success)
            {
                var done = task.Groups[1].Value is "x" or "X";
                html.Append(done ? "<input type=\"checkbox\" disabled checked> " : "<input type=\"checkbox\" disabled> ");
                item[0] = first[task.Length..];
            }

            for (var k = 0; k < item.Count; k++)
            {
                if (k > 0)
                {
                    html.Append("<br>");
                }

                RenderInline(item[k], html, itemLink, true);
            }

            html.Append("</li>\n");
        }

        html.Append("</").Append(tag).Append(">\n");
        return i;
    }

    private static void RenderParagraph(IReadOnlyList<string> lines, StringBuilder html, Func<int, string?>? itemLink)
    {
        html.Append("<p>");
        for (var k = 0; k < lines.Count; k++)
        {
            if (k > 0)
            {
                html.Append("<br>\n");
            }

            RenderInline(lines[k].Trim(), html, itemLink, true);
        }

        html.Append("</p>\n");
    }

    private static void RenderInline(string text, StringBuilder html, Func<int, string?>? itemLink, bool allowLinks)
    {
        var i = 0;
        while (i < text.Length)
        {
            var c = text[i];
            if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < text.Length && char.IsAsciiLetterOrDigit(text[i + 1]) is false && !char.IsWhiteSpace(text[i + 1]))
            {
                AppendEscaped(html, text[i + 1]);
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }

            if (c == '`' && TryCode(text, i, html, out var afterCode))
            {
                i = afterCode;
                continue;
            }

            if (allowLinks && c == '!' && i + 1 < text.Length && text[i + 1] == '[' && TryLink(text, i + 1, out var alt, out var source, out var afterImage))
            {
                if (IsLocalPath(source))
                {
                    html.Append("<img src=\"").Append(Escape(source)).Append("\" alt=\"").Append(Escape(alt)).Append("\" loading=\"lazy\">");
                }
                else
                {
                    AppendLink(html, source, alt, itemLink);
                }

                i = afterImage;
                continue;
            }

            if (allowLinks && c == '[' && TryLink(text, i, out var label, out var target, out var afterLink))
            {
                AppendLink(html, target, label, itemLink);
                i = afterLink;
                continue;
            }

            if (c is '*' or '_' or '~' && TryEmphasis(text, i, html, itemLink, allowLinks, out var afterEmphasis))
            {
                i = afterEmphasis;
                continue;
            }

            if (allowLinks && c is 'h' or 'H' && IsWordStart(text, i) && TryAutoLink(text, i, html, out var afterAuto))
            {
                i = afterAuto;
                continue;
            }

            if (allowLinks && c == '#' && itemLink is not null && IsWordStart(text, i) && TryItemLink(text, i, html, itemLink, out var afterItem))
            {
                i = afterItem;
                continue;
            }

            AppendEscaped(html, c);
            i++;
        }
    }

    private static bool IsWordStart(string text, int index) =>
        index == 0 || char.IsWhiteSpace(text[index - 1]) || text[index - 1] is '(' or '[';

    private static bool TryCode(string text, int start, StringBuilder html, out int after)
    {
        var run = 0;
        while (start + run < text.Length && text[start + run] == '`')
        {
            run++;
        }

        var fence = new string('`', run);
        var close = text.IndexOf(fence, start + run, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        if (close < 0 || close == start + run)
        {
            after = start;
            return false;
        }

        html.Append("<code>").Append(Escape(text[(start + run)..close].Trim())).Append("</code>");
        after = close + run;
        return true;
    }

    private static bool TryLink(string text, int open, out string label, out string url, out int after)
    {
        label = string.Empty;
        url = string.Empty;
        after = open;
        var depth = 0;
        var close = -1;
        for (var k = open; k < text.Length; k++)
        {
            if (text[k] == '[')
            {
                depth++;
            }
            else if (text[k] == ']')
            {
                depth--;
                if (depth == 0)
                {
                    close = k;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (close < 0 || close + 1 >= text.Length || text[close + 1] != '(')
        {
            return false;
        }

        var end = text.IndexOf(')', close + 2);
        if (end < 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var inside = text[(close + 2)..end].Trim();
        var space = inside.IndexOf(' ', StringComparison.Ordinal);
        url = space < 0 ? inside : inside[..space];
        if (url.Length == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        label = text[(open + 1)..close];
        after = end + 1;
        return true;
    }

    private static void AppendLink(StringBuilder html, string url, string label, Func<int, string?>? itemLink)
    {
        if (!IsSafeLink(url))
        {
            RenderInline(label, html, itemLink, false);
            return;
        }

        html.Append("<a href=\"").Append(Escape(url)).Append('"');
        if (!IsLocalPath(url))
        {
            html.Append(" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" target=\"_blank\"");
        }

        html.Append('>');
        RenderInline(label.Length == 0 ? url : label, html, itemLink, false);
        html.Append("</a>");
    }

    private static bool TryEmphasis(string text, int start, StringBuilder html, Func<int, string?>? itemLink, bool allowLinks, out int after)
    {
        after = start;
        var c = text[start];
        var doubled = start + 1 < text.Length && text[start + 1] == c;
        if (c == '~' && !doubled)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (c == '_' && start > 0 && char.IsLetterOrDigit(text[start - 1]))
        {
            return false;
        }

        var marker = doubled ? new string(c, 2) : c.ToString();
        var contentStart = start + marker.Length;
        if (contentStart >= text.Length || char.IsWhiteSpace(text[contentStart]))
        {
            return false;
        }

        var close = contentStart;
        while (true)
        {
            close = text.IndexOf(marker, close + 1, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (close < 0)
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (char.IsWhiteSpace(text[close - 1]))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (!doubled && close + 1 < text.Length && text[close + 1] == c)
            {
                close++;
                continue;
            }

            if (c == '_' && close + marker.Length < text.Length && char.IsLetterOrDigit(text[close + marker.Length]))
            {
                continue;
            }

            break;
        }

        var tag = c == '~' ? "del" : doubled ? "strong" : "em";
        html.Append('<').Append(tag).Append('>');
        RenderInline(text[contentStart..close], html, itemLink, allowLinks);
        html.Append("</").Append(tag).Append('>');
        after = close + marker.Length;
        return true;
    }

    private static bool TryAutoLink(string text, int start, StringBuilder html, out int after)
    {
        after = start;
        var rest = text.AsSpan(start);
        if (!rest.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && !rest.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return false;
        }

        var end = start;
        while (end < text.Length && !char.IsWhiteSpace(text[end]) && text[end] is not '<' and not '>' and not '"')
        {
            end++;
        }

        while (end > start && text[end - 1] is '.' or ',' or ';' or ':' or '!' or '?' or ')' or ']' or '\'')
        {
            end--;
        }

        var url = text[start..end];
        if (!Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri.Host))
        {
            return false;
        }

        html.Append("<a href=\"").Append(Escape(url)).Append("\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" target=\"_blank\">")
            .Append(Escape(url)).Append("</a>");
        after = end;
        return true;
    }

    private static bool TryItemLink(string text, int start, StringBuilder html, Func<int, string?> itemLink, out int after)
    {
        after = start;
        var end = start + 1;
        while (end < text.Length && char.IsAsciiDigit(text[end]) && end - start <= 9)
        {
            end++;
        }

        if (end == start + 1 || (end < text.Length && char.IsLetterOrDigit(text[end])))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!int.TryParse(text.AsSpan(start + 1, end - start - 1), out var number) || number <= 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var href = itemLink(number);
        if (href is null || !IsLocalPath(href))
        {
            return false;
        }

        html.Append("<a href=\"").Append(Escape(href)).Append("\">#").Append(number).Append("</a>");
        after = end;
        return true;
    }

    private static void AppendEscaped(StringBuilder builder, char c)
    {
        switch (c)
        {
            case '&':
                builder.Append("&amp;");
                break;
            case '<':
                builder.Append("&lt;");
                break;
            case '>':
                builder.Append("&gt;");
                break;
            case '"':
                builder.Append("&quot;");
                break;
            case '\'':
                builder.Append("&#39;");
                break;
            default:
                builder.Append(c);
                break;
        }
    }

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$")]
    private static partial Regex HeadingPattern();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^\s{0,3}([-*_])(\s*\1){2,}\s*$")]
    private static partial Regex RulePattern();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^\s{0,3}[-*+]\s+(.*)$")]
    private static partial Regex BulletPattern();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^\s{0,3}\d{1,9}[.)]\s+(.*)$")]
    private static partial Regex OrderedPattern();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^\[([ xX])\]\s+")]
    private static partial Regex TaskPattern();
}

    public const int MaxProjectName = 80;

    public static string? PointsProblem(int? points) =>

    public static string? SprintDatesProblem(DateOnly? starts, DateOnly? ends) =>
        starts is { } s && ends is { } e && e < s ? "A sprint cannot end before it starts." : null;

    public static string Description(string? text) => PlainText.Block(text, RichText.MaxLength);

    public static string Comment(string? text) => PlainText.Block(text, MaxComment);

using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Nest;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Trash;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Access;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Nest;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Administration;

internal sealed class TrashService(Deletions deletions, NestEntryStore nestEntries, NestService nest)
{
    public Task<IReadOnlyList<TrashRecord>> ListAsync(Guid? projectId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
        deletions.ListAsync(projectId, 500, cancellationToken);

    public async Task<bool> SoftDeleteAsync(Actor actor, Subject subject, Guid id, string summary, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(actor);
        var changed = await deletions.SoftDeleteAsync(subject, id, actor.PersonId, Audits.For(actor, "soft-delete", subject, id, summary), cancellationToken);
        if (changed && subject == Subject.NestEntry)
        {
            nest.Remove(id);
        }

        return changed;
    }

    public async Task<bool> RestoreAsync(Actor actor, Subject subject, Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(actor);
        var record = await deletions.FindAsync(subject, id, cancellationToken);
        if (record is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var changed = await deletions.RestoreAsync(subject, id, Audits.For(actor, "restore", subject, id, record.Title), cancellationToken);
        if (changed && subject == Subject.NestEntry
            && await nestEntries.FindAsync(id, cancellationToken) is { } stored
            && NestStorage.ToEntry(stored) is { } entry)
        {
            nest.Restore(entry);
        }

        return changed;
    }

    public async Task<bool> HardDeleteAsync(Actor actor, Subject subject, Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(actor);
        if (!AccessPolicy.CanHardDelete(actor))
        {
            return false;
        }

        var record = await deletions.FindAsync(subject, id, cancellationToken);
        return record is not null
            && await deletions.HardDeleteAsync(subject, id, Audits.For(actor, "hard-delete", subject, id, record.Title), cancellationToken);
    }
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Drawing;

internal sealed class CanvasService
{
    public const int MaxCoordinate = 4095;
    public const int MaxBatchPoints = 256;
    public const int MaxStrokePoints = 2048;
    public const int MaxOfferedStrokes = 500;

    public static readonly TimeSpan ResetCooldown = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);

    private readonly TimeProvider _time;
    private readonly int _maxPoints;
    private readonly double _pointBurst;
    private readonly double _pointsPerSecond;
    private readonly KeyedTokenBuckets _resets;
    private readonly Lock _gate = new();
    private readonly LinkedList<Stroke> _strokes = new();
    private readonly HashSet<Guid> _ids = [];
    private readonly HashSet<ICanvasSubscriber> _subscribers = [];
    private int _epoch = 1;
    private int _points;
    private long? _lastReset;
    private Guid _resetId;
    private Guid _lastId;

    public CanvasService(TimeProvider time, IOptions<ChaosOptions> options)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(time);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        var limits = options.Value;
        _time = time;
        _maxPoints = limits.CanvasMaxPoints;
        _pointBurst = limits.StrokePointBurst;
        _pointsPerSecond = limits.StrokePointsPerSecond;
        _resets = new KeyedTokenBuckets(limits.ResetBurst, limits.ResetsPerSecond, time);
        StartedAt = time.GetUtcNow();
    }

    public DateTimeOffset StartedAt { get; }

    public int MaxPoints => _maxPoints;

    public int Epoch
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _epoch;
            }
        }
    }

    public Guid ResetId
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _resetId;
            }
        }
    }

    public int PointCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _points;
            }
        }
    }

    public int StrokeCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _strokes.Count;
            }
        }
    }

    public CanvasSession OpenSession(ICanvasSubscriber subscriber) =>
        new(subscriber, new TokenBucket(_pointBurst, _pointsPerSecond, _time));

    public DrawResult Draw(CanvasSession session, int epoch, int clientStroke, int[] points, bool end)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(session);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(points);

        if (points.Length % 2 != 0 || points.Length > MaxBatchPoints * 2 || (points.Length == 0 && !end) || !InRange(points))
        {
            return DrawResult.Invalid;
        }

        var count = points.Length / 2;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (epoch != _epoch)
            {
                return DrawResult.Stale;
            }

            var stroke = session.Open is { } open && open.Epoch == _epoch && open.ClientId == clientStroke ? open : null;
            if (stroke is null)
            {
                if (clientStroke <= session.LastClientId || count == 0)
                {
                    return DrawResult.Invalid;
                }
            }
            else if (stroke.Count + count > MaxStrokePoints)
            {
                FinishOpen(session);
                return DrawResult.TooLong;
            }

            if (!session.Bucket.TryTake(count))
            {
                return DrawResult.TooFast;
            }

            if (!MakeRoom(count))
            {
                return DrawResult.Full;
            }

            if (stroke is null)
            {
                FinishOpen(session);
                stroke = new Stroke(Mint(), _epoch, clientStroke);
                _strokes.AddLast(stroke);
                _ids.Add(stroke.Id);
                session.Open = stroke;
                session.LastClientId = clientStroke;
                session.LastStroke = stroke.Id;
            }

            var offset = stroke.Count;
            stroke.Append(points);
            _points += count;
            if (end)
            {
                stroke.Done = true;
                session.Open = null;
            }

            Broadcast(CanvasUpdate.ForStroke(_epoch, stroke.Id, offset, points, end), session.Subscriber);
            return DrawResult.Accepted;
        }
    }

    public ResetResult Reset(string client)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            var now = _time.GetTimestamp();
            if (_lastReset is { } last && _time.GetElapsedTime(last, now) < ResetCooldown)
            {
                return ResetResult.TooFast;
            }

            if (!_resets.TryTake(client))
            {
                return ResetResult.TooFast;
            }

            _lastReset = now;
            _epoch++;
            _resetId = Mint();
            _strokes.Clear();
            _ids.Clear();
            _points = 0;
            Broadcast(CanvasUpdate.ForReset(_epoch, _resetId), null);
            return ResetResult.Accepted;
        }
    }

    public bool OfferReset(Guid reset)
    {
        if (!MessageWindow.IsRestorable(reset, _time.GetUtcNow(), StartedAt))
        {
            return false;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (reset.CompareTo(_resetId) <= 0)
            {
                return false;
            }

            _resetId = reset;
            if (reset.CompareTo(_lastId) > 0)
            {
                _lastId = reset;
            }

            var node = _strokes.First;
            while (node is not null)
            {
                var next = node.Next;
                if (node.Value.Id.CompareTo(reset) <= 0)
                {
                    _points -= node.Value.Count;
                    _ids.Remove(node.Value.Id);
                    _strokes.Remove(node);
                }
                else
                {
                    node.Value.Done = true;
                }

                node = next;
            }

            _epoch++;
            Broadcast(Snapshot(), null);
            return true;
        }
    }

    public int OfferStrokes(IEnumerable<StrokeOffer> offered)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(offered);
        var now = _time.GetUtcNow();
        var valid = offered
            .Take(MaxOfferedStrokes)
            .Where(offer => offer is not null && IsRestorable(offer, now))
            .DistinctBy(offer => offer.Id)
            .OrderByDescending(offer => offer.Id)
            .ToList();
        if (valid.Count == 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            var added = new List<StrokeSnapshot>();
            foreach (var offer in valid)
            {
                var count = offer.Points.Count / 2;
                if (offer.Id.CompareTo(_resetId) <= 0 || _ids.Contains(offer.Id) || _points + count > _maxPoints)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var stroke = new Stroke(offer.Id, _epoch, 0) { Done = true };
                stroke.Append(offer.Points);
                Insert(stroke);
                _points += count;
                if (offer.Id.CompareTo(_lastId) > 0)
                {
                    _lastId = offer.Id;
                }

                added.Add(new StrokeSnapshot(stroke.Id, stroke.ToArray(), true));
            }

            if (added.Count > 0)
            {
                Broadcast(CanvasUpdate.ForMerge(_epoch, added), null);
            }

            return added.Count;
        }
    }

    public void Abandon(CanvasSession session)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(session);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            FinishOpen(session);
        }
    }

    public void Subscribe(ICanvasSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(subscriber);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (subscriber.Deliver(Snapshot()))
            {
                _subscribers.Add(subscriber);
            }
        }
    }

    public void Unsubscribe(ICanvasSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _subscribers.Remove(subscriber);
        }
    }

    public bool IsSubscribed(ICanvasSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _subscribers.Contains(subscriber);
        }
    }

    private static bool InRange(IReadOnlyList<int> points)
    {
        foreach (var value in points)
        {
            if ((uint)value > MaxCoordinate)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private bool IsRestorable(StrokeOffer offer, DateTimeOffset now) =>
        offer.Points is { Count: > 0 } points
        && points.Count % 2 == 0
        && points.Count <= MaxStrokePoints * 2
        && InRange(points)
        && MessageWindow.IsRestorable(offer.Id, now, StartedAt);

    private CanvasUpdate Snapshot() =>
        CanvasUpdate.ForSnapshot(
            _epoch,
            [.. _strokes.Select(stroke => new StrokeSnapshot(stroke.Id, stroke.ToArray(), stroke.Done))],
            _resetId == Guid.Empty ? null : _resetId,
            StartedAt.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
            Math.Max(0, _maxPoints - _points));

    private Guid Mint()
    {
        _lastId = Uuid7.After(_lastId, _time.GetUtcNow());
        return _lastId;
    }

    private void Insert(Stroke stroke)
    {
        var node = _strokes.First;
        while (node is not null && node.Value.Id.CompareTo(stroke.Id) < 0)
        {
            node = node.Next;
        }

        if (node is null)
        {
            _strokes.AddLast(stroke);
        }
        else
        {
            _strokes.AddBefore(node, stroke);
        }

        _ids.Add(stroke.Id);
    }

    private void FinishOpen(CanvasSession session)
    {
        if (session.Open is { } open && open.Epoch == _epoch && !open.Done)
        {
            open.Done = true;
            Broadcast(CanvasUpdate.ForStroke(_epoch, open.Id, open.Count, [], true), session.Subscriber);
        }

        session.Open = null;
    }

    private bool MakeRoom(int count)
    {
        var node = _strokes.First;
        while (_points + count > _maxPoints && node is not null)
        {
            var next = node.Next;
            if (node.Value.Done)
            {
                _points -= node.Value.Count;
                _ids.Remove(node.Value.Id);
                _strokes.Remove(node);
            }

            node = next;
        }

        return _points + count <= _maxPoints;
    }

    private void Broadcast(CanvasUpdate update, ICanvasSubscriber? except)
    {
        List<ICanvasSubscriber>? dropped = null;
        foreach (var subscriber in _subscribers)
        {
            if (!ReferenceEquals(subscriber, except) && !subscriber.Deliver(update))
            {
                (dropped ??= []).Add(subscriber);
            }
        }

        if (dropped is not null)
        {
            _subscribers.ExceptWith(dropped);
        }
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Latency;

internal sealed class HttpLatencyProbe : ILatencyProbe, IDisposable
{
    public const int Samples = 3;
    public const int Parallelism = 6;
    public const string UserAgent = "chaos-velixir-run/1.0 (+https://github.com/kusl/chaos-velixir-run)";

    private static readonly TimeSpan RequestTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(4);

    private readonly SocketsHttpHandler _handler;
    private readonly HttpClient _client;

    public HttpLatencyProbe()
    {
        _handler = new SocketsHttpHandler
        {
            AllowAutoRedirect = true,
            MaxAutomaticRedirections = 3,
            AutomaticDecompression = DecompressionMethods.None,
            UseCookies = false,
            ConnectTimeout = RequestTimeout,
            PooledConnectionLifetime = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),
            PooledConnectionIdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20),
            MaxConnectionsPerServer = 2,
        };
        _client = new HttpClient(_handler, disposeHandler: false)
        {
            Timeout = Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan,
            DefaultRequestVersion = HttpVersion.Version20,
            DefaultVersionPolicy = HttpVersionPolicy.RequestVersionOrLower,
        };
        _client.DefaultRequestHeaders.UserAgent.ParseAdd(UserAgent);
    }

    public async Task<int?[]> MeasureAsync(IReadOnlyList<LatencyEndpoint> endpoints, TimeSpan budget, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(endpoints);
        var results = new int?[endpoints.Count];
        var targets = new List<(int Index, Uri Uri)>();
        for (var i = 0; i < endpoints.Count; i++)
        {
            if (endpoints[i].FromServer && endpoints[i].Remote is { } uri)
            {
                targets.Add((i, uri));
            }
        }

        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        deadline.CancelAfter(budget);
        var options = new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = Parallelism, CancellationToken = deadline.Token };
        try
        {
            await Parallel.ForEachAsync(targets, options, async (target, token) =>
            {
                results[target.Index] = await MeasureOneAsync(target.Uri, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (deadline.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
        }

        return results;
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _client.Dispose();
        _handler.Dispose();
    }

    private async Task<int?> MeasureOneAsync(Uri uri, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (await TimeAsync(uri, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false) is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        int? best = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < Samples; i++)
        {
            if (await TimeAsync(uri, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false) is not { } elapsed)
            {
                break;
            }

            best = best is { } current ? Math.Min(current, elapsed) : elapsed;
        }

        return best;
    }

    private async Task<int?> TimeAsync(Uri uri, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        using var timeout = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        timeout.CancelAfter(RequestTimeout);
        try
        {
            using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, uri);
            request.Headers.CacheControl = new CacheControlHeaderValue { NoCache = true, NoStore = true };
            var start = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
            using var response = await _client.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, timeout.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var elapsed = Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(start);
            await response.Content.CopyToAsync(Stream.Null, timeout.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return (int)Math.Round(elapsed.TotalMilliseconds, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is HttpRequestException or OperationCanceledException or IOException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Latency;

internal enum LatencySide
{
    Browser,
    Server,
}

internal sealed record LatencyBoards(
    IReadOnlyList<Guid> FastJackpots,
    IReadOnlyList<Guid> SlowJackpots,
    IReadOnlyList<Guid> BrowserFastest,
    IReadOnlyList<Guid> BrowserSlowest,
    IReadOnlyList<Guid> ServerFastest,
    IReadOnlyList<Guid> ServerSlowest,
    IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> Runs);

internal sealed class LatencyLeaders
{
    public const int FastBelow = 10;
    public const int SlowFrom = 100;

    private LatencyLeaders(
        BoardMessage[] fastJackpots,
        BoardMessage[] slowJackpots,
        BoardMessage[] browserFastest,
        BoardMessage[] browserSlowest,
        BoardMessage[] serverFastest,
        BoardMessage[] serverSlowest)
    {
        FastJackpots = fastJackpots;
        SlowJackpots = slowJackpots;
        BrowserFastest = browserFastest;
        BrowserSlowest = browserSlowest;
        ServerFastest = serverFastest;
        ServerSlowest = serverSlowest;
    }

    public static LatencyLeaders Empty { get; } = new([], [], [], [], [], []);

    public BoardMessage[] FastJackpots { get; }

    public BoardMessage[] SlowJackpots { get; }

    public BoardMessage[] BrowserFastest { get; }

    public BoardMessage[] BrowserSlowest { get; }

    public BoardMessage[] ServerFastest { get; }

    public BoardMessage[] ServerSlowest { get; }

    private IEnumerable<BoardMessage[]> Lists => [FastJackpots, SlowJackpots, BrowserFastest, BrowserSlowest, ServerFastest, ServerSlowest];

    public static int? Of(LatencyRank rank, LatencySide side) => side == LatencySide.Browser ? rank.Browser : rank.Server;

    public static bool IsFast(int? median) => median < FastBelow;

    public static bool IsSlow(int? median) => median >= SlowFrom;

    public static bool IsFastJackpot(LatencyRank rank) => IsFast(rank.Browser) || IsFast(rank.Server);

    public static bool IsSlowJackpot(LatencyRank rank) => IsSlow(rank.Browser) || IsSlow(rank.Server);

    public LatencyLeaders? Merge(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> candidates, int rankCapacity, int jackpotCapacity)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(candidates);
        var scored = candidates.Select(Score).ToList();
        var next = new LatencyLeaders(
            Window(FastJackpots, scored.Where(entry => IsFastJackpot(entry.Rank)), jackpotCapacity),
            Window(SlowJackpots, scored.Where(entry => IsSlowJackpot(entry.Rank)), jackpotCapacity),
            Order(BrowserFastest, scored, LatencySide.Browser, fastest: true, rankCapacity),
            Order(BrowserSlowest, scored, LatencySide.Browser, fastest: false, rankCapacity),
            Order(ServerFastest, scored, LatencySide.Server, fastest: true, rankCapacity),
            Order(ServerSlowest, scored, LatencySide.Server, fastest: false, rankCapacity));
        return next.Lists.Zip(Lists).All(pair => pair.First.Select(run => run.Id).SequenceEqual(pair.Second.Select(run => run.Id))) ? null : next;
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<Guid> Entered(LatencyLeaders previous)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(previous);
        return [.. Lists.Zip(previous.Lists)
            .SelectMany(pair => pair.First.Select(run => run.Id).Except(pair.Second.Select(run => run.Id)))
            .Distinct()];
    }

    public LatencyBoards Boards(LatencyLeaders? previous)
    {
        var known = previous?.Lists.SelectMany(list => list).Select(run => run.Id).ToHashSet() ?? [];
        return new LatencyBoards(
            Ids(FastJackpots),
            Ids(SlowJackpots),
            Ids(BrowserFastest),
            Ids(BrowserSlowest),
            Ids(ServerFastest),
            Ids(ServerSlowest),
            [.. Lists.SelectMany(list => list).DistinctBy(run => run.Id).Where(run => !known.Contains(run.Id))]);
    }

    private static Guid[] Ids(BoardMessage[] runs) => [.. runs.Select(run => run.Id)];

    private static Scored Score(BoardMessage run) => new(run, LatencyRun.Rank(run.Text));

    private static BoardMessage[] Window(BoardMessage[] current, IEnumerable<Scored> candidates, int capacity) =>
        MessageWindow.Merge(current, candidates.Select(entry => entry.Run), capacity)?.Next ?? current;

    private static BoardMessage[] Order(BoardMessage[] current, IEnumerable<Scored> candidates, LatencySide side, bool fastest, int capacity)
    {
        var pool = current.Select(Score)
            .Concat(candidates)
            .Where(entry => Of(entry.Rank, side) is not null)
            .DistinctBy(entry => entry.Run.Id);
        var sorted = fastest
            ? pool.OrderBy(entry => Of(entry.Rank, side))
            : pool.OrderByDescending(entry => Of(entry.Rank, side));
        return [.. sorted.ThenBy(entry => entry.Run.Id).Take(capacity).Select(entry => entry.Run)];
    }

    private sealed record Scored(BoardMessage Run, LatencyRank Rank);
}

using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Latency;

internal sealed record LatencyResult(string Key, int? Browser, int? Server);

internal sealed record LatencySummary(int? Browser, int? Server, int Answered, int Total);

internal sealed record LatencyRank(int? Browser, int? Server)
{
    public static LatencyRank None { get; } = new(null, null);
}

internal static class LatencyRun
{
    public const int MaxMilliseconds = 60_000;
    public const int MaxEntries = 64;
    public const int MaxKeyLength = 32;
    public const int MaxLength = 4096;

    public static string Compose(IReadOnlyList<LatencyEndpoint> endpoints, IReadOnlyList<int?> browser, IReadOnlyList<int?> server)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(endpoints);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(browser);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(server);
        var results = new List<LatencyResult>(endpoints.Count);
        for (var i = 0; i < endpoints.Count; i++)
        {
            results.Add(new LatencyResult(
                endpoints[i].Key,
                i < browser.Count ? Clamp(browser[i]) : null,
                endpoints[i].FromServer && i < server.Count ? Clamp(server[i]) : null));
        }

        return Format(results);
    }

    public static string Format(IEnumerable<LatencyResult> results)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(results);
        var builder = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (var result in results)
        {
            if (builder.Length > 0)
            {
                builder.Append(';');
            }

            builder.Append(result.Key).Append('=');
            if (result.Browser is { } browser)
            {
                builder.Append(browser.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }

            builder.Append(',');
            if (result.Server is { } server)
            {
                builder.Append(server.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }
        }

        return builder.ToString();
    }

    public static bool TryParse([NotNullWhen(true)] string? text, [NotNullWhen(true)] out IReadOnlyList<LatencyResult>? results)
    {
        results = null;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || text.Length > MaxLength)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var entries = text.Split(';');
        if (entries.Length > MaxEntries)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var parsed = new List<LatencyResult>(entries.Length);
        var keys = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var entry in entries)
        {
            var equals = entry.IndexOf('=', StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (equals <= 0)
            {
                return false;
            }

            var key = entry[..equals];
            var values = entry[(equals + 1)..].Split(',');
            if (!IsKey(key) || !keys.Add(key) || values.Length != 2
                || !TryValue(values[0], out var browser) || !TryValue(values[1], out var server))
            {
                return false;
            }

            parsed.Add(new LatencyResult(key, browser, server));
        }

        results = parsed;
        return true;
    }

    public static bool IsValid([NotNullWhen(true)] string? text) =>
        TryParse(text, out var results) && string.Equals(Format(results), text, StringComparison.Ordinal);

    public static LatencySummary Summarize(IReadOnlyList<LatencyResult> results)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(results);
        return new LatencySummary(
            Median(results.Select(result => result.Browser)),
            Median(results.Select(result => result.Server)),
            results.Count(result => result.Browser is not null || result.Server is not null),
            results.Count);
    }

    public static LatencyRank Rank(IReadOnlyList<LatencyResult> results)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(results);
        var quorum = (results.Count + 1) / 2;
        return new LatencyRank(
            Counted([.. results.Select(result => result.Browser)], quorum),
            Counted([.. results.Select(result => result.Server)], quorum));
    }

    public static LatencyRank Rank(string? text) => TryParse(text, out var results) ? Rank(results) : LatencyRank.None;

    public static int? Median(IEnumerable<int?> values)
    {
        var sorted = values.OfType<int>().Order().ToArray();
        if (sorted.Length == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var middle = sorted.Length / 2;
        return sorted.Length % 2 == 1 ? sorted[middle] : (int)Math.Round((sorted[middle - 1] + sorted[middle]) / 2.0, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
    }

    public static string Milliseconds(int? value) =>
        value is { } milliseconds ? milliseconds.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " ms" : "–";

    private static int? Counted(int?[] values, int quorum) =>
        values.Count(value => value is not null) >= quorum ? Median(values) : null;

    private static int? Clamp(int? value) => value is { } milliseconds and >= 0 ? Math.Min(milliseconds, MaxMilliseconds) : null;

    private static bool IsKey(string key)
    {
        if (key.Length > MaxKeyLength)
        {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (var c in key)
        {
            if (!char.IsAsciiLetterLower(c) && !char.IsAsciiDigit(c) && c != '-')
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static bool TryValue(string value, out int? milliseconds)
    {
        milliseconds = null;
        if (value.Length == 0)
        {
            return true;
        }

        if (value.Length > 5 || !value.All(char.IsAsciiDigit)
            || !int.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var parsed) || parsed > MaxMilliseconds)
        {
            return false;
        }

        milliseconds = parsed;
        return true;
    }
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Latency;

internal sealed partial class LatencyService : IDisposable
{
    public const int MaxOffers = 50;
    public const int MaxLeaderOffers = 40;

    private readonly TimeProvider _time;
    private readonly ILatencyProbe _probe;
    private readonly ILogger<LatencyService> _logger;
    private readonly KeyedCooldowns _cooldowns;
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _stopping = new();
    private readonly Lock _gate = new();
    private readonly HashSet<ILatencySubscriber> _subscribers = [];
    private readonly bool _serverProbe;
    private readonly TimeSpan _gap;
    private BoardMessage[] _messages = [];
    private LatencyLeaders _leaders = LatencyLeaders.Empty;
    private long _version;
    private Pending? _pending;
    private long? _lastStart;
    private Task _idle = Task.CompletedTask;

    public LatencyService(TimeProvider time, IOptions<ChaosOptions> options, ILatencyProbe probe, ILogger<LatencyService> logger)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(time);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(probe);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(logger);
        var limits = options.Value;
        _time = time;
        _probe = probe;
        _logger = logger;
        Capacity = limits.LatencyCapacity;
        RankCapacity = limits.LatencyRankCapacity;
        JackpotCapacity = limits.LatencyJackpotCapacity;
        Cooldown = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(limits.LatencyCooldownSeconds);
        Budget = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(limits.LatencyBudgetSeconds);
        BrowserWait = Budget + TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);
        _gap = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(limits.LatencyGapSeconds);
        _serverProbe = limits.LatencyServerProbe;
        _cooldowns = new KeyedCooldowns(Cooldown, time);
        StartedAt = time.GetUtcNow();
    }

    public int Capacity { get; }

    public int RankCapacity { get; }

    public int JackpotCapacity { get; }

    public TimeSpan Cooldown { get; }

    public TimeSpan Budget { get; }

    public TimeSpan BrowserWait { get; }

    public DateTimeOffset StartedAt { get; }

    public IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> Messages => Volatile.Read(ref _messages);

    public LatencyLeaders Leaders => Volatile.Read(ref _leaders);

    public bool Running
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _pending is not null;
            }
        }
    }

    public Task WhenIdle()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _idle;
        }
    }

    public LatencyStart Begin(string client)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            var now = _time.GetTimestamp();
            if (_pending is not null || (_lastStart is { } last && _time.GetElapsedTime(last, now) < _gap))
            {
                return LatencyStart.Busy;
            }

            if (!_cooldowns.TryStart(client, out var remaining))
            {
                return LatencyStart.Wait(Seconds(remaining));
            }

            _lastStart = now;
            var pending = new Pending(Uuid7.After(LatestId(), _time.GetUtcNow()));
            _pending = pending;
            Broadcast(LatencyUpdate.State(_version, true));
            _idle = RunAsync(pending);
            return LatencyStart.Started(pending.Id, Seconds(Cooldown));
        }
    }

    public bool Finish(Guid id, IReadOnlyList<int>? browser)
    {
        if (browser is null || browser.Count != LatencyCatalog.Endpoints.Count)
        {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (var value in browser)
        {
            if (value < -1 || value > LatencyRun.MaxMilliseconds)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _pending is { } pending && pending.Id == id && pending.Browser.TrySetResult([.. browser.Select(value => value < 0 ? (int?)null : value)]);
        }
    }

    public int Offer(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> offered) => Restore(offered, MaxOffers, recent: true);

    public int OfferLeaders(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> offered) => Restore(offered, MaxLeaderOffers, recent: false);

    public void Subscribe(ILatencySubscriber subscriber)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(subscriber);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (subscriber.Deliver(LatencyUpdate.Snapshot(_version, _messages, _pending is not null, _leaders.Boards(null))))
            {
                _subscribers.Add(subscriber);
            }
        }
    }

    public void Unsubscribe(ILatencySubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _subscribers.Remove(subscriber);
        }
    }

    public bool IsSubscribed(ILatencySubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _subscribers.Contains(subscriber);
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _stopping.Cancel();
        _stopping.Dispose();
    }

    private static int Seconds(TimeSpan span) => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(span.TotalSeconds));

    private int Restore(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> offered, int limit, bool recent)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(offered);
        var now = _time.GetUtcNow();
        var valid = offered
            .Take(limit)
            .Where(message => message is not null && MessageWindow.IsRestorable(message.Id, now, StartedAt) && LatencyRun.IsValid(message.Text))
            .ToList();
        if (valid.Count == 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            return Merge(valid, recent);
        }
    }

    private Guid LatestId() => _messages.Length > 0 ? _messages[0].Id : Guid.Empty;

    private async Task RunAsync(Pending pending)
    {
        var endpoints = LatencyCatalog.Endpoints;
        var token = _stopping.Token;
        var server = new int?[endpoints.Count];
        IReadOnlyList<int?> browser = [];
        try
        {
            await Task.Yield();
            if (_serverProbe)
            {
                server = await _probe.MeasureAsync(endpoints, Budget, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }

            browser = await pending.Browser.Task.WaitAsync(BrowserWait, _time, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (TimeoutException)
        {
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (token.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            return;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LogProbeFailed(_logger, exception);
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            _pending = null;
            var message = new BoardMessage(pending.Id, LatencyRun.Compose(endpoints, browser, server));
            if (Merge([message], recent: true) == 0)
            {
                Broadcast(LatencyUpdate.State(_version, false));
            }
        }
    }

    private int Merge(IReadOnlyCollection<BoardMessage> candidates, bool recent)
    {
        var change = recent ? MessageWindow.Merge(_messages, candidates, Capacity) : null;
        var leaders = _leaders.Merge(candidates, RankCapacity, JackpotCapacity);
        if (change is null && leaders is null)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var previous = _version;
        _version++;
        if (change is not null)
        {
            Volatile.Write(ref _messages, change.Next);
        }

        LatencyBoards? boards = null;
        IReadOnlyList<Guid> entered = [];
        if (leaders is not null)
        {
            boards = leaders.Boards(_leaders);
            entered = leaders.Entered(_leaders);
            Volatile.Write(ref _leaders, leaders);
        }

        Broadcast(LatencyUpdate.Delta(_version, previous, change?.Added ?? [], change?.Removed ?? [], _pending is not null, boards));
        return (change?.Added ?? []).Select(message => message.Id).Concat(entered).Distinct().Count();
    }

    private void Broadcast(LatencyUpdate update)
    {
        List<ILatencySubscriber>? dropped = null;
        foreach (var subscriber in _subscribers)
        {
            if (!subscriber.Deliver(update))
            {
                (dropped ??= []).Add(subscriber);
            }
        }

        if (dropped is not null)
        {
            _subscribers.ExceptWith(dropped);
        }
    }

    [LoggerMessage(Level = LogLevel.Warning, Message = "Server latency probe failed")]
    private static partial void LogProbeFailed(ILogger logger, Exception exception);

    private sealed class Pending(Guid id)
    {
        public Guid Id { get; } = id;

        public TaskCompletionSource<IReadOnlyList<int?>> Browser { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    }
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;

internal sealed class BoardService
{
    public const int MaxOffers = 50;
    public const int RepeatWindow = 10;

    private readonly TimeProvider _time;
    private readonly KeyedTokenBuckets _posts;
    private readonly Lock _gate = new();
    private readonly HashSet<IBoardSubscriber> _subscribers = [];
    private BoardMessage[] _messages = [];
    private long _version;

    public BoardService(TimeProvider time, IOptions<ChaosOptions> options)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(time);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        var limits = options.Value;
        _time = time;
        Capacity = limits.BoardCapacity;
        _posts = new KeyedTokenBuckets(limits.PostBurst, limits.PostsPerSecond, time);
        StartedAt = time.GetUtcNow();
    }

    public int Capacity { get; }

    public DateTimeOffset StartedAt { get; }

    public IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> Messages => Volatile.Read(ref _messages);

    public long Version
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _version;
            }
        }
    }

    public PostResult Post(string? input, string client) => Submit(input, client, null).Result;

    public PostReply Submit(string? input, string client, IEnumerable<MetaEntry?>? meta)
    {
        var text = MessageText.Normalize(input);
        if (text.Length == 0)
        {
            return new PostReply(PostResult.Empty);
        }

        if (!_posts.TryTake(client))
        {
            return new PostReply(PostResult.TooFast);
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            var window = Math.Min(RepeatWindow, _messages.Length);
            for (var i = 0; i < window; i++)
            {
                if (string.Equals(_messages[i].Text, text, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    return new PostReply(PostResult.Repeat);
                }
            }

            var message = new BoardMessage(Guid.CreateVersion7(_time.GetUtcNow()), text, MessageMeta.Normalize(meta));
            Merge([message]);
            return new PostReply(PostResult.Accepted, message);
        }
    }

    public int Offer(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> offered)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(offered);
        var now = _time.GetUtcNow();
        var valid = new List<BoardMessage>();
        foreach (var message in offered.Take(MaxOffers))
        {
            if (IsAcceptable(message, now))
            {
                valid.Add(message);
            }
        }

        if (valid.Count == 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            return Merge(valid);
        }
    }

    public void Subscribe(IBoardSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(subscriber);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (subscriber.Deliver(BoardUpdate.Snapshot(_version, _messages)))
            {
                _subscribers.Add(subscriber);
            }
        }
    }

    public void Unsubscribe(IBoardSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _subscribers.Remove(subscriber);
        }
    }

    public bool IsSubscribed(IBoardSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _subscribers.Contains(subscriber);
        }
    }

    private bool IsAcceptable(BoardMessage message, DateTimeOffset now) =>
        message is not null
        && MessageWindow.IsRestorable(message.Id, now, StartedAt)
        && MessageText.IsNormalized(message.Text)
        && MessageMeta.IsNormalized(message.Meta);

    private int Merge(IReadOnlyCollection<BoardMessage> candidates)
    {
        var change = MessageWindow.Merge(_messages, candidates, Capacity);
        if (change is null)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var previous = _version;
        _version++;
        Volatile.Write(ref _messages, change.Next);
        Broadcast(BoardUpdate.Delta(_version, previous, change.Added, change.Removed));
        return change.Added.Length;
    }

    private void Broadcast(BoardUpdate update)
    {
        List<IBoardSubscriber>? dropped = null;
        foreach (var subscriber in _subscribers)
        {
            if (!subscriber.Deliver(update))
            {
                (dropped ??= []).Add(subscriber);
            }
        }

        if (dropped is not null)
        {
            _subscribers.ExceptWith(dropped);
        }
    }
}

        new("colorScheme", "Color scheme", 16),
        new("reducedMotion", "Reduced motion", 8),
        new("contrast", "Contrast", 16),
        new("online", "Online", 8),
        new("connection", "Connection", 32),
        new("downlink", "Downlink (Mb/s)", 16, 0, 1e6),
        new("rtt", "Round trip (ms)", 16, 0, 1e6),
        new("saveData", "Data saver", 8),
    ];

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, int> Order = Fields
        .Select((field, index) => (field.Key, index))
        .ToDictionary(pair => pair.Key, pair => pair.index, StringComparer.Ordinal);

    public static string LabelOf(string key) =>
        Order.TryGetValue(key, out var index) ? Fields[index].Label : key;

    public static MetaEntry[]? Normalize(IEnumerable<MetaEntry?>? entries)
    {
        if (entries is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var values = new string?[Fields.Count];
        foreach (var entry in entries.Take(Fields.Count * 2))
        {
            if (entry?.Key is not { } key || !Order.TryGetValue(key, out var index) || values[index] is not null)
            {
                continue;
            }

            values[index] = Clean(Fields[index], entry.Value);
        }

        if (values[0] is null || values[1] is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var normalized = new List<MetaEntry>(Fields.Count);
        for (var i = 0; i < Fields.Count; i++)
        {
            if (values[i] is { } value)
            {
                normalized.Add(new MetaEntry(Fields[i].Key, value));
            }
        }

        return [.. normalized];
    }

    public static bool IsNormalized(IReadOnlyList<MetaEntry>? entries)
    {
        if (entries is null)
        {
            return true;
        }

        var normalized = Normalize(entries);
        return normalized is not null && normalized.SequenceEqual(entries);
    }

    private static string? Clean(MetaField field, string? input)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input))
        {
            return null;
        }

        var builder = new StringBuilder(Math.Min(input.Length, field.MaxLength));
        foreach (var c in input)
        {
            if (!char.IsControl(c))
            {
                builder.Append(c);
            }
        }

        var text = builder.ToString().Trim();
        if (text.Length > field.MaxLength)
        {
            var cut = field.MaxLength;
            if (char.IsHighSurrogate(text[cut - 1]))
            {
                cut--;
            }

            text = text[..cut].TrimEnd();
        }

        if (text.Length == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (!field.IsNumber)
        {
            return text;
        }

        return double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var number)
            && double.IsFinite(number)
            && number >= (field.Min ?? double.MinValue)
            && number <= (field.Max ?? double.MaxValue)
            ? text
            : null;
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;

internal static partial class MessageText
{
    public const int MaxLength = 500;

    public static string Normalize(string? input, int maxLength = MaxLength)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input))
        {
            return "";
        }

        var text = string.Concat(input.ReplaceLineEndings("\n").Where(c => c == '\n' || !char.IsControl(c)));
        text = ExtraBlankLines().Replace(text, "\n\n").Trim();

        if (text.Length > maxLength)
        {
            var cut = 0;
            while (cut < text.Length)
            {
                var next = StringInfo.GetNextTextElementLength(text, cut);
                if (cut + next > maxLength)
                {
                    break;
                }

                cut += next;
            }

            text = text[..cut].TrimEnd();
        }

        return text.Any(IsVisible) ? text : "";
    }

    public static bool IsNormalized(string? text, int maxLength = MaxLength) =>
        !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && string.Equals(Normalize(text, maxLength), text, StringComparison.Ordinal);

    private static bool IsVisible(char c) =>
        !char.IsWhiteSpace(c) && char.GetUnicodeCategory(c) != UnicodeCategory.Format;

    [GeneratedRegex(@"\n{3,}")]
    private static partial Regex ExtraBlankLines();
}

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;

internal sealed record WindowChange(BoardMessage[] Next, BoardMessage[] Added, Guid[] Removed);

internal static class MessageWindow
{
    public static WindowChange? Merge(BoardMessage[] current, IEnumerable<BoardMessage> candidates, int capacity)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(current);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(candidates);
        var known = new HashSet<Guid>(current.Length);
        foreach (var message in current)
        {
            known.Add(message.Id);
        }

        var next = current
            .Concat(candidates.Where(message => !known.Contains(message.Id)).DistinctBy(message => message.Id))
            .OrderByDescending(message => message.Id)
            .Take(capacity)
            .ToArray();
        var added = next.Where(message => !known.Contains(message.Id)).ToArray();
        if (added.Length == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var kept = next.Select(message => message.Id).ToHashSet();
        var removed = current.Where(message => !kept.Contains(message.Id)).Select(message => message.Id).ToArray();
        return new WindowChange(next, added, removed);
    }

    public static bool IsRestorable(Guid id, DateTimeOffset now, DateTimeOffset startedAt)
    {
        if (!Uuid7.IsValid(id))
        {
            return false;
        }

        var at = Uuid7.Timestamp(id);
        return at <= now && at < startedAt;
    }
}

using System.Buffers.Binary;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Postcards;

internal static class ImageSanitizer
{
    public const string Png = "image/png";
    public const string Jpeg = "image/jpeg";
    public const string Gif = "image/gif";

    private static readonly byte[] PngSignature = [0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A];

    private static readonly HashSet<string> PngKept = new(StringComparer.Ordinal)
    {
        "IHDR", "PLTE", "IDAT", "IEND", "tRNS", "cHRM", "gAMA", "iCCP", "sBIT", "sRGB", "cICP", "mDCV", "cLLI", "pHYs", "bKGD", "hIST", "acTL", "fcTL", "fdAT",
    };

    public static CleanImage? Clean(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
    {
        if (data.Length == 0 || data.Length > PostcardRules.MaxImageBytes)
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (data.StartsWith(PngSignature))
        {
            return CleanPng(data);
        }

        if (data.Length >= 3 && data[0] == 0xFF && data[1] == 0xD8 && data[2] == 0xFF)
        {
            return CleanJpeg(data);
        }

        if (data.StartsWith("GIF87a"u8) || data.StartsWith("GIF89a"u8))
        {
            return CleanGif(data);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static CleanImage? Finish(string type, int width, int height, MemoryStream output)
    {
        if (!PostcardRules.FitsSize(width, height))
        {
            return null;
        }

        var bytes = output.ToArray();
        return new CleanImage(new PostcardImage(type, width, height, bytes.Length), bytes);
    }

    private static CleanImage? CleanPng(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
    {
        using var output = new MemoryStream(data.Length);
        output.Write(PngSignature);
        var position = PngSignature.Length;
        var width = 0;
        var height = 0;
        var first = true;
        var hasData = false;
        while (true)
        {
            if (data.Length - position < 12)
            {
                return null;
            }

            var length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32BigEndian(data[position..]);
            if (length > (uint)(data.Length - position - 12))
            {
                return null;
            }

            var type = data.Slice(position + 4, 4);
            if (!IsChunkType(type))
            {
                return null;
            }

            var name = System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetString(type);
            var chunk = data.Slice(position, (int)length + 12);
            if (first)
            {
                if (name != "IHDR" || length != 13)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                width = ToInt(BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32BigEndian(data[(position + 8)..]));
                height = ToInt(BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32BigEndian(data[(position + 12)..]));
                first = false;
            }
            else if (name == "IHDR")
            {
                return null;
            }

            var critical = (type[0] & 0x20) == 0;
            if (PngKept.Contains(name))
            {
                output.Write(chunk);
                hasData |= name == "IDAT";
            }
            else if (critical)
            {
                return null;
            }

            position += chunk.Length;
            if (name == "IEND")
            {
                return hasData ? Finish(Png, width, height, output) : null;
            }
        }
    }

    private static bool IsChunkType(ReadOnlySpan<byte> type)
    {
        foreach (var b in type)
        {
            if (!char.IsAsciiLetter((char)b))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int ToInt(uint value) => value > int.MaxValue ? 0 : (int)value;

    private static CleanImage? CleanJpeg(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
    {
        using var output = new MemoryStream(data.Length);
        output.Write([0xFF, 0xD8]);
        var position = 2;
        var width = 0;
        var height = 0;
        var orientation = 0;
        var sawFrame = false;
        var wroteOrientation = false;
        while (true)
        {
            if (position >= data.Length || data[position] != 0xFF)
            {
                return null;
            }

            while (position < data.Length && data[position] == 0xFF)
            {
                position++;
            }

            if (position >= data.Length)
            {
                return null;
            }

            var marker = data[position];
            position++;
            if (marker is 0xD8 or 0xD9 or 0x00)
            {
                return null;
            }

            if (marker is (>= 0xD0 and <= 0xD7) or 0x01)
            {
                output.Write([0xFF, marker]);
                continue;
            }

            if (data.Length - position < 2)
            {
                return null;
            }

            var length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(data[position..]);
            if (length < 2 || length > data.Length - position)
            {
                return null;
            }

            var body = data.Slice(position + 2, length - 2);
            if (marker == 0xDA)
            {
                if (!sawFrame)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                if (orientation is > 1 and <= 8 && !wroteOrientation)
                {
                    WriteOrientation(output, orientation);
                }

                output.Write([0xFF, marker]);
                output.Write(data[position..]);
                return Finish(Jpeg, width, height, output);
            }

            if (IsFrame(marker))
            {
                if (body.Length < 6 || sawFrame)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                height = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(body[1..]);
                width = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(body[3..]);
                sawFrame = true;
            }

            if (marker == 0xE1 && orientation == 0)
            {
                orientation = ReadOrientation(body);
            }

            if (KeepsJpegSegment(marker, body))
            {
                if (marker != 0xE0 && orientation is > 1 and <= 8 && !wroteOrientation)
                {
                    WriteOrientation(output, orientation);
                    wroteOrientation = true;
                }

                output.Write([0xFF, marker]);
                output.Write(data.Slice(position, length));
            }

            position += length;
        }
    }

    private static bool IsFrame(byte marker) =>
        marker is >= 0xC0 and <= 0xCF && marker is not (0xC4 or 0xC8 or 0xCC);

    private static bool KeepsJpegSegment(byte marker, ReadOnlySpan<byte> body) => marker switch
    {
        0xE0 => true,
        0xE2 => body.StartsWith("ICC_PROFILE\0"u8),
        0xEE => body.StartsWith("Adobe"u8),
        >= 0xE1 and <= 0xEF => false,
        0xFE => false,
        _ => true,
    };

    private static int ReadOrientation(ReadOnlySpan<byte> body)
    {
        if (!body.StartsWith("Exif\0\0"u8))
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var tiff = body[6..];
        if (tiff.Length < 8)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        bool little;
        if (tiff.StartsWith("II*\0"u8))
        {
            little = true;
        }
        else if (tiff.StartsWith("MM\0*"u8))
        {
            little = false;
        }
        else
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var ifd = ReadUInt32(tiff[4..], little);
        if (ifd > (uint)(tiff.Length - 2))
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var count = ReadUInt16(tiff[(int)ifd..], little);
        var entries = (int)ifd + 2;
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            var at = entries + (i * 12);
            if (at + 12 > tiff.Length)
            {
                return 0;
            }

            if (ReadUInt16(tiff[at..], little) == 0x0112 && ReadUInt16(tiff[(at + 2)..], little) == 3)
            {
                var value = ReadUInt16(tiff[(at + 8)..], little);
                return value is >= 1 and <= 8 ? value : 0;
            }
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private static ushort ReadUInt16(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, bool little) =>
        little ? BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16LittleEndian(data) : BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(data);

    private static uint ReadUInt32(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, bool little) =>
        little ? BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32LittleEndian(data) : BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32BigEndian(data);

    private static void WriteOrientation(MemoryStream output, int orientation)
    {
        output.Write(
        [
            0xFF, 0xE1, 0x00, 0x22,
            (byte)'E', (byte)'x', (byte)'i', (byte)'f', 0x00, 0x00,
            (byte)'M', (byte)'M', 0x00, 0x2A, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x08,
            0x00, 0x01,
            0x01, 0x12, 0x00, 0x03, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00, (byte)orientation, 0x00, 0x00,
            0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
        ]);
    }

    private static CleanImage? CleanGif(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
    {
        if (data.Length < 13)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var width = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16LittleEndian(data[6..]);
        var height = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16LittleEndian(data[8..]);
        var packed = data[10];
        var position = 13;
        if ((packed & 0x80) != 0)
        {
            position += 3 * (1 << ((packed & 0x07) + 1));
        }

        if (position > data.Length)
        {
            return null;
        }

        using var output = new MemoryStream(data.Length);
        output.Write(data[..position]);
        var frames = 0;
        while (position < data.Length)
        {
            var start = position;
            var block = data[position];
            switch (block)
            {
                case 0x3B:
                    output.WriteByte(0x3B);
                    return frames > 0 ? Finish(Gif, width, height, output) : null;
                case 0x21:
                {
                    if (data.Length - position < 2)
                    {
                        return null;
                    }

                    var label = data[position + 1];
                    var end = SkipSubBlocks(data, position + 2);
                    if (end < 0)
                    {
                        return null;
                    }

                    if (KeepsGifExtension(label, data[(position + 2)..end]))
                    {
                        output.Write(data[start..end]);
                    }

                    position = end;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x2C:
                {
                    if (data.Length - position < 11 || ++frames > PostcardRules.MaxFrames)
                    {
                        return null;
                    }

                    var local = data[position + 9];
                    var after = position + 10;
                    if ((local & 0x80) != 0)
                    {
                        after += 3 * (1 << ((local & 0x07) + 1));
                    }

                    if (after >= data.Length)
                    {
                        return null;
                    }

                    var end = SkipSubBlocks(data, after + 1);
                    if (end < 0)
                    {
                        return null;
                    }

                    output.Write(data[start..end]);
                    position = end;
                    break;
                }

                default:
                    return null;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static int SkipSubBlocks(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, int position)
    {
        while (position < data.Length)
        {
            var size = data[position];
            position += 1 + size;
            if (size == 0)
            {
                return position <= data.Length ? position : -1;
            }
        }

        return -1;
    }

    private static bool KeepsGifExtension(byte label, ReadOnlySpan<byte> blocks) => label switch
    {
        0xF9 => true,
        0xFF => blocks.Length >= 12 && blocks[0] == 11 && (blocks[1..12].SequenceEqual("NETSCAPE2.0"u8) || blocks[1..12].SequenceEqual("ANIMEXTS1.0"u8)),
        _ => false,
    };
}

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Postcards;

internal static class PostcardEndpoint
{
    public const string Prefix = "postcard/images";

    public static string PathOf(Guid id, int index) => $"{Prefix}/{id:D}/{index}";

    public static IEndpointRouteBuilder MapPostcardImages(this IEndpointRouteBuilder app)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(app);
        app.MapGet($"/{Prefix}/{{id:guid}}/{{index:int}}", static (Guid id, int index, PostcardService postcards, HttpResponse response) =>
        {
            if (!postcards.TryGetImage(id, index, out var image, out var bytes) || image is null)
            {
                response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-store";
                return Results.NotFound();
            }

            response.Headers.CacheControl = "private, max-age=31536000, immutable";
            response.Headers.ContentDisposition = $"inline; filename=\"postcard-{index + 1}.{Extension(image.Type)}\"";
            return Results.Bytes(bytes, image.Type);
        });
        return app;
    }

    private static string Extension(string type) => type switch
    {
        ImageSanitizer.Png => "png",
        ImageSanitizer.Gif => "gif",
        _ => "jpg",
    };
}

internal static class PostcardRules
{
    public const int MaxTextLength = 5000;
    public const int MaxImages = 4;
    public const int MaxImageBytes = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
    public const int MaxTotalBytes = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
    public const int MaxSide = 4096;
    public const long MaxPixels = (long)MaxSide * MaxSide;
    public const int MaxFrames = 1000;

    public static bool FitsSize(int width, int height) =>
        width is > 0 and <= MaxSide && height is > 0 and <= MaxSide && (long)width * height <= MaxPixels;
}
