using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Postcards;

internal sealed class PostcardService : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TimeProvider _time;
    private readonly KeyedTokenBuckets _posts;
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _uploads;
    private readonly Lock _gate = new();
    private readonly HashSet<IPostcardSubscriber> _subscribers = [];
    private Stored? _current;
    private long _version;

    public PostcardService(TimeProvider time, IOptions<ChaosOptions> options)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(time);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        var limits = options.Value;
        _time = time;
        _posts = new KeyedTokenBuckets(limits.PostcardBurst, limits.PostcardsPerSecond, time);
        _uploads = new SemaphoreSlim(limits.PostcardUploads, limits.PostcardUploads);
        StartedAt = time.GetUtcNow();
    }

    public DateTimeOffset StartedAt { get; }

    public Postcard? Current => Volatile.Read(ref _current)?.Card;

    public long Version
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _version;
            }
        }
    }

    public void Dispose() => _uploads.Dispose();

    public static PostcardResult Check(string? text, IReadOnlyList<long> lengths)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(lengths);
        if (lengths.Count > PostcardRules.MaxImages)
        {
            return PostcardResult.TooManyImages;
        }

        long total = 0;
        foreach (var length in lengths)
        {
            if (length is <= 0 or > PostcardRules.MaxImageBytes)
            {
                return PostcardResult.TooLarge;
            }

            total += length;
        }

        if (total > PostcardRules.MaxTotalBytes)
        {
            return PostcardResult.TooLarge;
        }

        return lengths.Count == 0 && MessageText.Normalize(text, PostcardRules.MaxTextLength).Length == 0
            ? PostcardResult.Empty
            : PostcardResult.Accepted;
    }

    public PostcardResult Admit(string? text, IReadOnlyList<long> lengths, string client)
    {
        var check = Check(text, lengths);
        if (check is not PostcardResult.Accepted)
        {
            return check;
        }

        return _posts.TryTake(client) ? PostcardResult.Accepted : PostcardResult.TooFast;
    }

    public IDisposable? TryBeginUpload() => _uploads.Wait(0) ? new UploadLease(_uploads) : null;

    public PostcardReply Submit(string? text, IReadOnlyList<byte[]> images, IEnumerable<MetaEntry?>? meta, string client)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(images);
        var admitted = Admit(text, [.. images.Select(image => (long)image.Length)], client);
        return admitted is PostcardResult.Accepted ? Publish(text, images, meta) : new PostcardReply(admitted);
    }

    public PostcardReply Publish(string? input, IReadOnlyList<byte[]> images, IEnumerable<MetaEntry?>? meta)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(images);
        var text = MessageText.Normalize(input, PostcardRules.MaxTextLength);
        var check = Check(text, [.. images.Select(image => (long)image.Length)]);
        if (check is not PostcardResult.Accepted)
        {
            return new PostcardReply(check);
        }

        var clean = Clean(images);
        if (clean is null)
        {
            return new PostcardReply(PostcardResult.BadImage);
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_current is { } current && current.Matches(text, clean))
            {
                return new PostcardReply(PostcardResult.Repeat);
            }

            var id = Uuid7.After(_current?.Card.Id ?? Guid.Empty, _time.GetUtcNow());
            var card = new Postcard(id, text, [.. clean.Select(image => image.Info)], MessageMeta.Normalize(meta));
            Replace(new Stored(card, clean));
            return new PostcardReply(PostcardResult.Accepted, card);
        }
    }

    public bool WouldRestore(Guid id)
    {
        if (!MessageWindow.IsRestorable(id, _time.GetUtcNow(), StartedAt))
        {
            return false;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _current is null || _current.Card.Id.CompareTo(id) < 0;
        }
    }

    public bool Offer(Guid id, string? text, IReadOnlyList<byte[]> images, IReadOnlyList<MetaEntry>? meta)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(images);
        text ??= "";
        if (!WouldRestore(id)
            || (text.Length > 0 && !MessageText.IsNormalized(text, PostcardRules.MaxTextLength))
            || Check(text, [.. images.Select(image => (long)image.Length)]) is not PostcardResult.Accepted
            || !MessageMeta.IsNormalized(meta))
        {
            return false;
        }

        var clean = Clean(images);
        if (clean is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_current is not null && _current.Card.Id.CompareTo(id) >= 0)
            {
                return false;
            }

            Replace(new Stored(new Postcard(id, text, [.. clean.Select(image => image.Info)], meta is { Count: > 0 } ? [.. meta] : null), clean));
            return true;
        }
    }

    public bool TryGetImage(Guid id, int index, out PostcardImage? info, out ReadOnlyMemory<byte> bytes)
    {
        var current = Volatile.Read(ref _current);
        if (current is not null && current.Card.Id == id && index >= 0 && index < current.Images.Length)
        {
            info = current.Images[index].Info;
            bytes = current.Images[index].Bytes;
            return true;
        }

        info = null;
        bytes = default;
        return false;
    }

    public void Subscribe(IPostcardSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(subscriber);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (subscriber.Deliver(PostcardUpdate.Snapshot(_version, _current?.Card)))
            {
                _subscribers.Add(subscriber);
            }
        }
    }

    public void Unsubscribe(IPostcardSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _subscribers.Remove(subscriber);
        }
    }

    public bool IsSubscribed(IPostcardSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _subscribers.Contains(subscriber);
        }
    }

    private static CleanImage[]? Clean(IReadOnlyList<byte[]> images)
    {
        var clean = new CleanImage[images.Count];
        for (var i = 0; i < images.Count; i++)
        {
            if (images[i] is not { } bytes || ImageSanitizer.Clean(bytes) is not { } image)
            {
                return null;
            }

            clean[i] = image;
        }

        return clean;
    }

    private void Replace(Stored next)
    {
        _version++;
        Volatile.Write(ref _current, next);
        var update = PostcardUpdate.Change(_version, next.Card);
        List<IPostcardSubscriber>? dropped = null;
        foreach (var subscriber in _subscribers)
        {
            if (!subscriber.Deliver(update))
            {
                (dropped ??= []).Add(subscriber);
            }
        }

        if (dropped is not null)
        {
            _subscribers.ExceptWith(dropped);
        }
    }

    private sealed record Stored(Postcard Card, CleanImage[] Images)
    {
        public bool Matches(string text, CleanImage[] images) =>
            string.Equals(Card.Text, text, StringComparison.Ordinal)
            && Images.Length == images.Length
            && Images.Zip(images).All(pair => pair.First.Bytes.AsSpan().SequenceEqual(pair.Second.Bytes));
    }

    private sealed class UploadLease(SemaphoreSlim gate) : IDisposable
    {
        private int _released;

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _released, 1) == 0)
            {
                gate.Release();
            }
        }
    }
}

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Postcards;

internal sealed record PostcardUpdate(string Kind, long Version, Postcard? Card)
{
    public static PostcardUpdate Snapshot(long version, Postcard? card) => new("snapshot", version, card);

    public static PostcardUpdate Change(long version, Postcard? card) => new("change", version, card);
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.Extensions.FileProviders;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Reading;

internal sealed partial class ArticleLibrary
{
    public const long MaxFileBytes = 64L * 1024 * 1024;
    private const int Attempts = 2;

    private readonly IFileProvider _files;
    private readonly string _path;
    private readonly ILogger<ArticleLibrary> _logger;
    private readonly Lock _gate = new();
    private Shelf _shelf = Shelf.Unread;

    public ArticleLibrary(IFileProvider files, IOptions<ChaosOptions> options, ILogger<ArticleLibrary> logger)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(files);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(logger);
        _files = files;
        _path = options.Value.ArticlesFile;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public int Count => Current().Entries.Count;

    public Article? Find(string? id)
    {
        if (!ArticleText.IsId(id))
        {
            return null;
        }

        for (var attempt = 0; attempt < Attempts; attempt++)
        {
            var shelf = Current();
            if (!shelf.ById.TryGetValue(id, out var entry))
            {
                return null;
            }

            if (Load(shelf, entry) is { } article)
            {
                return article;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    public Article? Random() => Pick(RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32);

    public Article? Pick(Func<int, int> choose)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(choose);
        for (var attempt = 0; attempt < Attempts; attempt++)
        {
            var shelf = Current();
            if (shelf.Entries.Count == 0)
            {
                return null;
            }

            var index = choose(shelf.Entries.Count);
            if (index < 0 || index >= shelf.Entries.Count)
            {
                return null;
            }

            if (Load(shelf, shelf.Entries[index]) is { } article)
            {
                return article;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Shelf Current()
    {
        var file = _files.GetFileInfo(_path);
        var stamp = Stamp.Of(file);
        var shelf = Volatile.Read(ref _shelf);
        if (shelf.Stamp == stamp)
        {
            return shelf;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            shelf = _shelf;
            if (shelf.Stamp != stamp)
            {
                shelf = Build(file, stamp);
                Volatile.Write(ref _shelf, shelf);
            }

            return shelf;
        }
    }

    private Shelf Build(IFileInfo file, Stamp stamp)
    {
        if (!stamp.Exists)
        {
            return Shelf.Empty(stamp);
        }

        if (stamp.Length > MaxFileBytes)
        {
            LogTooLarge(_logger, _path, stamp.Length);
            return Shelf.Empty(stamp);
        }

        try
        {
            var bytes = Read(file, 0, (int)stamp.Length);
            var entries = new List<ArticleEntry>();
            var byId = new Dictionary<string, ArticleEntry>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var range in ArticleText.Records(bytes))
            {
                var (offset, length) = range.GetOffsetAndLength(bytes.Length);
                var article = ArticleText.Parse(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes, offset, length));
                if (article is null)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var entry = new ArticleEntry(article.Id, offset, length);
                if (byId.TryAdd(entry.Id, entry))
                {
                    entries.Add(entry);
                }
            }

            return new Shelf(stamp, entries, byId);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            LogUnreadable(_logger, _path, exception);
            return Shelf.Unread;
        }
    }

    private Article? Load(Shelf shelf, ArticleEntry entry)
    {
        try
        {
            var file = _files.GetFileInfo(_path);
            if (Stamp.Of(file) != shelf.Stamp)
            {
                return null;
            }

            var article = ArticleText.Parse(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Read(file, entry.Offset, entry.Length)));
            if (article?.Id == entry.Id)
            {
                return article;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            LogUnreadable(_logger, _path, exception);
        }

        Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _shelf, Shelf.Unread, shelf);
        return null;
    }

    private static byte[] Read(IFileInfo file, long offset, int length)
    {
        using var stream = file.CreateReadStream();
        if (stream.CanSeek)
        {
            stream.Seek(offset, SeekOrigin.Begin);
        }
        else
        {
            var skip = new byte[Math.Min(81_920, Math.Max(1L, offset))];
            for (var left = offset; left > 0;)
            {
                var read = stream.Read(skip, 0, (int)Math.Min(skip.Length, left));
                if (read == 0)
                {
                    throw new EndOfStreamException();
                }

                left -= read;
            }
        }

        var bytes = new byte[length];
        stream.ReadExactly(bytes);
        return bytes;
    }

    [LoggerMessage(Level = LogLevel.Warning, Message = "Articles file {Path} is {Length} bytes, over the limit; no articles are shown")]
    private static partial void LogTooLarge(ILogger logger, string path, long length);

    [LoggerMessage(Level = LogLevel.Warning, Message = "Articles file {Path} could not be read")]
    private static partial void LogUnreadable(ILogger logger, string path, Exception exception);

    private readonly record struct Stamp(bool Exists, long Length, DateTimeOffset Modified)
    {
        public static readonly Stamp None = new(false, -2, DateTimeOffset.MinValue);

        public static Stamp Of(IFileInfo file) =>
            file.Exists && !file.IsDirectory ? new Stamp(true, file.Length, file.LastModified) : new Stamp(false, -1, DateTimeOffset.MinValue);
    }

    private sealed record Shelf(Stamp Stamp, IReadOnlyList<ArticleEntry> Entries, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, ArticleEntry> ById)
    {
        public static readonly Shelf Unread = Empty(Stamp.None);

        public static Shelf Empty(Stamp stamp) => new(stamp, [], new Dictionary<string, ArticleEntry>(StringComparer.Ordinal));
    }
}

using System.Buffers;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Reading;

internal static class ArticleText
{
    public const int IdLength = 12;
    public const int MinRule = 20;
    public const int MaxHeaderLines = 6;
    public const int MaxTitleLength = 200;

    private const string Untitled = "Untitled";
    private const string SummaryMarker = "SUMMARY";
    private const string ArticleMarker = "ARTICLE";
    private const string BylinePrefix = "By ";
    private const string PublishedPrefix = "Published ";
    private static readonly string[] ListMarkers = ["- ", "\u2022 ", "* ", "\uf0b7 "];
    private static readonly SearchValues<byte> Blank = SearchValues.Create(" \t\r\n"u8);

    private static ReadOnlySpan<byte> Bom => [0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF];

    public static bool IsId([NotNullWhen(true)] string? value) =>
        value is { Length: IdLength } && value.All(char.IsAsciiHexDigitLower);

    public static IReadOnlyList<Range> Records(ReadOnlySpan<byte> utf8)
    {
        var rules = new List<(int Line, int Start)>();
        var line = 0;
        var origin = utf8.StartsWith(Bom) ? Bom.Length : 0;
        var start = origin;
        while (start < utf8.Length)
        {
            var end = utf8[start..].IndexOf((byte)'\n');
            var next = end < 0 ? utf8.Length : start + end + 1;
            if (IsRule(utf8[start..(end < 0 ? utf8.Length : start + end)]))
            {
                rules.Add((line, start));
            }

            line++;
            start = next;
        }

        var opens = new List<int>();
        for (var i = 0; i + 1 < rules.Count; i++)
        {
            var gap = rules[i + 1].Line - rules[i].Line - 1;
            if (gap is >= 1 and <= MaxHeaderLines)
            {
                opens.Add(rules[i].Start);
                i++;
            }
        }

        if (opens.Count == 0)
        {
            return HasText(utf8[origin..]) ? [new Range(origin, utf8.Length)] : [];
        }

        var records = new List<Range>(opens.Count);
        for (var i = 0; i < opens.Count; i++)
        {
            records.Add(new Range(opens[i], i + 1 < opens.Count ? opens[i + 1] : utf8.Length));
        }

        return records;
    }

    public static Article? Parse(string record)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(record);
        var lines = record.TrimStart('\uFEFF').Replace("\r\n", "\n", StringComparison.Ordinal).Split('\n');
        var first = 0;
        while (first < lines.Length && lines[first].Trim().Length == 0)
        {
            first++;
        }

        string? slug = null;
        if (first < lines.Length && IsRule(lines[first]))
        {
            var close = Array.FindIndex(lines, first + 1, IsRule);
            if (close > first)
            {
                slug = lines[(first + 1)..close].Select(header => header.Trim()).FirstOrDefault(header => header.Length > 0);
                first = close + 1;
            }
        }

        var paragraphs = Paragraphs(lines.AsSpan(first));
        var summaryAt = paragraphs.FindIndex(paragraph => IsMarker(paragraph, SummaryMarker));
        var articleAt = paragraphs.FindIndex(paragraph => IsMarker(paragraph, ArticleMarker));

        string? summary = null;
        List<List<string>> content;
        if (articleAt >= 0)
        {
            if (summaryAt >= 0 && summaryAt < articleAt)
            {
                summary = Joined(paragraphs[(summaryAt + 1)..articleAt].SelectMany(paragraph => paragraph));
            }

            content = paragraphs[(articleAt + 1)..];
        }
        else
        {
            content = [.. paragraphs.Where(paragraph => !IsMarker(paragraph, SummaryMarker))];
        }

        string? title = null;
        string? dek = null;
        string? byline = null;
        DateTimeOffset? published = null;
        Uri? source = null;
        if (articleAt >= 0 && content.Count > 0)
        {
            (title, dek, byline, published, source) = Head(content[0]);
            content = content[1..];
        }
        else if (content.Count > 1 && content[0] is [var only] && only.Length <= MaxTitleLength)
        {
            title = only;
            content = content[1..];
        }

        if (content.Count == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        title ??= TitleOf(slug) ?? Untitled;
        var blocks = content.Select(Block).ToArray();
        var key = source?.AbsoluteUri ?? title + "\n" + string.Join("\n\n", blocks.Select(block => block.Text));
        return new Article(IdOf(key), title, dek, byline, published, source, summary, blocks);
    }

    public static string IdOf(string key) =>
        Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key)))[..IdLength];

    public static string? TitleOf(string? slug)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(slug))
        {
            return null;
        }

        var name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(slug.Trim());
        var words = name.Replace('-', ' ').Replace('_', ' ').Trim();
        if (words.Length == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return string.Concat(char.ToUpperInvariant(words[0]).ToString(), words[1..]);
    }

    private static (string Title, string? Dek, string? Byline, DateTimeOffset? Published, Uri? Source) Head(List<string> head)
    {
        var end = head.Count;
        Uri? source = null;
        if (end > 1 && Uri.TryCreate(head[end - 1], UriKind.Absolute, out var uri) && (uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps || uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp))
        {
            source = uri;
            end--;
        }

        DateTimeOffset? published = null;
        if (end > 1 && head[end - 1].StartsWith(PublishedPrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            published = PublishedOf(head[end - 1][PublishedPrefix.Length..]);
            end--;
        }

        string? byline = null;
        if (end > 1 && head[end - 1].StartsWith(BylinePrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            byline = head[end - 1];
            end--;
        }

        var dek = end > 1 ? Joined(head[1..end]) : null;
        return (head[0], dek, byline, published, source);
    }

    private static DateTimeOffset? PublishedOf(string text) =>
        DateTimeOffset.TryParseExact(text.Trim(), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm 'UTC'", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal, out var at)
            ? at
            : null;

    private static ArticleBlock Block(List<string> lines)
    {
        if (lines.All(IsListItem))
        {
            return new ArticleBlock([.. lines.Select(line => line[2..].Trim())], true);
        }

        return new ArticleBlock(lines, false);
    }

    private static bool IsListItem(string line) =>
        line.Length > 2 && ListMarkers.Any(marker => line.StartsWith(marker, StringComparison.Ordinal));

    private static List<List<string>> Paragraphs(ReadOnlySpan<string> lines)
    {
        var paragraphs = new List<List<string>>();
        List<string>? current = null;
        foreach (var raw in lines)
        {
            var line = raw.Trim();
            if (line.Length == 0)
            {
                current = null;
                continue;
            }

            if (IsRule(line))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (current is null)
            {
                current = [];
                paragraphs.Add(current);
            }

            current.Add(line);
        }

        return paragraphs;
    }

    private static string? Joined(IEnumerable<string> lines)
    {
        var text = string.Join(' ', lines).Trim();
        return text.Length > 0 ? text : null;
    }

    private static bool IsMarker(List<string> paragraph, string marker) =>
        paragraph is [var only] && string.Equals(only, marker, StringComparison.Ordinal);

    private static bool IsRule(string line)
    {
        var text = line.AsSpan().Trim();
        return text.Length >= MinRule && !text.ContainsAnyExcept('=');
    }

    private static bool IsRule(ReadOnlySpan<byte> line)
    {
        var text = line.TrimEnd((byte)'\r');
        return text.Length >= MinRule && !text.ContainsAnyExcept((byte)'=');
    }

    private static bool HasText(ReadOnlySpan<byte> utf8) =>
        utf8.ContainsAnyExcept(Blank);
}

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Reading;

internal static class RandomArticle
{
    public const string Path = "/read";

    public static IApplicationBuilder UseRandomArticle(this IApplicationBuilder app)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(app);
        return app.Use(static (context, next) =>
        {
            var request = context.Request;
            if (!(HttpMethods.IsGet(request.Method) || HttpMethods.IsHead(request.Method))
                || !string.Equals(request.Path.Value?.TrimEnd('/'), Path, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || context.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<ArticleLibrary>().Random() is not { } article)
            {
                return next(context);
            }

            context.Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-store";
            context.Response.Redirect($"{request.PathBase}{Path}/{article.Id}");
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        });
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Slots;

internal static class SlotRules
{
    public const int Length = 5;
    public const string Symbols = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";

    public static string Draw() => Draw(Symbols);

    public static string Draw(string alphabet) => RandomNumberGenerator.GetString(alphabet, Length);

    public static bool IsAlphabet([NotNullWhen(true)] string? alphabet) =>
        !string.IsNullOrEmpty(alphabet) && alphabet.Length <= Symbols.Length && alphabet.All(c => Symbols.Contains(c, StringComparison.Ordinal));

    public static bool IsJackpot(SlotWin win) => win is SlotWin.FourOfAKind or SlotWin.FiveOfAKind or SlotWin.SequenceUp or SlotWin.SequenceDown;

    public static bool IsJackpot(string? text) => IsJackpot(Classify(text));

    public static bool IsValid([NotNullWhen(true)] string? text)
    {
        if (text is null || text.Length != Length)
        {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (var c in text)
        {
            if (!char.IsAsciiDigit(c) && !char.IsAsciiLetterUpper(c))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static SlotWin Classify(string? text)
    {
        if (!IsValid(text))
        {
            return SlotWin.None;
        }

        var most = text.GroupBy(c => c).Max(group => group.Count());
        if (most >= 5)
        {
            return SlotWin.FiveOfAKind;
        }

        if (most == 4)
        {
            return SlotWin.FourOfAKind;
        }

        if (most == 3)
        {
            return SlotWin.ThreeOfAKind;
        }

        if (IsConsecutive(text, 1))
        {
            return SlotWin.SequenceUp;
        }

        if (IsConsecutive(text, -1))
        {
            return SlotWin.SequenceDown;
        }

        if (IsOrdered(text, 1))
        {
            return SlotWin.StraightUp;
        }

        return IsOrdered(text, -1) ? SlotWin.StraightDown : SlotWin.None;
    }

    public static bool[] Hits(string? text)
    {
        var hits = new bool[Length];
        if (!IsValid(text))
        {
            return hits;
        }

        var win = Classify(text);
        if (win is SlotWin.None)
        {
            return hits;
        }

        if (win is SlotWin.StraightUp or SlotWin.StraightDown or SlotWin.SequenceUp or SlotWin.SequenceDown)
        {
            Array.Fill(hits, true);
            return hits;
        }

        var top = text.GroupBy(c => c).MaxBy(group => group.Count())!.Key;
        for (var i = 0; i < Length; i++)
        {
            hits[i] = text[i] == top;
        }

        return hits;
    }

    public static string Label(SlotWin win) => win switch
    {
        SlotWin.ThreeOfAKind => "Three of a kind",
        SlotWin.FourOfAKind => "Four of a kind",
        SlotWin.FiveOfAKind => "Five of a kind",
        SlotWin.StraightUp => "Straight up",
        SlotWin.StraightDown => "Straight down",
        SlotWin.SequenceUp => "Sequence up",
        SlotWin.SequenceDown => "Sequence down",
        _ => "",
    };

    public static char Above(char symbol) => Symbols[(Symbols.IndexOf(symbol, StringComparison.Ordinal) + 1) % Symbols.Length];

    public static char Below(char symbol) => Symbols[(Symbols.IndexOf(symbol, StringComparison.Ordinal) + Symbols.Length - 1) % Symbols.Length];

    private static bool IsConsecutive(string text, int direction)
    {
        for (var i = 1; i < text.Length; i++)
        {
            if (Symbols.IndexOf(text[i], StringComparison.Ordinal) - Symbols.IndexOf(text[i - 1], StringComparison.Ordinal) != direction)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsOrdered(string text, int direction)
    {
        for (var i = 1; i < text.Length; i++)
        {
            if ((text[i] - text[i - 1]) * direction <= 0)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Slots;

internal sealed class SlotService
{
    public const int MaxOffers = 50;
    public const int MaxWinnerOffers = 500;
    public const int MaxJackpotOffers = 500;

    private readonly TimeProvider _time;
    private readonly KeyedTokenBuckets _presses;
    private readonly string _alphabet;
    private readonly Lock _gate = new();
    private readonly HashSet<ISlotSubscriber> _subscribers = [];
    private BoardMessage[] _messages = [];
    private BoardMessage[] _winners = [];
    private BoardMessage[] _jackpots = [];
    private long _version;
    private Guid _spinId;
    private long? _spinStarted;

    public SlotService(TimeProvider time, IOptions<ChaosOptions> options)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(time);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        var limits = options.Value;
        _time = time;
        Capacity = limits.SlotCapacity;
        WinnerCapacity = limits.SlotWinnerCapacity;
        JackpotCapacity = limits.SlotJackpotCapacity;
        _alphabet = SlotRules.IsAlphabet(limits.SlotDrawSymbols) ? limits.SlotDrawSymbols : SlotRules.Symbols;
        SpinTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(limits.SpinMilliseconds);
        _presses = new KeyedTokenBuckets(limits.PressBurst, limits.PressesPerSecond, time);
        StartedAt = time.GetUtcNow();
    }

    public int Capacity { get; }

    public int WinnerCapacity { get; }

    public int JackpotCapacity { get; }

    public TimeSpan SpinTime { get; }

    public DateTimeOffset StartedAt { get; }

    public IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> Messages => Volatile.Read(ref _messages);

    public IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> Winners => Volatile.Read(ref _winners);

    public IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> Jackpots => Volatile.Read(ref _jackpots);

    public SlotSpin? Spinning
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return CurrentSpin(_time.GetTimestamp());
            }
        }
    }

    public SlotPress Press(string client)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            var now = _time.GetTimestamp();
            if (CurrentSpin(now) is not null)
            {
                return SlotPress.Busy;
            }

            if (!_presses.TryTake(client))
            {
                return SlotPress.TooFast;
            }

            var message = new BoardMessage(Guid.CreateVersion7(_time.GetUtcNow()), SlotRules.Draw(_alphabet));
            _spinId = message.Id;
            _spinStarted = now;
            Merge([message], new SlotSpin(message.Id, Milliseconds(SpinTime)), Lists.All, drawn: true);
            return SlotPress.Started(message.Id);
        }
    }

    public int Offer(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> offered) => Restore(offered, MaxOffers, Lists.All);

    public int OfferWinners(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> offered) => Restore(offered, MaxWinnerOffers, Lists.Winners | Lists.Jackpots);

    public int OfferJackpots(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> offered) => Restore(offered, MaxJackpotOffers, Lists.Jackpots);

    public void Subscribe(ISlotSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(subscriber);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (subscriber.Deliver(SlotUpdate.Snapshot(_version, _messages, _winners, _jackpots, CurrentSpin(_time.GetTimestamp()))))
            {
                _subscribers.Add(subscriber);
            }
        }
    }

    public void Unsubscribe(ISlotSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _subscribers.Remove(subscriber);
        }
    }

    public bool IsSubscribed(ISlotSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _subscribers.Contains(subscriber);
        }
    }

    private static int Milliseconds(TimeSpan span) => (int)Math.Ceiling(span.TotalMilliseconds);

    private static bool IsWinner(BoardMessage message) => SlotRules.Classify(message.Text) is not SlotWin.None;

    private static bool IsJackpot(BoardMessage message) => SlotRules.IsJackpot(message.Text);

    private static bool Accepts(BoardMessage message, Lists lists) =>
        lists.HasFlag(Lists.Recent)
        || (lists.HasFlag(Lists.Winners) && IsWinner(message))
        || (lists.HasFlag(Lists.Jackpots) && IsJackpot(message));

    private int Restore(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> offered, int limit, Lists lists)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(offered);
        var now = _time.GetUtcNow();
        var valid = offered
            .Take(limit)
            .Where(message => message is not null && MessageWindow.IsRestorable(message.Id, now, StartedAt) && SlotRules.IsValid(message.Text))
            .Where(message => Accepts(message, lists))
            .ToList();
        if (valid.Count == 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            return Merge(valid, null, lists, drawn: false);
        }
    }

    private SlotSpin? CurrentSpin(long now)
    {
        if (_spinStarted is not { } started)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var remaining = SpinTime - _time.GetElapsedTime(started, now);
        return remaining > TimeSpan.Zero ? new SlotSpin(_spinId, Milliseconds(remaining)) : null;
    }

    private WindowChange? Enshrine(IEnumerable<BoardMessage> candidates, bool drawn)
    {
        var known = _jackpots.Select(message => message.Id).ToHashSet();
        var fresh = candidates
            .Where(message => IsJackpot(message) && !known.Contains(message.Id))
            .DistinctBy(message => message.Id)
            .Take(drawn ? int.MaxValue : Math.Max(0, JackpotCapacity - _jackpots.Length))
            .ToList();
        return fresh.Count == 0 ? null : MessageWindow.Merge(_jackpots, fresh, int.MaxValue);
    }

    private int Merge(IReadOnlyCollection<BoardMessage> candidates, SlotSpin? spin, Lists lists, bool drawn)
    {
        var change = lists.HasFlag(Lists.Recent) ? MessageWindow.Merge(_messages, candidates, Capacity) : null;
        var crowned = lists.HasFlag(Lists.Winners) ? MessageWindow.Merge(_winners, candidates.Where(IsWinner), WinnerCapacity) : null;
        var enshrined = lists.HasFlag(Lists.Jackpots) ? Enshrine(candidates, drawn) : null;
        if (change is null && crowned is null && enshrined is null)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var previous = _version;
        _version++;
        if (change is not null)
        {
            Volatile.Write(ref _messages, change.Next);
        }

        if (crowned is not null)
        {
            Volatile.Write(ref _winners, crowned.Next);
        }

        if (enshrined is not null)
        {
            Volatile.Write(ref _jackpots, enshrined.Next);
        }

        Broadcast(SlotUpdate.Delta(
            _version,
            previous,
            change?.Added ?? [],
            change?.Removed ?? [],
            spin,
            crowned?.Added ?? [],
            crowned?.Removed ?? [],
            enshrined?.Added ?? []));
        return (change?.Added ?? [])
            .Concat(crowned?.Added ?? [])
            .Concat(enshrined?.Added ?? [])
            .Select(message => message.Id)
            .Distinct()
            .Count();
    }

    private void Broadcast(SlotUpdate update)
    {
        List<ISlotSubscriber>? dropped = null;
        foreach (var subscriber in _subscribers)
        {
            if (!subscriber.Deliver(update))
            {
                (dropped ??= []).Add(subscriber);
            }
        }

        if (dropped is not null)
        {
            _subscribers.ExceptWith(dropped);
        }
    }

    [Flags]
    private enum Lists
    {
        None = 0,
        Recent = 1,
        Winners = 2,
        Jackpots = 4,
        All = Recent | Winners | Jackpots,
    }
}

export const THEME_KEY = 'playground-theme';
export const MAX_RETRIES = 30;
export const RECONNECTED_EVENTS = Object.freeze(['chaos:reconnected', 'nest:reconnected']);

export const VIEWS = Object.freeze({
    homes: './Pages/HomesPage.razor.js',
    listing: './Pages/ListingPage.razor.js',
});

export const ENHANCERS = Object.freeze([
    { selector: '[data-editor]', path: '../work/editor.js' },
    { selector: '[data-board]', path: '../work/board.js' },
]);

export function viewId(root) {
    return root ? `${root.dataset.view}|${root.dataset.key ?? ''}` : null;
}

export class ViewHost {
    constructor(win, load = path => import(path), shared = () => import('../js/sync.js')) {
        this.win = win;
        this.load = load;
        this.shared = shared;
        this.current = null;
        this.generation = 0;
    }

    async mount() {
        const root = this.win.document.querySelector('[data-view]');
        const id = viewId(root);
        if (this.current && this.current.id === id && this.current.root === root) {
            return;
        }
        this.generation += 1;
        const generation = this.generation;
        this.current?.view.dispose();
        this.current = null;
        const path = root ? VIEWS[root.dataset.view] : undefined;
        if (!path) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            const [{ nest }, module] = await Promise.all([this.shared(), this.load(path)]);
            if (generation !== this.generation) {
                return;
            }
            this.current = { id, root, view: module.mount(root, nest(this.win), this.win) };
        } catch {
        }
    }
}

const enhanced = new WeakSet();

export async function enhance(win, load = path => import(path), seen = enhanced) {
    for (const { selector, path } of ENHANCERS) {
        const elements = [...win.document.querySelectorAll(selector)].filter(element => !seen.has(element));
        if (elements.length === 0) {
            continue;
        }
        try {
            const module = await load(path);
            for (const element of elements) {
                seen.add(element);
                module.mount(element, win);
            }
        } catch {
        }
    }
}

export function storedTheme(storage) {
    try {
        const value = storage?.getItem(THEME_KEY);
        return value === 'light' || value === 'dark' ? value : null;
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

export function toggledTheme(current, prefersDark) {
    const effective = current ?? (prefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
    return effective === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
}

export function reconnectDelay(attempt, random = Math.random) {
    if (attempt <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    const ceiling = Math.min(30000, 1000 * 2 ** (attempt - 1));
    return Math.round(ceiling / 2 + random() * ceiling / 2);
}

export const CLOCK_SYNC_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
export const DRIFT_PER_MS = 0.0001;

export function zoneLabel(offsetMinutes) {
    if (!offsetMinutes) {
        return 'UTC';
    }
    const magnitude = Math.abs(offsetMinutes);
    const hours = String(Math.floor(magnitude / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    const minutes = String(magnitude % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    return `UTC${offsetMinutes < 0 ? '-' : '+'}${hours}:${minutes}`;
}

export function clockLabel(serverMs, offsetMinutes) {
    const iso = new Date(serverMs + offsetMinutes * 60000).toISOString();
    return `${iso.slice(0, 10)} ${iso.slice(11, 19)} ${zoneLabel(offsetMinutes)}`;
}

export function sample(serverMs, start, end, offsetMinutes = 0) {
    const low = Math.min(start, end);
    const high = Math.max(start, end);
    return { offset: serverMs - (low + high) / 2, error: (high - low) / 2, at: high, zone: offsetMinutes };
}

export function uncertainty(current, now) {
    return current ? current.error + Math.max(0, now - current.at) * DRIFT_PER_MS : Infinity;
}

export function better(candidate, current, now) {
    return !current || candidate.error <= uncertainty(current, now);
}

export function untilNextSecond(serverMs) {
    return 1000 - (((Math.floor(serverMs) % 1000) + 1000) % 1000) + 5;
}

export class ServerClock {
    constructor(win) {
        this.win = win;
        this.doc = win.document;
        this.current = null;
        this.timer = 0;
        this.lastPerf = 0;
        this.lastWall = 0;
        this.syncing = null;
        this.syncedAt = -Infinity;
    }

    element() {
        return this.doc.getElementById('server-clock');
    }

    start() {
        const element = this.element();
        const now = Number(element?.dataset.now);
        if (Number.isFinite(now) && now > 0) {
            const navigation = this.win.performance.getEntriesByType?.('navigation')?.[0];
            const start = navigation?.requestStart || 0;
            const end = navigation?.responseStart || this.win.performance.now();
            this.current = sample(now, start, end, Number(element.dataset.offset) || 0);
        }
        this.doc.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
            if (this.doc.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                this.sync(true);
            }
        });
        this.lastPerf = this.win.performance.now();
        this.lastWall = Date.now();
        this.tick();
        this.sync(false);
    }

    async sync(force) {
        const perf = this.win.performance;
        if (this.syncing || (!force && perf.now() - this.syncedAt < CLOCK_SYNC_MS && this.current)) {
            return;
        }
        this.syncing = (async () => {
            try {
                const start = perf.now();
                const response = await this.win.fetch(`/time?n=${Math.round(start)}`, { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'omit' });
                const end = perf.now();
                if (!response.ok) {
                    return;
                }
                const body = await response.json();
                if (!Number.isFinite(body?.unixMs)) {
                    return;
                }
                const candidate = sample(body.unixMs, start, end, Number(body.offsetMinutes) || 0);
                if (force || better(candidate, this.current, end)) {
                    this.current = candidate;
                } else {
                    this.current = { ...this.current, zone: candidate.zone };
                }
                this.syncedAt = end;
                this.render();
            } catch {
            } finally {
                this.syncing = null;
            }
        })();
        await this.syncing;
    }

    now() {
        return this.current ? this.win.performance.now() + this.current.offset : null;
    }

    render() {
        const element = this.element();
        const now = this.now();
        if (!element || now === null) {
            return now;
        }
        element.textContent = clockLabel(now, this.current.zone);
        element.dateTime = new Date(now).toISOString();
        return now;
    }

    tick() {
        const perf = this.win.performance.now();
        const wall = Date.now();
        if (Math.abs((wall - this.lastWall) - (perf - this.lastPerf)) > 2000) {
            this.sync(true);
        }
        this.lastPerf = perf;
        this.lastWall = wall;
        if (perf - this.syncedAt >= CLOCK_SYNC_MS) {
            this.sync(false);
        }
        const now = this.render();
        this.win.clearTimeout(this.timer);
        this.timer = this.win.setTimeout(() => this.tick(), now === null ? 1000 : untilNextSecond(now));
    }
}

export function boot(win) {
    const doc = win.document;
    const darkQuery = win.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');

    const applyTheme = theme => {
        if (theme) {
            doc.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
        } else {
            delete doc.documentElement.dataset.theme;
        }
        const dark = theme ? theme === 'dark' : darkQuery.matches;
        for (const button of doc.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-toggle]')) {
            button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(dark));
        }
    };

    const applyStoredTheme = () => applyTheme(storedTheme(win.localStorage));

    const toggleTheme = () => {
        const next = toggledTheme(doc.documentElement.dataset.theme ?? null, darkQuery.matches);
        try {
            win.localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, next);
        } catch {
        }
        applyTheme(next);
    };

    const retryWhenVisible = () => {
        if (doc.visibilityState === 'visible') {
            retry();
        }
    };

    const retry = async () => {
        doc.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', retryWhenVisible);
        try {
            if (await win.Blazor.reconnect()) {
                return;
            }
            if (await win.Blazor.resumeCircuit()) {
                return;
            }
            win.location.reload();
        } catch {
            doc.addEventListener('visibilitychange', retryWhenVisible);
        }
    };

    const resume = async () => {
        try {
            if (await win.Blazor.resumeCircuit()) {
                return;
            }
        } catch {
        }
        win.location.reload();
    };

    const clearHistory = async button => {
        const output = doc.getElementById(button.dataset.clearHistory);
        button.disabled = true;
        try {
            const [
                { DB_NAME: BOARD_DB, SHARE_KEY, deleteDatabase },
                { DB_NAME: SLOTS_DB, PRESS_KEY },
                { DB_NAME: CANVAS_DB },
                { DB_NAME: LATENCY_DB, RUNS_KEY, NEXT_KEY },
                { DB_NAME: POSTCARD_DB },
                { DB_NAME: READING_DB },
            ] = await Promise.all([
                import('./Islands/BoardIsland.razor.js'),
                import('./Islands/SlotIsland.razor.js'),
                import('./Islands/CanvasIsland.razor.js'),
                import('./Islands/LatencyIsland.razor.js'),
                import('./Islands/PostcardIsland.razor.js'),
                import('./Pages/ReadPage.razor.js'),
            ]);
            const outcomes = await Promise.all([BOARD_DB, POSTCARD_DB, SLOTS_DB, CANVAS_DB, LATENCY_DB, READING_DB].map(name => deleteDatabase(win.indexedDB, name)));
            for (const key of [SHARE_KEY, PRESS_KEY, RUNS_KEY, NEXT_KEY]) {
                try {
                    win.localStorage.removeItem(key);
                } catch {
                }
            }
            if (output) {
                output.textContent = outcomes.includes('blocked')
                    ? 'Close any other board, postcard, canvas, slots, latency or reading tabs to finish clearing.'
                    : 'Local history cleared.';
            }
        } catch {
            if (output) {
                output.textContent = 'Could not clear the local history.';
            }
        } finally {
            button.disabled = false;
        }
    };

    const clearLocal = async button => {
        const output = doc.getElementById(button.dataset.clearLocal);
        button.disabled = true;
        try {
            const [{ DB_NAME, deleteDatabase, draftKeys }, { current }, { MINE_KEY }] = await Promise.all([
                import('../js/store.js'),
                import('../js/sync.js'),
                import('./Pages/HomesPage.razor.js'),
            ]);
            await current()?.clear();
            const outcome = await deleteDatabase(win.indexedDB, DB_NAME);
            for (const key of [...draftKeys(win.localStorage), MINE_KEY]) {
                try {
                    win.localStorage.removeItem(key);
                } catch {
                }
            }
            if (output) {
                output.textContent = outcome === 'blocked'
                    ? 'Close any other homes tabs to finish clearing.'
                    : 'This browser\'s copy of the homes is gone. The server and other browsers keep theirs.';
            }
        } catch {
            if (output) {
                output.textContent = 'Could not clear this browser\'s copy of the homes.';
            }
        } finally {
            button.disabled = false;
        }
    };

    const actions = {
        themeToggle: toggleTheme,
        reconnectRetry: retry,
        reconnectResume: resume,
        reconnectReload: () => win.location.reload(),
        clearHistory,
        clearLocal,
    };

    doc.addEventListener('click', event => {
        const button = event.target instanceof win.Element ? event.target.closest('button') : null;
        if (!button) {
            return;
        }
        for (const [name, action] of Object.entries(actions)) {
            if (name in button.dataset) {
                action(button);
                return;
            }
        }
    });

    doc.getElementById('components-reconnect-modal')?.addEventListener('components-reconnect-state-changed', event => {
        const state = event.detail?.state;
        if (state === 'rejected') {
            win.location.reload();
        } else if (state === 'hide') {
            for (const name of RECONNECTED_EVENTS) {
                win.dispatchEvent(new win.CustomEvent(name));
            }
        } else if (state === 'failed') {
            doc.addEventListener('visibilitychange', retryWhenVisible);
        }
    });

    darkQuery.addEventListener('change', applyStoredTheme);
    applyStoredTheme();

    const clock = new ServerClock(win);
    clock.start();

    const trackReading = () => {
        if (doc.getElementById('reading-history')) {
            import('./Pages/ReadPage.razor.js').then(module => module.track(win)).catch(() => {});
        }
    };
    trackReading();

    const views = new ViewHost(win);
    views.mount();
    enhance(win);

    const afterNavigation = () => {
        applyStoredTheme();
        const announcer = doc.getElementById('announcer');
        if (announcer) {
            announcer.textContent = '';
        }
        clock.render();
        trackReading();
        views.mount();
        enhance(win);
    };

    return win.Blazor.start({
        circuit: {
            reconnectionOptions: {
                maxRetries: MAX_RETRIES,
                retryIntervalMilliseconds: attempt => reconnectDelay(attempt),
            },
        },
    }).then(() => win.Blazor.addEventListener('enhancedload', afterNavigation));
}

if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.Blazor) {
    boot(window);
}

    private static readonly TimeSpan MetaTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);
    private readonly TaskCompletionSource _attached = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    private DotNetObjectReference<BoardIsland>? _self;
    private IJSObjectReference? _module;
    private IJSObjectReference? _client;
    private Outbox<BoardUpdate>? _outbox;
    private Subscriber? _subscriber;
    private string? _draft;
    private string? _status;
    private bool _ready;
    private bool _sending;
    private int _offered;

    [Parameter, EditorRequired]
    public string Client { get; set; } = ClientAddress.Unknown;

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (!firstRender)
        {
            return;
        }

        _self = DotNetObjectReference.Create(this);
        _module = await JS.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("import", ModulePath.Of(Assets["Components/Islands/BoardIsland.razor.js"]));
        _client = await _module.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("attach", _self);
        _attached.TrySetResult();
        _ready = true;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public int Offer(string[] ids, string[] texts, MetaEntry[]?[]? metas)
    {
        if (ids is null || texts is null || ids.Length != texts.Length || (metas is not null && metas.Length != ids.Length))
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var count = Math.Min(BoardService.MaxOffers - _offered, ids.Length);
        if (count <= 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        _offered += count;
        var offered = new List<BoardMessage>(count);
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            if (Guid.TryParseExact(ids[i], "D", out var id) && texts[i] is { } text)
            {
                offered.Add(new BoardMessage(id, text, metas?[i]));
            }
        }

        return Board.Offer(offered);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public async Task Join()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        var outbox = new Outbox<BoardUpdate>(64, 16, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20), SendAsync, Logger);
        _outbox = outbox;
        _subscriber = new Subscriber(outbox);
        Board.Subscribe(_subscriber);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public bool Ping() => _subscriber is not null && _outbox is { IsFaulted: false } && Board.IsSubscribed(_subscriber);

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_client, "dispose");
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_module, null);
        _self?.Dispose();
    }

    private async Task Send()
    {
        if (_sending)
        {
            return;
        }

        _sending = true;
        try
        {
            var meta = await ReadMetaAsync();
            var reply = Board.Submit(_draft, Client, meta);
            _status = reply.Result switch
            {
                PostResult.Empty => "Type a message first.",
                PostResult.TooFast => "Slow down. You can post again in a moment.",
                PostResult.Repeat => "That message was just posted.",
                _ => null,
            };

            if (reply.Message is { } message)
            {
                _draft = null;
                await SentAsync(message.Id);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _sending = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task<MetaEntry[]?> ReadMetaAsync()
    {
        if (_client is null || MessageText.Normalize(_draft).Length == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        try
        {
            using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(MetaTimeout);
            return await _client.InvokeAsync<MetaEntry[]?>("meta", timeout.Token);
        }
        catch (JSDisconnectedException)
        {
            return null;
        }
        catch (JSException)
        {
            return null;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private async Task SentAsync(Guid id)
    {
        if (_client is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            await _client.InvokeVoidAsync("sent", id.ToString("D"));
        }
        catch (JSDisconnectedException)
        {
        }
        catch (JSException)
        {
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
        }
    }

    private async Task SendAsync(IReadOnlyList<BoardUpdate> batch, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await _attached.Task.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
        await InvokeAsync(() => _client is null
            ? Task.FromException(new InvalidOperationException("The board module is not attached."))
            : _client.InvokeVoidAsync("apply", cancellationToken, batch).AsTask());
    }

    private async Task StopAsync()
    {
        if (_subscriber is not null)
        {
            Board.Unsubscribe(_subscriber);
            _subscriber = null;
        }

        if (_outbox is not null)
        {
            await _outbox.DisposeAsync();
            _outbox = null;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Subscriber(Outbox<BoardUpdate> outbox) : IBoardSubscriber
    {
        public bool Deliver(BoardUpdate update) => outbox.TryPost(update);
    }
}

export function timestampOf(id) {
    return Number.parseInt(id.slice(0, 8) + id.slice(9, 13), 16);
}

export function isoOf(id) {
    return new Date(timestampOf(id)).toISOString();
}

export function labelOf(id, now = Date.now()) {
    const iso = isoOf(id);
    const today = new Date(now).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    return iso.slice(0, 10) === today ? iso.slice(11, 19) : `${iso.slice(0, 10)} ${iso.slice(11, 16)}`;
}

export function newestFirst(a, b) {
    if (a.id === b.id) {
        return 0;
    }
    return a.id < b.id ? 1 : -1;
}

export function chunkOffers(messages, maxBytes = OFFER_BYTES, limit = OFFER_LIMIT) {
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const chunks = [];
    let chunk = [];
    let size = 0;
    for (const message of messages.slice(0, limit)) {
        const meta = message.meta ? encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(message.meta)).length : 0;
        const bytes = encoder.encode(message.id).length + encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(message.text)).length + meta + 8;
        if (bytes > maxBytes) {
            continue;
        }
        if (chunk.length > 0 && size + bytes > maxBytes) {
            chunks.push(chunk);
            chunk = [];
            size = 0;
        }
        chunk.push(message);
        size += bytes;
    }
    if (chunk.length > 0) {
        chunks.push(chunk);
    }
    return chunks;
}

export const NOTICE_MS = 6000;
export const REPEAT_MS = 120;

export class StatusLine {
    constructor(element, timers, ms = NOTICE_MS) {
        this.element = element ?? null;
        this.timers = timers;
        this.ms = ms;
        this.owner = null;
        this.timer = 0;
        this.pending = 0;
    }

    show(text, owner = null, ms = owner === null ? this.ms : 0) {
        this.cancel();
        this.owner = text ? owner : null;
        if (!this.element) {
            return;
        }
        if (text && this.element.textContent === text) {
            this.element.textContent = '';
            this.pending = this.timers.setTimeout(() => {
                this.pending = 0;
                this.element.textContent = text;
            }, REPEAT_MS);
        } else {
            this.element.textContent = text;
        }
        if (text && ms > 0) {
            this.timer = this.timers.setTimeout(() => this.clear(), ms);
        }
    }

    clear() {
        this.cancel();
        this.owner = null;
        if (this.element) {
            this.element.textContent = '';
        }
    }

    release(owner) {
        if (this.owner !== null && this.owner === owner) {
            this.clear();
        }
    }

    supersede(owner) {
        if (this.owner !== null && this.owner !== owner) {
            this.clear();
        }
    }

    cancel() {
        this.timers.clearTimeout(this.timer);
        this.timers.clearTimeout(this.pending);
        this.timer = 0;
        this.pending = 0;
    }

    dispose() {
        this.cancel();
    }
}

export function formatOffset(minutesEast) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(minutesEast)) {
        return null;
    }
    const sign = minutesEast < 0 ? '-' : '+';
    const total = Math.abs(Math.trunc(minutesEast));
    return `${sign}${String(Math.trunc(total / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function localStamp(date) {
    const pad = (value, length = 2) => String(value).padStart(length, '0');
    return `${pad(date.getFullYear(), 4)}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}:${pad(date.getSeconds())}`;
}

function numberText(value) {
    return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? String(value) : null;
}

function flag(value) {
    return typeof value === 'boolean' ? (value ? 'yes' : 'no') : null;
}

function size(width, height) {
    return Number.isFinite(width) && Number.isFinite(height) ? `${width}x${height}` : null;
}

function resolvedIntl(win) {
    try {
        return (win.Intl ?? Intl).DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions();
    } catch {
        return {};
    }
}

function mediaQuery(win) {
    return query => {
        try {
            return typeof win.matchMedia === 'function' ? win.matchMedia(query).matches === true : null;
        } catch {
            return null;
        }
    };
}

function firstMatch(media, name, values, fallback) {
    for (const value of values) {
        const matched = media(`(${name}: ${value})`);
        if (matched === null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (matched) {
            return value;
        }
    }
    return fallback;
}

export function collectMeta(position, win, now = new Date()) {
    const coords = position?.coords;
    if (!coords || !Number.isFinite(coords.latitude) || !Number.isFinite(coords.longitude)) {
        return null;
    }
    const nav = win?.navigator ?? {};
    const agent = nav.userAgentData;
    const connection = nav.connection;
    const screen = win?.screen;
    const intl = resolvedIntl(win ?? {});
    const media = mediaQuery(win ?? {});
    const values = {
        latitude: numberText(coords.latitude),
        longitude: numberText(coords.longitude),
        accuracy: numberText(coords.accuracy),
        altitude: numberText(coords.altitude),
        altitudeAccuracy: numberText(coords.altitudeAccuracy),
        heading: numberText(coords.heading),
        speed: numberText(coords.speed),
        positionAt: Number.isFinite(position.timestamp) ? new Date(position.timestamp).toISOString() : null,
        timeZone: intl.timeZone,
        utcOffset: formatOffset(-now.getTimezoneOffset()),
        localTime: localStamp(now),
        locale: intl.locale,
        calendar: intl.calendar,
        numberingSystem: intl.numberingSystem,
        language: nav.language,
        languages: Array.isArray(nav.languages) ? nav.languages.join(', ') : null,
        userAgent: nav.userAgent,
        brands: Array.isArray(agent?.brands) ? agent.brands.map(brand => `${brand.brand} ${brand.version}`).join(', ') : null,
        platform: agent?.platform || nav.platform,
        mobile: flag(agent?.mobile),
        vendor: nav.vendor,
        webdriver: flag(nav.webdriver),
        doNotTrack: nav.doNotTrack,
        globalPrivacyControl: flag(nav.globalPrivacyControl),
        pdfViewer: flag(nav.pdfViewerEnabled),
        screen: size(screen?.width, screen?.height),
        availableScreen: size(screen?.availWidth, screen?.availHeight),
        viewport: size(win?.innerWidth, win?.innerHeight),
        pixelRatio: numberText(win?.devicePixelRatio),
        colorDepth: numberText(screen?.colorDepth),
        orientation: screen?.orientation?.type,
        cores: numberText(nav.hardwareConcurrency),
        memory: numberText(nav.deviceMemory),
        touchPoints: numberText(nav.maxTouchPoints),
        pointer: firstMatch(media, 'pointer', ['coarse', 'fine'], 'none'),
        colorScheme: firstMatch(media, 'prefers-color-scheme', ['dark'], 'light'),
        reducedMotion: flag(media('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')),
        contrast: firstMatch(media, 'prefers-contrast', ['more', 'less'], 'no preference'),
        online: flag(nav.onLine),
        connection: [connection?.effectiveType, connection?.type].filter(value => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0).join(', ') || null,
        downlink: numberText(connection?.downlink),
        rtt: numberText(connection?.rtt),
        saveData: flag(connection?.saveData),
    };
    const entries = [];
    for (const [key] of META_FIELDS) {
        const value = values[key];
        if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0) {
            entries.push({ key, value });
        }
    }
    return entries;
}

export function toRecord(message, mine) {
    const record = { id: message.id, text: message.text };
    if (Array.isArray(message.meta) && message.meta.length > 0) {
        record.meta = message.meta;

export function metaElement(doc, meta) {
    if (!Array.isArray(meta) || meta.length === 0) {
        return null;
    }
    const details = doc.createElement('details');
    details.className = 'meta';
    const summary = doc.createElement('summary');
    summary.textContent = 'Details';
    const list = doc.createElement('dl');
    for (const entry of meta) {
        const row = doc.createElement('div');
        const term = doc.createElement('dt');
        term.textContent = metaLabel(entry.key);
        const value = doc.createElement('dd');
        value.textContent = entry.value;
        row.append(term, value);
        list.append(row);
    }
    details.append(summary, list);
    return details;
}

function settle(request) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
}

function finished(transaction) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
    });
}

export function deleteDatabase(factory, name) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = factory.deleteDatabase(name);
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve('deleted');
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
        request.onblocked = () => resolve('blocked');
    });
}

export function openDatabase(factory, schema = SCHEMA, onClose = () => {}, allowReset = true) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = factory.open(schema.name, schema.version);
        request.onupgradeneeded = event => upgrade(request.result, event.oldVersion, event.newVersion ?? schema.version, schema.migrations);
        request.onsuccess = () => {
            const db = request.result;
            db.onversionchange = () => {
                db.close();
                onClose();
            };
            db.onclose = onClose;
            resolve(db);
        };
        request.onerror = event => {
            if (allowReset && request.error?.name === 'VersionError') {
                event.preventDefault();
                deleteDatabase(factory, schema.name)
                    .then(() => openDatabase(factory, schema, onClose, false))
                    .then(resolve, reject);
                return;
            }
            reject(request.error);
        };
    });
}

export class LocalHistory {
    constructor(factory, schema = SCHEMA) {
        this.factory = factory ?? null;
        this.schema = schema;
        this.db = null;
        this.opening = null;
    }

    database() {
        if (this.db) {
            return Promise.resolve(this.db);
        }
        if (!this.factory) {
            return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
        this.opening ??= openDatabase(this.factory, this.schema, () => {
            this.db = null;
        })
            .then(db => {
                this.db = db;
                return db;
            }, () => {
                this.factory = null;
                return null;
            })
            .finally(() => {
                this.opening = null;
            });
        return this.opening;
    }

    async newest(limit) {
        const db = await this.database();
        if (!db) {
            return [];
        }
        const store = db.transaction(this.schema.store, 'readonly').objectStore(this.schema.store);
        const items = [];
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const request = store.openCursor(null, 'prev');
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                const cursor = request.result;
                if (!cursor || items.length >= limit) {
                    resolve();
                    return;
                }
                items.push(cursor.value);
                cursor.continue();
            };
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
        });
        return items;
    }

    async page(before, limit, skip) {
        const db = await this.database();
        if (!db) {
            return { items: [], last: before, done: true };
        }
        const range = before ? IDBKeyRange.upperBound(before, true) : null;
        const store = db.transaction(this.schema.store, 'readonly').objectStore(this.schema.store);
        const items = [];
        let last = before;
        let done = true;
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const request = store.openCursor(range, 'prev');
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                const cursor = request.result;
                if (!cursor) {
                    resolve();
                    return;
                }
                if (items.length >= limit) {
                    done = false;
                    resolve();
                    return;
                }
                last = cursor.key;
                if (!skip.has(cursor.key)) {
                    items.push(cursor.value);
                }
                cursor.continue();
            };
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
        });
        return { items, last, done };
    }

    async save(messages) {
        const db = await this.database();
        if (!db || messages.length === 0) {
            return;
        }
        const transaction = db.transaction(this.schema.store, 'readwrite');
        const done = finished(transaction);
        const store = transaction.objectStore(this.schema.store);
        for (const message of messages) {
            store.put(message);
        }
        const excess = excessOf(await settle(store.count()), this.schema.cap);
        if (excess > 0) {
            const keys = await settle(store.getAllKeys(null, excess));
            store.delete(IDBKeyRange.upperBound(keys[keys.length - 1]));
        }
        await done;
    }
}

class BoardClient {
