        this.joining = null;
        this.permission = null;
        this.timer = 0;
        this.disposed = false;
        this.onKeyDown = event => this.keyDown(event);
        this.onInput = () => this.recount();
        this.onOlder = () => this.loadOlder();
        this.onReconnected = () => this.join();
        this.onShare = () => this.toggleShare();
        this.onPermission = () => this.permissionChanged();
    }

    async start() {
        this.textarea?.addEventListener('keydown', this.onKeyDown);
        this.textarea?.addEventListener('input', this.onInput);
        this.older?.addEventListener('click', this.onOlder);
        this.win.addEventListener('chaos:reconnected', this.onReconnected);
        this.recount();
        this.timer = this.win.setInterval(() => this.ping(), PING_MS);
        try {
            await this.setupShare();
        } catch {
        }
        try {
            await this.offer();
        } catch {
        }
        await this.join();
    }

    geolocation() {
        return this.win.navigator?.geolocation ?? null;
    }

    async setupShare() {
        if (!this.share || !this.shareBox || !this.geolocation() || this.disposed) {
            return;
        }
        let state = null;
        try {
            this.permission = await this.win.navigator.permissions?.query({ name: 'geolocation' }) ?? null;
            state = this.permission?.state ?? null;
        } catch {
            this.permission = null;
        }
        if (this.disposed) {
            return;
        }
        this.permission?.addEventListener('change', this.onPermission);
        this.share.checked = shareDefault(readShare(this.win.localStorage), state);
        this.share.addEventListener('change', this.onShare);
        this.shareBox.hidden = false;
    }

    setShareStatus(text) {
        if (this.shareStatus) {
            this.shareStatus.textContent = text;
        }
    }

    permissionChanged() {
        if (this.permission?.state === 'denied' && this.share?.checked) {
            this.share.checked = false;
            this.setShareStatus('Location permission was turned off, so nothing is attached.');
        }
    }

    position() {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const geolocation = this.geolocation();
            if (!geolocation) {
                reject(new Error('Geolocation is not available.'));
                return;
            }
            geolocation.getCurrentPosition(resolve, reject, POSITION_OPTIONS);
        });
    }

    async toggleShare() {
        if (!this.share) {
            return;
        }
        if (!this.share.checked) {
            writeShare(this.win.localStorage, 'off');
            this.setShareStatus('Nothing is attached to your messages.');
            return;
        }
        this.share.disabled = true;
        this.setShareStatus('Asking for your location.');
        try {
            await this.position();
            writeShare(this.win.localStorage, 'on');
            this.setShareStatus('Your location and browser details will be attached to your messages.');
        } catch {
            this.share.checked = false;
            this.setShareStatus('No location permission, so nothing is attached.');
        } finally {
            this.share.disabled = false;
        }
    }

    async meta() {
        if (this.disposed || !this.share?.checked) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            return collectMeta(await this.position(), this.win);
        } catch (error) {
            if (error?.code === 1) {
                this.share.checked = false;
            }
            this.setShareStatus('Could not read your location, so that message has no details.');
            return null;
        }
    }

    recount() {
        if (!this.count || !this.textarea || this.disposed) {
            return;
        }
        const max = this.textarea.maxLength;
        const length = this.textarea.value.length;
        this.count.textContent = countText(length, max);
        this.count.classList.toggle('full', max > 0 && length >= max);
    }

    keyDown(event) {
        if (event.key !== 'Enter' || !(event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey)) {
            return;
        }
        event.preventDefault();
        this.textarea.dispatchEvent(new this.win.Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        this.textarea.form?.requestSubmit();
    }

    async offer() {
        const local = await this.history.newest(OFFER_LIMIT * 2);
        for (const record of local) {
            if (record.mine) {
                this.mine.add(record.id);
            }
        }
        for (const chunk of chunkOffers(local)) {
            if (this.disposed) {
                return;
            }
            await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync(
                'Offer',
                chunk.map(message => message.id),
                chunk.map(message => message.text),
                chunk.map(message => (Array.isArray(message.meta) && message.meta.length > 0 ? message.meta : null)));
        }
    }

    join() {
        if (this.disposed) {
            return Promise.resolve();
        }
        this.version = -1;
        this.joining ??= this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Join')
            .catch(() => {})
            .finally(() => {
                this.joining = null;
            });
        return this.joining;
    }

    async ping() {
        if (this.disposed || this.joining) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            if (!(await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Ping'))) {
                await this.join();
            }
        } catch {
        }
    }

    async apply(updates) {
        for (const update of updates) {
            if (this.disposed) {
                return;
            }
            if (update.kind === 'snapshot') {
                await this.snapshot(update);
            } else if (update.kind === 'delta' && this.version >= 0) {
                if (needsResync(this.version, update)) {
                    this.join();
                    return;
                }
                await this.delta(update);
            }
        }
    }

    async save(messages) {
        try {
            await this.history.save(messages.map(message => toRecord(message, this.mine.has(message.id))));
        } catch {
        }
    }

    async snapshot(update) {
        this.version = update.version;
        this.live = new Map(update.added.map(message => [message.id, message]));
        await this.save(update.added);
        let archive = { items: [], last: null, done: true };
        try {
            archive = await this.history.page(null, PAGE_SIZE, this.live);
        } catch {
        }
        this.cursor = archive.last;
        this.remember(archive.items);
        this.render([...update.added, ...archive.items].sort(newestFirst), archive.done);
    }

    async delta(update) {
        this.version = update.version;
        for (const id of update.removed) {
            this.live.delete(id);
            this.shown.get(id)?.classList.add('archived');
        }
        const fresh = [];
        for (const message of update.added) {
            this.live.set(message.id, message);
            const existing = this.shown.get(message.id);
            if (existing) {
                existing.classList.remove('archived');
            } else {
                this.insert(message, true);
                fresh.push(message);
            }
        }
        this.updateEmpty();
        this.announce(fresh);
        await this.save(update.added);
    }

    async sent(id) {
        if (this.textarea && !this.disposed) {
            this.textarea.value = '';
        }
        this.recount();
        await this.own(id);
    }

    async own(id) {
        if (this.disposed || typeof id !== 'string') {
            return;
        }
        this.mine.add(id);
        const existing = this.shown.get(id);
        const message = this.live.get(id);
        if (existing && message) {
            const element = this.item(message, existing.classList.contains('fresh'));
            existing.replaceWith(element);
            this.shown.set(id, element);
        }
        if (message) {
            await this.save([message]);
        }
    }

    remember(records) {
        for (const record of records) {
            if (record.mine) {
                this.mine.add(record.id);
            }
        }
    }

    async loadOlder() {
        if (!this.older) {
            return;
        }
        this.older.disabled = true;
        try {
            const archive = await this.history.page(this.cursor, PAGE_SIZE, this.live);
            this.cursor = archive.last ?? this.cursor;
            this.remember(archive.items);
            for (const message of archive.items) {
                if (!this.shown.has(message.id)) {
                    this.insert(message, false);
                }
            }
            this.older.hidden = archive.done;
        } catch {
            this.older.hidden = true;
        } finally {
            this.older.disabled = false;
        }
    }

    item(message, fresh) {
        const mine = this.mine.has(message.id) || message.mine === true;
        const element = this.doc.createElement('li');
        element.className = 'msg';
        element.classList.toggle('archived', !this.live.has(message.id));
        element.classList.toggle('fresh', fresh);
        element.classList.toggle('mine', mine);
        element.dataset.id = message.id;
        const head = this.doc.createElement('div');
        head.className = 'head';
        const time = this.doc.createElement('time');
        time.dateTime = isoOf(message.id);
        time.textContent = labelOf(message.id);
        head.append(time);
        if (mine) {
            const yours = this.doc.createElement('span');
            yours.className = 'yours';
            yours.textContent = 'Your message';
            head.append(yours);
        }
        const text = this.doc.createElement('p');
        text.className = 'text';
        text.textContent = message.text;
        element.append(head, text);
        const details = metaElement(this.doc, message.meta);
        if (details) {
            element.append(details);
        }
        return element;
    }

    insert(message, fresh) {
        const element = this.item(message, fresh);
        let next = this.feed.firstElementChild;
        while (next && next.dataset.id > message.id) {
            next = next.nextElementSibling;
        }
        this.feed.insertBefore(element, next);
        this.shown.set(message.id, element);
    }

    render(messages, done) {
        this.shown.clear();
        const fragment = this.doc.createDocumentFragment();
        for (const message of messages) {
            const element = this.item(message, false);
            this.shown.set(message.id, element);
            fragment.append(element);
        }
        this.feed.replaceChildren(fragment);
        if (this.older) {
            this.older.hidden = done;
        }
        this.updateEmpty();
    }

    announce(messages) {
        if (this.disposed || !this.feed?.isConnected || messages.length === 0) {
            return;
        }
        const newest = [...messages].sort(newestFirst)[0];
        announce(this.doc, `New message: ${newest.text.slice(0, 140)}`);
    }

    updateEmpty() {
        if (this.empty) {
            this.empty.hidden = this.shown.size > 0;
        }
    }

    dispose() {
        this.disposed = true;
        this.win.clearInterval(this.timer);
        this.textarea?.removeEventListener('keydown', this.onKeyDown);
        this.textarea?.removeEventListener('input', this.onInput);
        this.older?.removeEventListener('click', this.onOlder);
        this.share?.removeEventListener('change', this.onShare);
        this.permission?.removeEventListener('change', this.onPermission);
        this.win.removeEventListener('chaos:reconnected', this.onReconnected);
    }
}

export function attach(dotnet) {
    const client = new BoardClient(dotnet, document, window);
    client.start();
    return {
        apply: updates => client.apply(updates),
        meta: () => client.meta(),
        sent: id => client.sent(id),
        dispose: () => client.dispose(),
    };
}

@implements IAsyncDisposable
@inject CanvasService Canvas
@inject IJSRuntime JS
@inject ILogger<CanvasIsland> Logger

<div class="stage">
    <canvas @ref="_canvas" class="paper" width="1024" height="1024" role="img"
            aria-label="Shared drawing canvas. Drawing needs a mouse, a finger or a stylus."></canvas>
</div>

    <output class="status">@_status</output>

@code {
    private const int MaxResetOffers = 4;

    private ElementReference _canvas;
    private readonly TaskCompletionSource _attached = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    private DotNetObjectReference<CanvasIsland>? _self;
    private IJSObjectReference? _module;
    private IJSObjectReference? _client;
    private Outbox<CanvasUpdate>? _outbox;
    private Subscriber? _subscriber;
    private CanvasSession? _session;
    private string? _status;
    private bool _ready;
    private int _offeredStrokes;
    private int _offeredPoints;
    private int _offeredResets;

    [Parameter, EditorRequired]
    public string Client { get; set; } = ClientAddress.Unknown;

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (!firstRender)
        {
            return;
        }

        _self = DotNetObjectReference.Create(this);
        _module = await JS.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("import", ModulePath.Of(Assets["Components/Islands/CanvasIsland.razor.js"]));
        _client = await _module.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("attach", _canvas, _self);
        _attached.TrySetResult();
        _ready = true;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public async Task Join()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        var outbox = new Outbox<CanvasUpdate>(256, 64, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20), SendAsync, Logger);
        _outbox = outbox;
        _subscriber = new Subscriber(outbox);
        _session = Canvas.OpenSession(_subscriber);
        Canvas.Subscribe(_subscriber);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public string Draw(int stroke, int epoch, int[] points, bool end)
    {
        if (_session is null || points is null)
        {
            return DrawReply.Format(DrawResult.Invalid, Guid.Empty);
        }

        var result = Canvas.Draw(_session, epoch, stroke, points, end);
        SetStatus(result switch
        {
            DrawResult.TooFast => "Slow down a little.",
            DrawResult.Full => "The canvas is full. Reset it to keep drawing.",
            DrawResult.TooLong => "That stroke got too long, so it ended.",
            _ => null,
        });
        return DrawReply.Format(result, _session.LastStroke);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public bool OfferReset(string id)
    {
        if (_offeredResets >= MaxResetOffers || !Guid.TryParseExact(id, "D", out var reset))
        {
            return false;
        }

        _offeredResets++;
        return Canvas.OfferReset(reset);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public int OfferStrokes(string[] ids, int[][] points)
    {
        if (ids is null || points is null || ids.Length != points.Length)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var offered = new List<StrokeOffer>(ids.Length);
        for (var i = 0; i < ids.Length && _offeredStrokes < CanvasService.MaxOfferedStrokes; i++)
        {
            if (points[i] is not { } stroke || _offeredPoints + (stroke.Length / 2) > Canvas.MaxPoints)
            {
                continue;
            }

            _offeredStrokes++;
            _offeredPoints += stroke.Length / 2;
            if (Guid.TryParseExact(ids[i], "D", out var id))
            {
                offered.Add(new StrokeOffer(id, stroke));
            }
        }

        return offered.Count == 0 ? 0 : Canvas.OfferStrokes(offered);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public bool Ping() => _subscriber is not null && _outbox is { IsFaulted: false } && Canvas.IsSubscribed(_subscriber);

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_client, "dispose");
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_module, null);
        _self?.Dispose();
    }

    private void Reset()
    {
        _status = Canvas.Reset(Client) is ResetResult.TooFast ? "It was just reset. Try again in a second." : null;
    }

    private void SetStatus(string? status)
    {
        if (status != _status)
        {
            _status = status;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task SendAsync(IReadOnlyList<CanvasUpdate> batch, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await _attached.Task.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
        await InvokeAsync(() =>
        {
            if (_client is null)
            {
                return Task.FromException(new InvalidOperationException("The canvas module is not attached."));
            }

            if (batch.Any(update => update.Kind == "reset"))
            {
                SetStatus(null);
            }

            return _client.InvokeVoidAsync("apply", cancellationToken, batch).AsTask();
        });
    }

    private async Task StopAsync()
    {
        if (_session is not null)
        {
            Canvas.Abandon(_session);
            _session = null;
        }

        if (_subscriber is not null)
        {
            Canvas.Unsubscribe(_subscriber);
            _subscriber = null;
        }

        if (_outbox is not null)
        {
            await _outbox.DisposeAsync();
            _outbox = null;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Subscriber(Outbox<CanvasUpdate> outbox) : ICanvasSubscriber
    {
        public bool Deliver(CanvasUpdate update) => outbox.TryPost(update);
    }
}

import { deleteDatabase, excessOf, openDatabase, timestampOf } from './BoardIsland.razor.js';

export const RESOLUTION = 4095;
export const BRUSH = 0.006;
export const FLUSH_MS = 50;
export const MAX_BATCH = 256;
export const MAX_STROKE = 2000;
export const MIN_STEP = 3;
export const PALM_SIZE = 40;
export const PEN_GRACE_MS = 1500;
export const PING_MS = 25000;
export const DB_NAME = 'chaos-canvas';
export const DB_VERSION = 1;
export const STROKES = 'strokes';
export const META = 'meta';
export const LOCAL_CAP = 10000;
export const OFFER_LIMIT = 500;
export const OFFER_BYTES = 24000;

export const migrations = [
    db => {
        db.createObjectStore(STROKES, { keyPath: 'id' });
        db.createObjectStore(META, { keyPath: 'key' });
    },
];

export const SCHEMA = Object.freeze({ name: DB_NAME, version: DB_VERSION, store: STROKES, migrations, cap: LOCAL_CAP });

export { deleteDatabase };

export const Result = Object.freeze({
    Accepted: 0,
    Stale: 1,
    TooFast: 2,
    Invalid: 3,
    Full: 4,
    TooLong: 5,
});

export function quantize(value) {
    return Math.round(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value)) * RESOLUTION);
}

export function toPoint(clientX, clientY, rect) {
    return [quantize((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width), quantize((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height)];
}

export function farEnough(points, x, y, minStep = MIN_STEP) {
    const length = points.length;
    if (length < 2) {
        return true;
    }
    return Math.hypot(x - points[length - 2], y - points[length - 1]) >= minStep;
}

export function isPalm(event, lastPenAt, now) {
    if (event.pointerType !== 'touch') {
        return false;
    }
    if (now - lastPenAt < PEN_GRACE_MS) {
        return true;
    }
    return event.width > PALM_SIZE || event.height > PALM_SIZE;
}

export function backingSize(cssSize, ratio) {
    return Math.max(1, Math.round(cssSize * ratio));
}

export function brushWidth(size) {
    return Math.max(1, size * BRUSH);
}

export function unseen(have, offset, points) {
    if (offset > have) {
        return null;
    }
    const skip = (have - offset) * 2;
    return skip >= points.length ? [] : points.slice(skip);
}

export function parseDrawReply(reply) {
    if (typeof reply !== 'string') {
        return { result: Result.Invalid, stroke: null };
    }
    const [code, stroke] = reply.split(' ');
    const result = Number.parseInt(code, 10);
    return {
        result: Number.isInteger(result) ? result : Result.Invalid,
        stroke: result === Result.Accepted && isUuid7(stroke) ? stroke : null,
    };
}

export function isUuid7(id) {
    return typeof id === 'string' && /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(id);
}

export function timeKey(milliseconds) {
    const hex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(milliseconds)).toString(16).padStart(12, '0');
    return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}`;
}

export function later(a, b) {
    if (!a) {
        return b ?? null;
    }
    if (!b) {
        return a;
    }
    return a > b ? a : b;
}

export function shouldOfferReset(local, server, started) {
    return isUuid7(local) && (!server || local > server) && timestampOf(local) < started;
}

export function pickOffers(strokes, known, floor, started, room, limit = OFFER_LIMIT) {
    const picked = [];
    let budget = room;
    for (const stroke of strokes) {
        if (picked.length >= limit) {
            break;
        }
        const count = stroke.points.length / 2;
        if (!isUuid7(stroke.id) || known.has(stroke.id) || (floor && stroke.id <= floor) || timestampOf(stroke.id) >= started || count === 0 || count > budget) {
            continue;
        }
        picked.push(stroke);
        budget -= count;
    }
    return picked;
}

export function chunkStrokes(strokes, maxBytes = OFFER_BYTES) {
    const chunks = [];
    let chunk = [];
    let size = 0;
    for (const stroke of strokes) {
        const bytes = stroke.id.length + 8 + stroke.points.length * 5;
        if (bytes > maxBytes) {
            continue;
        }
        if (chunk.length > 0 && size + bytes > maxBytes) {
            chunks.push(chunk);
            chunk = [];
            size = 0;
        }
        chunk.push(stroke);
        size += bytes;
    }
    if (chunk.length > 0) {
        chunks.push(chunk);
    }
    return chunks;
}

function settle(request) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
}

function finished(transaction) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
    });
}

export class StrokeHistory {
    constructor(factory, schema = SCHEMA) {
        this.factory = factory ?? null;
        this.schema = schema;
        this.db = null;
        this.opening = null;
    }

    database() {
        if (this.db) {
            return Promise.resolve(this.db);
        }
        if (!this.factory) {
            return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
        this.opening ??= openDatabase(this.factory, this.schema, () => {
            this.db = null;
        })
            .then(db => {
                this.db = db;
                return db;
            }, () => {
                this.factory = null;
                return null;
            })
            .finally(() => {
                this.opening = null;
            });
        return this.opening;
    }

    async reset() {
        const db = await this.database();
        if (!db) {
            return null;
        }
        const record = await settle(db.transaction(META, 'readonly').objectStore(META).get('reset'));
        return record?.id ?? null;
    }

    async setReset(id) {
        const db = await this.database();
        if (!db || !isUuid7(id)) {
            return;
        }
        const transaction = db.transaction([META, STROKES], 'readwrite');
        const done = finished(transaction);
        const meta = transaction.objectStore(META);
        const current = await settle(meta.get('reset'));
        if (!current?.id || id > current.id) {
            meta.put({ key: 'reset', id });
            transaction.objectStore(STROKES).delete(IDBKeyRange.upperBound(id));
        }
        await done;
    }

    async save(strokes) {
        const db = await this.database();
        const usable = strokes.filter(stroke => isUuid7(stroke.id) && stroke.points.length > 0);
        if (!db || usable.length === 0) {
            return;
        }
        const transaction = db.transaction([META, STROKES], 'readwrite');
        const done = finished(transaction);
        const reset = (await settle(transaction.objectStore(META).get('reset')))?.id ?? null;
        const store = transaction.objectStore(STROKES);
        for (const stroke of usable) {
            if (!reset || stroke.id > reset) {
                store.put({ id: stroke.id, points: Uint16Array.from(stroke.points) });
            }
        }
        const excess = excessOf(await settle(store.count()), this.schema.cap);
        if (excess > 0) {
            const keys = await settle(store.getAllKeys(null, excess));
            store.delete(IDBKeyRange.upperBound(keys[keys.length - 1]));
        }
        await done;
    }

    async candidates(floor, started, known, limit) {
        const db = await this.database();
        if (!db) {
            return [];
        }
        const upper = timeKey(started);
        if (floor && floor >= upper) {
            return [];
        }
        const range = floor ? IDBKeyRange.bound(floor, upper, true, true) : IDBKeyRange.upperBound(upper, true);
        const store = db.transaction(STROKES, 'readonly').objectStore(STROKES);
        const items = [];
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const request = store.openCursor(range, 'prev');
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                const cursor = request.result;
                if (!cursor || items.length >= limit) {
                    resolve();
                    return;
                }
                if (!known.has(cursor.key)) {
                    items.push({ id: cursor.value.id, points: Array.from(cursor.value.points) });
                }
                cursor.continue();
            };
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
        });
        return items;
    }
}

export function drawPath(context, size, points, from) {
    if (points.length === 0 || from >= points.length) {
        return;
    }
    const scale = size / RESOLUTION;
    context.beginPath();
    if (points.length === 2) {
        context.arc(points[0] * scale, points[1] * scale, context.lineWidth / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fill();
        return;
    }
    const start = Math.max(0, from - 2);
    context.moveTo(points[start] * scale, points[start + 1] * scale);
    for (let index = start + 2; index < points.length; index += 2) {
        context.lineTo(points[index] * scale, points[index + 1] * scale);
    }
    context.stroke();
}

class CanvasClient {
    constructor(canvas, dotnet, win) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.dotnet = dotnet;
        this.win = win;
        this.context = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.history = new StrokeHistory(win.indexedDB);
        this.epoch = 0;
        this.size = 0;
        this.strokes = new Map();
        this.localId = 0;
        this.active = null;
        this.queue = [];
        this.sending = false;
        this.flushTimer = 0;
        this.lastPenAt = -Infinity;
        this.joining = null;
        this.timer = 0;
        this.observer = null;
        this.ratioQuery = null;
        this.persisting = Promise.resolve();
        this.offeredResets = new Set();
        this.disposed = false;
        this.handlers = {
            pointerdown: event => this.down(event),
            pointermove: event => this.move(event),
            pointerup: event => this.up(event),
            pointercancel: event => this.up(event),
            lostpointercapture: event => this.up(event),
            contextmenu: event => event.preventDefault(),
            contextrestored: () => this.redraw(),
        };
        this.onRatio = () => {
            this.watchRatio();
            this.resize();
        };
        this.onReconnected = () => this.join();
    }

    start() {
        for (const [name, handler] of Object.entries(this.handlers)) {
            this.canvas.addEventListener(name, handler);
        }
        this.observer = new this.win.ResizeObserver(() => this.resize());
        this.observer.observe(this.canvas);
        this.watchRatio();
        this.win.addEventListener('chaos:reconnected', this.onReconnected);
        this.timer = this.win.setInterval(() => this.ping(), PING_MS);
        this.resize();
        this.join();
    }

    watchRatio() {
        this.ratioQuery?.removeEventListener('change', this.onRatio);
        this.ratioQuery = this.win.matchMedia(`(resolution: ${this.win.devicePixelRatio || 1}dppx)`);
        this.ratioQuery.addEventListener('change', this.onRatio);
    }

    resize() {
        const width = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect().width;
        if (width === 0) {
            return;
        }
        const size = backingSize(width, this.win.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        if (size === this.size) {
            return;
        }
        this.size = size;
        this.canvas.width = size;
        this.canvas.height = size;
        this.redraw();
    }

    prepare() {
        this.context.lineWidth = brushWidth(this.size);
        this.context.lineCap = 'round';
        this.context.lineJoin = 'round';
        this.context.strokeStyle = '#000';
        this.context.fillStyle = '#000';
    }

    redraw() {
        this.prepare();
        this.context.clearRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);
        for (const points of this.strokes.values()) {
            drawPath(this.context, this.size, points, 0);
        }
    }

    join() {
        if (this.disposed) {
            return Promise.resolve();
        }
        this.joining ??= this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Join')
            .catch(() => {})
            .finally(() => {
                this.joining = null;
            });
        return this.joining;
    }

    async ping() {
        if (this.disposed || this.joining) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            if (!(await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Ping'))) {
                await this.join();
            }
        } catch {
        }
    }

    apply(updates) {
        for (const update of updates) {
            if (this.disposed) {
                return;
            }
            if (update.kind === 'snapshot') {
                this.snapshot(update);
            } else if (update.kind === 'reset') {
                this.clear(update.epoch);
                this.persist(() => this.history.setReset(update.reset));
            } else if (update.kind === 'stroke') {
                this.remote(update);
            } else if (update.kind === 'merge') {
                this.merge(update);
            }
        }
    }

    persist(work) {
        this.persisting = this.persisting.then(() => (this.disposed ? null : work())).catch(() => {});
        return this.persisting;
    }

    snapshot(update) {
        this.clear(update.epoch);
        const known = new Set();
        for (const stroke of update.strokes ?? []) {
            this.strokes.set(`r${stroke.id}`, [...stroke.points]);
            known.add(stroke.id);
        }
        this.redraw();
        this.canvas.dataset.ready = '';
        const done = (update.strokes ?? []).filter(stroke => stroke.done);
        this.persist(() => this.restore(update, known, done));
    }

    async restore(update, known, done) {
        const server = update.reset ?? null;
        if (server) {
            await this.history.setReset(server);
        }
        await this.history.save(done);
        const local = await this.history.reset();
        if (shouldOfferReset(local, server, update.started) && !this.offeredResets.has(local)) {
            this.offeredResets.add(local);
            if (await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('OfferReset', local)) {
                return;
            }
        }
        if (this.disposed || update.epoch !== this.epoch) {
            return;
        }
        const floor = later(server, local);
        const candidates = await this.history.candidates(floor, update.started, known, OFFER_LIMIT);
        const offers = pickOffers(candidates, known, floor, update.started, update.room ?? 0);
        for (const chunk of chunkStrokes(offers)) {
            if (this.disposed || update.epoch !== this.epoch) {
                return;
            }
            await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('OfferStrokes', chunk.map(stroke => stroke.id), chunk.map(stroke => stroke.points));
        }
    }

    clear(epoch) {
        this.epoch = epoch;
        this.strokes.clear();
        this.active = null;
        this.queue = [];
        this.redraw();
    }

    merge(update) {
        if (update.epoch !== this.epoch) {
            return;
        }
        const fresh = [];
        for (const stroke of update.strokes ?? []) {
            const key = `r${stroke.id}`;
            if (this.strokes.has(key)) {
                continue;
            }
            const points = [...stroke.points];
            this.strokes.set(key, points);
            drawPath(this.context, this.size, points, 0);
            fresh.push({ id: stroke.id, points });
        }
        this.persist(() => this.history.save(fresh));
    }

    remote(update) {
        if (update.epoch !== this.epoch) {
            return;
        }
        const key = `r${update.stroke}`;
        let points = this.strokes.get(key);
        if (!points) {
            if (update.offset !== 0) {
                this.join();
                return;
            }
            points = [];
            this.strokes.set(key, points);
        }
        const fresh = unseen(points.length / 2, update.offset, update.points);
        if (fresh === null) {
            this.join();
            return;
        }
        if (fresh.length > 0) {
            const from = points.length;
            points.push(...fresh);
            drawPath(this.context, this.size, points, from);
        }
        if (update.done) {
            const stroke = { id: update.stroke, points: [...points] };
            this.persist(() => this.history.save([stroke]));
        }
    }

    down(event) {
        if (this.active || this.epoch === 0 || !event.isPrimary) {
            return;
        }
        if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' && event.button !== 0) {
            return;
        }
        if (event.pointerType === 'pen') {
            this.lastPenAt = event.timeStamp;
        }
        if (isPalm(event, this.lastPenAt, event.timeStamp)) {
            return;
        }
        event.preventDefault();
        this.canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        this.localId += 1;
        const points = [];
        this.strokes.set(`l${this.localId}`, points);
        this.active = { pointerId: event.pointerId, id: this.localId, epoch: this.epoch, points, sent: 0, ended: false, stroke: null };
        this.queue.push(this.active);
        this.add(event);
    }

    move(event) {
        if (!this.active || event.pointerId !== this.active.pointerId) {
            return;
        }
        const samples = typeof event.getCoalescedEvents === 'function' ? event.getCoalescedEvents() : [];
        for (const sample of samples.length > 0 ? samples : [event]) {
            if (!this.active) {
                return;
            }
            this.add(sample);
        }
    }

    up(event) {
        if (this.active && event.pointerId === this.active.pointerId) {
            this.finish();
        }
    }

    add(event) {
        const record = this.active;
        const [x, y] = toPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect());
        if (!farEnough(record.points, x, y)) {
            return;
        }
        if (record.points.length / 2 >= MAX_STROKE) {
            this.finish();
            return;
        }
        const from = record.points.length;
        record.points.push(x, y);
        drawPath(this.context, this.size, record.points, from);
        this.schedule();
    }

    finish() {
        if (!this.active) {
            return;
        }
        this.active.ended = true;
        this.active = null;
        this.flush();
    }

    schedule() {
        if (this.flushTimer) {
            return;
        }
        this.flushTimer = this.win.setTimeout(() => {
            this.flushTimer = 0;
            this.flush();
        }, FLUSH_MS);
    }

    async flush() {
        if (this.sending || this.disposed) {
            return;
        }
        const record = this.queue[0];
        if (!record) {
            return;
        }
        const total = record.points.length / 2;
        const count = Math.min(MAX_BATCH, total - record.sent);
        const end = record.ended && record.sent + count === total;
        if (count === 0 && !end) {
            return;
        }
        const points = record.points.slice(record.sent * 2, (record.sent + count) * 2);
        this.sending = true;
        let reply = { result: Result.Invalid, stroke: null };
        try {
            reply = parseDrawReply(await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Draw', record.id, record.epoch, points, end));
        } catch {
            reply = { result: Result.Invalid, stroke: null };
        } finally {
            this.sending = false;
        }
        if (reply.result === Result.Accepted) {
            record.stroke ??= reply.stroke;
            record.sent += count;
            if (end) {
                this.drop(record);
                this.keep(record);
            }
        } else {
            this.drop(record);
            if (this.active === record) {
                this.active = null;
            }
            if (reply.result !== Result.Stale && reply.result !== Result.Invalid) {
                this.keep(record);
            }
            if (reply.result !== Result.Stale) {
                this.join();
            }
        }
        if (this.queue.length > 0) {
            this.schedule();
        }
    }

    keep(record) {
        if (!record.stroke || record.sent === 0) {
            return;
        }
        const stroke = { id: record.stroke, points: record.points.slice(0, record.sent * 2) };
        this.persist(() => this.history.save([stroke]));
    }

    drop(record) {
        const index = this.queue.indexOf(record);
        if (index >= 0) {
            this.queue.splice(index, 1);
        }
    }

    dispose() {
        this.disposed = true;
        for (const [name, handler] of Object.entries(this.handlers)) {
            this.canvas.removeEventListener(name, handler);
        }
        this.observer?.disconnect();
        this.ratioQuery?.removeEventListener('change', this.onRatio);
        this.win.removeEventListener('chaos:reconnected', this.onReconnected);
        this.win.clearInterval(this.timer);
        this.win.clearTimeout(this.flushTimer);
    }
}

export function attach(canvas, dotnet) {
    const client = new CanvasClient(canvas, dotnet, window);
    client.start();
    return {
        apply: updates => client.apply(updates),
        dispose: () => client.dispose(),
    };
}

    private ElementReference _panel;
    private readonly TaskCompletionSource _attached = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    private DotNetObjectReference<LatencyIsland>? _self;
    private IJSObjectReference? _module;
    private IJSObjectReference? _client;
    private Outbox<LatencyUpdate>? _outbox;
    private Subscriber? _subscriber;
    private int _offered;
    private int _offeredLeaders;

    [Parameter, EditorRequired]
    public string Client { get; set; } = ClientAddress.Unknown;

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (!firstRender)
        {
            return;
        }

        _self = DotNetObjectReference.Create(this);
        _module = await JS.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("import", ModulePath.Of(Assets["Components/Islands/LatencyIsland.razor.js"]));
        _client = await _module.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("attach", _panel, _self);
        _attached.TrySetResult();
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public int Offer(string[] ids, string[] texts) => Latency.Offer(Parse(ids, texts, LatencyService.MaxOffers, ref _offered));

    [JSInvokable]
    public int OfferLeaders(string[] ids, string[] texts) => Latency.OfferLeaders(Parse(ids, texts, LatencyService.MaxLeaderOffers, ref _offeredLeaders));

    [JSInvokable]
    public async Task Join()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        var outbox = new Outbox<LatencyUpdate>(64, 16, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20), SendAsync, Logger);
        _outbox = outbox;
        _subscriber = new Subscriber(outbox);
        Latency.Subscribe(_subscriber);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public string Begin() => Latency.Begin(Client).Reply;

    [JSInvokable]
    public bool Finish(string id, int[] browser) =>
        Guid.TryParseExact(id, "D", out var run) && Latency.Finish(run, browser);

    [JSInvokable]
    public bool Ping() => _subscriber is not null && _outbox is { IsFaulted: false } && Latency.IsSubscribed(_subscriber);

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_client, "dispose");
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_module, null);
        _self?.Dispose();
    }

    private static List<BoardMessage> Parse(string[]? ids, string[]? texts, int limit, ref int used)
    {
        if (ids is null || texts is null || ids.Length != texts.Length)
        {
            return [];
        }

        var count = Math.Min(limit - used, ids.Length);
        if (count <= 0)
        {
            return [];
        }

        used += count;
        var offered = new List<BoardMessage>(count);
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            if (Guid.TryParseExact(ids[i], "D", out var id) && texts[i] is { } text)
            {
                offered.Add(new BoardMessage(id, text));
            }
        }

        return offered;
    }

    private async Task SendAsync(IReadOnlyList<LatencyUpdate> batch, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await _attached.Task.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
        await InvokeAsync(() => _client is null
            ? Task.FromException(new InvalidOperationException("The latency module is not attached."))
            : _client.InvokeVoidAsync("apply", cancellationToken, batch).AsTask());
    }

    private async Task StopAsync()
    {
        if (_subscriber is not null)
        {
            Latency.Unsubscribe(_subscriber);
            _subscriber = null;
        }

        if (_outbox is not null)
        {
            await _outbox.DisposeAsync();
            _outbox = null;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Subscriber(Outbox<LatencyUpdate> outbox) : ILatencySubscriber
    {
        public bool Deliver(LatencyUpdate update) => outbox.TryPost(update);
    }
}

export const DB_NAME = 'chaos-latency';
export const DB_VERSION = 1;
export const STORE = 'runs';
export const LOCAL_CAP = 10000;
export const PING_MS = 25000;
export const RUNS_KEY = 'chaos-latency-runs';
export const NEXT_KEY = 'chaos-latency-next';
export const AUTO_UNLOCK = 10;
export const SAMPLES = 3;
export const PARALLEL = 6;
export const REQUEST_MS = 4000;
export const MAX_MS = 60000;

export const FAST_BELOW = 10;

    { key: 'fastJackpots', id: 'latency-jackpot-winners', jackpot: 'fast' },

    db => db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: 'id' }),

export const SCHEMA = Object.freeze({ name: DB_NAME, version: DB_VERSION, store: STORE, migrations, cap: LOCAL_CAP });

const KEY = /^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$/;
const VALUE = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,4})?$/;

function value(text) {
    if (!VALUE.test(text)) {
        return undefined;
    }
    if (text === '') {
        return null;
    }
    const number = Number.parseInt(text, 10);
    return number <= MAX_MS ? number : undefined;
}

export function parseRun(text) {
    if (typeof text !== 'string' || text.length === 0 || text.length > 4096) {
        return null;
    }
    const entries = text.split(';');
    if (entries.length > 64) {
        return null;
    }
    const keys = new Set();
    const results = [];
    for (const entry of entries) {
        const equals = entry.indexOf('=');
        if (equals <= 0) {
            return null;
        }
        const key = entry.slice(0, equals);
        const values = entry.slice(equals + 1).split(',');
        if (!KEY.test(key) || keys.has(key) || values.length !== 2) {
            return null;
        }
        const browser = value(values[0]);
        const server = value(values[1]);
        if (browser === undefined || server === undefined) {
            return null;
        }
        keys.add(key);
        results.push({ key, browser, server });
    }
    return results;
}

export function median(values) {
    const sorted = values.filter(item => Number.isInteger(item)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    if (sorted.length === 0) {
        return null;
    }
    const middle = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
    return sorted.length % 2 === 1 ? sorted[middle] : Math.round((sorted[middle - 1] + sorted[middle]) / 2);
}

export function summarize(results) {
    return {
        browser: median(results.map(result => result.browser)),
        server: median(results.map(result => result.server)),
        answered: results.filter(result => result.browser !== null || result.server !== null).length,
        total: results.length,
    };
}

export function rank(results) {
    const quorum = Math.ceil(results.length / 2);
    const counted = values => (values.filter(item => Number.isInteger(item)).length >= quorum ? median(values) : null);
    return {
        browser: counted(results.map(result => result.browser)),
        server: counted(results.map(result => result.server)),
    };
}

export function isFast(value) {
    return Number.isInteger(value) && value < FAST_BELOW;
}

export function isSlow(value) {
    return Number.isInteger(value) && value >= SLOW_FROM;
}

export function qualifies(value, jackpot) {
    return jackpot === 'fast' ? isFast(value) : isSlow(value);
}

function byId(a, b) {
    return a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0;
}

export function leadersOf(records, limit = LEADER_OFFERS) {
    const scored = [];
    for (const record of records) {
        const results = typeof record?.id === 'string' ? parseRun(record.text) : null;
        if (results) {
            scored.push({ id: record.id, record, rank: rank(results) });
        }
    }
    const chosen = new Map();
    for (const side of SIDES) {
        const ranked = scored.filter(item => item.rank[side] !== null);
        const fastest = [...ranked].sort((a, b) => a.rank[side] - b.rank[side] || byId(a, b));
        const slowest = [...ranked].sort((a, b) => b.rank[side] - a.rank[side] || byId(a, b));
        for (const item of [...fastest.slice(0, limit), ...slowest.slice(0, limit)]) {
            chosen.set(item.id, item.record);
        }
    }
    return [...chosen.values()];
}

export function boardIds(boards) {
    return Object.fromEntries(BOARDS.map(board => [board.key, Array.isArray(boards?.[board.key]) ? boards[board.key] : []]));
}

export function readAll(db, store) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = db.transaction(store, 'readonly').objectStore(store).getAll();
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
}

export function ms(value) {
    return Number.isInteger(value) ? `${value} ms` : '–';
}

export function parseStartReply(reply) {
    if (reply === 'busy') {
        return { kind: 'busy' };
    }
    const parts = typeof reply === 'string' ? reply.split(' ') : [];
    if (parts[0] === 'wait' && parts.length === 2) {
        const seconds = Number.parseInt(parts[1], 10);
        return Number.isInteger(seconds) && seconds > 0 ? { kind: 'wait', seconds } : { kind: 'error' };
    }
    if (parts[0] === 'ok' && parts.length === 3 && /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(parts[1])) {
        const seconds = Number.parseInt(parts[2], 10);
        return { kind: 'ok', id: parts[1], seconds: Number.isInteger(seconds) && seconds > 0 ? seconds : 300 };
    }
    return { kind: 'error' };
}

export function clockText(milliseconds) {
    const total = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(milliseconds / 1000));
    return `${Math.floor(total / 60)}:${String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function progressText(runs, unlock = AUTO_UNLOCK) {
    if (runs >= unlock) {
        return `${runs} tests from this browser.`;
    }
    const left = unlock - runs;
    return `${left} more ${left === 1 ? 'test unlocks' : 'tests unlock'} auto run.`;
}

export function readNumber(storage, key) {
    try {
        const parsed = Number.parseInt(storage?.getItem(key) ?? '0', 10);
        return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 0;
    } catch {
        return 0;
    }
}

function writeNumber(storage, key, number) {
    try {
        storage?.setItem(key, String(number));
    } catch {
    }
}

export function fetchOptions(url, signal) {
    const options = { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'omit', referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer', redirect: 'follow', signal };
    if (/^https?:\/\//.test(url)) {
        options.mode = 'no-cors';
    }
    return options;
}

export function cacheBusted(url, nonce) {
    if (/^https?:\/\//.test(url)) {
        return url;
    }
    return `${url}${url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'}n=${nonce}`;
}

export function defaults(win) {
    return {
        fetch: (url, options) => win.fetch(url, options),
        now: () => win.performance.now(),
        setTimeout: (callback, delay) => win.setTimeout(callback, delay),
        clearTimeout: handle => win.clearTimeout(handle),
        AbortController: win.AbortController,
    };
}

export async function timeOnce(url, deps, parent, nonce = 0) {
    const controller = new deps.AbortController();
    const onAbort = () => controller.abort();
    parent?.addEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    const timer = deps.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), REQUEST_MS);
    try {
        if (parent?.aborted) {
            return null;
        }
        const start = deps.now();
        await deps.fetch(cacheBusted(url, nonce), fetchOptions(url, controller.signal));
        return Math.max(0, Math.round(deps.now() - start));
    } catch {
        return null;
    } finally {
        deps.clearTimeout(timer);
        parent?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    }
}

export async function measure(url, deps, parent, samples = SAMPLES) {
    let nonce = 0;
    if (await timeOnce(url, deps, parent, nonce++) === null) {
        return null;
    }
    let best = null;
    for (let index = 0; index < samples; index += 1) {
        const elapsed = await timeOnce(url, deps, parent, nonce++);
        if (elapsed === null) {
            break;
        }
        best = best === null ? elapsed : Math.min(best, elapsed);
    }
    return best === null ? null : Math.min(best, MAX_MS);
}

export async function measureAll(urls, deps, budgetMs, onResult = () => {}, parallel = PARALLEL) {
    const results = urls.map(() => null);
    const controller = new deps.AbortController();
    const deadline = deps.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), budgetMs);
    let next = 0;
    const worker = async () => {
        while (next < urls.length && !controller.signal.aborted) {
            const index = next;
            next += 1;
            const result = await measure(urls[index], deps, controller.signal);
            results[index] = controller.signal.aborted ? null : result;
            onResult(index, results[index]);
        }
    };
    try {
        await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(parallel, urls.length) }, worker));
    } finally {
        deps.clearTimeout(deadline);
    }
    return results;
}

class LatencyClient {
    constructor(panel, dotnet, doc, win) {
        this.panel = panel;
        this.dotnet = dotnet;
        this.doc = doc;
        this.win = win;
        this.history = new LocalHistory(win.indexedDB, SCHEMA);
        this.rows = [...panel.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')];
        this.endpoints = this.rows.map(row => ({
            key: row.dataset.key,
            url: row.dataset.url,
            label: row.dataset.label,
            server: row.dataset.server === 'true',
            browserCell: row.querySelector('.browser'),
            serverCell: row.querySelector('.server'),
        }));
        this.labels = new Map(this.endpoints.map(endpoint => [endpoint.key, endpoint.label]));
        this.runButton = panel.querySelector('.run');
        this.autoButton = panel.querySelector('.auto');
        this.status = new StatusLine(panel.querySelector('.status'), win);
        this.progress = panel.querySelector('.progress');
        this.feed = doc.getElementById('latency-feed');
        this.empty = doc.getElementById('latency-empty');
        this.older = doc.getElementById('latency-older');
        this.boardLists = BOARDS.map(board => ({
            ...board,
            list: doc.getElementById(board.id),
            empty: doc.getElementById(`${board.id}-empty`),
        }));
        this.cooldown = (Number.parseInt(panel.dataset.cooldown, 10) || 300) * 1000;
        this.budget = (Number.parseInt(panel.dataset.budget, 10) || 30) * 1000;
        this.runs = readNumber(win.localStorage, RUNS_KEY);
        this.next = readNumber(win.localStorage, NEXT_KEY);
        this.retryAt = 0;
        this.version = -1;
        this.live = new Map();
        this.shown = new Map();
        this.mine = new Set();
        this.leaders = new Map();
        this.boards = boardIds(null);
        this.drawn = new Map();
        this.cursor = null;
        this.ready = false;
        this.running = false;
        this.testing = false;
        this.waiting = null;
        this.auto = false;
        this.joining = null;
        this.timer = 0;
        this.ticker = 0;
        this.disposed = false;
        this.onRun = () => this.press(true);
        this.onAuto = () => this.toggleAuto();
        this.onOlder = () => this.loadOlder();
        this.onReconnected = () => this.join();
    }

    async start() {
        this.runButton?.addEventListener('click', this.onRun);
        this.autoButton?.addEventListener('click', this.onAuto);
        this.older?.addEventListener('click', this.onOlder);
        this.win.addEventListener('chaos:reconnected', this.onReconnected);
        this.timer = this.win.setInterval(() => this.ping(), PING_MS);
        this.ticker = this.win.setInterval(() => this.tick(), 1000);
        this.updateControls();
        try {
            await this.offer();
        } catch {
        }
        try {
            await this.offerLeaders();
        } catch {
        }
        await this.join();
    }

    async offer() {
        const local = await this.history.newest(OFFER_LIMIT * 2);
        for (const record of local) {
            if (record.mine) {
                this.mine.add(record.id);
            }
        }
        for (const chunk of chunkOffers(local)) {
            if (this.disposed) {
                return;
            }
            await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Offer', chunk.map(record => record.id), chunk.map(record => record.text));
        }
    }

    async offerLeaders() {
        const db = await this.history.database();
        if (!db || this.disposed) {
            return;
        }
        const records = await readAll(db, STORE);
        for (const record of records) {
            if (record.mine) {
                this.mine.add(record.id);
            }
        }
        for (const chunk of chunkOffers(leadersOf(records), undefined, LEADER_OFFERS * 4)) {
            if (this.disposed) {
                return;
            }
            await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('OfferLeaders', chunk.map(record => record.id), chunk.map(record => record.text));
        }
    }

    join() {
        if (this.disposed) {
            return Promise.resolve();
        }
        this.version = -1;
        this.joining ??= this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Join')
            .catch(() => {})
            .finally(() => {
                this.joining = null;
            });
        return this.joining;
    }

    async ping() {
        if (this.disposed || this.joining) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            if (!(await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Ping'))) {
                await this.join();
            }
        } catch {
        }
    }

    async apply(updates) {
        for (const update of updates) {
            if (this.disposed) {
                return;
            }
            this.running = update.running === true;
            if (this.running && !this.testing && this.waiting === null) {
                this.status.supersede(null);
            }
            if (update.kind === 'snapshot') {
                await this.snapshot(update);
                await this.board(update.boards, true);
            } else if (update.kind === 'delta' && this.version >= 0) {
                if (needsResync(this.version, update)) {
                    this.join();
                    return;
                }
                await this.delta(update);
                if (update.boards) {
                    await this.board(update.boards, false);
                }
            }
            this.updateControls();
        }
    }

    record(message) {
        return { id: message.id, text: message.text, mine: this.mine.has(message.id) };
    }

    async save(messages) {
        try {
            await this.history.save(messages.map(message => this.record(message)));
        } catch {
        }
    }

    async snapshot(update) {
        this.version = update.version;
        this.live = new Map(update.added.map(message => [message.id, message]));
        await this.save(update.added);
        let archive = { items: [], last: null, done: true };
        try {
            archive = await this.history.page(null, PAGE_SIZE, this.live);
        } catch {
        }
        this.cursor = archive.last;
        this.render([...update.added, ...archive.items].sort(newestFirst), archive.done);
        for (const message of update.added) {
            this.landed(message);
        }
        if (!this.ready) {
            this.ready = true;
            this.panel.dataset.ready = '';
        }
    }

    async delta(update) {
        this.version = update.version;
        for (const id of update.removed) {
            this.live.delete(id);
            this.shown.get(id)?.classList.add('archived');
        }
        const fresh = [];
        for (const message of update.added) {
            this.live.set(message.id, message);
            const existing = this.shown.get(message.id);
            if (existing) {
                existing.classList.remove('archived');
            } else {
                this.insert(message, true);
                fresh.push(message);
                this.status.supersede(message.id);
            }
            this.landed(message);
        }
        this.updateEmpty();
        if (fresh.length > 0 && !this.disposed && this.feed?.isConnected) {
            const newest = [...fresh].sort(newestFirst)[0];
            const summary = summarize(parseRun(newest.text) ?? []);
            announce(this.doc, `New latency result: browser median ${ms(summary.browser)}, server median ${ms(summary.server)}.`);
        }
        await this.save(update.added);
    }

    async board(boards, reset) {
        if (reset) {
            this.leaders.clear();
            this.drawn.clear();
        }
        const runs = Array.isArray(boards?.runs) ? boards.runs : [];
        for (const message of runs) {
            this.leaders.set(message.id, message);
        }
        this.boards = boardIds(boards);
        const keep = new Set(Object.values(this.boards).flat());
        for (const id of [...this.leaders.keys()]) {
            if (!keep.has(id)) {
                this.leaders.delete(id);
            }
        }
        this.renderBoards();
        await this.save(runs);
    }

    renderBoards() {
        for (const board of this.boardLists) {
            if (!board.list) {
                continue;
            }
            const ids = this.boards[board.key].filter(id => this.leaders.has(id));
            const signature = ids.map(id => `${id}${this.mine.has(id) ? '*' : ''}`).join();
            if (this.drawn.get(board.key) === signature) {
                continue;
            }
            this.drawn.set(board.key, signature);
            const fragment = this.doc.createDocumentFragment();
            ids.forEach((id, index) => fragment.append(this.leader(this.leaders.get(id), board, index + 1)));
            board.list.replaceChildren(fragment);
            if (board.empty) {
                board.empty.hidden = ids.length > 0;
            }
        }
    }

    leader(message, board, place) {
        const element = this.item(message, false);
        element.classList.remove('archived');
        element.classList.add('leader');
        const ranks = rank(parseRun(message.text) ?? []);
        const headline = this.element('p', 'headline');
        if (board.side) {
            headline.append(this.element('span', 'place', String(place)), this.element('strong', null, ms(ranks[board.side])));
        } else {
            element.classList.add(board.jackpot);
            for (const side of SIDES) {
                if (qualifies(ranks[side], board.jackpot)) {
                    headline.append(this.element('strong', null, `${SIDE_LABELS[side]} ${ms(ranks[side])}`));
                }
            }
        }
        element.prepend(headline);
        return element;
    }

    landed(message) {
        if (message.id !== this.waiting) {
            return;
        }
        this.waiting = null;
        const results = new Map((parseRun(message.text) ?? []).map(result => [result.key, result]));
        for (const endpoint of this.endpoints) {
            const result = results.get(endpoint.key);
            if (endpoint.serverCell) {
                endpoint.serverCell.textContent = ms(result?.server ?? null);
            }
        }
        this.status.show('Done. Your result is at the top of the list.', message.id);
    }

    clearTable() {
        for (const endpoint of this.endpoints) {
            if (endpoint.browserCell) {
                endpoint.browserCell.textContent = '…';
            }
            if (endpoint.serverCell) {
                endpoint.serverCell.textContent = endpoint.server ? '…' : '–';
            }
        }
    }

    canPress(now = Date.now()) {
        return this.ready && !this.testing && !this.running && !this.disposed && now >= this.next;
    }

    async press(manual) {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (!this.ready || this.testing || this.disposed) {
            return;
        }
        if (now < this.next) {
            if (manual) {
                this.status.show(`You can run the next test in ${clockText(this.next - now)}.`);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (this.running) {
            if (manual) {
                this.status.show('Someone else is testing right now. Try again in a few seconds.');
            }
            return;
        }
        this.testing = true;
        this.updateControls();
        let reply = { kind: 'error' };
        try {
            reply = parseStartReply(await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Begin'));
        } catch {
        }
        if (this.disposed) {
            return;
        }
        if (reply.kind === 'ok') {
            await this.test(reply);
        } else if (reply.kind === 'busy') {
            this.retryAt = Date.now() + 10000 + Math.round(Math.random() * 20000);
            if (manual) {
                this.status.show('Someone else is testing right now. Try again in a few seconds.');
            }
        } else if (reply.kind === 'wait') {
            this.setNext(Date.now() + reply.seconds * 1000);
            this.status.show(`A test ran from your network recently. Devices sharing an internet connection share this limit. The next one is possible in ${clockText(reply.seconds * 1000)}.`);
        } else {
            this.status.show('Could not reach the server.');
        }
        this.testing = false;
        this.updateControls();
    }

    async test(reply) {
        this.mine.add(reply.id);
        this.waiting = reply.id;
        this.runs += 1;
        writeNumber(this.win.localStorage, RUNS_KEY, this.runs);
        this.setNext(Date.now() + reply.seconds * 1000);
        this.clearTable();
        let done = 0;
        this.status.show(`Testing from your browser: 0 of ${this.endpoints.length}.`, reply.id);
        const results = await measureAll(this.endpoints.map(endpoint => endpoint.url), defaults(this.win), this.budget, (index, result) => {
            done += 1;
            const cell = this.endpoints[index].browserCell;
            if (cell) {
                cell.textContent = ms(result);
            }
            if (this.waiting === reply.id) {
                this.status.show(`Testing from your browser: ${done} of ${this.endpoints.length}.`, reply.id);
            }
        });
        if (this.disposed) {
            return;
        }
        let accepted = false;
        try {
            accepted = await this.dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Finish', reply.id, results.map(result => (result === null ? -1 : result)));
        } catch {
        }
        if (this.waiting === reply.id) {
            this.status.show(accepted ? 'Your browser is done. Waiting for the server.' : 'The server stopped waiting for this browser. Its own numbers still count.', reply.id);
        }
    }

    setNext(at) {
        this.next = at;
        writeNumber(this.win.localStorage, NEXT_KEY, at);
    }

    toggleAuto() {
        if (this.runs < AUTO_UNLOCK) {
            return;
        }
        this.auto = !this.auto;
        this.status.show(this.auto ? 'Auto run is on. It runs a test whenever one is allowed.' : 'Auto run is off.');
        this.updateControls();
    }

    tick() {
        if (this.disposed) {
            return;
        }
        const now = Date.now();
        if (this.auto && this.canPress(now) && now >= this.retryAt) {
            this.press(false);
            return;
        }
        this.updateControls();
    }

    updateControls() {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (this.runButton) {
            this.runButton.disabled = !this.ready || this.testing || this.running || now < this.next;
            this.runButton.textContent = this.testing ? 'Testing…' : now < this.next ? `Next test in ${clockText(this.next - now)}` : 'Run test';
        }
        if (this.autoButton) {
            this.autoButton.hidden = this.runs < AUTO_UNLOCK;
            this.autoButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(this.auto));
        }
        if (this.progress) {
            this.progress.textContent = this.running && !this.testing && !this.waiting
                ? 'Someone is running a test right now.'
                : progressText(this.runs);
        }
    }

    async loadOlder() {
        if (!this.older) {
            return;
        }
        this.older.disabled = true;
        try {
            const archive = await this.history.page(this.cursor, PAGE_SIZE, this.live);
            this.cursor = archive.last ?? this.cursor;
            for (const record of archive.items) {
                if (record.mine) {
                    this.mine.add(record.id);
                }
                if (!this.shown.has(record.id)) {
                    this.insert(record, false);
                }
            }
            this.older.hidden = archive.done;
        } catch {
            this.older.hidden = true;
        } finally {
            this.older.disabled = false;
        }
    }

    element(tag, className, text) {
        const element = this.doc.createElement(tag);
        if (className) {
            element.className = className;
        }
        if (text !== undefined) {
            element.textContent = text;
        }
        return element;
    }

    item(message, fresh) {
        const results = parseRun(message.text) ?? [];
        const summary = summarize(results);
        const mine = this.mine.has(message.id) || message.mine === true;
        const element = this.element('li', 'msg');
        element.classList.toggle('mine', mine);
        element.classList.toggle('archived', !this.live.has(message.id));
        element.classList.toggle('fresh', fresh);
        element.dataset.id = message.id;
        const time = this.element('time', null, labelOf(message.id));
        time.dateTime = isoOf(message.id);
        const line = this.element('p', 'summary');
        for (const [label, value] of [['Browser median ', ms(summary.browser)], ['Server median ', ms(summary.server)]]) {
            const span = this.element('span', null, label);
            span.append(this.element('strong', null, value));
            line.append(span);
        }
        line.append(this.element('span', null, `${summary.answered} of ${summary.total} answered`));
        element.append(time, line);
        if (mine) {
            const tags = this.element('p', 'tags');
            tags.append(this.element('span', 'yours', 'Your test'));
            element.append(tags);
        }
        const details = this.element('details');
        details.append(this.element('summary', null, 'All endpoints'));
        const wrap = this.element('div', 'table-wrap');
        const table = this.element('table');
        const head = this.element('thead');
        const headRow = this.element('tr');
        for (const title of ['Endpoint', 'Browser', 'Server']) {
            const cell = this.element('th', null, title);
            cell.scope = 'col';
            headRow.append(cell);
        }
        head.append(headRow);
        const body = this.element('tbody');
        for (const result of results) {
            const row = this.element('tr');
            const name = this.element('th', null, this.labels.get(result.key) ?? result.key);
            name.scope = 'row';
            row.append(name, this.element('td', null, ms(result.browser)), this.element('td', null, ms(result.server)));
            body.append(row);
        }
        table.append(head, body);
        wrap.append(table);
        details.append(wrap);
        element.append(details);
        return element;
    }

    insert(message, fresh) {
        const element = this.item(message, fresh);
        let next = this.feed.firstElementChild;
        while (next && next.dataset.id > message.id) {
            next = next.nextElementSibling;
        }
        this.feed.insertBefore(element, next);
        this.shown.set(message.id, element);
    }

    render(messages, done) {
        this.shown.clear();
        const fragment = this.doc.createDocumentFragment();
        for (const message of messages) {
            if (message.mine) {
                this.mine.add(message.id);
            }
            const element = this.item(message, false);
            this.shown.set(message.id, element);
            fragment.append(element);
        }
        this.feed.replaceChildren(fragment);
        if (this.older) {
            this.older.hidden = done;
        }
        this.updateEmpty();
    }

    updateEmpty() {
        if (this.empty) {
            this.empty.hidden = this.shown.size > 0;
        }
    }

    dispose() {
        this.disposed = true;
        this.win.clearInterval(this.timer);
        this.win.clearInterval(this.ticker);
        this.status.dispose();
        this.runButton?.removeEventListener('click', this.onRun);
        this.autoButton?.removeEventListener('click', this.onAuto);
        this.older?.removeEventListener('click', this.onOlder);
        this.win.removeEventListener('chaos:reconnected', this.onReconnected);
    }
}

export function attach(panel, dotnet) {
    const client = new LatencyClient(panel, dotnet, document, window);
    client.start();
    return {
        apply: updates => client.apply(updates),
        dispose: () => client.dispose(),
    };
}

@code {
    private static readonly TimeSpan UploadTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60);
    private readonly TaskCompletionSource _attached = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    private DotNetObjectReference<PostcardIsland>? _self;
    private IJSObjectReference? _module;
    private IJSObjectReference? _client;
    private Outbox<PostcardUpdate>? _outbox;
    private Subscriber? _subscriber;
    private bool _offered;

    [Parameter, EditorRequired]
    public string Client { get; set; } = ClientAddress.Unknown;

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (!firstRender)
        {
            return;
        }

        _self = DotNetObjectReference.Create(this);
        _module = await JS.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("import", ModulePath.Of(Assets["Components/Islands/PostcardIsland.razor.js"]));
        _client = await _module.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("attach", _self);
        _attached.TrySetResult();
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public async Task<PostcardSent> Send(string? text, IJSStreamReference[]? images, MetaEntry[]? meta)
    {
        var uploads = images ?? [];
        try
        {
            var admitted = Postcards.Admit(text, [.. uploads.Select(upload => upload.Length)], Client);
            if (admitted is not PostcardResult.Accepted)
            {
                return new PostcardSent(null, PostcardSent.StatusOf(admitted));
            }

            using var lease = uploads.Length == 0 ? null : Postcards.TryBeginUpload();
            if (uploads.Length > 0 && lease is null)
            {
                return new PostcardSent(null, PostcardSent.StatusOf(PostcardResult.Busy));
            }

            var bytes = await ReadAsync(uploads);
            return bytes is null
                ? new PostcardSent(null, PostcardSent.StatusOf(PostcardResult.Failed))
                : PostcardSent.From(Postcards.Publish(text, bytes, meta));
        }
        finally
        {
            await ReleaseAsync(uploads);
        }
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public async Task<bool> Offer(string? id, string? text, MetaEntry[]? meta, IJSStreamReference[]? images)
    {
        var uploads = images ?? [];
        try
        {
            if (_offered || !Guid.TryParseExact(id, "D", out var parsed) || !Postcards.WouldRestore(parsed))
            {
                return false;
            }

            _offered = true;
            if (PostcardService.Check(text, [.. uploads.Select(upload => upload.Length)]) is not PostcardResult.Accepted)
            {
                return false;
            }

            using var lease = uploads.Length == 0 ? null : Postcards.TryBeginUpload();
            if (uploads.Length > 0 && lease is null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            var bytes = await ReadAsync(uploads);
            return bytes is not null && Postcards.Offer(parsed, text, bytes, meta);
        }
        finally
        {
            await ReleaseAsync(uploads);
        }
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public async Task Join()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        var outbox = new Outbox<PostcardUpdate>(16, 4, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20), SendAsync, Logger);
        _outbox = outbox;
        _subscriber = new Subscriber(outbox);
        Postcards.Subscribe(_subscriber);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public bool Ping() => _subscriber is not null && _outbox is { IsFaulted: false } && Postcards.IsSubscribed(_subscriber);

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_client, "dispose");
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_module, null);
        _self?.Dispose();
    }

    private static async Task<byte[][]?> ReadAsync(IJSStreamReference[] uploads)
    {
        var result = new byte[uploads.Length][];
        try
        {
            using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(UploadTimeout);
            for (var i = 0; i < uploads.Length; i++)
            {
                await using var stream = await uploads[i].OpenReadStreamAsync(PostcardRules.MaxImageBytes, timeout.Token);
                using var buffer = new MemoryStream((int)uploads[i].Length);
                await stream.CopyToAsync(buffer, timeout.Token);
                if (buffer.Length != uploads[i].Length)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                result[i] = buffer.ToArray();
            }

            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is JSException or JSDisconnectedException or OperationCanceledException or IOException or ArgumentOutOfRangeException or InvalidOperationException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static async Task ReleaseAsync(IJSStreamReference[] uploads)
    {
        foreach (var upload in uploads)
        {
            try
            {
                await upload.DisposeAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception exception) when (exception is JSException or JSDisconnectedException or OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task SendAsync(IReadOnlyList<PostcardUpdate> batch, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await _attached.Task.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
        await InvokeAsync(() => _client is null
            ? Task.FromException(new InvalidOperationException("The postcard module is not attached."))
            : _client.InvokeVoidAsync("apply", cancellationToken, batch).AsTask());
    }

    private async Task StopAsync()
    {
        if (_subscriber is not null)
        {
            Postcards.Unsubscribe(_subscriber);
            _subscriber = null;
        }

        if (_outbox is not null)
        {
            await _outbox.DisposeAsync();
            _outbox = null;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Subscriber(Outbox<PostcardUpdate> outbox) : IPostcardSubscriber
    {
        public bool Deliver(PostcardUpdate update) => outbox.TryPost(update);
    }
}
