@using System.Text.Json
@implements IAsyncDisposable
@inject NestService Service
@inject IJSRuntime JS
@inject ILogger<SyncIsland> Logger

@code {
    private readonly TaskCompletionSource _attached = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    private DotNetObjectReference<SyncIsland>? _self;
    private IJSObjectReference? _module;
    private IJSObjectReference? _client;
    private Outbox<NestUpdate>? _outbox;
    private Subscriber? _subscriber;
    private int _offered;

    [Parameter, EditorRequired]
    public string Client { get; set; } = ClientAddress.Unknown;

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (!firstRender)
        {
            return;
        }

        _self = DotNetObjectReference.Create(this);
        _module = await JS.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("import", ModulePath.Of(Assets["Components/Islands/SyncIsland.razor.js"]));
        _client = await _module.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("attach", _self);
        _attached.TrySetResult();
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public async Task Join()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        var outbox = new Outbox<NestUpdate>(64, 16, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20), SendAsync, Logger);
        _outbox = outbox;
        _subscriber = new Subscriber(outbox);
        Service.Subscribe(_subscriber);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public bool Ping() => _subscriber is not null && _outbox is { IsFaulted: false } && Service.IsSubscribed(_subscriber);

    [JSInvokable]
    public JsonElement Fetch(string[]? ids)
    {
        var parsed = new List<Guid>();
        foreach (var id in (ids ?? []).Take(NestService.MaxFetch))
        {
            if (Guid.TryParseExact(id, "D", out var guid))
            {
                parsed.Add(guid);
            }
        }

        return Wire.Write(Service.Find(parsed));
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public int Offer(JsonElement entries)
    {
        var wires = Wire.Read<EntryWire?[]>(entries);
        var budget = Math.Min(Service.Capacity - _offered, wires?.Length ?? 0);
        if (wires is null || budget <= 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        _offered += budget;
        var offered = new List<Entry>(budget);
        for (var i = 0; i < budget; i++)
        {
            if (wires[i]?.ToEntry() is { } entry)
            {
                offered.Add(entry);
            }
        }

        return Service.Offer(offered);
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public JsonElement Post(JsonElement draft) =>
        Wire.Write(PostOutcome.From(Service.Submit(Wire.Read<EntryDraft>(draft), Client)));

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        await StopAsync();
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_client, "dispose");
        await JsCleanup.DisposeAsync(_module, null);
        _self?.Dispose();
    }

    private async Task SendAsync(IReadOnlyList<NestUpdate> batch, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await _attached.Task.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
        await InvokeAsync(() => _client is null
            ? Task.FromException(new InvalidOperationException("The sync module is not attached."))
            : _client.InvokeVoidAsync("apply", cancellationToken, batch).AsTask());
    }

    private async Task StopAsync()
    {
        if (_subscriber is not null)
        {
            Service.Unsubscribe(_subscriber);
            _subscriber = null;
        }

        if (_outbox is not null)
        {
            await _outbox.DisposeAsync();
            _outbox = null;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Subscriber(Outbox<NestUpdate> outbox) : INestSubscriber
    {
        public bool Deliver(NestUpdate update) => outbox.TryPost(update);
    }
}

@page "/about"

<PageTitle>About</PageTitle>

<h1>About</h1>
<p class="lede">This site has three parts: a project tracker that needs an account, a house hunting notebook, and a set of shared toys. The last two work without an account.</p>

<h2>Accounts and roles</h2>
<ul>
    <li>Most of the site needs no account. Accounts are only needed for the <a href="work">project tracker</a> and for deleting things.</li>
    <li>The first account is created at <code>/setup</code> with a one-time code from the server log, and becomes an <strong>administrator</strong>. Administrators manage accounts, grant roles and see the audit log.</li>
    <li>Each project has <strong>editors</strong> and <strong>members</strong>. Members can add and edit anything in the project. Editors can also delete, restore and manage members. Administrators can do everything editors can, everywhere.</li>
    <li>Nobody else can delete anything. You may edit, but not delete.</li>
    <li>Deleting moves things to the trash. Only administrators can delete for good, and every deletion, restore and permanent deletion is written to the audit log.</li>
    <li>Home pages can have editors too, granted by an administrator. They can delete entries posted on that home.</li>
</ul>

<h2>Work</h2>
<p>Projects hold work items: stories, tasks, bugs and epics. Items move through backlog, to do, in progress, in review and done. Plan items into sprints, start one sprint at a time, and follow it on the board. On a phone, swipe between board columns or pick a status from the list on each card; on a computer you can also drag cards between columns.</p>
<p>Descriptions and comments take Markdown. Paste or drop screenshots and files into them and they are uploaded and linked where the cursor is. Files are stored in the database, in one-megabyte pieces.</p>

<h2>Homes</h2>
<p>Paste a link to a home from Zillow, Redfin, Realtor.com or any other site, or add one by its address. Anyone can fill in the details and leave comments. Every entry is stored in the database and also in each browser that sees it. If the server ever loses an entry, browsers offer it back.</p>
<h3>How the same home is recognized</h3>
<p>Every home is known by one or more IDs:</p>
<ul>
    <li>A Zillow ID (<code>zpid</code>), Redfin ID or Realtor.com property ID, read from the link. Query strings, tracking codes and the address part of the link are ignored, so <code>zillow.com/homedetails/2893-State-Route-26-…/29747113_zpid/</code> and <code>zillow.com/homedetails/29747113_zpid/?utm_source=share</code> are the same home.</li>
    <li>The street address and ZIP code, in a standard form: <code>Street</code> and <code>St</code>, <code>Route</code> and <code>Rte</code>, <code>Apt 4</code> and <code>#4</code> all match.</li>
    <li>For other sites, the link itself without its query string.</li>
</ul>
<p>Everything anyone adds is filed under all the IDs its home had at that moment. Anything that shares an ID with anything else ends up on the same page. So if one person adds a Zillow link and its address, and later someone else adds a Redfin link with the same address, both appear on one page, with every detail and comment from both.</p>
<p>When two people set the same detail, the newest value wins and the one before it is shown next to it. Comments are never merged away; they are listed oldest first.</p>
<p>Merging cannot be undone. A wrong link or address joins two homes for everyone who has seen it.</p>


<h2>Toys</h2>
<p>The board, postcard, canvas, slots and latency test are shared live with everyone on the page. The server keeps very little of them, in memory, and forgets it when it restarts; each browser keeps its own copy and offers it back.</p>
<h3>What you can do</h3>
<dl>
    <dt><a href="board">Board</a></dt>
    <dd>Post a message of up to 500 characters. Everyone on the board sees it at once. The server keeps the newest 50. This browser keeps up to 10,000 on your device, so you still see messages after the server has forgotten them. Those have a dotted border. Your own messages are marked <em>Your message</em> in this browser only. You can choose to attach your location and some browser details to your messages; see <a href="about#location">Location and details</a>.</dd>
    <dt><a href="postcard">Postcard</a></dt>
    <dd>Send a postcard of up to 5,000 characters with up to four PNG, JPEG or GIF images, each up to 2 MB and 4,096 pixels on a side, 4 MB in all. Larger photos are scaled down in your browser before sending. The server keeps only the newest postcard; the next one replaces it for everyone. This browser keeps up to 10,000 postcards and up to 256 MB of their images; when images go over that, the oldest images are dropped first and their text stays. The server removes metadata such as camera details and GPS coordinates from the images, keeping only the rotation. Location and details work as on the board.</dd>
    <dt><a href="canvas">Canvas</a></dt>
    <dd>Draw with a mouse, a finger or a stylus. Everyone sees each stroke as it is drawn. Anyone can reset the page for everyone. This browser keeps up to 10,000 finished strokes, so after a server restart the drawing comes back from the browsers that saw it, unless someone had pressed reset since.</dd>
    <dt><a href="slots">Slots</a></dt>
    <dd>Press the button and the shared machine spins for everyone watching. Nobody can press again until the reels stop, and then whoever presses first goes next. Nobody knows who pressed, but you are told whether your own press worked. After ten successful presses from this browser you get an auto spin button that presses for you each time the reels stop, even while the tab is in the background. Four or five of a kind, or five symbols in an unbroken sequence like <code>ABCDE</code>, is a jackpot: the machine celebrates, and every jackpot is kept forever in its own list. The newest 500 winners stay in their own list below the results. Tap any winner to see how rare it was and the probability behind it. No money or prizes are involved; it is just for fun.</dd>
    <dt><a href="latency">Latency</a></dt>
    <dd>Press the button and your browser times how long a list of public endpoints takes to answer, while this server times the same endpoints from its data centre. Each endpoint gets one warm-up request and then the fastest of three is kept. Everyone sees every result, with no name or address attached. Each network can start a test every five minutes, so phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi share that limit. After ten tests from this browser an auto run button appears. Below the results, a leaderboard shows the ten fastest and slowest medians from browsers and from the server. At the bottom, a browser or server median under 10 ms is a jackpot winner and 100 ms or more a jackpot loser. A median only counts when at least half of the endpoints answered.</dd>
    <dt><a href="read">Read</a></dt>
    <dd>Open a plain-text article picked at random from a file this site serves, and ask for another whenever you like. Each article has its own address, so you can come back to it. This browser lists the articles you opened at the bottom of the page, newest first, up to 1,000. Nobody else sees that list, and the server keeps no record of what anyone reads. If an article is ever removed from the file, its address says so instead of failing.</dd>
</dl>

<h3>Winners</h3>
<p>Each spin is five symbols, each one of the letters A to Z or the digits 0 to 9. A spin is a winner if:</p>
<ul>
    <li><strong>Three, four or five of a kind:</strong> the same symbol appears at least three times, anywhere. <code>7Q7A7</code> wins.</li>
    <li><strong>Sequence up or down:</strong> five neighbours in a row along 0 to 9 and then A to Z, with no gaps. <code>ABCDE</code>, <code>789AB</code>, <code>43210</code> and <code>VWXYZ</code> win. It does not wrap around, so <code>YZ012</code> does not.</li>
    <li><strong>Straight up or down:</strong> all five symbols climb or all five fall, with no repeats but with gaps, in the same order. <code>13AKZ</code> and <code>ZKA80</code> win; <code>ZK8A0</code> does not.</li>
</ul>
<p>Winners have a gold border and a star badge in the results, and their winning symbols are highlighted. About one spin in fifty wins: 1,201,320 of the 60,466,176 possible results. Straights are the most common win, 753,920 results. Five of a kind is 1 in 1,679,616. A sequence in either direction is 1 in 944,784: only 32 runs go up and 32 come down.</p>
<p>Four of a kind, five of a kind and sequences are <strong>jackpots</strong>: 6,400 results, about 1 in 9,448. Jackpots get a red border and a crown badge, and they are never removed: not by the server, not by your browser's 10,000 limit.</p>

<h3>How the toys work</h3>
<ul>
    <li>Pages are rendered on the server and arrive as plain HTML. Only the board, the postcard, the canvas, the slot machine and the latency test open a live connection, over a WebSocket.</li>
    <li>The clock at the bottom of every page shows the server's time, not your device's. The page measures how far its own clock is from the server's and keeps ticking from there.</li>
    <li>Every message and every spin gets a UUIDv7 from the server clock, so its ID also records when it happened. Anything that claims to come from the future is rejected.</li>
    <li>The server can restart at any time and then remembers nothing. When you open the board or the slots, your browser offers its 50 newest entries back; the postcard page offers its newest postcard, images included, when the server has none, and the server keeps the ones that fit among its newest 50. The slots page also offers its 500 newest winners back for the winners list and up to 500 jackpots for the jackpot list.</li>
    <li>The canvas sends strokes in small batches of points measured from 0 to 1 across a square page, so phones and desktops draw the same picture. Each reset starts a new round, and strokes still in flight from the old one are dropped. Every finished stroke and every reset gets a UUIDv7, so after a restart the server takes back only strokes drawn after the newest reset anyone remembers.</li>
    <li>The latency test from your browser uses plain requests whose answers it cannot read, only time. It cannot see anything those sites send back, and they see a request with no cookies and no referrer.</li>
    <li>The slot result is drawn on the server with a cryptographic random number generator the moment a press is accepted. The server then refuses every press until the spin time has passed, so only one spin runs at a time. Your browser plays the reels for the time the server says is left, then adds the result to the list; your own button stays off until your reels stop, so a spin always settles on your screen before you can press again.</li>
    <li>The reels are plain HTML animated with the Web Animations API. If your device asks for reduced motion, the symbols change without spinning.</li>
    <li>A strict Content Security Policy only allows scripts, styles and images from this site (postcard images are shown from your browser's own copy), and connections only to this site and the latency test endpoints. There are no inline scripts.</li>
</ul>


<h2>Before you post</h2>
<p class="warning">Anything you post to homes or the toys goes to every connected browser at once and is stored on their devices. Deleting an entry removes it from the server and from browsers that connect afterwards, but copies already made elsewhere cannot be recalled. Don't share anything private.</p>

<h2>Your data</h2>
<p>Pages with forms set a cookie that protects those forms from cross-site requests, and signing in sets one that keeps you signed in. There is no tracking. Your theme choice is kept in this browser's local storage. Rate limits count by network address in the server's memory only; addresses are never saved or shown.</p>
<h3 id="location">Location and details</h3>
<p>This is optional and off unless you turn it on. The board and the postcard work the same either way, and share one setting. If you tick <em>Attach my location and browser details</em> and your browser grants location permission, every message or postcard you send carries what your browser reports at that moment: latitude, longitude and accuracy, plus altitude, heading and speed when known, your time zone, UTC offset and local time, language, user agent, platform, screen and window size, CPU threads, memory, touch points, color scheme, motion and contrast settings, and connection type. Anyone can open it under the message with <em>Details</em>, and it is kept and offered back like the message itself. Nothing is looked up from it: no maps, no address, no third-party service. The server does not add your network address. Your browser reports these values and the server cannot check them. Untick the box, or block location for this site, to stop. Messages already sent keep their details.</p>

    <button type="button" data-clear-history="clear-status">Clear local toy history</button>
    <button type="button" data-clear-local="clear-local-status" class="secondary">Delete this browser's copy of the homes</button>
    <output id="clear-status"></output>
    <output id="clear-local-status"></output>
</p>

@code {
    private string? _message;
    private bool _error;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "rename")]
    private RenameModel Name { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "password")]
    private PasswordModel Password { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        Name ??= new RenameModel { DisplayName = HttpContext.User.DisplayName() };
        Password ??= new PasswordModel();
    }

    private async Task RenameAsync()
    {
        var result = await Accounts.RenameAsync(HttpContext.User.PersonId()!.Value, Name.DisplayName, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        await RefreshAsync(result, "Saved.");
    }

    private async Task ChangePasswordAsync()
    {
        var result = await Accounts.ChangePasswordAsync(HttpContext.User.PersonId()!.Value, Password.Current, Password.Next, ClientAddress.Key(HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        Password = new PasswordModel();
        await RefreshAsync(result, "Password changed.");
    }

    private async Task RefreshAsync(AccountResult result, string success)
    {
        _error = !result.Succeeded;
        _message = result.Problem ?? success;
        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            await HttpContext.SignInAsync(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme, PlaygroundClaims.Create(result.Person!), new AuthenticationProperties { IsPersistent = true });
            Name.DisplayName = result.Person!.DisplayName;
        }
    }

    public sealed class RenameModel
    {
        public string? DisplayName { get; set; }
    }

    public sealed class PasswordModel
    {
        public string? Current { get; set; }

        public string? Next { get; set; }
    }
}

                                <button type="submit" class="small secondary">@(person.IsAdministrator ? "Remove administrator" : "Make administrator")</button>
                            </form>
                            <form method="post" @formname="@($"disable-{id:N}")" @onsubmit="() => ToggleDisabledAsync(person)" data-enhance class="inline-form">

@code {
    private IReadOnlyList<PersonRecord> _people = [];
    private bool _registrationOpen;
    private string? _message;
    private bool _error;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    private Actor Actor => HttpContext.User.ToActor()!;

    protected override Task OnInitializedAsync() => LoadAsync();

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        _people = await People.ListAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _registrationOpen = await Settings.GetFlagAsync(SiteSettings.RegistrationOpen, true, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    private async Task ToggleRegistrationAsync()
    {
        var open = !_registrationOpen;
        await Settings.SetAsync(SiteSettings.RegistrationOpen, open ? "true" : "false", HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        await Audit.WriteAsync(Audits.For(Actor, open ? "registration-opened" : "registration-closed", "setting", SiteSettings.RegistrationOpen, open ? "Opened registration" : "Closed registration"), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        Say(open ? "Registration is open." : "Registration is closed.", false);
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task ToggleAdministratorAsync(PersonRecord person)
    {
        var grant = !person.IsAdministrator;
        if (await People.SetAdministratorAsync(person.Id, grant, Actor.PersonId, HttpContext.RequestAborted))
        {
            await Audit.WriteAsync(Audits.For(Actor, grant ? "role-granted" : "role-revoked", "person", person.Id.ToString(), $"{person.UserName} {(grant ? "is now" : "is no longer")} an administrator"), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            Say(grant ? $"{person.UserName} is now an administrator." : $"{person.UserName} is no longer an administrator.", false);
        }
        else
        {
            Say(grant ? "Nothing changed." : "The site needs at least one active administrator.", true);
        }

        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task ToggleDisabledAsync(PersonRecord person)
    {
        var disable = person.DisabledAt is null;
        if (await People.SetDisabledAsync(person.Id, disable, HttpContext.RequestAborted))
        {
            await Audit.WriteAsync(Audits.For(Actor, disable ? "account-disabled" : "account-enabled", "person", person.Id.ToString(), $"{person.UserName} {(disable ? "disabled" : "enabled")}"), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            Say(disable ? $"{person.UserName} is disabled and signed out." : $"{person.UserName} can sign in again.", false);
        }
        else
        {
            Say(disable ? "The last active administrator cannot be disabled." : "Nothing changed.", true);
        }

        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private void Say(string message, bool error)
    {
        _message = message;
        _error = error;
    }
}

                        <td><code>@editor.PageKey</code></td>
                        <td>@editor.DisplayName <span class="muted">@editor.UserName</span></td>
                        <td>@Clock.Format(editor.GrantedAt)</td>
                        <td>
                            <form method="post" @formname="@($"revoke-{editor.PersonId:N}-{editor.PageKey}")" @onsubmit="() => RevokeAsync(editor)" data-enhance class="inline-form">
                                <AntiforgeryToken />
                                <button type="submit" class="small secondary">Revoke</button>
                            </form>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                }
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
}

@code {
    private IReadOnlyList<PageEditorRecord> _editors = [];
    private string? _message;
    private bool _error;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "grant")]
    private GrantModel Grant { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Grant ??= new GrantModel();
        _editors = await Editors.ListAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    private async Task GrantAsync()
    {
        var actor = HttpContext.User.ToActor()!;
        var key = (Grant.Key ?? "").Trim();
        if (!ListingKey.IsValid(key))
        {
            (_message, _error) = ("That is not a home key. Copy one from the Known as list on a home.", true);
            return;
        }

        var person = await People.FindByUserNameAsync((Grant.UserName ?? "").Trim().ToLowerInvariant(), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (person is null || person.DisabledAt is not null)
        {
            (_message, _error) = ("There is no active account with that user name.", true);
            return;
        }

        var page = NestModeration.PageKey(key);
        if (await Editors.GrantAsync(page, person.Id, actor.PersonId, HttpContext.RequestAborted))
        {
            await Audit.WriteAsync(Audits.For(actor, "editor-granted", "page", page, $"{person.UserName} edits {page}"), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        }

        (_message, _error) = ($"{person.UserName} is an editor of {key}.", false);
        Grant = new GrantModel();
        _editors = await Editors.ListAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    private async Task RevokeAsync(PageEditorRecord editor)
    {
        var actor = HttpContext.User.ToActor()!;
        if (await Editors.RevokeAsync(editor.PageKey, editor.PersonId, HttpContext.RequestAborted))
        {
            await Audit.WriteAsync(Audits.For(actor, "editor-revoked", "page", editor.PageKey, $"{editor.UserName} no longer edits {editor.PageKey}"), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        }

        (_message, _error) = ($"{editor.UserName} is no longer an editor of {editor.PageKey}.", false);
        _editors = await Editors.ListAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    public sealed class GrantModel
    {
        public string? Key { get; set; }

        public string? UserName { get; set; }
    }
}

                                    <AntiforgeryToken />
                                    <button type="submit" class="small secondary">Restore</button>
                                </form>

                                    <AntiforgeryToken />
                                    <button type="submit" class="small danger">Delete forever</button>
                                </form>
                            </div>

@code {
    private IReadOnlyList<TrashRecord> _records = [];
    private string? _message;
    private bool _error;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => _records = await Trash.ListAsync(null, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

    private async Task RestoreAsync(TrashRecord record)
    {
        var done = await Trash.RestoreAsync(HttpContext.User.ToActor()!, record.Subject, record.Id, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _message = done ? $"Restored {record.Title}." : "That is no longer in the trash.";
        _error = !done;
        _records = await Trash.ListAsync(null, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    private async Task PurgeAsync(TrashRecord record)
    {
        var done = await Trash.HardDeleteAsync(HttpContext.User.ToActor()!, record.Subject, record.Id, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _message = done ? $"Deleted {record.Title} for good." : "That is no longer in the trash.";
        _error = !done;
        _records = await Trash.ListAsync(null, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }
}

                                    <AntiforgeryToken />
                                    <button type="submit" class="small danger">Delete</button>
                                </form>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <form method="post" @formname="@($"restore-{entry.Id:N}")" @onsubmit="() => RestoreAsync(entry)" data-enhance class="inline-form">
                                    <AntiforgeryToken />
                                    <button type="submit" class="small secondary">Restore</button>
                                </form>
                            }
                        </div>
                    }
                </li>
            }
        </ul>
    }

@code {
    private string? _key;
    private HomeModeration? _home;
    private string? _message;
    private bool _error;

    [Parameter]
    public string? Provider { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public string? Token { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        _key = Provider is null ? null : ListingKey.Of(Provider, Token);
        if (_key is not null)
        {
            _home = await Moderation.LoadAsync(_key, HttpContext.User.ToActor(), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteAsync(NestEntryRecord entry)
    {
        var done = await Moderation.DeleteAsync(HttpContext.User.ToActor(), entry.Id, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        (_message, _error) = done ? ("Deleted.", false) : ("Could not delete that entry.", true);
        _home = await Moderation.LoadAsync(_key!, HttpContext.User.ToActor(), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    private async Task RestoreAsync(NestEntryRecord entry)
    {
        var done = await Moderation.RestoreAsync(HttpContext.User.ToActor(), entry.Id, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        (_message, _error) = done ? ("Restored.", false) : ("Could not restore that entry.", true);
        _home = await Moderation.LoadAsync(_key!, HttpContext.User.ToActor(), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    private static string Describe(NestEntryRecord entry) =>
        entry.Text ?? entry.Url ?? (entry.Fields is { } fields ? fields : string.Join(", ", entry.Keys));
}

        <p id="homes-empty" class="empty" hidden="@(_listings.Count > 0)">No homes yet. Paste a link to start.</p>
        <ol id="homes-list" class="cards">
            @foreach (var listing in _listings.Take(100))
            {
                <ListingCard @key="listing.Key" HomeKey="@listing.Key" Title="@listing.Title" Place="@listing.Place" Summary="@listing.Summary"
                             Sources="@listing.Sources" CommentCount="listing.Comments.Count" Updated="listing.Updated" />
            }
        </ol>
        <button type="button" id="homes-more" class="more" hidden>Show more homes</button>
    </section>
</div>

@code {
    private IReadOnlyList<Listing> _listings = [];
    private string _client = ClientAddress.Unknown;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext? HttpContext { get; set; }

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        _listings = Service.Listings;
        _client = ClientAddress.Key(HttpContext?.Connection.RemoteIpAddress);
    }
}

import { addressKey, keyPath, parseLink, providerLabel } from '../../js/keys.js';
import { ADDRESS_FIELDS, normalizeField, placeOf, summaryOf } from '../../js/fields.js';
import { findListing, matches, timestampOf } from '../../js/merge.js';

export const PAGE_SIZE = 100;
export const MINE_KEY = 'nest-mine-only';

export const STATUS_TEXT = Object.freeze({
    local: 'Showing what this browser has. Connecting…',
    connecting: 'Connecting…',
    live: 'Live',
    offline: 'Offline. Showing what this browser has.',
});

export const RESULT_TEXT = Object.freeze({
    accepted: '',
    exists: '',
    empty: 'Fill in the street address and ZIP code.',
    invalid: 'That doesn\'t look like a listing link or an address.',
    tooFast: 'Slow down. Try again in a moment.',
    repeat: 'That was just added.',
    offline: 'Not connected to the server yet. Try again in a moment.',
});

export function timeLabel(id, format) {
    const at = new Date(timestampOf(id));
    try {
        return format ? format.format(at) : at.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
    } catch {
        return at.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
    }
}

export function isoOf(id) {
    return new Date(timestampOf(id)).toISOString();
}

export function previewText(parsed, local) {
    if (!parsed) {
        return '';
    }
    const what = parsed.provider === 'url' ? 'A link from another site' : `${providerLabel(parsed.provider)} home ${parsed.key.slice(parsed.key.indexOf(':') + 1).toUpperCase()}`;
    return local ? `${what}. Already here: ${local.title}.` : `${what}.`;
}

export function visibleListings(listings, query, mineOnly) {
    return listings.filter(listing => (!mineOnly || listing.mine) && matches(listing, query));
}

export function commentsLabel(count) {
    return count === 1 ? '1 comment' : `${count} comments`;
}

export function readMineOnly(storage) {
    try {
        return storage?.getItem(MINE_KEY) === 'on';
    } catch {
        return false;
    }
}

export function writeMineOnly(storage, on) {
    try {
        if (on) {
            storage?.setItem(MINE_KEY, 'on');
        } else {
            storage?.removeItem(MINE_KEY);
        }
    } catch {
    }
}

export function navigate(win, path) {
    if (typeof win.Blazor?.navigateTo === 'function') {
        win.Blazor.navigateTo(path);
    } else {
        win.location.assign(path);
    }
}

export function cardElement(doc, listing, live, format) {
    const item = doc.createElement('li');
    item.className = 'home';
    item.classList.toggle('archived', !live);
    item.classList.toggle('mine', listing.mine);
    item.dataset.key = listing.key;
    const link = doc.createElement('a');
    link.href = keyPath(listing.key);
    const title = doc.createElement('strong');
    title.className = 'title';
    title.textContent = listing.title;
    link.append(title);
    const place = placeOf(listing.fields);
    if (place && place !== listing.title) {
        const span = doc.createElement('span');
        span.className = 'place';
        span.textContent = place;
        link.append(span);
    }
    const summary = summaryOf(listing.fields);
    if (summary) {
        const span = doc.createElement('span');
        span.className = 'summary';
        span.textContent = summary;
        link.append(span);
    }
    const meta = doc.createElement('span');
    meta.className = 'meta';
    const sources = [...new Set(listing.links.map(entry => providerLabel(entry.provider)))];
    for (const text of [sources.join(' · '), commentsLabel(listing.comments.length)]) {
        if (text) {
            const span = doc.createElement('span');
            span.textContent = text;
            meta.append(span);
        }
    }
    const time = doc.createElement('time');
    time.dateTime = isoOf(listing.updated);
    time.textContent = timeLabel(listing.updated, format);
    meta.append(time);
    link.append(meta);
    item.append(link);
    return item;
}

class HomesView {
    constructor(root, shared, win) {
        this.root = root;
        this.nest = shared;
        this.win = win;
        this.doc = root.ownerDocument;
        this.format = new win.Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' });
        this.limit = PAGE_SIZE;
        this.find = id => this.doc.getElementById(id);
        this.linkForm = this.find('add-link');
        this.linkInput = this.find('link-input');
        this.linkPreview = this.find('link-preview');
        this.addressForm = this.find('add-address');
        this.addressStatus = this.find('address-status');
        this.filter = this.find('homes-filter');
        this.mineOnly = this.find('homes-mine');
        this.list = this.find('homes-list');
        this.empty = this.find('homes-empty');
        this.more = this.find('homes-more');
        this.status = this.find('sync-status');
        this.busy = false;
        this.handlers = [
            [this.linkForm, 'submit', event => this.submitLink(event)],
            [this.linkInput, 'input', () => this.preview()],
            [this.addressForm, 'submit', event => this.submitAddress(event)],
            [this.filter, 'input', () => this.renderList(true)],
            [this.mineOnly, 'change', () => this.toggleMine()],
            [this.more, 'click', () => this.showMore()],
        ];
    }

    start() {
        for (const [element, type, handler] of this.handlers) {
            element?.addEventListener(type, handler);
        }
        if (this.mineOnly) {
            this.mineOnly.checked = readMineOnly(this.win.localStorage);
        }
        this.unlisten = this.nest.listen(() => this.render());
        this.render();
    }

    dispose() {
        this.unlisten?.();
        for (const [element, type, handler] of this.handlers) {
            element?.removeEventListener(type, handler);
        }
    }

    render() {
        if (this.status) {
            this.status.dataset.status = this.nest.status;
            this.status.textContent = STATUS_TEXT[this.nest.status] ?? '';
        }
        for (const button of this.root.querySelectorAll('form button[type="submit"]')) {
            button.disabled = this.busy || !this.nest.live;
        }
        if (this.nest.ready && (this.nest.live || this.nest.entries.size > 0)) {
            this.renderList(false);
        }
        this.preview();
    }

    renderList(resetLimit) {
        if (!this.list) {
            return;
        }
        if (resetLimit) {
            this.limit = PAGE_SIZE;
        }
        const listings = visibleListings(this.nest.listings(), this.filter?.value ?? '', this.mineOnly?.checked ?? false);
        const fragment = this.doc.createDocumentFragment();
        for (const listing of listings.slice(0, this.limit)) {
            fragment.append(cardElement(this.doc, listing, listing.ids.some(id => this.nest.isLive(id)), this.format));
        }
        this.list.replaceChildren(fragment);
        if (this.more) {
            this.more.hidden = listings.length <= this.limit;
        }
        if (this.empty) {
            this.empty.hidden = listings.length > 0;
            this.empty.textContent = this.nest.listings().length > 0 ? 'No homes match.' : 'No homes yet. Paste a link to start.';
        }
    }

    showMore() {
        this.limit += PAGE_SIZE;
        this.renderList(false);
    }

    toggleMine() {
        writeMineOnly(this.win.localStorage, this.mineOnly.checked);
        this.renderList(true);
    }

    preview() {
        if (!this.linkPreview || !this.linkInput) {
            return;
        }
        const value = this.linkInput.value.trim();
        const parsed = parseLink(value);
        const local = parsed ? findListing(this.nest.listings(), parsed.key) : null;
        this.linkPreview.textContent = value && !parsed ? 'Paste a full link that starts with https://' : previewText(parsed, local);
    }

    async submitLink(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const parsed = parseLink(this.linkInput?.value ?? '');
        if (!parsed) {
            this.linkPreview.textContent = RESULT_TEXT.invalid;
            return;
        }
        const local = findListing(this.nest.listings(), parsed.key);
        if (local) {
            navigate(this.win, keyPath(local.key));
            return;
        }
        await this.send({ kind: 'link', anchors: [], url: parsed.url }, this.linkPreview);
    }

    async submitAddress(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const form = this.addressForm;
        const values = {};
        for (const key of ADDRESS_FIELDS) {
            const result = normalizeField(key, form.elements.namedItem(key)?.value ?? '');
            if (!result.ok) {
                this.addressStatus.textContent = result.error;
                return;
            }
            values[key] = result.value;
        }
        const key = addressKey(values.street, values.unit, values.zip);
        if (!key) {
            this.addressStatus.textContent = RESULT_TEXT.empty;
            return;
        }
        const local = findListing(this.nest.listings(), key);
        if (local) {
            navigate(this.win, keyPath(local.key));
            return;
        }
        const fields = ADDRESS_FIELDS.filter(name => values[name]).map(name => ({ key: name, value: values[name] }));
        await this.send({ kind: 'fact', anchors: [], fields }, this.addressStatus);
    }

    async send(draft, output) {
        this.busy = true;
        this.render();
        try {
            const outcome = await this.nest.post(draft);
            if ((outcome.result === 'accepted' || outcome.result === 'exists') && outcome.key) {
                output.textContent = '';
                navigate(this.win, keyPath(outcome.key));
                return;
            }
            output.textContent = RESULT_TEXT[outcome.result] ?? RESULT_TEXT.invalid;
        } finally {
            this.busy = false;
            this.render();
        }
    }
}

export function mount(root, shared, win) {
    const view = new HomesView(root, shared, win);
    view.start();
    return { dispose: () => view.dispose() };
}

@page "/latency"
@inject LatencyService Latency
@inject TimeProvider Time

<PageTitle>Chaos latency</PageTitle>

<h1>Latency</h1>
<p class="lede">One button times how long @LatencyCatalog.Endpoints.Count public endpoints take to answer, once from your browser and once from this server. Everyone sees every result. Each network can run a test every @Minutes minutes, so devices on the same Wi-Fi share that limit.</p>

<LatencyIsland Client="@_client" @rendermode="InteractiveServer" />

<section class="feed" data-permanent="latency-feed" aria-labelledby="runs-title">
    <h2 id="runs-title">Results</h2>
    <p id="latency-empty" class="empty" hidden="@(_runs.Count > 0)">No tests yet. Press the button.</p>
    <ol id="latency-feed" class="runs">
        @foreach (var run in _runs)
        {
            @Item(run, null, null, 0)
        }
    </ol>
    <button type="button" id="latency-older" class="older" hidden>Show older results</button>
</section>

<section class="feed" data-permanent="latency-leaders" aria-labelledby="leaders-title">
    <h2 id="leaders-title">Leaderboard</h2>
    <p class="note">The @Latency.RankCapacity lowest and highest medians seen. A median only counts when at least half of the endpoints answered on that side.</p>
    <div class="boards">
        @Board("latency-browser-fastest", "Fastest browsers", "No browser results yet.", _leaders.BrowserFastest, null, LatencySide.Browser)
        @Board("latency-browser-slowest", "Slowest browsers", "No browser results yet.", _leaders.BrowserSlowest, null, LatencySide.Browser)
        @Board("latency-server-fastest", "Fastest server runs", "No server results yet.", _leaders.ServerFastest, null, LatencySide.Server)
        @Board("latency-server-slowest", "Slowest server runs", "No server results yet.", _leaders.ServerSlowest, null, LatencySide.Server)
    </div>
</section>

<section class="feed" data-permanent="latency-jackpots" aria-labelledby="jackpots-title">
    <h2 id="jackpots-title">Jackpots</h2>
    <p class="note">A browser or server median under @LatencyLeaders.FastBelow ms wins; @LatencyLeaders.SlowFrom ms or more loses. The newest @Latency.JackpotCapacity of each are kept.</p>
    <div class="boards">
        @Board("latency-jackpot-winners", "Winners", "Nobody yet. Probably nobody ever.", _leaders.FastJackpots, "fast", null)
        @Board("latency-jackpot-losers", "Losers", "Nobody yet. Hopefully nobody ever.", _leaders.SlowJackpots, "slow", null)
    </div>
</section>

@code {
    private IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> _runs = [];
    private LatencyLeaders _leaders = LatencyLeaders.Empty;
    private DateTimeOffset _now;
    private string _client = ClientAddress.Unknown;

    private int Minutes => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Round(Latency.Cooldown.TotalMinutes));

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext? HttpContext { get; set; }

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        _runs = Latency.Messages;
        _leaders = Latency.Leaders;
        _now = Time.GetUtcNow();
        _client = ClientAddress.Key(HttpContext?.Connection.RemoteIpAddress);
    }

    private static string SideLabel(LatencySide side) => side == LatencySide.Browser ? "Browser" : "Server";

    private RenderFragment Board(string id, string title, string empty, IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> runs, string? jackpot, LatencySide? side) =>
        @<section class="board" aria-labelledby="@(id + "-title")">
            <h3 id="@(id + "-title")">@title</h3>
            <p id="@(id + "-empty")" class="empty" hidden="@(runs.Count > 0)">@empty</p>
            <ol id="@id" class="runs leaders">
                @for (var i = 0; i < runs.Count; i++)
                {
                    @Item(runs[i], jackpot, side, i + 1)
                }
            </ol>
        </section>;

    private RenderFragment Item(BoardMessage run, string? jackpot, LatencySide? side, int place) => __builder =>
    {
        if (!LatencyRun.TryParse(run.Text, out var results))
        {
            return;
        }

        var summary = LatencyRun.Summarize(results);
        var rank = LatencyRun.Rank(results);
        var css = jackpot is not null ? $"msg leader {jackpot}" : side is not null ? "msg leader" : "msg";
        <li @key="run.Id" class="@css" data-id="@run.Id">
            @if (side is { } ranked)
            {
                <p class="headline"><span class="place">@place</span><strong>@LatencyRun.Milliseconds(LatencyLeaders.Of(rank, ranked))</strong></p>
            }
            else if (jackpot is not null)
            {
                <p class="headline">
                    @foreach (var each in Sides)
                    {
                        var median = LatencyLeaders.Of(rank, each);
                        if (jackpot == "fast" ? LatencyLeaders.IsFast(median) : LatencyLeaders.IsSlow(median))
                        {
                            <strong>@SideLabel(each) @LatencyRun.Milliseconds(median)</strong>
                        }
                    }
                </p>
            }
            <time datetime="@MessageFormat.Iso(run.Id)">@MessageFormat.Label(run.Id, _now)</time>
            <p class="summary">
                <span>Browser median <strong>@LatencyRun.Milliseconds(summary.Browser)</strong></span>
                <span>Server median <strong>@LatencyRun.Milliseconds(summary.Server)</strong></span>
                <span>@summary.Answered of @summary.Total answered</span>
            </p>
            <details>
                <summary>All endpoints</summary>
                <div class="table-wrap">
                    <table>
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th scope="col">Endpoint</th>
                                <th scope="col">Browser</th>
                                <th scope="col">Server</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            @foreach (var result in results)
                            {
                                <tr>
                                    <th scope="row">@LatencyCatalog.LabelOf(result.Key)</th>
                                    <td>@LatencyRun.Milliseconds(result.Browser)</td>
                                    <td>@LatencyRun.Milliseconds(result.Server)</td>
                                </tr>
                            }
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            </details>
        </li>
    };

    private static readonly LatencySide[] Sides = [LatencySide.Browser, LatencySide.Server];
}

@code {
    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> NoFields = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private string? _key;
    private Listing? _listing;
    private IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> _fields = NoFields;
    private string _title = "";
    private string _place = "";
    private string _summary = "";
    private string _client = ClientAddress.Unknown;

    [Parameter]
    public string? Provider { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public string? Token { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext? HttpContext { get; set; }

    private string CountLabel => _listing is { Comments.Count: > 0 } listing
        ? string.Concat("(", listing.Comments.Count.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), ")")
        : "";

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        _key = Provider is null ? null : ListingKey.Of(Provider, Token);
        _client = ClientAddress.Key(HttpContext?.Connection.RemoteIpAddress);
        if (_key is null)
        {
            if (HttpContext is { Response.HasStarted: false } context)
            {
                context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
            }

            return;
        }

        _listing = Service.FindListing(_key);
        _fields = _listing?.Fields ?? NoFields;
        _title = _listing?.Title ?? ListingKey.Label(_key);
        _place = _listing is null || _listing.Place == _title ? "" : _listing.Place;
        _summary = _listing?.Summary ?? "";
    }

    private static string KeyText(string key)
    {
        var label = ListingKey.Label(key);
        return ListingKey.ProviderOf(key) == ListingKey.Address ? label : label[(label.IndexOf(' ', StringComparison.Ordinal) + 1)..];
    }
}

import { compareKeys, guessAddress, keyLabel, keyUrl, parseLink, providerLabel, providerOf } from '../../js/keys.js';
import { ADDRESS_FIELDS, FIELDS, changedFields, displayValue, placeOf, summaryOf } from '../../js/fields.js';
import { findListing } from '../../js/merge.js';
import { readDraft, writeDraft } from '../../js/store.js';
import { RESULT_TEXT, STATUS_TEXT, isoOf, timeLabel } from './HomesPage.razor.js';

export const COMMENT_MAX = 4000;

export function anchorsOf(listing, key) {
    const keys = listing ? [...listing.keys] : [key];
    return keys.sort(compareKeys).slice(0, 8);
}

export function previousValue(history, key, current) {
    const values = history?.[key] ?? [];
    for (let index = values.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
        if (values[index].value !== current && values[index].value !== '') {
            return values[index].value;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

export function addressSuggestion(listing) {
    if (!listing || listing.fields.street || listing.fields.zip) {
        return null;
    }
    for (const link of listing.links) {
        const guess = guessAddress(link.url);
        if (guess && (guess.street || guess.zip)) {
            return guess;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

export function countText(length, max) {
    return `${length} / ${max}`;
}

class ListingView {
    constructor(root, shared, win) {
        this.root = root;
        this.nest = shared;
        this.win = win;
        this.doc = root.ownerDocument;
        this.key = root.dataset.key;
        this.format = new win.Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' });
        this.find = id => this.doc.getElementById(id);
        this.title = this.find('listing-title');
        this.place = this.find('listing-place');
        this.summary = this.find('listing-summary');
        this.status = this.find('sync-status');
        this.missing = this.find('listing-missing');
        this.missingText = this.find('listing-missing-text');
        this.claim = this.find('listing-claim');
        this.links = this.find('listing-links');
        this.linkForm = this.find('add-more-link');
        this.linkInput = this.find('more-link-input');
        this.linkStatus = this.find('more-link-status');
        this.facts = this.find('listing-facts');
        this.factsEmpty = this.find('facts-empty');
        this.factsForm = this.find('facts-form');
        this.factsStatus = this.find('facts-status');
        this.suggestion = this.find('facts-suggestion');
        this.comments = this.find('comments');
        this.commentsEmpty = this.find('comments-empty');
        this.commentsCount = this.find('comments-count');
        this.commentForm = this.find('comment-form');
        this.commentText = this.find('comment-text');
        this.commentCount = this.find('comment-count');
        this.commentStatus = this.find('comment-status');
        this.keys = this.find('listing-keys');
        this.listing = null;
        this.shown = new Map();
        this.dirty = false;
        this.busy = false;
        this.seen = null;
        this.handlers = [
            [this.linkForm, 'submit', event => this.submitLink(event)],
            [this.factsForm, 'submit', event => this.submitFacts(event)],
            [this.factsForm, 'input', () => {
                this.dirty = true;
            }],
            [this.commentForm, 'submit', event => this.submitComment(event)],
            [this.commentText, 'input', () => this.commentInput()],
            [this.commentText, 'keydown', event => this.commentKey(event)],
            [this.claim, 'click', () => this.claimHome()],
        ];
    }

    start() {
        for (const [element, type, handler] of this.handlers) {
            element?.addEventListener(type, handler);
        }
        if (this.commentText && !this.commentText.value) {
            this.commentText.value = readDraft(this.win.localStorage, this.key);
        }
        this.commentInput(false);
        this.unlisten = this.nest.listen(() => this.render());
        this.render();
    }

    dispose() {
        this.unlisten?.();
        for (const [element, type, handler] of this.handlers) {
            element?.removeEventListener(type, handler);
        }
    }

    render() {
        if (this.status) {
            this.status.dataset.status = this.nest.status;
            this.status.textContent = STATUS_TEXT[this.nest.status] ?? '';
        }
        for (const button of this.root.querySelectorAll('form button[type="submit"]')) {
            button.disabled = this.busy || !this.nest.live;
        }
        if (this.claim) {
            this.claim.disabled = this.busy || !this.nest.live;
        }
        const listing = findListing(this.nest.listings(), this.key);
        if (!listing) {
            if (this.nest.ready && this.nest.live) {
                this.renderMissing();
            }
            return;
        }
        this.listing = listing;
        if (this.missing) {
            this.missing.hidden = true;
        }
        if (this.claim) {
            this.claim.hidden = true;
        }
        this.doc.title = `${listing.title} · Nest`;
        this.title.textContent = listing.title;
        this.setText(this.place, placeOf(listing.fields) === listing.title ? '' : placeOf(listing.fields));
        this.setText(this.summary, summaryOf(listing.fields));
        this.renderLinks(listing);
        this.renderFacts(listing);
        this.renderForm(listing);
        this.renderComments(listing);
        this.renderKeys(listing);
    }

    setText(element, text) {
        if (element) {
            element.textContent = text;
            element.hidden = text.length === 0;
        }
    }

    renderMissing() {
        if (this.missing) {
            this.missing.hidden = false;
            this.missingText.textContent = 'Nobody connected has this home right now, and this browser has never seen it.';
        }
        if (this.claim) {
            this.claim.hidden = keyUrl(this.key) === null;
        }
    }

    renderLinks(listing) {
        if (!this.links) {
            return;
        }
        const fragment = this.doc.createDocumentFragment();
        for (const link of listing.links) {
            const item = this.doc.createElement('li');
            const anchor = this.doc.createElement('a');
            anchor.href = link.url;
            anchor.target = '_blank';
            anchor.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
            anchor.textContent = `Open on ${providerLabel(link.provider)}`;
            const where = this.doc.createElement('span');
            where.className = 'url';
            where.textContent = link.url.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '');
            item.append(anchor, where);
            fragment.append(item);
        }
        this.links.replaceChildren(fragment);
    }

    renderFacts(listing) {
        if (!this.facts) {
            return;
        }
        const fragment = this.doc.createDocumentFragment();
        for (const field of FIELDS) {
            const value = listing.fields[field.key];
            if (!value) {
                continue;
            }
            const row = this.doc.createElement('div');
            const term = this.doc.createElement('dt');
            term.textContent = field.label;
            const detail = this.doc.createElement('dd');
            detail.textContent = displayValue(field.key, value);
            const previous = previousValue(listing.history, field.key, value);
            if (previous !== null) {
                const was = this.doc.createElement('small');
                was.className = 'was';
                was.textContent = `was ${displayValue(field.key, previous)}`;
                detail.append(' ', was);
            }
            row.append(term, detail);
            fragment.append(row);
        }
        this.facts.replaceChildren(fragment);
        this.facts.hidden = this.facts.childElementCount === 0;
        if (this.factsEmpty) {
            this.factsEmpty.hidden = this.facts.childElementCount > 0;
        }
    }

    renderForm(listing) {
        if (!this.factsForm || this.dirty) {
            return;
        }
        const suggestion = addressSuggestion(listing);
        for (const field of FIELDS) {
            const input = this.factsForm.elements.namedItem(field.key);
            if (!input) {
                continue;
            }
            const suggested = suggestion && ADDRESS_FIELDS.includes(field.key) ? suggestion[field.key] ?? '' : '';
            input.value = listing.fields[field.key] ?? suggested;
        }
        if (this.suggestion) {
            this.suggestion.hidden = !suggestion;
            this.suggestion.textContent = suggestion
                ? suggestion.mixed
                    ? 'The address below comes from the link, which mixes the street and the city. Fix it, then save.'
                    : 'The address below comes from the link. Check it, then save.'
                : '';
        }
    }

    commentElement(comment, fresh) {
        const item = this.doc.createElement('li');
        item.className = 'comment';
        item.dataset.id = comment.id;
        item.classList.toggle('fresh', fresh);
        const head = this.doc.createElement('div');
        head.className = 'head';
        const time = this.doc.createElement('time');
        time.dateTime = isoOf(comment.id);
        time.textContent = timeLabel(comment.id, this.format);
        head.append(time);
        if (comment.mine) {
            const yours = this.doc.createElement('span');
            yours.className = 'yours';
            yours.textContent = 'You';
            head.append(yours);
        }
        const text = this.doc.createElement('p');
        text.className = 'text';
        text.textContent = comment.text;
        item.append(head, text);
        return item;
    }

    renderComments(listing) {
        if (!this.comments) {
            return;
        }
        const first = this.seen === null;
        const seen = this.seen ?? new Set();
        const next = new Map();
        const arrived = [];
        for (const comment of listing.comments) {
            let item = this.shown.get(comment.id);
            const mine = comment.mine === true;
            if (!item || item.classList.contains('mine') !== mine) {
                item = this.commentElement(comment, !first && !seen.has(comment.id));
                item.classList.toggle('mine', mine);
            }
            if (!first && !seen.has(comment.id) && !mine) {
                arrived.push(comment);
            }
            item.classList.toggle('archived', !this.nest.isLive(comment.id));
            next.set(comment.id, item);
            seen.add(comment.id);
        }
        this.comments.replaceChildren(...next.values());
        this.shown = next;
        this.seen = seen;
        if (this.commentsEmpty) {
            this.commentsEmpty.hidden = listing.comments.length > 0;
        }
        if (this.commentsCount) {
            this.commentsCount.textContent = listing.comments.length > 0 ? `(${listing.comments.length})` : '';
        }
        if (arrived.length > 0) {
            const announcer = this.doc.getElementById('announcer');
            if (announcer) {
                announcer.textContent = `New comment: ${arrived.at(-1).text.slice(0, 140)}`;
            }
        }
    }

    renderKeys(listing) {
        if (!this.keys) {
            return;
        }
        const fragment = this.doc.createDocumentFragment();
        for (const key of listing.keys) {
            const item = this.doc.createElement('li');
            const provider = this.doc.createElement('span');
            provider.className = 'provider';
            provider.textContent = providerLabel(providerOf(key));
            const value = this.doc.createElement('code');
            const label = keyLabel(key);
            value.textContent = providerOf(key) === 'address' ? label : label.slice(label.indexOf(' ') + 1);
            item.append(provider, ' ', value);
            fragment.append(item);
        }
        this.keys.replaceChildren(fragment);
    }

    commentInput(save = true) {
        if (!this.commentText) {
            return;
        }
        const length = this.commentText.value.length;
        if (this.commentCount) {
            this.commentCount.textContent = countText(length, COMMENT_MAX);
            this.commentCount.classList.toggle('full', length >= COMMENT_MAX);
        }
        if (save) {
            writeDraft(this.win.localStorage, this.key, this.commentText.value);
        }
    }

    commentKey(event) {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' && (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            this.commentForm?.requestSubmit();
        }
    }

    async send(draft, output) {
        this.busy = true;
        this.render();
        try {
            const outcome = await this.nest.post(draft);
            const ok = outcome.result === 'accepted' || outcome.result === 'exists';
            if (output) {
                output.textContent = ok ? '' : RESULT_TEXT[outcome.result] ?? RESULT_TEXT.invalid;
            }
            return ok ? outcome : null;
        } finally {
            this.busy = false;
            this.render();
        }
    }

    anchors() {
        return anchorsOf(this.listing, this.key);
    }

    async submitComment(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const text = this.commentText?.value ?? '';
        if (text.trim().length === 0) {
            this.commentStatus.textContent = 'Write something first.';
            return;
        }
        const outcome = await this.send({ kind: 'comment', anchors: this.anchors(), text }, this.commentStatus);
        if (outcome) {
            this.commentText.value = '';
            this.commentInput();
        }
    }

    async submitFacts(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const inputs = {};
        for (const field of FIELDS) {
            const input = this.factsForm.elements.namedItem(field.key);
            if (input) {
                inputs[field.key] = input.value;
            }
        }
        for (const element of this.factsForm.querySelectorAll('.error')) {
            element.textContent = '';
        }
        const { changes, errors } = changedFields(this.listing?.fields ?? {}, inputs);
        if (errors.length > 0) {
            for (const { key, error } of errors) {
                const output = this.find(`fact-${key}-error`);
                if (output) {
                    output.textContent = error;
                }
            }
            this.factsStatus.textContent = 'Fix the highlighted values.';
            this.factsForm.elements.namedItem(errors[0].key)?.focus();
            return;
        }
        if (changes.length === 0) {
            this.factsStatus.textContent = 'Nothing changed.';
            return;
        }
        const outcome = await this.send({ kind: 'fact', anchors: this.anchors(), fields: changes }, this.factsStatus);
        if (outcome) {
            this.dirty = false;
            this.factsStatus.textContent = 'Saved.';
            this.render();
        }
    }

    async submitLink(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const parsed = parseLink(this.linkInput?.value ?? '');
        if (!parsed) {
            this.linkStatus.textContent = 'Paste a full link that starts with https://';
            return;
        }
        if (this.listing?.keys.includes(parsed.key)) {
            this.linkStatus.textContent = 'This home already has that link.';
            return;
        }
        const outcome = await this.send({ kind: 'link', anchors: this.anchors(), url: parsed.url }, this.linkStatus);
        if (outcome) {
            this.linkInput.value = '';
            this.linkStatus.textContent = 'Link added.';
        }
    }

    async claimHome() {
        const url = keyUrl(this.key);
        if (url) {
            await this.send({ kind: 'link', anchors: [], url }, this.missingText);
        }
    }
}

export function mount(root, shared, win) {
    const view = new ListingView(root, shared, win);
    view.start();
    return { dispose: () => view.dispose() };
}

import { openDatabase } from '../Islands/BoardIsland.razor.js';

export const DB_NAME = 'chaos-reading';
export const DB_VERSION = 1;
export const STORE = 'articles';
export const LOCAL_CAP = 1000;

export const migrations = [
    db => db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: 'id' }),
];

export const SCHEMA = Object.freeze({ name: DB_NAME, version: DB_VERSION, store: STORE, migrations, cap: LOCAL_CAP });

const ID = /^[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const MAX_TEXT = 500;

function clip(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
        return null;
    }
    const text = value.trim();
    return text.length > 0 ? text.slice(0, MAX_TEXT) : null;
}

export function isId(value) {
    return typeof value === 'string' && ID.test(value);
}

export function entryOf(dataset) {
    const id = dataset?.reading;
    const title = clip(dataset?.title);
    if (!isId(id) || !title) {
        return null;
    }
    return { id, title, byline: clip(dataset.byline), published: clip(dataset.published) };
}

export function remember(previous, entry, now) {
    const reads = Number.isFinite(previous?.reads) && previous.reads > 0 ? previous.reads : 0;
    const first = Number.isFinite(previous?.first) ? previous.first : now;
    return { ...entry, first, last: now, reads: reads + 1 };
}

export function recentFirst(a, b) {
    const difference = (b.last ?? 0) - (a.last ?? 0);
    if (difference !== 0) {
        return difference;
    }
    return a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0;
}

export function shelved(records) {
    return records.filter(record => isId(record?.id) && clip(record.title)).sort(recentFirst);
}

export function overflow(records, cap = LOCAL_CAP) {
    return shelved(records).slice(cap).map(record => record.id);
}

export function readLabel(ms, now = Date.now()) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) {
        return '';
    }
    const iso = new Date(ms).toISOString();
    const today = new Date(now).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    return iso.slice(0, 10) === today ? `today ${iso.slice(11, 16)} UTC` : iso.slice(0, 10);
}

export function readsText(reads) {
    return reads > 1 ? `${reads} reads` : '';
}

export function hrefOf(id) {
    return `read/${id}`;
}

function settle(request) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
}

function finished(transaction) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
    });
}

export async function visit(factory, entry, now = Date.now()) {
    if (!factory) {
        return [];
    }
    const db = await openDatabase(factory, SCHEMA);
    try {
        if (entry) {
            const transaction = db.transaction(STORE, 'readwrite');
            const done = finished(transaction);
            const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE);
            store.put(remember(await settle(store.get(entry.id)), entry, now));
            await done;
        }
        const records = await settle(db.transaction(STORE, 'readonly').objectStore(STORE).getAll());
        const excess = overflow(records);
        if (excess.length > 0) {
            const transaction = db.transaction(STORE, 'readwrite');
            const done = finished(transaction);
            const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE);
            for (const id of excess) {
                store.delete(id);
            }
            await done;
        }
        const gone = new Set(excess);
        return shelved(records).filter(record => !gone.has(record.id));
    } finally {
        db.close();
    }
}

function item(doc, record, current, now) {
    const element = doc.createElement('li');
    element.dataset.id = record.id;
    const link = doc.createElement('a');
    link.href = hrefOf(record.id);
    link.textContent = record.title;
    if (record.id === current) {
        link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    }
    const seen = doc.createElement('span');
    seen.className = 'seen';
    const parts = [record.byline, readLabel(record.last, now) && `Read ${readLabel(record.last, now)}`, readsText(record.reads)].filter(Boolean);
    for (const part of parts) {
        const span = doc.createElement('span');
        span.textContent = part;
        seen.append(span);
    }
    if (record.id === current) {
        const badge = doc.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'now';
        badge.textContent = 'Reading now';
        seen.append(badge);
    }
    element.append(link, seen);
    return element;
}

export function render(doc, list, empty, records, current, now = Date.now()) {
    const fragment = doc.createDocumentFragment();
    for (const record of records) {
        fragment.append(item(doc, record, current, now));
    }
    list.replaceChildren(fragment);
    if (empty) {
        empty.hidden = records.length > 0;
    }
}

let generation = 0;

export async function track(win) {
    const doc = win.document;
    const list = doc.getElementById('reading-history');
    if (!list) {
        return;
    }
    const run = ++generation;
    const article = doc.querySelector('article[data-reading]');
    const entry = article ? entryOf(article.dataset) : null;
    let records = [];
    try {
        records = await visit(win.indexedDB, entry);
    } catch {
        records = entry ? [remember(null, entry, Date.now())] : [];
    }
    if (run !== generation || !list.isConnected) {
        return;
    }
    render(doc, list, doc.getElementById('reading-empty'), records, entry?.id ?? null);
}

@code {
    private ProjectAccess? _access;
    private IReadOnlyList<WorkItemSummary> _items = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<SprintRecord> _sprints = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<MemberRecord> _members = [];
    private string? _message;
    private bool _error;

    [Parameter]
    public string Key { get; set; } = "";

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "q")]
    public string? Q { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "kind")]
    public string? KindFilter { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "assignee")]
    public Guid? Assignee { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "done")]
    public bool Done { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    private bool Filtered => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Q) || KindFilter is { Length: > 0 } || Assignee is not null || Done;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(Name = "sprint")]
    private string? PlanSprint { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "quick-add")]
    private ItemForm Quick { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        Quick ??= new ItemForm();
        _access = await Work.OpenAsync(Key, HttpContext.User.ToActor(), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (_access is null)
        {
            HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
            return;
        }

        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        var project = _access!.Project.Id;
        _sprints = await Sprints.ListAsync(project, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _members = await Projects.MembersAsync(project, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _items = await Items.ListAsync(
            new WorkItemQuery(project, IncludeDone: Done, Kind: WorkItemKinds.IsKnown(KindFilter) ? KindFilter : null, AssigneeId: Assignee, Text: string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Q) ? null : Q),
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    private async Task QuickAddAsync()
    {
        if (_access is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        Quick.Status = WorkItemStatuses.Backlog;
        var (problem, number) = await Work.CreateItemAsync(_access, Quick, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (problem is not null)
        {
            Say(problem, true);
            return;
        }

        Quick = new ItemForm { Kind = Quick.Kind };
        Say($"Added {_access.Key}-{number}.", false);
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task MoveAsync(int number, bool up)
    {
        await Work.MoveAsync(_access!, number, up, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task PlanAsync(int number, string? sprint)
    {
        var problem = await Work.SetSprintAsync(_access!, number, Guid.TryParse(sprint, out var id) ? id : null, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (problem is not null)
        {
            Say(problem, true);
        }

        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private void Say(string message, bool error)
    {
        _message = message;
        _error = error;
    }

    private RenderFragment Rows(IReadOnlyList<WorkItemSummary> items) => __builder =>
    {
        var access = _access!;
        var key = access.Key;
        if (items.Count == 0)
        {
            <p class="empty">Nothing here.</p>
            return;
        }

        <ol class="item-list">
            @foreach (var item in items)
            {
                var number = item.Number;
                <li class="item-row">
                    <div>
                        <div class="title">

@code {
    private ProjectAccess? _access;
    private SprintRecord? _active;
    private IReadOnlyList<WorkItemSummary> _items = [];
    private string? _message;

    [Parameter]
    public string Key { get; set; } = "";

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(Name = "status")]
    private string? Status { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        _access = await Work.OpenAsync(Key, HttpContext.User.ToActor(), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (_access is null)
        {
            HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
            return;
        }

        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        var sprints = await Sprints.ListAsync(_access!.Project.Id, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _active = sprints.FirstOrDefault(sprint => sprint.State == SprintStates.Active);
        var items = await Items.ListAsync(new WorkItemQuery(_access.Project.Id, SprintId: _active?.Id), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _items = _active is null ? items.Where(item => item.Status != WorkItemStatuses.Backlog).ToList() : items;
    }

    private async Task SetStatusAsync(int number)
    {
        _message = await Work.SetStatusAsync(_access!, number, Status, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        await LoadAsync();
    }
}

@code {
    private ProjectAccess? _access;
    private WorkItemRecord? _item;
    private IReadOnlyList<MemberRecord> _members = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<SprintRecord> _sprints = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<WorkItemSummary> _epics = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<WorkItemSummary> _children = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<CommentRecord> _comments = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<AttachmentRecord> _attachments = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<WorkItemEventRecord> _history = [];
    private string? _message;
    private bool _error;

    [Parameter]
    public string Key { get; set; } = "";

    [Parameter]
    public int Number { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "edit-item")]
    private ItemForm? Form { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(Name = "body")]
    private string? Body { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        _access = await Work.OpenAsync(Key, HttpContext.User.ToActor(), HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (_access is null)
        {
            HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
            return;
        }

        await LoadAsync(Form is null);
        if (_item is null)
        {
            HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync(bool resetForm)
    {
        var project = _access!.Project.Id;
        var cancellation = HttpContext.RequestAborted;
        _item = await Items.FindAsync(project, Number, cancellationToken: cancellation);
        if (_item is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (resetForm)
        {
            Form = ItemForm.From(_item);
        }

        _members = await Projects.MembersAsync(project, cancellation);
        _sprints = await Sprints.ListAsync(project, cancellation);
        _epics = await Items.EpicsAsync(project, cancellation);
        _children = _item.Kind == WorkItemKinds.Epic ? await Items.ChildrenAsync(_item.Id, cancellation) : [];
        _comments = await Comments.ListAsync(_item.Id, cancellation);
        _attachments = await Attachments.ListAsync(_item.Id, cancellation);
        _history = await Items.HistoryAsync(_item.Id, cancellation);
    }

    private async Task SaveAsync() => await RunAsync(Work.UpdateItemAsync(_access!, Number, Form!, HttpContext.RequestAborted), "Saved.");

    private async Task AddCommentAsync()
    {
        var problem = await Work.AddCommentAsync(_access!, _item!, Body, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        await AfterAsync(problem, "Comment added.");
    }

    private async Task EditCommentAsync(Guid id) => await RunAsync(Work.EditCommentAsync(_access!, _item!, id, Body, HttpContext.RequestAborted), "Comment saved.");

    private async Task DeleteCommentAsync(Guid id) => await RunAsync(Work.DeleteCommentAsync(_access!, _item!, id, HttpContext.RequestAborted), "Comment moved to the trash.");

    private async Task DeleteFileAsync(AttachmentRecord file) => await RunAsync(Work.DeleteAttachmentAsync(_access!, file, HttpContext.RequestAborted), "File moved to the trash.");

    private async Task DeleteAsync()
    {
        var problem = await Work.DeleteItemAsync(_access!, _item!, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (problem is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(_access!.Path());
            return;
        }

        await AfterAsync(problem, null);
    }

    private async Task RunAsync(Task<string?> action, string success) => await AfterAsync(await action, success);

    private async Task AfterAsync(string? problem, string? success)
    {
        _message = problem ?? success;
        _error = problem is not null;
        Body = null;
        await LoadAsync(problem is null);
    }

    private static string Describe(WorkItemEventRecord change) => change.Field switch
    {
        "created" => $"created {change.NewValue}",
        "description" => "edited the description",
        _ => $"changed {change.Field} from {change.OldValue ?? "nothing"} to {change.NewValue ?? "nothing"}",
    };
}
