using System.Threading.Channels;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Nest;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Nest;

internal sealed partial class NestJournal(NestEntryStore store, ILogger<NestJournal> logger) : BackgroundService, INestJournal
{
    private readonly Channel<Entry[]> _pending = Channel.CreateUnbounded<Entry[]>(new UnboundedChannelOptions { SingleReader = true });

    public void Append(IReadOnlyList<Entry> entries)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entries);
        if (entries.Count > 0)
        {
            _pending.Writer.TryWrite([.. entries]);
        }
    }

    public override async Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _pending.Writer.TryComplete();
        await base.StopAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        var reader = _pending.Reader;
        while (await WaitAsync(reader, stoppingToken))
        {
            var batch = new List<NestEntryRow>();
            while (batch.Count < 500 && reader.TryRead(out var entries))
            {
                batch.AddRange(entries.Select(NestStorage.ToRow));
            }

            for (var attempt = 1; ; attempt++)
            {
                try
                {
                    await store.InsertAsync(batch, CancellationToken.None);
                    break;
                }
                catch (Exception exception) when (exception is Npgsql.NpgsqlException or TimeoutException && attempt < 5)
                {
                    LogRetry(logger, batch.Count, attempt, exception.Message);
                    await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(attempt * 2), CancellationToken.None);
                }
                catch (Exception exception) when (exception is Npgsql.NpgsqlException or TimeoutException)
                {
                    LogLost(logger, batch.Count, exception.Message);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static async Task<bool> WaitAsync(ChannelReader<Entry[]> reader, CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        try
        {
            return await reader.WaitToReadAsync(stoppingToken);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return reader.TryPeek(out _);
        }
    }

    [LoggerMessage(Level = LogLevel.Warning, Message = "Could not store {Count} home entries (attempt {Attempt}): {Reason}")]
    private static partial void LogRetry(ILogger logger, int count, int attempt, string reason);

    [LoggerMessage(Level = LogLevel.Error, Message = "Gave up storing {Count} home entries: {Reason}. Browsers still hold them and will offer them back.")]
    private static partial void LogLost(ILogger logger, int count, string reason);
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Nest;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Nest;

internal sealed partial class NestLoader(NestEntryStore store, NestService service, IOptions<NestOptions> options, ILogger<NestLoader> logger)
{
    public async Task LoadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var records = await store.LoadAsync(options.Value.Capacity, cancellationToken);
        var deleted = records.Where(record => record.DeletedAt is not null).Select(record => record.Id).ToList();
        var live = new List<Entry>();
        var skipped = 0;
        foreach (var record in records.Where(record => record.DeletedAt is null))
        {
            if (NestStorage.ToEntry(record) is { } entry)
            {
                live.Add(entry);
            }
            else
            {
                skipped++;
            }
        }

        service.Load(live, deleted);
        LogLoaded(logger, live.Count, deleted.Count, skipped);
    }

    [LoggerMessage(Level = LogLevel.Information, Message = "Loaded {Live} home entries ({Deleted} deleted, {Skipped} unreadable)")]
    private static partial void LogLoaded(ILogger logger, int live, int deleted, int skipped);
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Nest;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Pages;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Trash;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Access;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Administration;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Nest;

internal sealed record HomeModeration(string Key, string Title, IReadOnlyList<string> Keys, IReadOnlyList<NestEntryRecord> Entries, bool CanModerate);

internal sealed class NestModeration(NestService nest, NestEntryStore entries, PageEditorStore editors, TrashService trash)
{
    public const string PagePrefix = "home:";

    public static string PageKey(string listingKey) => PagePrefix + listingKey;

    public async Task<HomeModeration> LoadAsync(string key, Actor? actor, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var listing = nest.FindListing(key);
        var keys = listing?.Keys ?? [key];
        var stored = await entries.ForKeysAsync(keys.ToArray(), cancellationToken);
        return new HomeModeration(key, listing?.Title ?? ListingKey.Label(key), keys, stored, await CanModerateAsync(actor, keys, cancellationToken));
    }

    public async Task<bool> DeleteAsync(Actor? actor, Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var entry = await entries.FindAsync(id, cancellationToken);
        if (actor is null || entry is null || !await CanModerateAsync(actor, entry.Keys, cancellationToken))
        {
            return false;
        }

        return await trash.SoftDeleteAsync(actor, Subject.NestEntry, id, Summary(entry), cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<bool> RestoreAsync(Actor? actor, Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var entry = await entries.FindAsync(id, cancellationToken);
        if (actor is null || entry is null || !await CanModerateAsync(actor, entry.Keys, cancellationToken))
        {
            return false;
        }

        return await trash.RestoreAsync(actor, Subject.NestEntry, id, cancellationToken);
    }

    public static string Summary(NestEntryRecord entry)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entry);
        var text = entry.Text ?? entry.Url ?? entry.Fields ?? string.Join(' ', entry.Keys);
        return $"{entry.Kind}: {(text.Length > 80 ? text[..80] : text)}";
    }

    private async Task<bool> CanModerateAsync(Actor? actor, IReadOnlyCollection<string> keys, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        actor is not null
        && (actor.IsAdministrator
            || await editors.IsEditorAsync(actor.PersonId, keys.Select(PageKey).ToArray(), cancellationToken));
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Nest;

internal sealed class NestService
{
    public const int MaxFetch = 100;
    public const int RepeatWindow = 20;

    private readonly TimeProvider _time;
    private readonly KeyedTokenBuckets _posts;
    private readonly Lock _gate = new();
    private readonly HashSet<INestSubscriber> _subscribers = [];
    private readonly INestJournal _journal;
    private HashSet<Guid> _deleted = [];
    private Entry[] _entries = [];
    private Dictionary<Guid, Entry> _byId = new();
    private ListingCache? _listings;
    private long _version;

    public NestService(TimeProvider time, IOptions<NestOptions> options, INestJournal? journal = null)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(time);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        var limits = options.Value;
        _time = time;
        _journal = journal ?? INestJournal.None;
        Capacity = limits.Capacity;
        _posts = new KeyedTokenBuckets(limits.PostBurst, limits.PostsPerSecond, time);
        StartedAt = time.GetUtcNow();
    }

    public int Capacity { get; }

    public DateTimeOffset StartedAt { get; }

    public IReadOnlyList<Entry> Entries => Volatile.Read(ref _entries);

    public long Version
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _version;
            }
        }
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<Listing> Listings
    {
        get
        {
            var entries = Volatile.Read(ref _entries);
            var cache = Volatile.Read(ref _listings);
            if (cache is not null && ReferenceEquals(cache.Source, entries))
            {
                return cache.Listings;
            }

            var listings = ListingIndex.Build(entries);
            Volatile.Write(ref _listings, new ListingCache(entries, listings));
            return listings;
        }
    }

    public Listing? FindListing(string key) => ListingIndex.Find(Listings, key);

    public SubmitReply Submit(EntryDraft? draft, string client)
    {
        var candidate = draft is null ? null : EntryRules.Build(Guid.Empty, draft);
        if (candidate is null)
        {
            return new SubmitReply(SubmitResult.Invalid);
        }

        var key = KeyOf(candidate);
        if (!_posts.TryTake(client))
        {
            return new SubmitReply(SubmitResult.TooFast);
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (Exists(candidate))
            {
                return new SubmitReply(SubmitResult.Exists, Key: key);
            }

            if (IsRepeat(candidate))
            {
                return new SubmitReply(SubmitResult.Repeat);
            }

            var newest = _entries.Length > 0 ? _entries[0].Id : Guid.Empty;
            var entry = candidate with { Id = Uuid7.After(newest, _time.GetUtcNow()) };
            Merge([entry]);
            return new SubmitReply(SubmitResult.Accepted, entry, key);
        }
    }

    public int Offer(IEnumerable<Entry> offered)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(offered);
        var now = _time.GetUtcNow();
        var valid = new List<Entry>();
        foreach (var entry in offered.Take(Capacity))
        {
            if (IsAcceptable(entry, now))
            {
                valid.Add(entry);
            }
        }

        if (valid.Count == 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            return Merge(valid);
        }
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<Entry> Find(IEnumerable<Guid> ids)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(ids);
        var byId = Volatile.Read(ref _byId);
        var found = new List<Entry>();
        foreach (var id in ids.Take(MaxFetch))
        {
            if (byId.TryGetValue(id, out var entry))
            {
                found.Add(entry);
            }
        }

        return found;
    }

    public void Subscribe(INestSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(subscriber);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (subscriber.Deliver(NestUpdate.Snapshot(_version, Capacity, _entries, [.. _deleted])))
            {
                _subscribers.Add(subscriber);
            }
        }
    }

    public void Unsubscribe(INestSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _subscribers.Remove(subscriber);
        }
    }

    public bool IsSubscribed(INestSubscriber subscriber)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _subscribers.Contains(subscriber);
        }
    }

    private static string KeyOf(Entry entry) =>
        EntryRules.DerivedKey(entry) ?? entry.Keys.Order(ListingKey.Comparer).First();

    private bool IsAcceptable(Entry? entry, DateTimeOffset now) =>
        entry is not null
        && !Volatile.Read(ref _deleted).Contains(entry.Id)
        && EntryWindow.IsRestorable(entry.Id, now, StartedAt)
        && EntryRules.IsNormalized(entry);

    private bool Exists(Entry candidate)
    {
        if (!string.Equals(candidate.Kind, EntryKinds.Link, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (var entry in _entries)
        {
            if (string.Equals(entry.Kind, EntryKinds.Link, StringComparison.Ordinal)
                && candidate.Keys.All(key => entry.Keys.Contains(key, StringComparer.Ordinal)))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private bool IsRepeat(Entry candidate)
    {
        var window = Math.Min(RepeatWindow, _entries.Length);
        for (var i = 0; i < window; i++)
        {
            var entry = _entries[i];
            if (string.Equals(entry.Kind, candidate.Kind, StringComparison.Ordinal)
                && string.Equals(entry.Text, candidate.Text, StringComparison.Ordinal)
                && entry.Keys.SequenceEqual(candidate.Keys, StringComparer.Ordinal)
                && FieldsEqual(entry.Fields, candidate.Fields))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static bool FieldsEqual(IReadOnlyList<FieldValue>? a, IReadOnlyList<FieldValue>? b) =>
        a is null ? b is null : b is not null && a.SequenceEqual(b);

    private int Merge(IReadOnlyCollection<Entry> candidates)
    {
        var change = EntryWindow.Merge(_entries, candidates, Capacity);
        if (change is null)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var previous = _version;
        _version++;
        Volatile.Write(ref _byId, change.Next.ToDictionary(entry => entry.Id));
        Volatile.Write(ref _entries, change.Next);
        Broadcast(NestUpdate.Delta(_version, previous, change.Added, change.Removed));
        _journal.Append(change.Added);
        return change.Added.Length;
    }

    public void Load(IEnumerable<Entry> entries, IEnumerable<Guid> deleted)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entries);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(deleted);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            var tombstones = deleted.ToHashSet();
            var next = entries
                .Where(entry => !tombstones.Contains(entry.Id))
                .DistinctBy(entry => entry.Id)
                .OrderByDescending(entry => entry.Id)
                .Take(Capacity)
                .ToArray();
            _version++;
            Volatile.Write(ref _deleted, tombstones);
            Volatile.Write(ref _byId, next.ToDictionary(entry => entry.Id));
            Volatile.Write(ref _entries, next);
            Broadcast(NestUpdate.Snapshot(_version, Capacity, next, [.. tombstones]));
        }
    }

    public bool Remove(Guid id)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            var deleted = new HashSet<Guid>(_deleted) { id };
            Volatile.Write(ref _deleted, deleted);
            var previous = _version;
            _version++;
            var next = _entries.Where(entry => entry.Id != id).ToArray();
            var removed = next.Length != _entries.Length;
            Volatile.Write(ref _byId, next.ToDictionary(entry => entry.Id));
            Volatile.Write(ref _entries, next);
            Broadcast(NestUpdate.Delta(_version, previous, [], removed ? [id] : [], [id]));
            return removed;
        }
    }

    public void Restore(Entry entry)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entry);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            var deleted = new HashSet<Guid>(_deleted);
            deleted.Remove(entry.Id);
            Volatile.Write(ref _deleted, deleted);
            var change = EntryWindow.Merge(_entries, [entry], Capacity);
            if (change is null)
            {
                return;
            }

            var previous = _version;
            _version++;
            Volatile.Write(ref _byId, change.Next.ToDictionary(item => item.Id));
            Volatile.Write(ref _entries, change.Next);
            Broadcast(NestUpdate.Delta(_version, previous, change.Added, change.Removed));
        }
    }

    private void Broadcast(NestUpdate update)
    {
        List<INestSubscriber>? dropped = null;
        foreach (var subscriber in _subscribers)
        {
            if (!subscriber.Deliver(update))
            {
                (dropped ??= []).Add(subscriber);
            }
        }

        if (dropped is not null)
        {
            _subscribers.ExceptWith(dropped);
        }
    }

    private sealed record ListingCache(Entry[] Source, IReadOnlyList<Listing> Listings);
}

using System.Text.Json;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Nest;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Nest;

internal static class NestStorage
{
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Json = new(JsonSerializerDefaults.Web);

    public static NestEntryRow ToRow(Entry entry)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entry);
        return new NestEntryRow(
            entry.Id,
            entry.Kind,
            [.. entry.Keys],
            entry.Url,
            entry.Fields is null ? null : JsonSerializer.Serialize(entry.Fields, Json),
            entry.Text);
    }

    public static Entry? ToEntry(NestEntryRecord record)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(record);
        IReadOnlyList<FieldValue>? fields = null;
        if (record.Fields is not null)
        {
            try
            {
                fields = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<FieldValue>>(record.Fields, Json);
            }
            catch (JsonException)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        var entry = new Entry(record.Id, record.Kind, record.Keys, record.Url, fields, record.Text);
        return EntryRules.IsNormalized(entry) ? entry : null;
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Nest;

internal sealed record FieldWire(string? Key, string? Value);

internal sealed record EntryWire(string? Id, string? Kind, IReadOnlyList<string?>? Keys, string? Url, IReadOnlyList<FieldWire?>? Fields, string? Text)
{
    public Entry? ToEntry()
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParseExact(Id, "D", out var id) || Kind is null || Keys is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var keys = new List<string>(Keys.Count);
        foreach (var key in Keys)
        {
            if (key is null)
            {
                return null;
            }

            keys.Add(key);
        }

        List<FieldValue>? fields = null;
        if (Fields is not null)
        {
            fields = new List<FieldValue>(Fields.Count);
            foreach (var field in Fields)
            {
                if (field?.Key is null || field.Value is null)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                fields.Add(new FieldValue(field.Key, field.Value));
            }
        }

        return new Entry(id, Kind, keys, Url, fields, Text);
    }
}

internal sealed record EntryDraft(string? Kind, IReadOnlyList<string?>? Anchors, string? Url, IReadOnlyList<FieldWire?>? Fields, string? Text);

internal sealed record PostOutcome(string Result, Entry? Entry, string? Key)
{
    public static PostOutcome From(SubmitReply reply)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(reply);
        return new PostOutcome(NameOf(reply.Result), reply.Entry, reply.Key);
    }

    public static string NameOf(SubmitResult result) => result switch
    {
        SubmitResult.Accepted => "accepted",
        SubmitResult.Exists => "exists",
        SubmitResult.TooFast => "tooFast",
        SubmitResult.Repeat => "repeat",
        _ => "invalid",
    };
}

internal static class Wire
{
    public static JsonSerializerOptions Options { get; } = new(JsonSerializerDefaults.Web);

    public static T? Read<T>(JsonElement element)
        where T : class
    {
        try
        {
            return element.Deserialize<T>(Options);
        }
        catch (JsonException)
        {
            return null;
        }
        catch (NotSupportedException)
        {
            return null;
        }
        catch (InvalidOperationException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static JsonElement Write<T>(T value) => JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(value, Options);
}

using Dapper;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Persistence;

internal sealed class DatabaseHealthCheck(Database database) : IHealthCheck
{
    public async Task<HealthCheckResult> CheckHealthAsync(HealthCheckContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            await using var connection = await database.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
            await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>(new CommandDefinition("SELECT 1", cancellationToken: cancellationToken));
            return HealthCheckResult.Healthy();
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is Npgsql.NpgsqlException or TimeoutException or InvalidOperationException)
        {
            return HealthCheckResult.Unhealthy("The database is not reachable.");
        }
    }

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection.KeyManagement;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Persistence;

internal static class PersistenceRegistration
{
    public const string ConnectionStringName = "Playground";

    public static IServiceCollection AddPersistence(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var connectionString = configuration.GetConnectionString(ConnectionStringName)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Set ConnectionStrings__{ConnectionStringName}.");
        services.AddSingleton(_ =>
        {
            var builder = new NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder(connectionString);
            builder.ConnectionStringBuilder.ApplicationName ??= "myblazorplayground";
            return builder.Build();
        });
        services.AddSingleton<Database>();
        services.AddSingleton<MigrationRunner>();
        services.AddSingleton<PersonStore>();
        services.AddSingleton<SiteSettings>();
        services.AddSingleton<AuditLog>();
        services.AddSingleton<DataProtectionKeyStore>();

using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Work;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Text;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Work;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Work;

public sealed class ItemForm
{
    private string _kind = WorkItemKinds.Story;
    private string _status = WorkItemStatuses.Backlog;
    private int _priority = Priorities.Medium;

    public string Kind
    {
        get => _kind;
        set => _kind = string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? WorkItemKinds.Story : value;
    }

    public string? Title { get; set; }

    public string? Description { get; set; }

    public string Status
    {
        get => _status;
        set => _status = string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? WorkItemStatuses.Backlog : value;
    }

    public int Priority
    {
        get => _priority;
        set => _priority = value == 0 ? Priorities.Medium : value;
    }

    public int? Points { get; set; }

    public Guid? AssigneeId { get; set; }

    public Guid? SprintId { get; set; }

    public Guid? ParentId { get; set; }

    public static ItemForm From(WorkItemRecord item)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(item);
        return new ItemForm
        {
            Kind = item.Kind,
            Title = item.Title,
            Description = item.Description,
            Status = item.Status,
            Priority = item.Priority,
            Points = item.Points,
            AssigneeId = item.AssigneeId,
            SprintId = item.SprintId,
            ParentId = item.ParentId,
        };
    }

    public string? Problem() =>
        !WorkItemKinds.IsKnown(Kind) ? "Pick a kind."
        : !WorkItemStatuses.IsKnown(Status) ? "Pick a status."
        : !Priorities.IsKnown(Priority) ? "Pick a priority."
        : WorkRules.TitleProblem(Title) ?? WorkRules.PointsProblem(Points);

    public WorkItemFields ToFields()
    {
        var status = SprintId is not null && Status == WorkItemStatuses.Backlog ? WorkItemStatuses.ToDo : Status;
        return new WorkItemFields(
            Kind,
            PlainText.Line(Title, WorkRules.MaxTitle),
            WorkRules.Description(Description),
            status,
            Priority,
            Points,
            AssigneeId,
            SprintId,
            Kind == WorkItemKinds.Epic ? null : ParentId);
    }
}

public sealed class SprintForm
{
    public string? Name { get; set; }

    public string? Goal { get; set; }

    public DateOnly? StartsOn { get; set; }

    public DateOnly? EndsOn { get; set; }

    public string? Problem() =>
        PlainText.Line(Name, WorkRules.MaxSprintName).Length == 0 ? "Give the sprint a name." : WorkRules.SprintDatesProblem(StartsOn, EndsOn);

    public SprintDraft ToDraft() =>
        new(PlainText.Line(Name, WorkRules.MaxSprintName), PlainText.Block(Goal, WorkRules.MaxGoal), StartsOn, EndsOn);
}

    public string? Key { get; set; }

    public string? Name { get; set; }

    public string? Description { get; set; }
}

using System.Text;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Antiforgery;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Features;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Microsoft.Net.Http.Headers;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Work;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Files;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Text;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Identity;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Work;

internal static class WorkEndpoints
{
    public const string FileNameHeader = "X-File-Name";
    private const int MaxPreviewBytes = 512 * 1024;

    public static IEndpointRouteBuilder MapWorkEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints)
    {
        var group = endpoints.MapGroup("/work").RequireAuthorization();
        group.MapPost("/{key}/attachments", UploadAsync).DisableAntiforgery();
        group.MapGet("/files/{id:guid}/{name?}", DownloadAsync);
        group.MapPost("/{key}/preview", PreviewAsync).DisableAntiforgery();
        return endpoints;
    }

    private static async Task<IResult> UploadAsync(
        string key,
        int? item,
        HttpContext context,
        IAntiforgery antiforgery,
        WorkService work,
        WorkItemStore items,
        AttachmentStore attachments,
        IOptions<WorkOptions> options)
    {
        if (!await antiforgery.IsRequestValidAsync(context))
        {
            return Results.BadRequest(new { error = "The page is out of date. Reload it and try again." });
        }

        var access = await work.OpenAsync(key, context.User.ToActor(), context.RequestAborted);
        if (access is null || !access.CanEdit)
        {
            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        Guid? itemId = null;
        if (item is { } number)
        {
            var record = await items.FindAsync(access.Project.Id, number, cancellationToken: context.RequestAborted);
            if (record is null)
            {
                return Results.NotFound();
            }

            itemId = record.Id;
        }

        var max = options.Value.MaxAttachmentBytes;
        if (context.Features.Get<IHttpMaxRequestBodySizeFeature>() is { IsReadOnly: false } limit)
        {
            limit.MaxRequestBodySize = max + 1;
        }

        if (context.Request.ContentLength is { } length && length > max)
        {
            return Results.Json(new { error = $"Files are at most {FileRules.Size(max)}." }, statusCode: StatusCodes.Status413PayloadTooLarge);
        }

        var name = FileRules.SafeFileName(Uri.UnescapeDataString(context.Request.Headers[FileNameHeader].ToString()));
        UploadResult result;
        try
        {
            result = await attachments.UploadAsync(new AttachmentUpload(access.Project.Id, itemId, access.Actor.PersonId, name), context.Request.Body, max, context.RequestAborted);
        }
        catch (BadHttpRequestException exception) when (exception.StatusCode == StatusCodes.Status413PayloadTooLarge)
        {
            result = new UploadResult(UploadOutcome.TooLarge);
        }

        return result switch
        {
            { Outcome: UploadOutcome.Stored, Attachment: { } stored } => Results.Json(new
            {
                id = stored.Id,
                name = stored.FileName,
                url = FileUrl(stored),
                image = stored.IsImage,
                size = FileRules.Size(stored.Length),
            }),
            { Outcome: UploadOutcome.TooLarge } => Results.Json(new { error = $"Files are at most {FileRules.Size(max)}." }, statusCode: StatusCodes.Status413PayloadTooLarge),
            _ => Results.BadRequest(new { error = "That file is empty." }),
        };
    }

    private static async Task DownloadAsync(Guid id, HttpContext context, WorkService work, AttachmentStore attachments)
    {
        var attachment = await attachments.FindAsync(id, context.RequestAborted);
        var access = attachment is null ? null : await work.OpenAsync(attachment.ProjectId, context.User.ToActor(), context.RequestAborted);
        if (attachment is null || access is null)
        {
            context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
            return;
        }

        var headers = context.Response.Headers;
        context.Response.ContentType = attachment.IsImage ? attachment.ContentType : "application/octet-stream";
        context.Response.ContentLength = attachment.Length;
        headers.CacheControl = "private, max-age=31536000, immutable";
        headers.ContentSecurityPolicy = "default-src 'none'; img-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; sandbox";
        headers.ContentDisposition = new ContentDispositionHeaderValue(attachment.IsImage ? "inline" : "attachment")
        {
            FileNameStar = attachment.FileName,
            FileName = Ascii(attachment.FileName),
        }.ToString();
        if (HttpMethods.IsHead(context.Request.Method))
        {
            return;
        }

        await attachments.CopyToAsync(attachment.Id, context.Response.Body, context.RequestAborted);
    }

    private static async Task<IResult> PreviewAsync(string key, HttpContext context, IAntiforgery antiforgery, WorkService work)
    {
        if (!await antiforgery.IsRequestValidAsync(context))
        {
            return Results.BadRequest();
        }

        var access = await work.OpenAsync(key, context.User.ToActor(), context.RequestAborted);
        if (access is null)
        {
            return Results.NotFound();
        }

        using var reader = new StreamReader(context.Request.Body, Encoding.UTF8);
        var buffer = new char[MaxPreviewBytes];
        var read = await reader.ReadBlockAsync(buffer.AsMemory(), context.RequestAborted);
        var html = access.RenderRich(new string(buffer, 0, read));
        return Results.Text(html.Length == 0 ? "<p class=\"muted\">Nothing to preview.</p>" : html, "text/html; charset=utf-8");
    }

    public static string FileUrl(AttachmentRecord attachment)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(attachment);
        return $"/work/files/{attachment.Id:D}/{Uri.EscapeDataString(attachment.FileName)}";
    }

    private static string Ascii(string name)
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder(name.Length);
        foreach (var c in name)
        {
            builder.Append(c is >= ' ' and <= '~' and not '"' and not '\\' ? c : '_');
        }

        return builder.ToString();
    }
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Trash;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Work;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Access;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Text;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Work;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Administration;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Work;

internal sealed class WorkService(
    ProjectStore projects,
    SprintStore sprints,
    WorkItemStore items,
    CommentStore comments,
    TrashService trash)
{
    private const string NotAllowed = "You can't do that here.";

    public async Task<ProjectAccess?> OpenAsync(string? key, Actor? actor, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (actor is null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key))
        {
            return null;
        }

        var project = await projects.FindAsync(WorkRules.NormalizeProjectKey(key), actor.PersonId, cancellationToken);
        return project is null || project.DeletedAt is not null || !AccessPolicy.CanView(actor, project.Role)
            ? null
            : new ProjectAccess(project, actor);
    }

    public async Task<ProjectAccess?> OpenAsync(Guid projectId, Actor? actor, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (actor is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var project = await projects.FindByIdAsync(projectId, actor.PersonId, cancellationToken);
        return project is null || project.DeletedAt is not null || !AccessPolicy.CanView(actor, project.Role)
            ? null
            : new ProjectAccess(project, actor);
    }

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<ProjectRecord>> ProjectsAsync(Actor actor, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(actor);
        return projects.ListAsync(actor.PersonId, actor.IsAdministrator, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<(string? Problem, string? Key)> CreateProjectAsync(Actor actor, ProjectForm form, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(actor);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(form);
        var key = WorkRules.NormalizeProjectKey(form.Key);
        if (WorkRules.ProjectKeyProblem(key) is { } keyProblem)
        {
            return (keyProblem, null);
        }

        if (WorkRules.ProjectNameProblem(form.Name) is { } nameProblem)
        {
            return (nameProblem, null);
        }

        var name = PlainText.Line(form.Name, WorkRules.MaxProjectName);
        var (result, _) = await projects.CreateAsync(
            key,
            name,
            WorkRules.Description(form.Description),
            actor.PersonId,
            Audits.For(actor, "create", SubjectNames.Of(Subject.Project), string.Empty, $"{key} {name}"),
            cancellationToken);
        return result == CreateProjectResult.KeyTaken ? ("Another project already uses that key.", null) : (null, key);
    }

    public async Task<string?> UpdateProjectAsync(ProjectAccess access, ProjectForm form, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(form);
        if (!access.CanManage)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        if (WorkRules.ProjectNameProblem(form.Name) is { } problem)
        {
            return problem;
        }

        await projects.UpdateAsync(access.Project.Id, PlainText.Line(form.Name, WorkRules.MaxProjectName), WorkRules.Description(form.Description), cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<string?> SetMemberAsync(ProjectAccess access, string? userName, string? role, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        if (!access.CanManage)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        if (!PageRoles.IsKnown(role))
        {
            return "Pick a role.";
        }

        var name = (userName ?? string.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        var change = await projects.SetMemberAsync(
            access.Project.Id,
            name,
            role!,
            access.Actor.PersonId,
            Audits.For(access.Actor, "member-set", SubjectNames.Of(Subject.Project), access.Project.Id.ToString(), $"{name} is now {PageRoles.Label(role)} of {access.Key}"),
            cancellationToken);
        return change switch
        {
            MemberChange.NotFound => "There is no active account with that user name.",
            MemberChange.LastEditor => "A project needs at least one editor.",
            _ => null,
        };
    }

    public async Task<string?> RemoveMemberAsync(ProjectAccess access, Guid personId, string userName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        if (!access.CanManage && personId != access.Actor.PersonId)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        var change = await projects.RemoveMemberAsync(
            access.Project.Id,
            personId,
            Audits.For(access.Actor, "member-removed", SubjectNames.Of(Subject.Project), access.Project.Id.ToString(), $"{userName} left {access.Key}"),
            cancellationToken);
        return change switch
        {
            MemberChange.LastEditor => "A project needs at least one editor.",
            MemberChange.NotFound => "That person is not a member.",
            _ => null,
        };
    }

    public async Task<string?> DeleteProjectAsync(ProjectAccess access, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        if (!access.CanDelete)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        await trash.SoftDeleteAsync(access.Actor, Subject.Project, access.Project.Id, $"{access.Key} {access.Project.Name}", cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<(string? Problem, int Number)> CreateItemAsync(ProjectAccess access, ItemForm form, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(form);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return (NotAllowed, 0);
        }

        if (form.Problem() is { } problem)
        {
            return (problem, 0);
        }

        var (_, number) = await items.CreateAsync(access.Project.Id, form.ToFields(), access.Actor.PersonId, cancellationToken);
        return (null, number);
    }

    public async Task<string?> UpdateItemAsync(ProjectAccess access, int number, ItemForm form, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(form);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        if (form.Problem() is { } problem)
        {
            return problem;
        }

        var fields = form.ToFields();
        return await items.UpdateAsync(access.Project.Id, number, _ => fields, access.Actor.PersonId, cancellationToken)
            ? null
            : "That item no longer exists.";
    }

    public async Task<string?> SetStatusAsync(ProjectAccess access, int number, string? status, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        if (!WorkItemStatuses.IsKnown(status))
        {
            return "Pick a status.";
        }

        return await items.UpdateAsync(access.Project.Id, number, current => current with { Status = status! }, access.Actor.PersonId, cancellationToken)
            ? null
            : "That item no longer exists.";
    }

    public async Task<string?> SetSprintAsync(ProjectAccess access, int number, Guid? sprintId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        return await items.UpdateAsync(
            access.Project.Id,
            number,
            current => current with
            {
                SprintId = sprintId,
                Status = sprintId is not null && current.Status == WorkItemStatuses.Backlog ? WorkItemStatuses.ToDo : current.Status,
            },
            access.Actor.PersonId,
            cancellationToken)
            ? null
            : "That item no longer exists.";
    }

    public async Task<string?> AssignAsync(ProjectAccess access, int number, Guid? assigneeId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        return await items.UpdateAsync(access.Project.Id, number, current => current with { AssigneeId = assigneeId }, access.Actor.PersonId, cancellationToken)
            ? null
            : "That item no longer exists.";
    }

    public async Task<string?> MoveAsync(ProjectAccess access, int number, bool up, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        await items.MoveAsync(access.Project.Id, number, up, cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<string?> DeleteItemAsync(ProjectAccess access, WorkItemRecord item, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(item);
        if (!access.CanDelete)
        {
            return "Only editors of this project and administrators can delete items.";
        }

        await trash.SoftDeleteAsync(access.Actor, Subject.WorkItem, item.Id, $"{access.Key}-{item.Number} {item.Title}", cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<string?> AddCommentAsync(ProjectAccess access, WorkItemRecord item, string? body, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(item);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        var text = WorkRules.Comment(body);
        if (text.Length == 0)
        {
            return "Write something first.";
        }

        await comments.AddAsync(item.Id, access.Actor.PersonId, text, cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<string?> EditCommentAsync(ProjectAccess access, WorkItemRecord item, Guid commentId, string? body, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(item);
        var comment = await comments.FindAsync(item.Id, commentId, cancellationToken);
        if (comment is null)
        {
            return "That comment no longer exists.";
        }

        if (!AccessPolicy.CanEditComment(access.Actor, access.Role, comment.AuthorId ?? Guid.Empty))
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        var text = WorkRules.Comment(body);
        if (text.Length == 0)
        {
            return "A comment cannot be empty. Delete it instead.";
        }

        await comments.EditAsync(item.Id, commentId, text, cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<string?> DeleteCommentAsync(ProjectAccess access, WorkItemRecord item, Guid commentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(item);
        if (!access.CanDelete)
        {
            return "Only editors of this project and administrators can delete comments.";
        }

        var comment = await comments.FindAsync(item.Id, commentId, cancellationToken);
        if (comment is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var preview = comment.Body.Length > 60 ? comment.Body[..60] : comment.Body;
        await trash.SoftDeleteAsync(access.Actor, Subject.Comment, commentId, $"{access.Key}-{item.Number}: {preview}", cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<string?> DeleteAttachmentAsync(ProjectAccess access, AttachmentRecord attachment, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(attachment);
        if (!access.CanDelete || attachment.ProjectId != access.Project.Id)
        {
            return "Only editors of this project and administrators can delete attachments.";
        }

        await trash.SoftDeleteAsync(access.Actor, Subject.Attachment, attachment.Id, $"{access.Key}: {attachment.FileName}", cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<string?> CreateSprintAsync(ProjectAccess access, SprintForm form, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(form);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        if (form.Problem() is { } problem)
        {
            return problem;
        }

        await sprints.CreateAsync(access.Project.Id, form.ToDraft(), cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<string?> UpdateSprintAsync(ProjectAccess access, Guid sprintId, SprintForm form, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(form);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        if (form.Problem() is { } problem)
        {
            return problem;
        }

        return await sprints.UpdateAsync(access.Project.Id, sprintId, form.ToDraft(), cancellationToken) ? null : "That sprint no longer exists.";
    }

    public async Task<string?> StartSprintAsync(ProjectAccess access, Guid sprintId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        return await sprints.StartAsync(access.Project.Id, sprintId, cancellationToken) switch
        {
            SprintChange.AnotherIsActive => "Another sprint is already active. Complete it first.",
            SprintChange.WrongState => "Only planned sprints can be started.",
            _ => null,
        };
    }

    public async Task<string?> CompleteSprintAsync(ProjectAccess access, Guid sprintId, Guid? moveOpenTo, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        if (!access.CanEdit)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        return await sprints.CompleteAsync(access.Project.Id, sprintId, moveOpenTo, cancellationToken) == SprintChange.Changed
            ? null
            : "Only the active sprint can be completed.";
    }

    public async Task<string?> DeleteSprintAsync(ProjectAccess access, SprintRecord sprint, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(sprint);
        if (!access.CanDelete)
        {
            return "Only editors of this project and administrators can delete sprints.";
        }

        await trash.SoftDeleteAsync(access.Actor, Subject.Sprint, sprint.Id, $"{access.Key}: {sprint.Name}", cancellationToken);
        return null;
    }

    public async Task<string?> RestoreAsync(ProjectAccess access, TrashRecord record, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(access);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(record);
        if (!AccessPolicy.CanRestore(access.Actor, access.Role) || record.Subject == Subject.Project || record.ProjectId != access.Project.Id)
        {
            return NotAllowed;
        }

        return await trash.RestoreAsync(access.Actor, record.Subject, record.Id, cancellationToken) ? null : "That is no longer in the trash.";
    }
}

import { lowerAscii } from './keys.js';

export const STATUS_OPTIONS = Object.freeze(['For sale', 'Coming soon', 'Pending', 'Sold', 'For rent', 'Off market']);
export const TYPE_OPTIONS = Object.freeze(['House', 'Condo', 'Townhouse', 'Multi-family', 'Manufactured', 'Land', 'Other']);

export const FIELDS = Object.freeze([
    { key: 'price', label: 'Price', kind: 'money', hint: '450000 or 450k' },
    { key: 'status', label: 'Status', kind: 'choice', options: STATUS_OPTIONS },
    { key: 'type', label: 'Type', kind: 'choice', options: TYPE_OPTIONS },
    { key: 'beds', label: 'Bedrooms', kind: 'count' },
    { key: 'baths', label: 'Bathrooms', kind: 'decimal', hint: '2.5' },
    { key: 'sqft', label: 'Square feet', kind: 'int', min: 1, max: 10000000 },
    { key: 'lot', label: 'Lot size', kind: 'text', max: 40, hint: '0.25 acres' },
    { key: 'year', label: 'Year built', kind: 'int', min: 1600, max: 2100 },
    { key: 'hoa', label: 'HOA per month', kind: 'money' },
    { key: 'taxes', label: 'Taxes per year', kind: 'money' },
    { key: 'parking', label: 'Parking', kind: 'text', max: 60 },
    { key: 'heating', label: 'Heating and cooling', kind: 'text', max: 60 },
    { key: 'mls', label: 'MLS number', kind: 'text', max: 40 },
    { key: 'street', label: 'Street address', kind: 'text', max: 120 },
    { key: 'unit', label: 'Unit', kind: 'text', max: 20 },
    { key: 'city', label: 'City', kind: 'text', max: 60 },
    { key: 'state', label: 'State', kind: 'state' },
    { key: 'zip', label: 'ZIP code', kind: 'zip' },
]);

export const ADDRESS_FIELDS = Object.freeze(['street', 'unit', 'city', 'state', 'zip']);

const BY_KEY = new Map(FIELDS.map(field => [field.key, field]));
const ORDER = new Map(FIELDS.map((field, index) => [field.key, index]));

const ERRORS = Object.freeze({
    money: 'Use a whole dollar amount like 450000, 450k or 1.2m.',
    count: 'Use a whole number from 0 to 99.',
    decimal: 'Use a number from 0 to 99 like 2 or 2.5.',
    int: 'Use a whole number.',
    choice: 'Pick one of the listed options.',
    state: 'Use the two-letter state code, like NY.',
    zip: 'Use a five-digit ZIP code.',
});

export function fieldOf(key) {
    return BY_KEY.get(key) ?? null;
}

export function fieldOrder(key) {
    return ORDER.get(key) ?? -1;
}

export function cleanText(input, max) {
    let text = '';
    for (const char of typeof input === 'string' ? input : '') {
        const code = char.charCodeAt(0);
        const space = (code >= 0x09 && code <= 0x0d) || code === 0x20 || code === 0xa0 || code === 0x1680 || (code >= 0x2000 && code <= 0x200a)
            || code === 0x202f || code === 0x205f || code === 0x3000;
        if (space) {
            if (text.length > 0 && !text.endsWith(' ')) {
                text += ' ';
            }
        } else if (code > 0x1f && (code < 0x7f || code > 0x9f)) {
            text += char;
        }
    }
    if (text.endsWith(' ')) {
        text = text.slice(0, -1);
    }
    if (text.length > max) {
        let cut = max;
        const code = text.charCodeAt(cut - 1);
        if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff) {
            cut -= 1;
        }
        text = text.slice(0, cut);
        if (text.endsWith(' ')) {
            text = text.slice(0, -1);
        }
    }
    return text;
}

function stripZeros(digits) {
    const trimmed = digits.replace(/^0+/, '');
    return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : '0';
}

function money(text) {
    const match = /^([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]+))?([kKmM])?$/.exec(text.replace(/[ ,$_]/g, ''));
    if (!match) {
        return null;
    }
    const places = match[3] === undefined ? 0 : match[3].toLowerCase() === 'k' ? 3 : 6;
    const fraction = match[2] ?? '';
    if (places === 0 && /[1-9]/.test(fraction)) {
        return null;
    }
    if (places > 0 && fraction.length > places) {
        return null;
    }
    const value = stripZeros(match[1] + (places > 0 ? fraction.padEnd(places, '0') : ''));
    return value.length <= 11 ? value : null;
}

function count(text) {
    return /^[0-9]{1,2}$/.test(text) ? stripZeros(text) : null;
}

function decimal(text) {
    const match = /^([0-9]{1,2})(?:\.([0-9]{1,2}))?$/.exec(text);
    if (!match) {
        return null;
    }
    const whole = stripZeros(match[1]);
    const fraction = (match[2] ?? '').replace(/0+$/, '');
    return fraction.length > 0 ? `${whole}.${fraction}` : whole;
}

function integer(text, field) {
    const cleaned = text.replace(/[ ,_]/g, '');
    if (!/^[0-9]{1,8}$/.test(cleaned)) {
        return null;
    }
    const value = stripZeros(cleaned);
    const number = Number(value);
    return number >= field.min && number <= field.max ? value : null;
}

function choice(text, field) {
    const lower = lowerAscii(text);
    return field.options.find(option => lowerAscii(option) === lower) ?? null;
}

function state(text) {
    return /^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(text) ? text.toUpperCase() : null;
}

function zip(text) {
    const match = /^([0-9]{5})(?:-?[0-9]{4})?$/.exec(text);
    return match ? match[1] : null;
}

export function normalizeField(key, input) {
    const field = fieldOf(key);
    if (!field) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Unknown field.' };
    }
    const text = cleanText(input, field.kind === 'text' ? field.max : 64);
    if (text.length === 0) {
        return { ok: true, value: '' };
    }
    let value;
    switch (field.kind) {
        case 'money':
            value = money(text);
            break;
        case 'count':
            value = count(text);
            break;
        case 'decimal':
            value = decimal(text);
            break;
        case 'int':
            value = integer(text, field);
            break;
        case 'choice':
            value = choice(text, field);
            break;
        case 'state':
            value = state(text);
            break;
        case 'zip':
            value = zip(text);
            break;
        default:
            value = text;
    }
    return value === null ? { ok: false, error: ERRORS[field.kind] ?? 'Check this value.' } : { ok: true, value };
}

function grouped(digits) {
    return digits.replace(/\B(?=([0-9]{3})+(?![0-9]))/g, ',');
}

export function displayValue(key, value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length === 0) {
        return '';
    }
    switch (fieldOf(key)?.kind) {
        case 'money':
            return `$${grouped(value)}`;
        case 'int':
            return key === 'year' ? value : grouped(value);
        default:
            return value;
    }
}

export function summaryOf(fields) {
    const parts = [];
    if (fields.price) {
        parts.push(displayValue('price', fields.price));
    }
    if (fields.beds) {
        parts.push(`${fields.beds} bd`);
    }
    if (fields.baths) {
        parts.push(`${fields.baths} ba`);
    }
    if (fields.sqft) {
        parts.push(`${displayValue('sqft', fields.sqft)} sq ft`);
    }
    if (fields.status) {
        parts.push(fields.status);
    }
    return parts.join(' · ');
}

export function placeOf(fields) {
    const city = [fields.city, fields.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    return [city, fields.zip].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
}

export function streetOf(fields) {
    if (!fields.street) {
        return '';
    }
    return fields.unit ? `${fields.street}, unit ${fields.unit.replace(/^(?:unit|apt|apartment|suite|ste|#)\s*/i, '')}` : fields.street;
}

export function changedFields(current, inputs) {
    const changes = [];
    const errors = [];
    for (const field of FIELDS) {
        if (!Object.hasOwn(inputs, field.key)) {
            continue;
        }
        const result = normalizeField(field.key, inputs[field.key]);
        if (!result.ok) {
            errors.push({ key: field.key, error: result.error });
        } else if (result.value !== (current[field.key] ?? '')) {
            changes.push({ key: field.key, value: result.value });
        }
    }
    if (changes.some(change => ADDRESS_FIELDS.includes(change.key))) {
        for (const key of ADDRESS_FIELDS) {
            if (!changes.some(change => change.key === key) && Object.hasOwn(inputs, key)) {
                const result = normalizeField(key, inputs[key]);
                if (result.ok) {
                    changes.push({ key, value: result.value });
                }
            }
        }
        changes.sort((a, b) => fieldOrder(a.key) - fieldOrder(b.key));
    }
    return { changes, errors };
}

export const PROVIDERS = Object.freeze(['zillow', 'redfin', 'realtor', 'address', 'url']);
export const MAX_KEYS = 8;
export const MAX_URL = 2048;
export const MAX_ADDRESS_TOKEN = 100;

const LABELS = Object.freeze({
    zillow: 'Zillow',
    redfin: 'Redfin',
    realtor: 'Realtor.com',
    address: 'Address',
    url: 'Link',
});

const TOKEN_PATTERNS = Object.freeze({
    zillow: /^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$/,
    redfin: /^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$/,
    realtor: /^m[0-9]{1,12}-[0-9]{1,12}$/,
    address: /^[0-9]{5}(?:-[a-z0-9]+)+$/,
    url: /^[0-9a-f]{16}$/,
});

const URL_PATTERN = /[hH][tT][tT][pP][sS]?:\/\/[\x21\x23-\x26\x28-\x3B\x3D\x3F-\x7E]+/;
const PARTS_PATTERN = /^([hH][tT][tT][pP][sS]?):\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/;
const HOST_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9.-]+(?::[0-9]{1,5})?$/;
const TRAILING = '.,;:!?)]}';

export const UNIT_WORDS = Object.freeze(['apt', 'apartment', 'unit', 'suite', 'ste']);

export function providerOf(key) {
    const colon = typeof key === 'string' ? key.indexOf(':') : -1;
    return colon > 0 ? key.slice(0, colon) : null;
}

export function tokenOf(key) {
    const colon = typeof key === 'string' ? key.indexOf(':') : -1;
    return colon > 0 ? key.slice(colon + 1) : null;
}

export function isKeyParts(provider, token) {
    const pattern = Object.hasOwn(TOKEN_PATTERNS, provider) ? TOKEN_PATTERNS[provider] : null;
    return pattern !== null
        && typeof token === 'string'
        && token.length <= MAX_ADDRESS_TOKEN
        && pattern.test(token);
}

export function isKey(key) {
    return isKeyParts(providerOf(key), tokenOf(key));
}

export function keyOf(provider, token) {
    return isKeyParts(provider, token) ? `${provider}:${token}` : null;
}

export function rankOf(key) {
    const rank = PROVIDERS.indexOf(providerOf(key));
    return rank < 0 ? PROVIDERS.length : rank;
}

export function compareKeys(a, b) {
    const rank = rankOf(a) - rankOf(b);
    if (rank !== 0) {
        return rank;
    }
    return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
}

export function providerLabel(provider) {
    return LABELS[provider] ?? 'Link';
}

export function keyLabel(key) {
    const provider = providerOf(key);
    const token = tokenOf(key) ?? '';
    switch (provider) {
        case 'zillow':
        case 'redfin':
            return `${providerLabel(provider)} ${token}`;
        case 'realtor':
            return `Realtor.com ${token.toUpperCase()}`;
        case 'address':
            return `${token.slice(6).replaceAll('-', ' ')}, ${token.slice(0, 5)}`;
        default:
            return `Link ${token.slice(0, 6)}`;
    }
}

export function keyPath(key) {
    return isKey(key) ? `homes/${providerOf(key)}/${tokenOf(key)}` : null;
}

export function keyUrl(key) {
    const token = tokenOf(key);
    switch (providerOf(key)) {
        case 'zillow':
            return `https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/${token}_zpid/`;
        case 'redfin':
            return `https://www.redfin.com/home/${token}`;
        default:
            return null;
    }
}

export function normalizeKeys(derived, anchors) {
    const keys = [];
    for (const key of [...(derived ?? []), ...(anchors ?? [])]) {
        if (keys.length >= MAX_KEYS) {
            break;
        }
        if (isKey(key) && !keys.includes(key)) {
            keys.push(key);
        }
    }
    return keys.sort((a, b) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
}

export function fnv1a64(text) {
    let hash = 0xcbf29ce484222325n;
    for (const byte of new TextEncoder().encode(text)) {
        hash ^= BigInt(byte);
        hash = (hash * 0x100000001b3n) & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
    }
    return hash.toString(16).padStart(16, '0');
}

export function extractUrl(text) {
    if (typeof text !== 'string') {
        return null;
    }
    const match = URL_PATTERN.exec(text);
    if (!match) {
        return null;
    }
    let url = match[0];
    while (url.length > 0 && TRAILING.includes(url.at(-1))) {
        url = url.slice(0, -1);
    }
    return url.length <= MAX_URL ? url : null;
}

export function lowerAscii(text) {
    return text.replace(/[A-Z]/g, char => String.fromCharCode(char.charCodeAt(0) + 32));
}

function isSite(site, domain) {
    return site === domain || site.endsWith(`.${domain}`);
}

function stripZeros(digits) {
    const trimmed = digits.replace(/^0+/, '');
    return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : '0';
}

export function parseLink(text) {
    const raw = extractUrl(text);
    const parts = raw ? PARTS_PATTERN.exec(raw) : null;
    if (!parts) {
        return null;
    }
    const scheme = parts[1].length === 5 ? 'https' : 'http';
    const host = lowerAscii(parts[2]);
    const path = parts[3].length > 0 ? parts[3] : '/';
    if (!HOST_PATTERN.test(host)) {
        return null;
    }
    const site = host.replace(/:[0-9]+$/, '').replace(/^www\./, '');
    if (!site.includes('.')) {
        return null;
    }

    let provider = null;
    let token = null;
    if (isSite(site, 'zillow.com')) {
        const match = /([0-9]+)_[zZ][pP][iI][dD]/.exec(path);
        provider = match ? 'zillow' : null;
        token = match ? stripZeros(match[1]) : null;
    } else if (isSite(site, 'redfin.com')) {
        const match = /\/home\/([0-9]+)/.exec(path);
        provider = match ? 'redfin' : null;
        token = match ? stripZeros(match[1]) : null;
    } else if (isSite(site, 'realtor.com')) {
        const match = /_[mM]([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)/.exec(path);
        provider = match ? 'realtor' : null;
        token = match ? `m${match[1]}-${match[2]}` : null;
    }

    const key = provider ? keyOf(provider, token) : null;
    if (key) {
        return { key, provider, url: `https://${host}${path}` };
    }
    const canonical = `${site}${path.replace(/\/+$/, '')}`;
    return { key: `url:${fnv1a64(canonical)}`, provider: 'url', url: `${scheme}://${host}${path}` };
}

export function words(text) {
    let current = '';
    const result = [];
    for (const char of typeof text === 'string' ? text : '') {
        const code = char.charCodeAt(0);
        if (code >= 65 && code <= 90) {
            current += String.fromCharCode(code + 32);
        } else if ((code >= 97 && code <= 122) || (code >= 48 && code <= 57)) {
            current += char;
        } else if (current.length > 0) {
            result.push(current);
            current = '';
        }
    }
    if (current.length > 0) {
        result.push(current);
    }
    return result;
}

function unitMarked(text) {
    return typeof text === 'string' ? text.replaceAll('#', ' unit ') : '';
}

export function addressKey(street, unit, zip) {
    if (typeof zip !== 'string' || !/^[0-9]{5}$/.test(zip)) {
        return null;
    }
    const tokens = words(unitMarked(street));
    const split = tokens.findIndex((token, index) => index > 0 && UNIT_WORDS.includes(token));
    const streetTokens = (split > 0 ? tokens.slice(0, split) : tokens).map(token => STREET_WORDS[token] ?? token);
    if (streetTokens.length === 0) {
        return null;
    }
    const unitInput = words(unitMarked(unit));
    const unitSource = unitInput.length > 0 ? unitInput : split > 0 ? tokens.slice(split) : [];
    const unitTokens = unitSource.filter(token => !UNIT_WORDS.includes(token));
    const parts = [zip, ...streetTokens];
    if (unitTokens.length > 0) {
        parts.push('unit', ...unitTokens);
    }
    return keyOf('address', parts.join('-'));
}

function decode(text) {
    try {
        return decodeURIComponent(text);
    } catch {
        return text;
    }
}

function spaced(text) {
    return decode(text).replaceAll('-', ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function splitZip(tokens) {
    const zip = tokens.length > 1 && /^[0-9]{5}$/.test(tokens.at(-1)) ? tokens.at(-1) : '';
    return { zip, rest: zip ? tokens.slice(0, -1) : tokens };
}

export function guessAddress(url) {
    const parts = typeof url === 'string' ? PARTS_PATTERN.exec(url) : null;
    if (!parts) {
        return null;
    }
    const host = parts[2].toLowerCase();
    const segments = parts[3].split('/').filter(segment => segment.length > 0);

    if (host.endsWith('zillow.com')) {
        const index = segments.indexOf('homedetails');
        if (index < 0 || index + 2 >= segments.length) {
            return null;
        }
        const { zip, rest } = splitZip(decode(segments[index + 1]).split('-').filter(Boolean));
        const state = zip && rest.length > 1 && /^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(rest.at(-1)) ? rest.at(-1).toUpperCase() : '';
        const street = (state ? rest.slice(0, -1) : rest).join(' ');
        return street || zip ? { street, unit: '', city: '', state, zip, mixed: true } : null;
    }

    if (host.endsWith('redfin.com')) {
        const index = segments.indexOf('home');
        if (index < 3) {
            return null;
        }
        const { zip, rest } = splitZip(decode(segments[2]).split('-').filter(Boolean));
        const unitSegment = index > 3 ? segments[3] : '';
        const unit = /^unit-/i.test(unitSegment) ? spaced(unitSegment.slice(5)) : '';
        const state = /^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(segments[0]) ? segments[0].toUpperCase() : '';
        return { street: rest.join(' '), unit, city: spaced(segments[1]), state, zip, mixed: false };
    }

    if (host.endsWith('realtor.com')) {
        const detail = segments.find(segment => /_M[0-9]+-[0-9]+/i.test(segment));
        const fields = detail ? detail.split('_') : [];
        if (fields.length < 5) {
            return null;
        }
        const zip = /^[0-9]{5}$/.test(fields[3]) ? fields[3] : '';
        const state = /^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(fields[2]) ? fields[2].toUpperCase() : '';
        return { street: spaced(fields[0]), unit: '', city: spaced(fields[1]), state, zip, mixed: false };
    }

    return null;
}

import { compareKeys, keyLabel, parseLink } from './keys.js';
import { placeOf, streetOf } from './fields.js';

export function newestFirst(a, b) {
    return a.id === b.id ? 0 : a.id < b.id ? 1 : -1;
}

export function oldestFirst(a, b) {
    return -newestFirst(a, b);
}

export function timestampOf(id) {
    return Number.parseInt(id.slice(0, 8) + id.slice(9, 13), 16);
}

class KeySets {
    constructor() {
        this.parent = new Map();
    }

    find(key) {
        let root = key;
        while (this.parent.has(root) && this.parent.get(root) !== root) {
            root = this.parent.get(root);
        }
        let node = key;
        while (node !== root) {
            const next = this.parent.get(node);
            this.parent.set(node, root);
            node = next;
        }
        if (!this.parent.has(root)) {
            this.parent.set(root, root);
        }
        return root;
    }

    union(a, b) {
        const rootA = this.find(a);
        const rootB = this.find(b);
        if (rootA === rootB) {
            return;
        }
        if (compareKeys(rootA, rootB) <= 0) {
            this.parent.set(rootB, rootA);
        } else {
            this.parent.set(rootA, rootB);
        }
    }
}

export function titleOf(listing) {
    return streetOf(listing.fields) || placeOf(listing.fields) || keyLabel(listing.key);
}

export function resolve(entries) {
    const sorted = [...entries].sort(oldestFirst);
    const keys = new Set();
    const links = new Map();
    const fields = {};
    const history = {};
    const comments = [];
    for (const entry of sorted) {
        for (const key of entry.keys) {
            keys.add(key);
        }
        if (entry.kind === 'link' && typeof entry.url === 'string') {
            const parsed = parseLink(entry.url);
            if (parsed) {
                links.set(parsed.key, { key: parsed.key, provider: parsed.provider, url: entry.url, id: entry.id });
            }
        } else if (entry.kind === 'fact' && Array.isArray(entry.fields)) {
            for (const { key, value } of entry.fields) {
                (history[key] ??= []).push({ value, id: entry.id });
                fields[key] = value;
            }
        } else if (entry.kind === 'comment') {
            comments.push(entry);
        }
    }
    for (const key of Object.keys(fields)) {
        if (fields[key] === '') {
            delete fields[key];
        }
    }
    const sortedKeys = [...keys].sort(compareKeys);
    const listing = {
        key: sortedKeys[0],
        keys: sortedKeys,
        links: [...links.values()].sort((a, b) => compareKeys(a.key, b.key)),
        fields,
        history,
        comments,
        ids: sorted.map(entry => entry.id),
        created: sorted[0].id,
        updated: sorted.at(-1).id,
        mine: sorted.some(entry => entry.mine === true),
    };
    listing.title = titleOf(listing);
    return listing;
}

export function buildListings(entries) {
    const sets = new KeySets();
    const usable = [];
    for (const entry of entries) {
        if (!entry || !Array.isArray(entry.keys) || entry.keys.length === 0) {
            continue;
        }
        usable.push(entry);
        for (const key of entry.keys.slice(1)) {
            sets.union(entry.keys[0], key);
        }
    }
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const entry of usable) {
        const root = sets.find(entry.keys[0]);
        const group = groups.get(root);
        if (group) {
            group.push(entry);
        } else {
            groups.set(root, [entry]);
        }
    }
    return [...groups.values()]
        .map(resolve)
        .sort((a, b) => (a.updated === b.updated ? compareKeys(a.key, b.key) : a.updated < b.updated ? 1 : -1));
}

export function findListing(listings, key) {
    return listings.find(listing => listing.keys.includes(key)) ?? null;
}

export function matches(listing, query) {
    const needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.length === 0) {
        return true;
    }
    const haystack = [listing.title, placeOf(listing.fields), listing.fields.mls ?? '', ...listing.keys, ...listing.links.map(link => link.url)]
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase();
    return needle.split(/\s+/).every(part => haystack.includes(part));
}

export const DB_NAME = 'nest';
export const DB_VERSION = 1;
export const STORE = 'entries';
export const LOCAL_CAP = 20000;
export const DRAFT_PREFIX = 'nest-draft:';

export const migrations = [
    db => db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: 'id' }),
];

export const SCHEMA = Object.freeze({ name: DB_NAME, version: DB_VERSION, store: STORE, migrations, cap: LOCAL_CAP });

export function upgrade(db, oldVersion, newVersion = DB_VERSION, steps = migrations) {
    for (let version = oldVersion; version < newVersion; version += 1) {
        steps[version](db);
    }
}

export function excessOf(count, cap = LOCAL_CAP) {
    return Math.max(0, count - cap);
}

function settle(request) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
}

function finished(transaction) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
    });
}

export function deleteDatabase(factory, name = DB_NAME) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (!factory) {
            resolve('deleted');
            return;
        }
        const request = factory.deleteDatabase(name);
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve('deleted');
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
        request.onblocked = () => resolve('blocked');
    });
}

export function openDatabase(factory, schema = SCHEMA, onClose = () => {}, allowReset = true) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = factory.open(schema.name, schema.version);
        request.onupgradeneeded = event => upgrade(request.result, event.oldVersion, event.newVersion ?? schema.version, schema.migrations);
        request.onsuccess = () => {
            const db = request.result;
            db.onversionchange = () => {
                db.close();
                onClose();
            };
            db.onclose = onClose;
            resolve(db);
        };
        request.onerror = event => {
            if (allowReset && request.error?.name === 'VersionError') {
                event.preventDefault();
                deleteDatabase(factory, schema.name)
                    .then(() => openDatabase(factory, schema, onClose, false))
                    .then(resolve, reject);
                return;
            }
            reject(request.error);
        };
    });
}

export function draftKeys(storage) {
    const keys = [];
    try {
        for (let index = 0; index < storage.length; index += 1) {
            const key = storage.key(index);
            if (key?.startsWith(DRAFT_PREFIX)) {
                keys.push(key);
            }
        }
    } catch {
    }
    return keys;
}

export function readDraft(storage, key) {
    try {
        return storage?.getItem(DRAFT_PREFIX + key) ?? '';
    } catch {
        return '';
    }
}

export function writeDraft(storage, key, text) {
    try {
        if (text) {
            storage?.setItem(DRAFT_PREFIX + key, text);
        } else {
            storage?.removeItem(DRAFT_PREFIX + key);
        }
    } catch {
    }
}

export class EntryStore {
    constructor(factory, schema = SCHEMA) {
        this.factory = factory ?? null;
        this.schema = schema;
        this.db = null;
        this.opening = null;
    }

    database() {
        if (this.db) {
            return Promise.resolve(this.db);
        }
        if (!this.factory) {
            return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
        this.opening ??= openDatabase(this.factory, this.schema, () => {
            this.db = null;
        })
            .then(db => {
                this.db = db;
                return db;
            }, () => {
                this.factory = null;
                return null;
            })
            .finally(() => {
                this.opening = null;
            });
        return this.opening;
    }

    async all() {
        const db = await this.database();
        if (!db) {
            return [];
        }
        return settle(db.transaction(this.schema.store, 'readonly').objectStore(this.schema.store).getAll());
    }

    async save(records) {
        const db = await this.database();
        if (!db || records.length === 0) {
            return [];
        }
        const transaction = db.transaction(this.schema.store, 'readwrite');
        const done = finished(transaction);
        const store = transaction.objectStore(this.schema.store);
        for (const record of records) {
            store.put(record);
        }
        let evicted = [];
        const excess = excessOf(await settle(store.count()), this.schema.cap);
        if (excess > 0) {
            evicted = await settle(store.getAllKeys(null, excess));
            store.delete(IDBKeyRange.upperBound(evicted.at(-1)));
        }
        await done;
        return evicted;
    }

    async remove(ids) {
        const db = await this.database();
        if (!db || ids.length === 0) {
            return;
        }
        const transaction = db.transaction(this.schema.store, 'readwrite');
        const done = finished(transaction);
        const store = transaction.objectStore(this.schema.store);
        for (const id of ids) {
            store.delete(id);
        }
        await done;
    }
}
