import { EntryStore } from './store.js';
import { buildListings, newestFirst } from './merge.js';

export const OFFER_BYTES = 24000;
export const FETCH_CHUNK = 50;
export const PING_MS = 25000;
export const FALLBACK_MS = 3000;
export const RECONNECTED_EVENT = 'nest:reconnected';

export function needsResync(version, update) {
    return update.previous !== version;
}

export function wire(entry) {
    const result = { id: entry.id, kind: entry.kind, keys: entry.keys };
    if (typeof entry.url === 'string') {
        result.url = entry.url;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(entry.fields)) {
        result.fields = entry.fields;
    }
    if (typeof entry.text === 'string') {
        result.text = entry.text;
    }
    return result;
}

export function missingIds(ids, have) {
    return ids.filter(id => !have.has(id));
}

export function offerCandidates(local, serverIds, capacity) {
    let oldest = null;
    if (serverIds.size >= capacity) {
        for (const id of serverIds) {
            if (oldest === null || id < oldest) {
                oldest = id;
            }
        }
    }
    return local
        .filter(entry => !serverIds.has(entry.id) && (oldest === null || entry.id > oldest))
        .sort(newestFirst)
        .slice(0, capacity)
        .map(wire);
}

export function chunkBySize(items, maxBytes = OFFER_BYTES) {
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const chunks = [];
    let chunk = [];
    let size = 0;
    for (const item of items) {
        const bytes = encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(item)).length + 1;
        if (bytes > maxBytes) {
            continue;
        }
        if (chunk.length > 0 && size + bytes > maxBytes) {
            chunks.push(chunk);
            chunk = [];
            size = 0;
        }
        chunk.push(item);
        size += bytes;
    }
    if (chunk.length > 0) {
        chunks.push(chunk);
    }
    return chunks;
}

export function chunk(items, size) {
    const chunks = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < items.length; index += size) {
        chunks.push(items.slice(index, index + size));
    }
    return chunks;
}

export class Nest {
    constructor(win, store = new EntryStore(win.indexedDB)) {
        this.win = win;
        this.store = store;
        this.entries = new Map();
        this.server = new Set();
        this.capacity = 0;
        this.version = -1;
        this.dotnet = null;
        this.status = 'local';
        this.ready = false;
        this.revision = 0;
        this.cached = null;
        this.cachedRevision = -1;
        this.listeners = new Set();
        this.joining = null;
        this.reconciling = null;
        this.timer = 0;
        this.fallback = win.setTimeout(() => this.markReady(), FALLBACK_MS);
        this.emitting = false;
        this.onReconnected = () => this.join();
        win.addEventListener(RECONNECTED_EVENT, this.onReconnected);
        this.loaded = this.load();
    }

    async load() {
        try {
            for (const record of await this.store.all()) {
                this.entries.set(record.id, record);
            }
        } catch {
        }
        this.changed();
    }

    listen(listener) {
        this.listeners.add(listener);
        return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
    }

    changed() {
        this.revision += 1;
        if (this.emitting) {
            return;
        }
        this.emitting = true;
        queueMicrotask(() => {
            this.emitting = false;
            for (const listener of [...this.listeners]) {
                try {
                    listener(this);
                } catch {
                }
            }
        });
    }

    markReady() {
        this.win.clearTimeout(this.fallback);
        if (!this.ready) {
            this.ready = true;
            this.changed();
        }
    }

    setStatus(status) {
        if (this.status !== status) {
            this.status = status;
            this.changed();
        }
    }

    listings() {
        if (this.cachedRevision !== this.revision) {
            this.cached = buildListings(this.entries.values());
            this.cachedRevision = this.revision;
        }
        return this.cached;
    }

    isLive(id) {
        return this.server.has(id);
    }

    get live() {
        return this.status === 'live' && this.dotnet !== null;
    }

    async connect(dotnet) {
        this.dotnet = dotnet;
        this.setStatus('connecting');
        this.win.clearInterval(this.timer);
        this.timer = this.win.setInterval(() => this.ping(), PING_MS);
        await this.loaded;
        await this.join();
    }

    disconnect(dotnet) {
        if (this.dotnet !== dotnet) {
            return;
        }
        this.dotnet = null;
        this.version = -1;
        this.win.clearInterval(this.timer);
        this.setStatus('local');
    }

    join() {
        const dotnet = this.dotnet;
        if (!dotnet) {
            return Promise.resolve();
        }
        this.version = -1;
        this.joining ??= dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Join')
            .catch(() => this.setStatus('offline'))
            .finally(() => {
                this.joining = null;
            });
        return this.joining;
    }

    async ping() {
        const dotnet = this.dotnet;
        if (!dotnet || this.joining) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            if (!(await dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Ping'))) {
                await this.join();
            }
        } catch {
            this.setStatus('offline');
        }
    }

    async apply(updates, dotnet) {
        if (dotnet !== this.dotnet) {
            return;
        }
        for (const update of updates) {
            if (update.kind === 'snapshot') {
                this.snapshot(update);
            } else if (update.kind === 'delta' && this.version >= 0) {
                if (needsResync(this.version, update)) {
                    this.join();
                    return;
                }
                await this.delta(update);
            }
        }
    }

    snapshot(update) {
        this.version = update.version;
        this.capacity = update.capacity;
        this.server = new Set(update.ids);
        this.purge(update.deleted);
        this.setStatus('live');
        this.changed();
        this.reconciling = this.reconcile(this.dotnet).finally(() => {
            this.reconciling = null;
        });
    }

    async reconcile(dotnet) {
        try {
            for (const ids of chunk(missingIds([...this.server], this.entries), FETCH_CHUNK)) {
                if (dotnet !== this.dotnet) {
                    return;
                }
                const fetched = await dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Fetch', ids);
                await this.add(fetched ?? []);
            }
            const offers = offerCandidates([...this.entries.values()], this.server, this.capacity);
            for (const offered of chunkBySize(offers)) {
                if (dotnet !== this.dotnet) {
                    return;
                }
                await dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Offer', offered);
            }
        } catch {
        } finally {
            this.markReady();
        }
    }

    async delta(update) {
        this.version = update.version;
        this.purge(update.deleted);
        for (const id of update.removed) {
            this.server.delete(id);
        }
        for (const entry of update.added) {
            this.server.add(entry.id);
        }
        await this.add(update.added);
        this.changed();
    }

    purge(ids) {
        if (!Array.isArray(ids) || ids.length === 0) {
            return;
        }
        const gone = ids.filter(id => this.entries.has(id) || this.server.has(id));
        if (gone.length === 0) {
            return;
        }
        for (const id of gone) {
            this.entries.delete(id);
            this.server.delete(id);
        }
        this.changed();
        this.store.remove(gone).catch(() => {});
    }

    async add(entries, mine = false) {
        const records = [];
        for (const entry of entries) {
            if (!entry || typeof entry.id !== 'string') {
                continue;
            }
            const known = this.entries.get(entry.id);
            if (known && !(mine && !known.mine)) {
                continue;
            }
            const record = wire(entry);
            if (mine || known?.mine) {
                record.mine = true;
            }
            this.entries.set(record.id, record);
            records.push(record);
        }
        if (records.length === 0) {
            return;
        }
        this.changed();
        try {
            for (const id of await this.store.save(records)) {
                this.entries.delete(id);
            }
        } catch {
        }
    }

    async post(draft) {
        const dotnet = this.dotnet;
        if (!dotnet || this.status !== 'live') {
            return { result: 'offline', entry: null, key: null };
        }
        try {
            const outcome = await dotnet.invokeMethodAsync('Post', draft);
            if (outcome?.entry) {
                this.server.add(outcome.entry.id);
                await this.add([outcome.entry], true);
            }
            return outcome ?? { result: 'invalid', entry: null, key: null };
        } catch {
            return { result: 'offline', entry: null, key: null };
        }
    }

    async clear() {
        this.entries.clear();
        this.server.clear();
        this.changed();
    }
}

let instance = null;

export function nest(win) {
    instance ??= new Nest(win);
    return instance;
}

export function current() {
    return instance;
}

export function targetStatus(column) {
    return column?.dataset.status ?? null;
}

export function mount(root, win) {
    let dragged = null;

    for (const button of root.querySelectorAll('[data-card-form] button[type="submit"]')) {
        button.hidden = true;
    }

    const submit = (card, status) => {
        const form = card?.querySelector('[data-card-form]');
        const select = form?.querySelector('[data-card-status]');
        if (!form || !select || !status || select.value === status) {
            return;
        }
        select.value = status;
        form.requestSubmit();
    };

    root.addEventListener('change', event => {
        const select = event.target instanceof win.HTMLSelectElement && event.target.matches('[data-card-status]') ? event.target : null;
        select?.closest('form')?.requestSubmit();
    });

    root.addEventListener('dragstart', event => {
        const card = event.target instanceof win.Element ? event.target.closest('[data-card]') : null;
        if (!card || card.getAttribute('draggable') !== 'true') {
            return;
        }
        dragged = card;
        event.dataTransfer?.setData('text/plain', card.dataset.card);
        if (event.dataTransfer) {
            event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        }
    });

    root.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
        dragged = null;
        for (const column of root.querySelectorAll('.drop-target')) {
            column.classList.remove('drop-target');
        }
    });

    root.addEventListener('dragover', event => {
        const column = event.target instanceof win.Element ? event.target.closest('[data-status]') : null;
        if (!dragged || !column) {
            return;
        }
        event.preventDefault();
        for (const other of root.querySelectorAll('.drop-target')) {
            if (other !== column) {
                other.classList.remove('drop-target');
            }
        }
        column.classList.add('drop-target');
    });

    root.addEventListener('drop', event => {
        const column = event.target instanceof win.Element ? event.target.closest('[data-status]') : null;
        if (!dragged || !column) {
            return;
        }
        event.preventDefault();
        column.classList.remove('drop-target');
        const card = dragged;
        dragged = null;
        if (card.closest('[data-status]') !== column) {
            column.append(card);
            submit(card, targetStatus(column));
        }
    });
}

const BLOCKS = new Set(['P', 'DIV', 'SECTION', 'ARTICLE', 'HEADER', 'FOOTER', 'TABLE', 'TR', 'UL', 'OL', 'PRE', 'BLOCKQUOTE', 'H1', 'H2', 'H3', 'H4', 'H5', 'H6']);
const SKIP = new Set(['SCRIPT', 'STYLE', 'TEMPLATE', 'NOSCRIPT', 'IFRAME', 'OBJECT', 'SVG', 'HEAD', 'TITLE', 'META', 'LINK']);

export function isWebUrl(value) {
    try {
        const url = new URL(value);
        return url.protocol === 'https:' || url.protocol === 'http:' || url.protocol === 'mailto:';
    } catch {
        return false;
    }
}

export function tidy(text) {
    return text
        .replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
        .trim();
}

function inline(node) {
    let out = '';
    for (const child of node.childNodes) {
        out += convert(child);
    }
    return out;
}

function wrap(text, marker) {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    return trimmed.length === 0 ? text : `${marker}${trimmed}${marker}`;
}

function convert(node) {
    if (node.nodeType === 3) {
        return node.nodeValue.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    }
    if (node.nodeType !== 1) {
        return '';
    }
    const tag = node.tagName.toUpperCase();
    if (SKIP.has(tag)) {
        return '';
    }
    switch (tag) {
        case 'BR':
            return '\n';
        case 'B':
        case 'STRONG':
            return wrap(inline(node), '**');
        case 'I':
        case 'EM':
            return wrap(inline(node), '*');
        case 'S':
        case 'DEL':
        case 'STRIKE':
            return wrap(inline(node), '~~');
        case 'CODE':
            return node.closest('pre') ? node.textContent : `\`${node.textContent.replace(/`/g, '')}\``;
        case 'PRE':
            return `\n\n\`\`\`\n${node.textContent.replace(/\n$/, '')}\n\`\`\`\n\n`;
        case 'A': {
            const href = node.getAttribute('href') ?? '';
            const text = inline(node).trim();
            return isWebUrl(href) ? `[${text || href}](${href})` : text;
        }
        case 'IMG': {
            const src = node.getAttribute('src') ?? '';
            const alt = (node.getAttribute('alt') ?? 'image').replace(/[[\]]/g, '');
            return isWebUrl(src) ? `[${alt}](${src})` : '';
        }
        case 'H1':
        case 'H2':
        case 'H3':
        case 'H4':
        case 'H5':
        case 'H6':
            return `\n\n${'#'.repeat(Number(tag[1]))} ${inline(node).trim()}\n\n`;
        case 'LI': {
            const list = node.parentElement?.tagName.toUpperCase();
            const index = [...(node.parentElement?.children ?? [])].indexOf(node) + 1;
            const marker = list === 'OL' ? `${index}.` : '-';
            return `\n${marker} ${inline(node).trim().replace(/\n+/g, ' ')}`;
        }
        case 'BLOCKQUOTE':
            return `\n\n${tidy(inline(node)).split('\n').map(line => `> ${line}`).join('\n')}\n\n`;
        case 'TD':
        case 'TH':
            return `${inline(node).trim()} | `;
        case 'TR':
            return `\n| ${inline(node).trim()}`;
        default:
            return BLOCKS.has(tag) ? `\n\n${inline(node)}\n\n` : inline(node);
    }
}

export function htmlToMarkdown(html, parser) {
    const doc = parser.parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
    return tidy(inline(doc.body));
}

export function markdownFor(file) {
    const name = file.name.replace(/[[\]]/g, '');
    return file.image ? `![${name}](${file.url})` : `[${name}](${file.url})`;
}

export function pastedName(file, now = new Date()) {
    if (file.name && file.name !== 'image.png' && file.name !== 'blob') {
        return file.name;
    }
    const stamp = now.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace('T', '-').slice(0, 15);
    const extension = (file.type.split('/')[1] ?? 'bin').replace('jpeg', 'jpg').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
    return `screenshot-${stamp}.${extension}`;
}

export function mount(root, win) {
    const doc = win.document;
    const input = root.querySelector('[data-editor-input]');
    const status = root.querySelector('[data-editor-status]');
    const attach = root.querySelector('[data-editor-attach]');
    const picker = root.querySelector('[data-editor-files]');
    const toggle = root.querySelector('[data-editor-toggle]');
    const preview = root.querySelector('[data-editor-preview]');
    if (!input) {
        return;
    }
    if (attach) {
        attach.hidden = false;
    }
    if (toggle && preview) {
        toggle.hidden = false;
    }
    let pending = 0;

    const token = () => root.closest('form')?.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value ?? '';

    const say = text => {
        if (status) {
            status.value = text;
            status.textContent = text;
        }
    };

    const insert = text => {
        const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
        const end = input.selectionEnd ?? start;
        const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
        const spacer = before.length > 0 && !before.endsWith('\n') && text.startsWith('!') ? '\n' : '';
        input.setRangeText(spacer + text, start, end, 'end');
        input.dispatchEvent(new win.Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    };

    const replace = (marker, text) => {
        const at = input.value.indexOf(marker);
        if (at >= 0) {
            input.setRangeText(text, at, at + marker.length, 'preserve');
            input.dispatchEvent(new win.Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        }
    };

    const upload = async file => {
        const name = pastedName(file);
        const marker = `[Uploading ${name.replace(/[[\]]/g, '')}…]`;
        insert(marker);
        pending += 1;
        say(`Uploading ${pending === 1 ? name : `${pending} files`}…`);
        try {
            const response = await win.fetch(root.dataset.upload, {
                method: 'POST',
                credentials: 'same-origin',
                headers: {
                    RequestVerificationToken: token(),
                    'X-File-Name': encodeURIComponent(name),
                    'Content-Type': file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                },
                body: file,
            });
            const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!response.ok || !body.url) {
                replace(marker, '');
                say(body.error ?? `Could not upload ${name}.`);
                return;
            }
            replace(marker, markdownFor(body));
            say(`Uploaded ${body.name} (${body.size}). Save to keep the link.`);
        } catch {
            replace(marker, '');
            say(`Could not upload ${name}. Check the connection and try again.`);
        } finally {
            pending -= 1;
        }
    };

    const uploadAll = files => {
        for (const file of files) {
            upload(file);
        }
    };

    input.addEventListener('paste', event => {
        const data = event.clipboardData;
        if (!data) {
            return;
        }
        const files = [...data.files];
        if (files.length > 0) {
            event.preventDefault();
            uploadAll(files);
            return;
        }
        const html = data.getData('text/html');
        if (html && 'DOMParser' in win) {
            const markdown = htmlToMarkdown(html, new win.DOMParser());
            if (markdown.length > 0) {
                event.preventDefault();
                insert(markdown);
            }
        }
    });

    input.addEventListener('dragover', event => {
        if (event.dataTransfer?.types?.includes('Files')) {
            event.preventDefault();
            root.classList.add('dragging');
        }
    });
    input.addEventListener('dragleave', () => root.classList.remove('dragging'));
    input.addEventListener('drop', event => {
        root.classList.remove('dragging');
        const files = [...(event.dataTransfer?.files ?? [])];
        if (files.length > 0) {
            event.preventDefault();
            input.focus();
            uploadAll(files);
        }
    });

    picker?.addEventListener('change', () => {
        uploadAll([...picker.files]);
        picker.value = '';
    });

    input.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' && (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            input.closest('form')?.requestSubmit();
        }
    });

    input.closest('form')?.addEventListener('submit', event => {
        if (pending > 0) {
            event.preventDefault();
            say('Wait for the uploads to finish.');
        }
    });

    toggle?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        if (!preview) {
            return;
        }
        if (!preview.hidden) {
            preview.hidden = true;
            toggle.textContent = 'Preview';
            return;
        }
        toggle.disabled = true;
        try {
            const response = await win.fetch(root.dataset.preview, {
                method: 'POST',
                credentials: 'same-origin',
                headers: { RequestVerificationToken: token(), 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' },
                body: input.value,
            });
            preview.innerHTML = response.ok ? await response.text() : '<p class="muted">Preview is not available right now.</p>';
            preview.hidden = false;
            toggle.textContent = 'Edit';
        } catch {
            say('Preview is not available right now.');
        } finally {
            toggle.disabled = false;
        }
    });

    doc.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (doc.visibilityState === 'hidden' && pending > 0) {
            say('Uploads continue in the background.');
        }
    });
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Nest;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Trash;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Work;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Work;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Tests;

public sealed class DeletionTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task SoftDeleteRestoreAndPurgeAreAudited()
    {
        await using var test = await TestDatabase.CreateAsync();
        var owner = await test.PersonAsync("owner", true);
        var (_, project) = await new ProjectStore(test.Database).CreateAsync("TRSH", "Trash", "", owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var items = new WorkItemStore(test.Database);
        var (item, number) = await items.CreateAsync(project, new WorkItemFields(WorkItemKinds.Bug, "Doomed", "", WorkItemStatuses.Backlog, 2, null, null, null, null), owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var deletions = new Deletions(test.Database);

        Assert.False(await deletions.HardDeleteAsync(Subject.WorkItem, item, TestDatabase.Audit(owner, "hard-delete"), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.True(await deletions.SoftDeleteAsync(Subject.WorkItem, item, owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner, "soft-delete"), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.False(await deletions.SoftDeleteAsync(Subject.WorkItem, item, owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner, "soft-delete"), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Null(await items.FindAsync(project, number, cancellationToken: TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.NotNull(await items.FindAsync(project, number, includeDeleted: true, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));

        var trashed = Assert.Single(await deletions.ListAsync(null, 10, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(Subject.WorkItem, trashed.Subject);
        Assert.Equal("TRSH", trashed.ProjectKey);
        Assert.Equal(project, trashed.ProjectId);
        Assert.Equal("#1 Doomed", trashed.Title);
        Assert.Single(await deletions.ListAsync(project, 10, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.NotNull(await deletions.FindAsync(Subject.WorkItem, item, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));

        Assert.True(await deletions.RestoreAsync(Subject.WorkItem, item, TestDatabase.Audit(owner, "restore"), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.NotNull(await items.FindAsync(project, number, cancellationToken: TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.True(await deletions.SoftDeleteAsync(Subject.WorkItem, item, owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner, "soft-delete"), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.True(await deletions.HardDeleteAsync(Subject.WorkItem, item, TestDatabase.Audit(owner, "hard-delete"), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Null(await items.FindAsync(project, number, includeDeleted: true, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Empty(await deletions.ListAsync(null, 10, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(["soft-delete", "restore", "soft-delete", "hard-delete"],
            await AuditActionsAsync(test));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PurgedHomeEntriesStayAsTombstones()
    {
        await using var test = await TestDatabase.CreateAsync();
        var admin = await test.PersonAsync("admin", true);
        var store = new NestEntryStore(test.Database);
        var first = new NestEntryRow(Guid.CreateVersion7(), "comment", ["zillow:1"], null, null, "spam");
        var second = new NestEntryRow(Guid.CreateVersion7(), "fact", ["zillow:1", "redfin:2"], null, "[{\"key\":\"price\",\"value\":\"450000\"}]", null);
        Assert.Equal(2, await store.InsertAsync([first, second], TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(0, await store.InsertAsync([first], TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));

        var deletions = new Deletions(test.Database);
        Assert.True(await deletions.SoftDeleteAsync(Subject.NestEntry, first.Id, admin, TestDatabase.Audit(admin), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Single(await deletions.ListAsync(null, 10, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.True(await deletions.HardDeleteAsync(Subject.NestEntry, first.Id, TestDatabase.Audit(admin), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Empty(await deletions.ListAsync(null, 10, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.False(await deletions.RestoreAsync(Subject.NestEntry, first.Id, TestDatabase.Audit(admin), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));

        var loaded = await store.LoadAsync(100, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        Assert.Equal(2, loaded.Count);
        var tombstone = loaded.Single(record => record.Id == first.Id);
        Assert.NotNull(tombstone.DeletedAt);
        Assert.Null(tombstone.Text);
        var live = loaded.Single(record => record.Id == second.Id);
        Assert.Equal(["zillow:1", "redfin:2"], live.Keys);
        Assert.Contains("450000", live.Fields!);

        Assert.Single(await store.ForKeysAsync(["redfin:2"], TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Single(await store.ForKeysAsync(["zillow:1"], TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.NotNull(await store.FindAsync(second.Id, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
    }

    private static async Task<string[]> AuditActionsAsync(TestDatabase test)
    {
        var log = new Audit.AuditLog(test.Database);
        return [.. (await log.ListAsync(100, null, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Where(entry => entry.SubjectType == "test" && entry.Action != "test").Reverse().Select(entry => entry.Action)];
    }
}

        Assert.Null(await people.FindByUserNameAsync("bob", TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));

    }

        var people = new PersonStore(test.Database);
        var admin = await test.PersonAsync("root", true);
        var other = await test.PersonAsync("other");
        Assert.False(await people.SetAdministratorAsync(admin, false, admin, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.False(await people.SetDisabledAsync(admin, true, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.True(await people.SetAdministratorAsync(other, true, admin, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.True(await people.SetAdministratorAsync(admin, false, other, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.True(await people.SetDisabledAsync(admin, true, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        var disabled = await people.FindAsync(admin, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        Assert.NotNull(disabled?.DisabledAt);
        Assert.True(await people.SetDisabledAsync(admin, false, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
    }

    {

        var people = new PersonStore(test.Database);

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Dapper;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Audit;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.People;
using Npgsql;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Tests;

internal sealed partial class TestDatabase : IAsyncDisposable
{
    public const string Variable = "PLAYGROUND_TEST_DATABASE";
    private readonly string _admin;
    private readonly string _name;
    private readonly NpgsqlDataSource _source;

    private TestDatabase(string admin, string name, NpgsqlDataSource source)
    {
        _admin = admin;
        _name = name;
        _source = source;
        Database = new Database(source);
    }

    public Database Database { get; }

    public static async Task<TestDatabase> CreateAsync()
    {
        var admin = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(Variable);
        Assert.SkipWhen(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(admin), $"Set {Variable} to a PostgreSQL connection string that may create databases.");
        var name = "playground_test_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        await ExecuteAsync(admin!, $"CREATE DATABASE {name}");
        var source = new NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder(DatabaseName().Replace(admin!, "Database=" + name)).Build();
        var database = new TestDatabase(admin!, name, source);
        await new MigrationRunner(database.Database, NullLogger<MigrationRunner>.Instance).RunAsync(1, TimeSpan.Zero, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        return database;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> PersonAsync(string userName, bool administrator = false)
    {
        var (_, id) = await new PersonStore(Database).CreateAsync(new NewPerson(userName, userName.ToUpperInvariant(), "pbkdf2-sha512$100000$AAAA$AAAA"), administrator);
        return id;
    }

    public static AuditEntry Audit(Guid actor, string action = "test") => new(actor, "tester", action, "test", "1", "summary");

    public async Task<T?> ScalarAsync<T>(string sql, object? parameters = null)
    {
        await using var connection = await Database.OpenAsync();
        return await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<T>(new CommandDefinition(sql, parameters));
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        await _source.DisposeAsync();
        await ExecuteAsync(_admin, $"DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS {_name} WITH (FORCE)");
    }

    private static async Task ExecuteAsync(string connectionString, string sql)
    {
        await using var source = new NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder(connectionString).Build();
        await using var connection = await source.OpenConnectionAsync();
        await connection.ExecuteAsync(new CommandDefinition(sql));
    }

    [GeneratedRegex("Database=[^;]*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex DatabaseName();
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Work;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Access;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Work;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Data.Tests;

public sealed class WorkStoreTests
{
    private static WorkItemFields Fields(string title, string kind = WorkItemKinds.Story, Guid? sprint = null, Guid? assignee = null, Guid? parent = null) =>
        new(kind, title, "", WorkItemStatuses.Backlog, Priorities.Medium, null, assignee, sprint, parent);

    [Fact]
    public async Task ProjectsHaveUniqueKeysAndTheirCreatorAsEditor()
    {
        await using var test = await TestDatabase.CreateAsync();
        var owner = await test.PersonAsync("owner");
        var stranger = await test.PersonAsync("stranger");
        var projects = new ProjectStore(test.Database);

        Assert.Equal(CreateProjectResult.Created, created);
        Assert.Equal(CreateProjectResult.KeyTaken, (await projects.CreateAsync("PAMS", "Again", "", owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Result);
        var mine = Assert.Single(await projects.ListAsync(owner, false, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(PageRoles.Editor, mine.Role);
        Assert.Equal(1, mine.MemberCount);
        Assert.Empty(await projects.ListAsync(stranger, false, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));

        Assert.Equal(id, (await projects.FindByIdAsync(id, owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken))!.Id);
        Assert.Equal(1L, await test.ScalarAsync<long>("SELECT count(*) FROM audit_event WHERE subject_id = @id", new { id = id.ToString() }));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ProjectsKeepAnEditor()
    {
        await using var test = await TestDatabase.CreateAsync();
        var owner = await test.PersonAsync("owner");
        await test.PersonAsync("helper");
        var projects = new ProjectStore(test.Database);
        var (_, id) = await projects.CreateAsync("TEAM", "Team", "", owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        Assert.Equal(MemberChange.Changed, await projects.SetMemberAsync(id, "helper", PageRoles.Member, owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(MemberChange.Unchanged, await projects.SetMemberAsync(id, "helper", PageRoles.Member, owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(MemberChange.NotFound, await projects.SetMemberAsync(id, "nobody", PageRoles.Member, owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(MemberChange.LastEditor, await projects.SetMemberAsync(id, "owner", PageRoles.Member, owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(MemberChange.LastEditor, await projects.RemoveMemberAsync(id, owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        var members = await projects.MembersAsync(id, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        Assert.Equal(2, members.Count);
        var helper = members.Single(member => member.UserName == "helper");
        Assert.Equal(MemberChange.Changed, await projects.RemoveMemberAsync(id, helper.PersonId, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ItemsAreNumberedRankedAndTracked()
    {
        await using var test = await TestDatabase.CreateAsync();
        var owner = await test.PersonAsync("owner");
        var outsider = await test.PersonAsync("outsider");
        var projects = new ProjectStore(test.Database);
        var items = new WorkItemStore(test.Database);
        var (_, project) = await projects.CreateAsync("ITEM", "Items", "", owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);

        var (epicId, epic) = await items.CreateAsync(project, Fields("Epic", WorkItemKinds.Epic), owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var (_, first) = await items.CreateAsync(project, Fields("First", parent: epicId, assignee: outsider), owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var (_, second) = await items.CreateAsync(project, Fields("Second"), owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        Assert.Equal([1, 2, 3], new[] { epic, first, second });

        var created = (await items.FindAsync(project, first, cancellationToken: TestContext.Current.CancellationToken))!;
        Assert.Null(created.AssigneeId);
        Assert.Equal(epicId, created.ParentId);
        Assert.Equal("OWNER", created.ReporterName);

        Assert.True(await items.UpdateAsync(project, first, current => current with { Status = WorkItemStatuses.InProgress, AssigneeId = owner, Title = "First!" }, owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        var updated = (await items.FindAsync(project, first, cancellationToken: TestContext.Current.CancellationToken))!;
        Assert.Equal(WorkItemStatuses.InProgress, updated.Status);
        Assert.Equal(owner, updated.AssigneeId);
        var history = await items.HistoryAsync(updated.Id, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        Assert.Equal(["created", "title", "status", "assignee"], history.Select(change => change.Field));
        Assert.Equal("In progress", history.Single(change => change.Field == "status").NewValue);
        Assert.Equal("OWNER", history.Single(change => change.Field == "assignee").NewValue);

        Assert.True(await items.UpdateAsync(project, first, current => current, owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(4, (await items.HistoryAsync(updated.Id, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Count);

        Assert.Equal([epic, first, second], (await items.ListAsync(new WorkItemQuery(project), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Select(item => item.Number));
        Assert.True(await items.MoveAsync(project, second, true, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal([epic, second, first], (await items.ListAsync(new WorkItemQuery(project), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Select(item => item.Number));
        Assert.False(await items.MoveAsync(project, epic, true, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));

        Assert.Equal([first], (await items.ListAsync(new WorkItemQuery(project, Text: "first!"), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Select(item => item.Number));
        Assert.Equal([second], (await items.ListAsync(new WorkItemQuery(project, Text: "#3"), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Select(item => item.Number));
        Assert.Equal([epic], (await items.EpicsAsync(project, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Select(item => item.Number));
        Assert.Equal([first], (await items.ChildrenAsync(epicId, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Select(item => item.Number));
        Assert.Equal([first], (await items.AssignedToAsync(owner, 10, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Select(item => item.Number));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task OneSprintIsActiveAndCompletingReturnsOpenWork()
    {
        await using var test = await TestDatabase.CreateAsync();
        var owner = await test.PersonAsync("owner");
        var projects = new ProjectStore(test.Database);
        var sprints = new SprintStore(test.Database);
        var items = new WorkItemStore(test.Database);
        var (_, project) = await projects.CreateAsync("SPRT", "Sprints", "", owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var one = await sprints.CreateAsync(project, new SprintDraft("One", "Goal", new DateOnly(2026, 11, 19), new DateOnly(2026, 12, 2)), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var two = await sprints.CreateAsync(project, new SprintDraft("Two", "", null, null), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var (_, open) = await items.CreateAsync(project, Fields("Open", sprint: one) with { Status = WorkItemStatuses.ToDo, Points = 3 }, owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var (_, done) = await items.CreateAsync(project, Fields("Done", sprint: one) with { Status = WorkItemStatuses.Done, Points = 5 }, owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);

        Assert.Equal(SprintChange.Changed, await sprints.StartAsync(project, one, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(SprintChange.AnotherIsActive, await sprints.StartAsync(project, two, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        var active = (await sprints.FindAsync(project, one, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken))!;
        Assert.Equal(SprintStates.Active, active.State);
        Assert.Equal(new DateOnly(2026, 11, 19), active.Starts);
        Assert.Equal(2, active.ItemCount);
        Assert.Equal(1, active.DoneCount);
        Assert.Equal(8, active.Points);
        Assert.Equal(5, active.DonePoints);

        Assert.Equal(SprintChange.Changed, await sprints.CompleteAsync(project, one, null, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(SprintChange.WrongState, await sprints.CompleteAsync(project, one, null, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        var returned = (await items.FindAsync(project, open, cancellationToken: TestContext.Current.CancellationToken))!;
        Assert.Null(returned.SprintId);
        Assert.Equal(WorkItemStatuses.Backlog, returned.Status);
        Assert.Equal(one, (await items.FindAsync(project, done, cancellationToken: TestContext.Current.CancellationToken))!.SprintId);

        Assert.Equal(SprintChange.Changed, await sprints.StartAsync(project, two, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal(["Two", "One"], (await sprints.ListAsync(project, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Select(sprint => sprint.Name));
        Assert.True(await sprints.UpdateAsync(project, two, new SprintDraft("Two b", "Ship", null, new DateOnly(2026, 12, 31)), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));
        Assert.Equal("Two b", (await sprints.FindAsync(project, two, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken))!.Name);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AttachmentsAreStoredInChunks()
    {
        await using var test = await TestDatabase.CreateAsync();
        var owner = await test.PersonAsync("owner");
        var (_, project) = await new ProjectStore(test.Database).CreateAsync("FILE", "Files", "", owner, TestDatabase.Audit(owner), TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var (item, _) = await new WorkItemStore(test.Database).CreateAsync(project, Fields("Files"), owner, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        var attachments = new AttachmentStore(test.Database);
        var bytes = new byte[(AttachmentStore.ChunkSize * 2) + 1234];
        RandomNumberGenerator.Fill(bytes);
        bytes[0] = 0x89;
        "PNG\r\n\u001a\n"u8.CopyTo(bytes.AsSpan(1));

        var stored = await attachments.UploadAsync(new AttachmentUpload(project, item, owner, "shot.png"), new MemoryStream(bytes), bytes.Length, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        Assert.Equal(UploadOutcome.Stored, stored.Outcome);
        Assert.Equal("image/png", stored.Attachment!.ContentType);
        Assert.Equal(bytes.Length, stored.Attachment.Length);
        Assert.Equal(3L, await test.ScalarAsync<long>("SELECT count(*) FROM attachment_chunk WHERE attachment_id = @id", new { id = stored.Attachment.Id }));

        var copy = new MemoryStream();
        await attachments.CopyToAsync(stored.Attachment.Id, copy, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
        Assert.Equal(bytes, copy.ToArray());
        Assert.Single(await attachments.ListAsync(item, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken));

        Assert.Equal(UploadOutcome.TooLarge, (await attachments.UploadAsync(new AttachmentUpload(project, item, owner, "big.bin"), new MemoryStream(bytes), 1000, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Outcome);
        Assert.Equal(UploadOutcome.Empty, (await attachments.UploadAsync(new AttachmentUpload(project, item, owner, "none.bin"), new MemoryStream(), 1000, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken)).Outcome);
        Assert.Equal(1L, await test.ScalarAsync<long>("SELECT count(*) FROM attachment"));
    }
}

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Text;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Tests;

public sealed class RichTextTests
{
    private static readonly string[] AllowedTags = ["p", "br", "strong", "em", "del", "code", "pre", "a", "img", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "hr", "ul", "ol", "li", "blockquote", "input"];
    private static readonly string[] AllowedAttributes = ["href", "src", "alt", "rel", "target", "loading", "class", "type", "disabled", "checked"];

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(null, "")]
    [InlineData("   ", "")]
    [InlineData("hello", "<p>hello</p>\n")]
    [InlineData("a\nb", "<p>a<br>\nb</p>\n")]
    [InlineData("a\n\nb", "<p>a</p>\n<p>b</p>\n")]
    [InlineData("**bold** and *it* and ~~old~~", "<p><strong>bold</strong> and <em>it</em> and <del>old</del></p>\n")]
    [InlineData("snake_case_name", "<p>snake_case_name</p>\n")]
    [InlineData("_lean_", "<p><em>lean</em></p>\n")]
    [InlineData("`<b>`", "<p><code>&lt;b&gt;</code></p>\n")]
    [InlineData("# Title", "<h3>Title</h3>\n")]
    [InlineData("### Deep ###", "<h5>Deep</h5>\n")]
    [InlineData("---", "<hr>\n")]
    [InlineData("- one\n- two", "<ul>\n<li>one</li>\n<li>two</li>\n</ul>\n")]
    [InlineData("1. one\n2. two", "<ol>\n<li>one</li>\n<li>two</li>\n</ol>\n")]
    [InlineData("- [x] done\n- [ ] open", "<ul>\n<li><input type=\"checkbox\" disabled checked> done</li>\n<li><input type=\"checkbox\" disabled> open</li>\n</ul>\n")]
    [InlineData("> quoted", "<blockquote>\n<p>quoted</p>\n</blockquote>\n")]
    [InlineData("```js\nlet a = '<x>';\n```", "<pre><code class=\"language-js\">let a = &#39;&lt;x&gt;&#39;;</code></pre>\n")]
    [InlineData("\\*not italic\\*", "<p>*not italic*</p>\n")]
    public void RendersTheSupportedSubset(string? markdown, string expected)
    {
        Assert.Equal(expected, RichText.ToHtml(markdown));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("<script>alert(1)</script>")]
    [InlineData("<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>")]
    [InlineData("[x](javascript:alert(1))")]
    [InlineData("![x](javascript:alert(1))")]
    [InlineData("[x](data:text/html,hi)")]
    [InlineData("\" onmouseover=\"alert(1)")]
    [InlineData("[a](https://example.com\" onclick=\"x)")]
    public void NeverEmitsActiveContent(string markdown)
    {
        var html = RichText.ToHtml(markdown);
        foreach (Match tag in Regex.Matches(html, "<(/?)([a-z0-9]+)([^>]*)>"))
        {
            Assert.Contains(tag.Groups[2].Value, AllowedTags);
            foreach (Match attribute in Regex.Matches(tag.Groups[3].Value, "\\s([a-z-]+)(?:=\"([^\"]*)\")?"))
            {
                Assert.Contains(attribute.Groups[1].Value, AllowedAttributes);
                var value = attribute.Groups[2].Value;
                Assert.False(value.StartsWith("javascript:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                Assert.False(value.StartsWith("data:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            }

            Assert.Equal(tag.Groups[3].Value, Regex.Replace(tag.Groups[3].Value, "\\s[a-z-]+(=\"[^\"]*\")?", m => m.Value));
        }

        Assert.Equal(html.Count(c => c == '<'), Regex.Matches(html, "<(/?)([a-z0-9]+)([^>]*)>").Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LinksOpenSafely()
    {
        Assert.Equal(
            "<p><a href=\"https://example.com/a?b=1&amp;c=2\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" target=\"_blank\">site</a></p>\n",
            RichText.ToHtml("[site](https://example.com/a?b=1&c=2)"));
        Assert.Equal("<p><a href=\"/work/A/items/1\">one</a></p>\n", RichText.ToHtml("[one](/work/A/items/1)"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AutoLinksBareUrls()
    {
        Assert.Equal(
            "<p>see <a href=\"https://example.com/x\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" target=\"_blank\">https://example.com/x</a>.</p>\n",
            RichText.ToHtml("see https://example.com/x."));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EmbedsOnlyLocalImages()
    {
        Assert.Equal("<p><img src=\"/work/files/1/a.png\" alt=\"shot\" loading=\"lazy\"></p>\n", RichText.ToHtml("![shot](/work/files/1/a.png)"));
        Assert.Equal(
            "<p><a href=\"https://example.com/a.png\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" target=\"_blank\">remote</a></p>\n",
            RichText.ToHtml("![remote](https://example.com/a.png)"));
        Assert.Equal("<p>sneaky</p>\n", RichText.ToHtml("![sneaky](//evil.example/a.png)"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LinksItemNumbersWhenAsked()
    {
        var html = RichText.ToHtml("fixes #12 but not x#3 or #0", number => $"/work/ABC/items/{number}");
        Assert.Equal("<p>fixes <a href=\"/work/ABC/items/12\">#12</a> but not x#3 or #0</p>\n", html);
        Assert.Equal("<p>#12</p>\n", RichText.ToHtml("#12"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LimitsLength()
    {
        var html = RichText.ToHtml(new string('a', RichText.MaxLength + 500));
        Assert.Equal(RichText.MaxLength + "<p></p>\n".Length, html.Length);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("/work/a", true)]
    [InlineData("//evil", false)]
    [InlineData("/\\evil", false)]
    [InlineData("/a b", false)]
    [InlineData("work", false)]
    [InlineData("/", false)]
    public void RecognizesLocalPaths(string url, bool expected)
    {
        Assert.Equal(expected, RichText.IsLocalPath(url));
    }
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Security;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Tests;

public sealed class PasswordHasherTests
{
    private readonly PasswordHasher _hasher = new(PasswordHasher.MinimumIterations);

    [Fact]
    public void VerifiesWhatItHashed()
    {
        var hash = _hasher.Hash("correct horse battery staple");
        Assert.StartsWith("pbkdf2-sha512$100000$", hash);
        Assert.Equal(PasswordCheck.Succeeded, _hasher.Verify(hash, "correct horse battery staple"));
        Assert.Equal(PasswordCheck.Failed, _hasher.Verify(hash, "correct horse battery stapler"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SaltsEveryHash()
    {
        Assert.NotEqual(_hasher.Hash("same"), _hasher.Hash("same"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AsksForARehashWhenTheWorkFactorRose()
    {
        var hash = _hasher.Hash("correct horse battery staple");
        Assert.Equal(PasswordCheck.SucceededNeedsRehash, new PasswordHasher(PasswordHasher.MinimumIterations + 1).Verify(hash, "correct horse battery staple"));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(null)]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData("plain")]
    [InlineData("pbkdf2-sha512$1000$AAAA$AAAA")]
    [InlineData("pbkdf2-sha512$100000$!!!$AAAA")]
    [InlineData("bcrypt$100000$AAAA$AAAA")]
    public void RejectsMalformedHashes(string? stored)
    {
        Assert.Equal(PasswordCheck.Failed, _hasher.Verify(stored, "anything"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RefusesTooFewIterations()
    {
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new PasswordHasher(1000));
    }
}

public sealed class SetupCodeTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void MatchesIgnoringCaseAndSpaces()
    {
        var code = SetupCode.Create();
        Assert.Matches("^[A-Z2-9]{4}(-[A-Z2-9]{4}){3}$", code.Value);
        Assert.True(code.Matches(code.Value));
        Assert.True(code.Matches(" " + code.Value.ToLowerInvariant() + " "));
        Assert.False(code.Matches(null));
        Assert.False(code.Matches(SetupCode.Create().Value));
    }
}

using System.Text;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Reading;
using Microsoft.Extensions.FileProviders;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Primitives;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Tests.Chaos;

public sealed class ArticleLibraryTests : IDisposable
{
    private const string FileName = "articles.txt";
    private readonly DirectoryInfo _root = Directory.CreateTempSubdirectory("chaos-articles-");
    private readonly PhysicalFileProvider _files;

    public ArticleLibraryTests() => _files = new PhysicalFileProvider(_root.FullName);

    private string FilePath => Path.Combine(_root.FullName, FileName);

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _files.Dispose();
        _root.Delete(true);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FindsEveryArticleById()
    {
        Write(ArticleSamples.Both);
        var library = Create();

        Assert.Equal(2, library.Count);
        Assert.Equal("Are Babies Conscious?", library.Find(ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.FirstUrl))?.Title);
        Assert.Equal("The 7 Keys to Longevity", library.Find(ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.SecondUrl))?.Title);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PicksAnyArticle()
    {
        Write(ArticleSamples.Both);
        var library = Create();

        Assert.Equal("Are Babies Conscious?", library.Pick(_ => 0)?.Title);
        Assert.Equal("The 7 Keys to Longevity", library.Pick(count => count - 1)?.Title);
        Assert.Null(library.Pick(count => count));
        var any = library.Random();
        Assert.NotNull(any);
        Assert.Contains(any.Title, new[] { "Are Babies Conscious?", "The 7 Keys to Longevity" });
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(null)]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData("ffffffffffff")]
    [InlineData("FFFFFFFFFFFF")]
    [InlineData("../articles.txt")]
    public void ReturnsNothingForUnknownIds(string? id)
    {
        Write(ArticleSamples.Both);
        Assert.Null(Create().Find(id));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KeepsTheFirstOfDuplicateArticles()
    {
        Write(ArticleSamples.First + ArticleSamples.First.Replace("Are Babies Conscious?", "Copy", StringComparison.Ordinal) + ArticleSamples.Second);
        var library = Create();

        Assert.Equal(2, library.Count);
        Assert.Equal("Are Babies Conscious?", library.Find(ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.FirstUrl))?.Title);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsEmptyWithoutAFile()
    {
        var library = Create();

        Assert.Equal(0, library.Count);
        Assert.Null(library.Random());
        Assert.Null(library.Find(ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.FirstUrl)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsEmptyWhenThePathIsAFolder()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(FilePath);
        Assert.Equal(0, Create().Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NoticesWhenTheFileAppearsChangesAndDisappears()
    {
        var library = Create();
        Assert.Equal(0, library.Count);

        Write(ArticleSamples.First);
        Assert.Equal(1, library.Count);

        Write(ArticleSamples.Second + ArticleSamples.First, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1));
        var first = ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.FirstUrl);
        Assert.Equal(2, library.Count);
        Assert.Equal("Are Babies Conscious?", library.Find(first)?.Title);

        Write(ArticleSamples.Second, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2));
        Assert.Null(library.Find(first));
        Assert.Equal("The 7 Keys to Longevity", library.Random()?.Title);

        File.Delete(FilePath);
        Assert.Null(library.Random());
        Assert.Equal(0, library.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReadsAPlainTextFileAsOneArticle()
    {
        Write("A title\n\nThe only paragraph.\n");
        var article = Create().Random();

        Assert.Equal("A title", article?.Title);
        Assert.Equal("The only paragraph.", Assert.Single(article!.Blocks).Text);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReadsArticlesAfterMultibyteText()
    {
        Write("﻿" + ArticleSamples.Record("é.html", "ü", "Ünïcödé — “quotes”\nBy Ñame\nPublished 2026-10-01 00:00 UTC\nhttps://example.com/u", "Body ½ €.") + ArticleSamples.Second);
        var library = Create();

        Assert.Equal("Ünïcödé — “quotes”", library.Find(ArticleText.IdOf("https://example.com/u"))?.Title);
        Assert.Equal("The 7 Keys to Longevity", library.Find(ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.SecondUrl))?.Title);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReadsFromProvidersThatCannotSeek()
    {
        var library = new ArticleLibrary(new MemoryFiles(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(ArticleSamples.Both)), Limits.Create(options => options.ArticlesFile = FileName), NullLogger<ArticleLibrary>.Instance);

        Assert.Equal("The 7 Keys to Longevity", library.Find(ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.SecondUrl))?.Title);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("", false)]
    [InlineData(" ", false)]
    [InlineData("nytimes.txt", true)]
    public void TheArticlesFileMustBeNamed(string name, bool valid) =>
        Assert.Equal(valid, new ChaosOptions { ArticlesFile = name }.IsValid());

    private ArticleLibrary Create() =>
        new(_files, Limits.Create(options => options.ArticlesFile = FileName), NullLogger<ArticleLibrary>.Instance);

    private void Write(string text, TimeSpan? later = null)
    {
        File.WriteAllText(FilePath, text, new UTF8Encoding(false));
        File.SetLastWriteTimeUtc(FilePath, new DateTime(2026, 11, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc) + (later ?? TimeSpan.Zero));
    }

    private sealed class MemoryFiles(byte[] bytes) : IFileProvider
    {
        public IDirectoryContents GetDirectoryContents(string subpath) => NotFoundDirectoryContents.Singleton;

        public IFileInfo GetFileInfo(string subpath) => new MemoryFile(bytes);

        public IChangeToken Watch(string filter) => NullChangeToken.Singleton;
    }

    private sealed class MemoryFile(byte[] bytes) : IFileInfo
    {
        public bool Exists => true;

        public long Length => bytes.Length;

        public string? PhysicalPath => null;

        public string Name => FileName;

        public DateTimeOffset LastModified => DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch;

        public bool IsDirectory => false;

        public Stream CreateReadStream() => new ForwardOnlyStream(bytes);
    }

    private sealed class ForwardOnlyStream(byte[] bytes) : MemoryStream(bytes, false)
    {
        public override bool CanSeek => false;
    }
}

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Tests.Chaos;

internal static class ArticleSamples

        "consciousness-brain-babies.html",
        "When does it begin?",

        "1. Move more.");

using System.Text;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Reading;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Tests.Chaos;

public sealed class ArticleTextTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void ParsesTheHeadSummaryAndBody()
    {
        var article = ArticleText.Parse(ArticleSamples.First);

        Assert.NotNull(article);
        Assert.Equal(ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.FirstUrl), article.Id);
        Assert.Equal("Are Babies Conscious?", article.Title);
        Assert.Equal("By pinpointing when it begins in young humans, scientists hope to better understand what consciousness is.", article.Dek);
        Assert.Equal("By Carl Zimmer", article.Byline);
        Assert.Equal(new DateTimeOffset(2026, 10, 5, 9, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero), article.Published);
        Assert.Equal(new Uri(ArticleSamples.FirstUrl), article.Source);
        Assert.Equal("When does it begin?", article.Summary);
        Assert.Equal(4, article.Blocks.Count);
        Assert.Equal("A newborn’s brain is busy.", article.Blocks[0].Text);
        Assert.False(article.Blocks[0].IsList);
        Assert.True(article.Blocks[2].IsList);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "Attention to faces.", "Surprise at the unexpected.", "A sense of time." }, article.Blocks[2].Lines);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReadsAHeadWithoutADek()
    {
        var article = ArticleText.Parse(ArticleSamples.Record("x.html", "s", "Title\nBy Someone\nPublished 2026-10-05 13:10 UTC\nhttps://example.com/live", "Body."));

        Assert.NotNull(article);
        Assert.Equal("Title", article.Title);
        Assert.Null(article.Dek);
        Assert.Equal("By Someone", article.Byline);
        Assert.Equal(ArticleText.IdOf("https://example.com/live"), article.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToleratesAnUnreadableDateAndNoSource()
    {
        var article = ArticleText.Parse(ArticleSamples.Record("x.html", "s", "Title\nPublished sometime", "Body."));

        Assert.NotNull(article);
        Assert.Null(article.Published);
        Assert.Null(article.Source);
        Assert.Null(article.Byline);
        Assert.Null(article.Dek);
        Assert.Equal(ArticleText.IdOf("Title\nBody."), article.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KeepsLineBreaksInsideAParagraphThatIsNotAList()
    {
        var article = ArticleText.Parse(ArticleSamples.Record("x.html", "s", "Title", "First line\n- second line"));

        Assert.NotNull(article);
        Assert.False(article.Blocks[0].IsList);
        Assert.Equal("First line\n- second line", article.Blocks[0].Text);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FallsBackToPlainText()
    {
        var article = ArticleText.Parse("﻿A plain title\r\n\r\nFirst paragraph.\r\n\r\nSecond paragraph.\r\n");

        Assert.NotNull(article);
        Assert.Equal("A plain title", article.Title);
        Assert.Null(article.Summary);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "First paragraph.", "Second paragraph." }, article.Blocks.Select(block => block.Text));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NamesAnUntitledRecordAfterItsSlug()
    {
        var article = ArticleText.Parse($"{ArticleSamples.Rule}\nlong-walks-home.html\n{ArticleSamples.Rule}\n\n{new string('w', 300)}\n");

        Assert.NotNull(article);
        Assert.Equal("Long walks home", article.Title);
        Assert.Single(article.Blocks);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData("   \n\n  ")]
    [InlineData("====================\nslug\n====================\n\n")]
    public void RejectsRecordsWithoutABody(string text) => Assert.Null(ArticleText.Parse(text));

    [Fact]
    public void SplitsRecordsAtHeaderRules()
    {
        var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(ArticleSamples.Both);
        var records = ArticleText.Records(bytes);

        Assert.Equal(2, records.Count);
        var titles = records.Select(range => ArticleText.Parse(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes[range]))!.Title);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "Are Babies Conscious?", "The 7 Keys to Longevity" }, titles);
        Assert.Equal(bytes.Length, records[^1].End.GetOffset(bytes.Length));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IgnoresARuleInsideABody()
    {
        var text = ArticleSamples.Record("a.html", "s", "Alpha", "One.", ArticleSamples.Rule, "Two.", "Three.", "Four.", "Five.", "Six.", "Seven.", "Eight.") + ArticleSamples.Second;
        var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("﻿" + text);
        var records = ArticleText.Records(bytes);

        Assert.Equal(2, records.Count);
        Assert.Equal("Alpha", ArticleText.Parse(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes[records[0]]))!.Title);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TreatsAFileWithoutRulesAsOneRecord()
    {
        Assert.Single(ArticleText.Records("Just some text.\n"u8));
        Assert.Empty(ArticleText.Records(" \r\n\t\n"u8));
        Assert.Empty(ArticleText.Records([]));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("0123456789ab", true)]
    [InlineData("0123456789AB", false)]
    [InlineData("0123456789a", false)]
    [InlineData("0123456789abc", false)]
    [InlineData("../../secret", false)]
    [InlineData(null, false)]
    public void ValidatesIds(string? id, bool valid) => Assert.Equal(valid, ArticleText.IsId(id));

    [Fact]
    public void MakesShortStableIds()
    {
        var id = ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.FirstUrl);
        Assert.Equal(ArticleText.IdLength, id.Length);
        Assert.True(ArticleText.IsId(id));
        Assert.Equal(id, ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.FirstUrl));
        Assert.NotEqual(id, ArticleText.IdOf(ArticleSamples.SecondUrl));
    }
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Tests.Chaos;

public sealed class BoardServiceTests
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Start = new(2026, 10, 12, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);
    private readonly ManualTimeProvider _time = new(Start);

    [Fact]
    public void PostStampsMessagesWithTheServerClock()
    {
        var board = Create();
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Accepted, board.Post("  hello  ", "a"));
        var message = Assert.Single(board.Messages);
        Assert.Equal("hello", message.Text);
        Assert.Equal(Start, Uuid7.Timestamp(message.Id));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PostRejectsBlankText()
    {
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Empty, Create().Post(" \n ", "a"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PostIsRateLimitedPerClient()
    {
        var board = Create(o =>
        {
            o.PostBurst = 2;
            o.PostsPerSecond = 0.5;
        });
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Accepted, board.Post("one", "a"));
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Accepted, board.Post("two", "a"));
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.TooFast, board.Post("three", "a"));
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Accepted, board.Post("four", "b"));
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Accepted, board.Post("five", "a"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PostRejectsRecentRepeats()
    {
        var board = Create();
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Accepted, board.Post("same", "a"));
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Repeat, board.Post("same", "b"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KeepsOnlyTheNewestMessages()
    {
        var board = Create(o => o.BoardCapacity = 3);
        for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++)
        {
            _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
            Assert.Equal(PostResult.Accepted, board.Post($"m{i}", $"c{i}"));
        }

        Assert.Equal(["m4", "m3", "m2"], board.Messages.Select(m => m.Text));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SubscribersGetASnapshotThenDeltas()
    {
        var board = Create(o => o.BoardCapacity = 1);
        board.Post("first", "a");
        var recorder = new BoardRecorder();
        board.Subscribe(recorder);
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
        board.Post("second", "b");

        Assert.Equal(2, recorder.Updates.Count);
        var snapshot = recorder.Updates[0];
        var delta = recorder.Updates[1];
        Assert.Equal("snapshot", snapshot.Kind);
        Assert.Equal("first", Assert.Single(snapshot.Added).Text);
        Assert.Equal("delta", delta.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(snapshot.Version, delta.Previous);
        Assert.Equal(snapshot.Version + 1, delta.Version);
        Assert.Equal("second", Assert.Single(delta.Added).Text);
        Assert.Equal(snapshot.Added[0].Id, Assert.Single(delta.Removed));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SubscribersThatCannotKeepUpAreDropped()
    {
        var board = Create();
        var recorder = new BoardRecorder(accept: false);
        board.Subscribe(recorder);
        Assert.False(board.IsSubscribed(recorder));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OfferAcceptsOlderMessagesWhenThereIsRoom()
    {
        var board = Create();
        Assert.Equal(2, board.Offer([Old(-2, "older"), Old(-1, "newer")]));
        Assert.Equal(["newer", "older"], board.Messages.Select(m => m.Text));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OfferRejectsMessagesFromTheFuture()
    {
        var board = Create();
        Assert.Equal(0, board.Offer([new BoardMessage(Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(1)), "future")]));
        Assert.Empty(board.Messages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OfferRejectsMessagesThisServerShouldAlreadyHave()
    {
        var board = Create();
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromHours(1));
        Assert.Equal(0, board.Offer([new BoardMessage(Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(5)), "forged")]));
        Assert.Equal(0, board.Offer([new BoardMessage(Guid.CreateVersion7(Start), "at start")]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OfferRejectsInvalidIdsAndText()
    {
        var board = Create();
        Assert.Equal(0, board.Offer(
        [
            new BoardMessage(Guid.NewGuid(), "v4"),
            Old(-1, " padded"),
            Old(-2, ""),
            Old(-3, new string('x', MessageText.MaxLength + 1)),
        ]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OfferDoesNothingWhenTheServerIsFullOfNewerMessages()
    {
        var board = Create(o => o.BoardCapacity = 2);
        board.Post("a", "a");
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
        board.Post("b", "b");
        var recorder = new BoardRecorder();
        board.Subscribe(recorder);
        Assert.Equal(0, board.Offer([Old(-1, "old")]));
        Assert.Single(recorder.Updates);
        Assert.Equal(["b", "a"], board.Messages.Select(m => m.Text));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OfferKeepsTheServerCopyOnTies()
    {
        var board = Create();
        var id = Old(-1, "x").Id;
        Assert.Equal(1, board.Offer([new BoardMessage(id, "kept")]));
        Assert.Equal(0, board.Offer([new BoardMessage(id, "ignored")]));
        Assert.Equal("kept", Assert.Single(board.Messages).Text);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OfferConsidersAtMostFiftyMessages()
    {
        var board = Create(o => o.BoardCapacity = 100);
        var offered = Enumerable.Range(1, 60).Select(i => Old(-i, $"m{i}")).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(BoardService.MaxOffers, board.Offer(offered));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SubmitReturnsTheMessageWithNormalizedDetails()
    {
        var board = Create();
        var reply = board.Submit("located", "a", [new("timeZone", " UTC "), new("longitude", "2"), new("latitude", "1"), new("mystery", "x")]);
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Accepted, reply.Result);
        var message = Assert.Single(board.Messages);
        Assert.Same(message, reply.Message);
        Assert.Equal(
            [new MetaEntry("latitude", "1"), new MetaEntry("longitude", "2"), new MetaEntry("timeZone", "UTC")],
            message.Meta);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SubmitDropsDetailsWithoutALocation()
    {
        var board = Create();
        Assert.Null(board.Submit("no location", "a", [new("timeZone", "UTC")]).Message!.Meta);
        Assert.Null(board.Submit("no details", "b", null).Message!.Meta);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SubmitReturnsNoMessageWhenRefused()
    {
        var board = Create();
        Assert.Null(board.Submit(" ", "a", null).Message);
        board.Submit("same", "a", null);
        var repeat = board.Submit("same", "b", [new("latitude", "1"), new("longitude", "2")]);
        Assert.Equal(PostResult.Repeat, repeat.Result);
        Assert.Null(repeat.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DetailsReachSubscribers()
    {
        var board = Create();
        var recorder = new BoardRecorder();
        board.Subscribe(recorder);
        board.Submit("shared", "a", [new("latitude", "1"), new("longitude", "2")]);
        Assert.Equal("1", Assert.Single(recorder.Updates[1].Added).Meta![0].Value);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OfferKeepsNormalizedDetailsAndRejectsOthers()
    {
        var board = Create();
        MetaEntry[] good = [new("latitude", "1"), new("longitude", "2")];
        Assert.Equal(1, board.Offer([Old(-1, "kept") with { Meta = good }]));
        Assert.Equal(0, board.Offer(
        [
            Old(-2, "reordered") with { Meta = [new("longitude", "2"), new("latitude", "1")] },
            Old(-3, "unknown") with { Meta = [new("latitude", "1"), new("longitude", "2"), new("mystery", "x")] },
            Old(-4, "empty") with { Meta = [] },
            Old(-5, "no location") with { Meta = [new("timeZone", "UTC")] },
        ]));
        Assert.Equal(good, Assert.Single(board.Messages).Meta);
    }

    private BoardService Create(Action<ChaosOptions>? configure = null) => new(_time, Limits.Create(configure));

    private static BoardMessage Old(int minutes, string text) =>
        new(Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(minutes)), text);
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Drawing;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Chaos.Messages;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Tests.Chaos;

public sealed class CanvasPersistenceTests
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Start = new(2026, 10, 12, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);
    private readonly ManualTimeProvider _time = new(Start);

    [Fact]
    public void StrokesAndResetsGetIncreasingIds()
    {
        var canvas = Create(o => o.ResetBurst = 10);
        var session = canvas.OpenSession(new CanvasRecorder());
        canvas.Draw(session, canvas.Epoch, 1, [1, 1], true);
        var first = session.LastStroke;
        canvas.Draw(session, canvas.Epoch, 2, [1, 1], true);
        var second = session.LastStroke;
        Assert.True(Uuid7.IsValid(first));
        Assert.True(second.CompareTo(first) > 0);

        Assert.Equal(ResetResult.Accepted, canvas.Reset("a"));
        Assert.True(canvas.ResetId.CompareTo(second) > 0);
        var next = canvas.OpenSession(new CanvasRecorder());
        canvas.Draw(next, canvas.Epoch, 1, [1, 1], true);
        Assert.True(next.LastStroke.CompareTo(canvas.ResetId) > 0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ResetsAreBroadcastWithTheirId()
    {
        var canvas = Create();
        var viewer = new CanvasRecorder();
        canvas.Subscribe(viewer);
        canvas.Reset("a");
        var update = viewer.Updates[^1];
        Assert.Equal("reset", update.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(canvas.ResetId, update.Reset);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SnapshotsCarryTheRestoreContext()
    {
        var canvas = Create(o => o.CanvasMaxPoints = 5000);
        var session = canvas.OpenSession(new CanvasRecorder());
        canvas.Draw(session, canvas.Epoch, 1, Points(10), true);
        var late = new CanvasRecorder();
        canvas.Subscribe(late);
        var snapshot = Assert.Single(late.Updates);
        Assert.Null(snapshot.Reset);
        Assert.Equal(Start.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(), snapshot.Started);
        Assert.Equal(4990, snapshot.Room);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void StrokesFromBeforeTheRestartAreTakenBack()
    {
        var canvas = Create();
        var viewer = new CanvasRecorder();
        canvas.Subscribe(viewer);
        var old = Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(-5));

        Assert.Equal(1, canvas.OfferStrokes([new StrokeOffer(old, [1, 2, 3, 4])]));
        Assert.Equal(1, canvas.StrokeCount);
        Assert.Equal(2, canvas.PointCount);
        var merge = viewer.Updates[^1];
        Assert.Equal("merge", merge.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(old, Assert.Single(merge.Strokes!).Id);
        Assert.Equal(0, canvas.OfferStrokes([new StrokeOffer(old, [1, 2, 3, 4])]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void StrokesFromThisRunOrTheFutureAreRefused()
    {
        var canvas = Create();
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1));
        var recent = Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddSeconds(1));
        var future = Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddHours(1));
        Assert.Equal(0, canvas.OfferStrokes([new StrokeOffer(recent, [1, 1]), new StrokeOffer(future, [1, 1]), new StrokeOffer(Guid.NewGuid(), [1, 1])]));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(new int[0])]
    [InlineData(new[] { 1, 2, 3 })]
    [InlineData(new[] { 4096, 1 })]
    [InlineData(new[] { -1, 1 })]
    public void MalformedStrokesAreRefused(int[] points)
    {
        var canvas = Create();
        Assert.Equal(0, canvas.OfferStrokes([new StrokeOffer(Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(-1)), points)]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OffersNeverEvictAndPreferTheNewest()
    {
        var canvas = Create(o => o.CanvasMaxPoints = CanvasService.MaxStrokePoints);
        var older = Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(-2));
        var newer = Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(-1));
        var accepted = canvas.OfferStrokes([new StrokeOffer(older, Points(1500)), new StrokeOffer(newer, Points(1500))]);
        Assert.Equal(1, accepted);
        var late = new CanvasRecorder();
        canvas.Subscribe(late);
        Assert.Equal(newer, Assert.Single(late.Updates[0].Strokes!).Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ARememberedResetDropsOlderStrokes()
    {
        var canvas = Create();
        var viewer = new CanvasRecorder();
        canvas.Subscribe(viewer);
        var before = Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(-3));
        var reset = Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(-2));
        var after = Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(-1));
        canvas.OfferStrokes([new StrokeOffer(before, [1, 1]), new StrokeOffer(after, [2, 2])]);
        var epoch = canvas.Epoch;

        Assert.True(canvas.OfferReset(reset));
        Assert.Equal(reset, canvas.ResetId);
        Assert.Equal(epoch + 1, canvas.Epoch);
        var snapshot = viewer.Updates[^1];
        Assert.Equal("snapshot", snapshot.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(after, Assert.Single(snapshot.Strokes!).Id);
        Assert.Equal(0, canvas.OfferStrokes([new StrokeOffer(before, [1, 1])]));
        Assert.False(canvas.OfferReset(before));
        Assert.False(canvas.OfferReset(reset));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ResetsFromThisRunWinOverRememberedOnes()
    {
        var canvas = Create();
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        canvas.Reset("a");
        Assert.False(canvas.OfferReset(Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(-1))));
        Assert.Equal(0, canvas.OfferStrokes([new StrokeOffer(Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddMinutes(-1)), [1, 1])]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ResetsFromAfterTheRestartAreRefused()
    {
        var canvas = Create();
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1));
        Assert.False(canvas.OfferReset(Guid.CreateVersion7(Start.AddSeconds(10))));
        Assert.False(canvas.OfferReset(Guid.NewGuid()));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DrawRepliesCarryTheStrokeId()
    {
        var id = Guid.CreateVersion7(Start);
        Assert.Equal($"0 {id:D}", DrawReply.Format(DrawResult.Accepted, id));
        Assert.Equal("2", DrawReply.Format(DrawResult.TooFast, id));
        Assert.Equal("0", DrawReply.Format(DrawResult.Accepted, Guid.Empty));
    }

    private CanvasService Create(Action<ChaosOptions>? configure = null) => new(_time, Limits.Create(configure));

    private static int[] Points(int count) => [.. Enumerable.Range(0, count * 2).Select(i => i % 4096)];
}
