using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Nest;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Tests.Nest;

public sealed class NestServiceTests
{
    private const string Zillow = "https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/29747113_zpid/";
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Start = new(2026, 11, 5, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);
    private readonly ManualTimeProvider _time = new(Start);

    [Fact]
    public void StampsEntriesWithTheServerClockInOrder()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        var first = nest.Submit(Drafts.Link(Zillow), "a");
        var second = nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("hi", "zillow:29747113"), "a");
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Accepted, first.Result);
        Assert.Equal("zillow:29747113", first.Key);
        Assert.Equal(Start, Uuid7.Timestamp(first.Entry!.Id));
        Assert.True(second.Entry!.Id.CompareTo(first.Entry.Id) > 0);
        Assert.Equal([second.Entry.Id, first.Entry.Id], nest.Entries.Select(entry => entry.Id));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RejectsInvalidDrafts()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Invalid, nest.Submit(null, "a").Result);
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Invalid, nest.Submit(Drafts.Link("nothing"), "a").Result);
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Invalid, nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("orphan"), "a").Result);
        Assert.Empty(nest.Entries);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReturnsTheExistingHomeForAKnownLink()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        nest.Submit(Drafts.Link(Zillow), "a");
        var again = nest.Submit(Drafts.Link(Zillow + "?utm_source=share"), "b");
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Exists, again.Result);
        Assert.Equal("zillow:29747113", again.Key);
        Assert.Null(again.Entry);
        var joined = nest.Submit(Drafts.Link(Zillow, "redfin:5"), "b");
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Accepted, joined.Result);
        Assert.Single(nest.Listings);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KeysAnAddressFactByItsAddress()
    {
        var reply = Create().Submit(Drafts.Fact([], ("street", "1 Main Street"), ("zip", "13777")), "a");
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Accepted, reply.Result);
        Assert.Equal("address:13777-1-main-st", reply.Key);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RefusesRecentRepeats()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Accepted, nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("same", "zillow:1"), "a").Result);
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Repeat, nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("same", "zillow:1"), "b").Result);
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Accepted, nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("same", "zillow:2"), "b").Result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RateLimitsEachClient()
    {
        var nest = Create(o =>
        {
            o.PostBurst = 2;
            o.PostsPerSecond = 0.5;
        });
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Accepted, nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("one", "zillow:1"), "a").Result);
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Accepted, nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("two", "zillow:1"), "a").Result);
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.TooFast, nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("three", "zillow:1"), "a").Result);
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Accepted, nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("four", "zillow:1"), "b").Result);
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
        Assert.Equal(SubmitResult.Accepted, nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("five", "zillow:1"), "a").Result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KeepsOnlyTheNewestEntries()
    {
        var nest = Create(o => o.Capacity = 3);
        for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++)
        {
            _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
            nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment($"c{i}", "zillow:1"), $"client {i}");
        }

        Assert.Equal(["c4", "c3", "c2"], nest.Entries.Select(entry => entry.Text));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AcceptsOffersFromBeforeItStarted()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        var old = Comment(Start.AddDays(-3), "kept by a browser");
        Assert.Equal(1, nest.Offer([old]));
        Assert.Equal(0, nest.Offer([old]));
        Assert.Equal(old.Id, Assert.Single(nest.Entries).Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RejectsOffersFromTheFutureOrAfterItStarted()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        Assert.Equal(0, nest.Offer([Comment(Start.AddMinutes(5), "from the future")]));
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10));
        Assert.Equal(0, nest.Offer([Comment(Start.AddMinutes(1), "forged")]));
        Assert.Empty(nest.Entries);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RejectsOffersThatAreNotNormalized()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        var at = Start.AddDays(-1);
        Assert.Equal(0, nest.Offer([Comment(at, " padded ")]));
        Assert.Equal(0, nest.Offer([new Entry(Guid.CreateVersion7(at), EntryKinds.Comment, ["bad"], Text: "x")]));
        Assert.Equal(0, nest.Offer([new Entry(Guid.NewGuid(), EntryKinds.Comment, ["zillow:1"], Text: "x")]));
        Assert.Equal(0, nest.Offer([new Entry(Guid.CreateVersion7(at), EntryKinds.Link, ["zillow:1"], Url: "https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/2_zpid/")]));
        Assert.Empty(nest.Entries);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KeepsItsOwnEntriesWhenFullAndOffersAreOlder()
    {
        var nest = Create(o => o.Capacity = 2);
        nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("new one", "zillow:1"), "a");
        nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("new two", "zillow:1"), "b");
        Assert.Equal(0, nest.Offer([Comment(Start.AddDays(-1), "older")]));
        Assert.Equal(["new two", "new one"], nest.Entries.Select(entry => entry.Text));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SubscribersGetIdsThenDeltas()
    {
        var nest = Create(o => o.Capacity = 1);
        var first = nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("first", "zillow:1"), "a").Entry!;
        var recorder = new NestRecorder();
        nest.Subscribe(recorder);
        _time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
        var second = nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("second", "zillow:1"), "b").Entry!;

        Assert.Equal(2, recorder.Updates.Count);
        var snapshot = recorder.Updates[0];
        Assert.Equal("snapshot", snapshot.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(1, snapshot.Capacity);
        Assert.Equal([first.Id], snapshot.Ids);
        Assert.Empty(snapshot.Added);
        var delta = recorder.Updates[1];
        Assert.Equal("delta", delta.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(snapshot.Version, delta.Previous);
        Assert.Equal(second.Id, Assert.Single(delta.Added).Id);
        Assert.Equal([first.Id], delta.Removed);
        Assert.True(nest.IsSubscribed(recorder));
        nest.Unsubscribe(recorder);
        Assert.False(nest.IsSubscribed(recorder));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DropsSubscribersThatCannotKeepUp()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        var refusing = new NestRecorder(accept: false);
        nest.Subscribe(refusing);
        Assert.False(nest.IsSubscribed(refusing));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FindsEntriesById()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        var entry = nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("find me", "zillow:1"), "a").Entry!;
        Assert.Equal([entry], nest.Find([entry.Id, Guid.NewGuid()]));
        Assert.Empty(nest.Find([]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BuildsListingsOncePerChange()
    {
        var nest = Create();
        nest.Submit(Drafts.Link(Zillow), "a");
        var listings = nest.Listings;
        Assert.Same(listings, nest.Listings);
        Assert.Equal("zillow:29747113", nest.FindListing("zillow:29747113")?.Key);
        nest.Submit(Drafts.Comment("new", "zillow:29747113"), "a");
        Assert.NotSame(listings, nest.Listings);
        Assert.Single(nest.FindListing("zillow:29747113")!.Comments);
        Assert.Equal(2, nest.Version);
    }

    private static Entry Comment(DateTimeOffset at, string text) =>
        new(Guid.CreateVersion7(at), EntryKinds.Comment, ["zillow:1"], Text: text);

    private NestService Create(Action<NestOptions>? configure = null) => new(_time, Limits.Create(configure));
}

public sealed class CommentTextTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void KeepsEmojiAndCutsOnGraphemes()
    {
        Assert.Equal("👍🏽 ok", CommentText.Normalize(" 👍🏽 ok "));
        var repeated = string.Concat(Enumerable.Repeat("👍🏽", CommentText.MaxLength));
        var cut = CommentText.Normalize(repeated);
        Assert.True(cut.Length <= CommentText.MaxLength);
        Assert.Equal(0, cut.Length % 4);
        Assert.True(CommentText.IsNormalized(cut));
        Assert.False(CommentText.IsNormalized(" x"));
        Assert.Equal("", CommentText.Normalize("​"));
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Infrastructure;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Nest;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Tests.Nest;

internal sealed class ManualTimeProvider(DateTimeOffset start) : TimeProvider
{
    private DateTimeOffset _now = start;
    private long _timestamp;

    public override long TimestampFrequency => TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond;

    public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => _now;

    public override long GetTimestamp() => _timestamp;

    public void Advance(TimeSpan by)
    {
        _now += by;
        _timestamp += by.Ticks;
    }
}

internal static class Limits
{
    public static IOptions<NestOptions> Create(Action<NestOptions>? configure = null)
    {
        var options = new NestOptions();
        configure?.Invoke(options);
        return Options.Create(options);
    }
}

internal sealed class NestRecorder(bool accept = true) : INestSubscriber
{
    public List<NestUpdate> Updates { get; } = [];

    public bool Deliver(NestUpdate update)
    {
        if (accept)
        {
            Updates.Add(update);
        }

        return accept;
    }
}

internal sealed record LinkVector(string Input, string? Key, string? Url);

internal sealed record AddressVector(string Street, string Unit, string Zip, string? Key);

internal sealed record FieldVector(string Key, string Input, bool Ok, string? Value);

internal sealed record ListingVector(string Key, string[] Keys, string[] Links, Dictionary<string, string> Fields, string[] Comments, string Updated, string Title);

internal sealed record ListingScenario(EntryWire[] Entries, ListingVector[] Listings);

internal static class Fixtures
{
    public static T Load<T>(string name)
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "fixtures", name + ".json");
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(File.ReadAllText(path), Wire.Options)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"The fixture {name} is empty.");
    }

    public static ListingScenario Listings() => Load<ListingScenario>("listings");

    public static Entry[] ListingEntries() =>
        [.. Listings().Entries.Select(wire => wire.ToEntry() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Bad fixture entry."))];
}

internal static class Drafts
{
    public static EntryDraft Link(string url, params string[] anchors) => new(EntryKinds.Link, anchors, url, null, null);

    public static EntryDraft Comment(string text, params string[] anchors) => new(EntryKinds.Comment, anchors, null, null, text);

    public static EntryDraft Fact(string[] anchors, params (string Key, string Value)[] fields) =>
        new(EntryKinds.Fact, anchors, null, [.. fields.Select(field => new FieldWire(field.Key, field.Value))], null);
}

using MyBlazorPlayground.Domain.Work;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Identity;
using MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Work;

namespace MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Tests.Work;

public sealed class WorkFormTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void PlannedItemsLeaveTheBacklogStatus()
    {
        var fields = new ItemForm { Title = "Ship it", Status = WorkItemStatuses.Backlog, SprintId = Guid.NewGuid() }.ToFields();
        Assert.Equal(WorkItemStatuses.ToDo, fields.Status);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MissingFormValuesFallBackToDefaults()
    {
        var form = new ItemForm { Kind = null!, Status = "", Priority = 0, Title = "x" };
        Assert.Equal(WorkItemKinds.Story, form.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(WorkItemStatuses.Backlog, form.Status);
        Assert.Equal(Priorities.Medium, form.Priority);
        Assert.Null(form.Problem());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EpicsHaveNoParent()
    {
        var fields = new ItemForm { Title = "Big", Kind = WorkItemKinds.Epic, ParentId = Guid.NewGuid() }.ToFields();
        Assert.Null(fields.ParentId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReportsProblems()
    {
        Assert.NotNull(new ItemForm { Title = " " }.Problem());
        Assert.NotNull(new ItemForm { Title = "x", Kind = "saga" }.Problem());
        Assert.NotNull(new ItemForm { Title = "x", Points = -1 }.Problem());
        Assert.NotNull(new ItemForm { Title = "x", Priority = 9 }.Problem());
        Assert.Null(new ItemForm { Title = "x", Points = 8 }.Problem());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TrimsTitlesAndDescriptions()
    {
        var fields = new ItemForm { Title = "  two   spaces \n", Description = "line\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nnext  " }.ToFields();
        Assert.Equal("two spaces", fields.Title);
        Assert.Equal("line\n\n\nnext", fields.Description);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SprintsNeedANameAndOrderedDates()
    {
        Assert.NotNull(new SprintForm { Name = "" }.Problem());
        Assert.NotNull(new SprintForm { Name = "S1", StartsOn = new DateOnly(2026, 11, 20), EndsOn = new DateOnly(2026, 11, 19) }.Problem());
        Assert.Null(new SprintForm { Name = "S1", StartsOn = new DateOnly(2026, 11, 19), EndsOn = new DateOnly(2026, 12, 3) }.Problem());
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("/work/ABC", "/work/ABC")]
    [InlineData("/", "/")]
    [InlineData(null, "/work")]
    [InlineData("", "/work")]
    [InlineData("//evil.example", "/work")]
    [InlineData("/\\evil.example", "/work")]
    [InlineData("https://evil.example/", "/work")]
    [InlineData("work", "/work")]
    public void OnlyFollowsLocalReturnUrls(string? url, string expected)
    {
        Assert.Equal(expected, LocalUrl.Or(url, "/work"));
    }
}

FILE:     tests/js/chaos/app.test.js
SIZE:     3.30 KB (3381 bytes)
LINES:    97
SHA256:   57a4b2220e0fc14f788140b53e715ba5613c13067e6712f76ecb728c29117acd
MODIFIED: 2026-11-19 10:37:40 (UTC)
================================================================================

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
    MAX_RETRIES,
    THEME_KEY,
    better,
    clockLabel,
    reconnectDelay,
    sample,
    storedTheme,
    toggledTheme,
    uncertainty,
    untilNextSecond,
    zoneLabel,
} from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/Components/App.razor.js';

describe('reconnectDelay', () => {
    it('retries the first attempt at once', () => {
        expect(reconnectDelay(0)).toBe(0);
    });

    it('doubles the ceiling and jitters inside its upper half', () => {
        expect(reconnectDelay(1, () => 0)).toBe(500);
        expect(reconnectDelay(1, () => 1)).toBe(1000);
        expect(reconnectDelay(3, () => 0.5)).toBe(3000);
    });

    it('caps the wait at thirty seconds', () => {
        expect(reconnectDelay(20, () => 1)).toBe(30000);
        expect(reconnectDelay(20, () => 0)).toBe(15000);
    });

    it('keeps trying for more than five minutes', () => {
        let total = 0;
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_RETRIES; attempt += 1) {
            total += reconnectDelay(attempt, () => 0);
        }
        expect(total).toBeGreaterThan(5 * 60 * 1000);
    });
});

describe('theme', () => {
    const storage = value => ({ getItem: key => (key === THEME_KEY ? value : null) });

    it('reads only known themes', () => {
        expect(storedTheme(storage('dark'))).toBe('dark');
        expect(storedTheme(storage('light'))).toBe('light');
        expect(storedTheme(storage('purple'))).toBeNull();
        expect(storedTheme(undefined)).toBeNull();
    });

    it('survives storage that throws', () => {
        expect(storedTheme({ getItem() { throw new Error('denied'); } })).toBeNull();
    });

    it('flips the system preference when nothing is stored', () => {
        expect(toggledTheme(null, true)).toBe('light');
        expect(toggledTheme(null, false)).toBe('dark');
    });

    it('flips a stored choice regardless of the system', () => {
        expect(toggledTheme('dark', false)).toBe('light');
        expect(toggledTheme('light', true)).toBe('dark');
    });
});

describe('server clock', () => {
    it('labels the server time in the server zone', () => {
        const at = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 16, 8, 10, 39, 500);
        expect(clockLabel(at, 0)).toBe('2026-10-16 08:10:39 UTC');
        expect(clockLabel(at, 330)).toBe('2026-10-16 13:40:39 UTC+05:30');
        expect(clockLabel(at, -240)).toBe('2026-10-16 04:10:39 UTC-04:00');
    });

    it('formats zones', () => {
        expect(zoneLabel(0)).toBe('UTC');
        expect(zoneLabel(60)).toBe('UTC+01:00');
        expect(zoneLabel(-570)).toBe('UTC-09:30');
    });

    it('takes the middle of the round trip', () => {
        expect(sample(10_000, 100, 300)).toEqual({ offset: 9800, error: 100, at: 300, zone: 0 });
    });

    it('prefers tighter samples but lets old ones age out', () => {
        const old = { offset: 0, error: 10, at: 0, zone: 0 };
        expect(better({ error: 50 }, old, 1000)).toBe(false);
        expect(better({ error: 50 }, old, 1_000_000)).toBe(true);
        expect(better({ error: 50 }, null, 0)).toBe(true);
        expect(uncertainty(null, 0)).toBe(Infinity);
    });

    it('wakes just after the next second', () => {
        expect(untilNextSecond(1000)).toBe(1005);
        expect(untilNextSecond(1999)).toBe(6);
        expect(untilNextSecond(1500.7)).toBe(505);
    });
});

describe('chunkOffers', () => {
    const message = (index, text = 'hi') => ({ id: `0199a000-0000-7000-8000-${String(index).padStart(12, '0')}`, text });

    it('keeps small offers in one chunk and stops at the limit', () => {
        const messages = Array.from({ length: 80 }, (_, index) => message(index));
        const chunks = chunkOffers(messages);
        expect(chunks).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(chunks[0]).toHaveLength(OFFER_LIMIT);
    });

    it('splits by size without reordering', () => {
        const messages = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => message(index, 'x'.repeat(400)));
        const chunks = chunkOffers(messages, 1000);
        expect(chunks.every(chunk => chunk.length === 2)).toBe(true);
        expect(chunks.flat()).toEqual(messages);
    });

    it('skips a message that can never fit', () => {
        expect(chunkOffers([message(1, 'x'.repeat(2000)), message(2)], 1000)).toEqual([[message(2)]]);
    });

    it('counts details toward the size', () => {
        const meta = [{ key: 'userAgent', value: 'x'.repeat(300) }];
        const messages = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, index) => ({ ...message(index, 'x'.repeat(100)), meta }));
        expect(chunkOffers(messages, 1000).every(chunk => chunk.length === 2)).toBe(true);
        expect(chunkOffers(messages.map(({ meta: _, ...rest }) => rest), 1000)).toHaveLength(1);
    });

describe('sharing choice', () => {
    const storage = () => {
        const values = new Map();
        return { getItem: key => values.get(key) ?? null, setItem: (key, value) => values.set(key, value) };
    };

    it('follows the permission unless turned off', () => {
        expect(shareDefault(null, 'granted')).toBe(true);
        expect(shareDefault('on', 'granted')).toBe(true);
        expect(shareDefault('off', 'granted')).toBe(false);
        expect(shareDefault('on', 'denied')).toBe(false);
        expect(shareDefault('on', 'prompt')).toBe(false);
        expect(shareDefault(null, 'prompt')).toBe(false);
        expect(shareDefault('on', null)).toBe(true);
        expect(shareDefault(null, null)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('remembers only on and off', () => {
        const store = storage();
        expect(readShare(store)).toBeNull();
        writeShare(store, 'on');
        expect(store.getItem(SHARE_KEY)).toBe('on');
        expect(readShare(store)).toBe('on');
        store.setItem(SHARE_KEY, 'maybe');
        expect(readShare(store)).toBeNull();
    });

    it('survives storage that throws', () => {
        const broken = { getItem: () => { throw new Error('denied'); }, setItem: () => { throw new Error('denied'); } };
        expect(readShare(broken)).toBeNull();
        expect(() => writeShare(broken, 'on')).not.toThrow();
        expect(readShare(undefined)).toBeNull();
    });
});

describe('persistence', () => {
    const id = (ms, tail = 1) => {
        const hex = ms.toString(16).padStart(12, '0');
        return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8)}-7000-8000-${String(tail).padStart(12, '0')}`;
    };

    it('reads draw replies', () => {
        expect(parseDrawReply('0 0199e1aa-bbbb-7ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee')).toEqual({ result: Result.Accepted, stroke: '0199e1aa-bbbb-7ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee' });
        expect(parseDrawReply('2')).toEqual({ result: Result.TooFast, stroke: null });
        expect(parseDrawReply('0 not-an-id')).toEqual({ result: Result.Accepted, stroke: null });
        expect(parseDrawReply(7)).toEqual({ result: Result.Invalid, stroke: null });
    });

    it('builds a key bound that sorts before every id from that millisecond', () => {
        const at = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 16);
        expect(id(at - 1) < timeKey(at)).toBe(true);
        expect(id(at) > timeKey(at)).toBe(true);
        expect(isUuid7(id(at))).toBe(true);
    });

    it('picks the later reset', () => {
        expect(later(null, null)).toBeNull();
        expect(later(id(5), null)).toBe(id(5));
        expect(later(id(5), id(9))).toBe(id(9));
    });

    it('offers a remembered reset only when it is newer and from before the restart', () => {
        expect(shouldOfferReset(id(5), null, 10)).toBe(true);
        expect(shouldOfferReset(id(5), id(4), 10)).toBe(true);
        expect(shouldOfferReset(id(5), id(6), 10)).toBe(false);
        expect(shouldOfferReset(id(12), null, 10)).toBe(false);
        expect(shouldOfferReset(null, null, 10)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('picks strokes after the reset, before the restart, within the room left', () => {
        const strokes = [
            { id: id(30), points: [1, 1] },
            { id: id(9), points: [1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3] },
            { id: id(8), points: [1, 1] },
            { id: id(7), points: [1, 1] },
            { id: id(3), points: [1, 1] },
        ];
        const picked = pickOffers(strokes, new Set([id(7)]), id(5), 20, 2);
        expect(picked.map(stroke => stroke.id)).toEqual([id(8)]);
        expect(pickOffers(strokes, new Set(), null, 20, 100, 2).map(stroke => stroke.id)).toEqual([id(9), id(8)]);
    });

    it('chunks offers under the message limit', () => {
        const stroke = { id: id(1), points: Array(1000).fill(4095) };
        const chunks = chunkStrokes([stroke, stroke, stroke, stroke, stroke, stroke], 12000);
        expect(chunks.length).toBe(3);
        expect(chunks.every(chunk => chunk.length === 2)).toBe(true);
        expect(chunkStrokes([{ id: id(1), points: Array(5000).fill(1) }], 1000)).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('keeps local history bounded', () => {
        expect(LOCAL_CAP).toBe(10000);
        expect(OFFER_LIMIT).toBe(500);
    });
});

    it('reads every reply', () => {
        expect(parseStartReply('ok 0199e1aa-bbbb-7ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee 300')).toEqual({ kind: 'ok', id: '0199e1aa-bbbb-7ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee', seconds: 300 });
        expect(parseStartReply('busy')).toEqual({ kind: 'busy' });
        expect(parseStartReply('wait 42')).toEqual({ kind: 'wait', seconds: 42 });
        expect(parseStartReply('wait x')).toEqual({ kind: 'error' });
        expect(parseStartReply('ok nope 300')).toEqual({ kind: 'error' });
        expect(parseStartReply(null)).toEqual({ kind: 'error' });
    });
});

describe('text helpers', () => {
    it('counts down in minutes and seconds', () => {
        expect(clockText(0)).toBe('0:00');
        expect(clockText(299_001)).toBe('5:00');
        expect(clockText(61_000)).toBe('1:01');
    });

    it('counts towards auto run', () => {
        expect(progressText(0)).toBe(`${AUTO_UNLOCK} more tests unlock auto run.`);
        expect(progressText(AUTO_UNLOCK - 1)).toBe('1 more test unlocks auto run.');
        expect(progressText(12)).toBe('12 tests from this browser.');
    });

    it('reads stored numbers defensively', () => {
        expect(readNumber({ getItem: () => '7' }, 'k')).toBe(7);
        expect(readNumber({ getItem: () => 'x' }, 'k')).toBe(0);
        expect(readNumber({ getItem() { throw new Error('denied'); } }, 'k')).toBe(0);
    });
});

describe('requests', () => {
    it('sends opaque requests without credentials to other sites', () => {
        expect(fetchOptions('https://example.com/', null)).toMatchObject({ mode: 'no-cors', cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'omit', referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer' });
        expect(fetchOptions('/time', null).mode).toBeUndefined();
        expect(cacheBusted('/time', 3)).toBe('/time?n=3');
        expect(cacheBusted('https://example.com/a?b=1', 3)).toBe('https://example.com/a?b=1');
    });

    const fake = (durations, failAfter = Infinity) => {
        let clock = 0;
        let calls = 0;
        return {
            calls: () => calls,
            deps: {
                now: () => clock,
                setTimeout: () => 0,
                clearTimeout: () => {},
                AbortController,
                fetch: async () => {
                    calls += 1;
                    if (calls > failAfter) {
                        throw new Error('down');
                    }
                    clock += durations[(calls - 1) % durations.length];
                    return {};
                },
            },
        };
    };

    it('warms up and keeps the fastest of three', async () => {
        const probe = fake([100, 30, 20, 25]);
        expect(await measure('https://example.com/', probe.deps)).toBe(20);
        expect(probe.calls()).toBe(4);
    });

    it('gives up when the warm up fails', async () => {
        const probe = fake([5], 0);
        expect(await measure('https://example.com/', probe.deps)).toBeNull();
        expect(probe.calls()).toBe(1);
    });

    it('keeps what it has when a later sample fails', async () => {
        const probe = fake([50, 9], 2);
        expect(await measure('https://example.com/', probe.deps)).toBe(9);
    });

    it('measures every endpoint and reports each one', async () => {
        const probe = fake([4]);
        const seen = [];
        const results = await measureAll(['a', 'b', 'c'], probe.deps, 1000, (index, value) => seen.push([index, value]), 1);
        expect(results).toEqual([4, 4, 4]);
        expect(seen.map(entry => entry[0]).sort()).toEqual([0, 1, 2]);
    });
});

describe('records', () => {

    it('keep only known fields and mark mine', () => {
        expect(toRecord(card, false)).toEqual({ id: ID, text: 'hi', images: [{ type: 'image/png', width: 4, height: 3, length: 99 }] });
        expect(toRecord({ ...card, meta: [{ key: 'latitude', value: '1' }] }, true)).toMatchObject({ mine: true, meta: [{ key: 'latitude', value: '1' }] });
        expect(toRecord({ id: ID }, false)).toEqual({ id: ID, text: '', images: [] });
    });

    it('never forget that a postcard was mine', () => {
        const record = toRecord(card, false);
        expect(merge({ ...record, mine: true }, record).mine).toBe(true);
        expect(merge(null, record)).not.toHaveProperty('mine');

describe('remember', () => {

    it('starts a new record', () => {
        expect(remember(undefined, entry, 1000)).toEqual({ ...entry, first: 1000, last: 1000, reads: 1 });
    });

    it('keeps the first read and counts again', () => {
        expect(remember({ ...entry, first: 10, last: 20, reads: 2 }, { ...entry, title: 'New title' }, 30))
            .toEqual({ ...entry, title: 'New title', first: 10, last: 30, reads: 3 });
    });

    it('repairs damaged records', () => {

    });

describe('odds', () => {
    it('counts every kind the same way an exhaustive search does', () => {
        const symbols = '89ABCD';
        const counts = { none: 0, three: 0, four: 0, five: 0, up: 0, down: 0, sequenceUp: 0, sequenceDown: 0 };
        const total = symbols.length ** 5;
        for (let index = 0; index < total; index += 1) {
            let text = '';
            for (let rest = index, reel = 0; reel < 5; reel += 1, rest = Math.floor(rest / symbols.length)) {
                text += symbols[rest % symbols.length];
            }
            counts[classify(text)] += 1;
        }
        for (const kind of Object.keys(LABELS)) {
            expect(counts[kind]).toBe(waysOf(kind, symbols.length));
        }
    });

    it('knows the real totals', () => {

        expect(FULL_HOUSE).toBe(12_600);
        expect(ALL_DIFFERENT).toBe(45_239_040);

    it('separates the median wait from the average', () => {

        expect(headsInARow(1 / 8192)).toBe(13);

    });

        expect(isFullHouse('77QQ7')).toBe(true);

    });

        ['kkkkk', false],
        [null, false],
    ])('knows whether %s is a jackpot', (text, expected) => {
        expect(isJackpot(text)).toBe(expected);
    });

    it('shouts about jackpots in the verdict', () => {
        expect(verdictText('KKKKK')).toBe('Jackpot! Five of a kind');
        expect(verdictText('XXXXB')).toBe('Jackpot! Four of a kind');
        expect(verdictText('ABCDE')).toBe('Jackpot! Sequence up');
        expect(verdictText('43210')).toBe('Jackpot! Sequence down');
        expect(verdictText('13AKZ')).toBe('Straight up');
        expect(verdictText('7Q7A7')).toBe('Three of a kind');
        expect(verdictText('ZK8A0')).toBe('');
    });

    it('keeps jackpots in their own store added by the second schema version', () => {
        expect(DB_VERSION).toBe(2);
        expect(migrations).toHaveLength(2);
        const created = [];
        upgrade({ createObjectStore: (name, options) => created.push([name, options]) }, 1, DB_VERSION, migrations);
        expect(created).toEqual([[JACKPOTS, { keyPath: 'id' }]]);
        expect(JACKPOTS).not.toBe(STORE);
    });

    it('offers every jackpot newest first', () => {
        const records = [
            { id: '0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001', text: 'XXXXB' },
            { id: '0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002', text: 'AAAB1' },
            { id: '0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000003', text: 'KKKKK' },
            { id: '0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000004', text: 'kkkkk' },
            { id: '0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000005', text: '13AKZ' },
            { id: '0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000006', text: '43210' },
        ];
        expect(newestJackpots(records).map(record => record.text)).toEqual(['43210', 'KKKKK', 'XXXXB']);
        expect(newestJackpots(records, 1)).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(JACKPOT_OFFERS).toBe(500);
        expect(WINNER_OFFERS).toBe(500);
    });

    it('celebrates for a few seconds', () => {
        expect(CELEBRATE_MS).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3000);
        expect(CELEBRATE_MS).toBeLessThanOrEqual(15000);
    });

    it('reads and writes whole stores', async () => {
        const rows = new Map();
        const db = {
            transaction(store, mode) {
                const transaction = {
                    objectStore(name) {
                        expect(name).toBe(store);
                        return {
                            put(record) {
                                expect(mode).toBe('readwrite');
                                rows.set(record.id, record);
                            },
                            getAll() {
                                const request = {};
                                queueMicrotask(() => {
                                    request.result = [...rows.values()];
                                    request.onsuccess();
                                });
                                return request;
                            },
                        };
                    },
                };
                queueMicrotask(() => transaction.oncomplete?.());
                return transaction;
            },
        };
        await putAll(db, JACKPOTS, []);
        expect(rows.size).toBe(0);
        await putAll(db, JACKPOTS, [{ id: 'a', text: 'KKKKK' }, { id: 'b', text: 'XXXXB' }]);
        expect((await readAll(db, JACKPOTS)).map(record => record.text)).toEqual(['KKKKK', 'XXXXB']);
    });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { NOTICE_MS, REPEAT_MS, StatusLine } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/Components/Islands/BoardIsland.razor.js';

function clock() {
    let now = 0;
    let next = 1;
    const pending = new Map();
    return {
        setTimeout(callback, ms) {
            const id = next++;
            pending.set(id, { at: now + ms, callback });
            return id;
        },
        clearTimeout(id) {
            pending.delete(id);
        },
        advance(ms) {
            now += ms;
            for (const [id, timer] of [...pending].sort((a, b) => a[1].at - b[1].at)) {
                if (timer.at <= now && pending.has(id)) {
                    pending.delete(id);
                    timer.callback();
                }
            }
        },
        get size() {
            return pending.size;
        },
    };
}

function line(ms) {
    const element = { textContent: '' };
    const timers = clock();
    return { element, timers, status: new StatusLine(element, timers, ms) };
}

describe('StatusLine', () => {
    it('clears unowned notices after a while', () => {
        const { element, timers, status } = line();
        status.show('Slow down a little.');
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('Slow down a little.');
        timers.advance(NOTICE_MS - 1);
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('Slow down a little.');
        timers.advance(1);
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('');
        expect(status.owner).toBeNull();
    });

    it('keeps an owned notice until its owner is released', () => {
        const { element, timers, status } = line();
        status.show('This spin is yours.', 'a');
        timers.advance(NOTICE_MS * 10);
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('This spin is yours.');
        status.release('b');
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('This spin is yours.');
        status.release('a');
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('');
    });

    it('lets an owned notice expire when asked to', () => {
        const { element, timers, status } = line();
        status.show('This spin is yours.', 'a', 500);
        timers.advance(500);
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('');
    });

    it('clears an owned notice when something else takes over', () => {
        const { element, status } = line();
        status.show('This spin is yours.', 'a');
        status.supersede('a');
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('This spin is yours.');
        status.supersede('b');
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('');
        status.show('Done.', 'c');
        status.supersede(null);
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('');
    });

    it('leaves unowned notices to their timer', () => {
        const { element, status } = line();
        status.show('Auto spin is off.');
        status.supersede('b');
        status.release(null);
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('Auto spin is off.');
    });

    it('rewrites a repeated notice so screen readers hear it again', () => {
        const { element, timers, status } = line();
        status.show('Slow down a little.');
        status.show('Slow down a little.');
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('');
        timers.advance(REPEAT_MS);
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('Slow down a little.');
    });

    it('cancels timers on clear and dispose', () => {
        const { element, timers, status } = line();
        status.show('Could not reach the server.');
        status.clear();
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('');
        expect(timers.size).toBe(0);
        status.show('Could not reach the server.');
        status.dispose();
        expect(timers.size).toBe(0);
    });

    it('treats empty text as a clear', () => {
        const { element, timers, status } = line();
        status.show('This spin is yours.', 'a');
        status.show('');
        expect(element.textContent).toBe('');
        expect(status.owner).toBeNull();
        expect(timers.size).toBe(0);
    });

    it('works without an element', () => {
        const status = new StatusLine(null, clock());
        expect(() => {
            status.show('Hello', 'a');
            status.release('a');
            status.dispose();
        }).not.toThrow();
    });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { MAX_RETRIES, THEME_KEY, ViewHost, reconnectDelay, storedTheme, toggledTheme, viewId } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/Components/App.razor.js';

describe('reconnectDelay', () => {
    it('retries at once, then backs off with jitter up to thirty seconds', () => {
        expect(reconnectDelay(0)).toBe(0);
        expect(reconnectDelay(1, () => 0)).toBe(500);
        expect(reconnectDelay(1, () => 1)).toBe(1000);
        expect(reconnectDelay(20, () => 1)).toBe(30000);
        expect(reconnectDelay(20, () => 0)).toBe(15000);
    });

    it('keeps trying for more than five minutes', () => {
        let total = 0;
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_RETRIES; attempt += 1) {
            total += reconnectDelay(attempt, () => 0);
        }
        expect(total).toBeGreaterThan(5 * 60 * 1000);
    });
});

describe('theme', () => {
    it('reads only known values', () => {
        expect(storedTheme({ getItem: key => (key === THEME_KEY ? 'dark' : null) })).toBe('dark');
        expect(storedTheme({ getItem: () => 'blue' })).toBeNull();
        expect(storedTheme({ getItem: () => { throw new Error('denied'); } })).toBeNull();
        expect(storedTheme(null)).toBeNull();
    });

    it('toggles from the effective theme', () => {
        expect(toggledTheme(null, true)).toBe('light');
        expect(toggledTheme(null, false)).toBe('dark');
        expect(toggledTheme('dark', false)).toBe('light');
    });
});

describe('ViewHost', () => {
    function host(root) {
        const mounted = [];
        const disposed = [];
        const win = { document: { querySelector: () => root.current } };
        const views = new ViewHost(
            win,
            async path => ({ mount: element => {
                mounted.push([path, element.dataset.key]);
                return { dispose: () => disposed.push(element.dataset.key) };
            } }),
            async () => ({ nest: () => ({}) }));
        return { views, mounted, disposed };
    }

    it('mounts the view for the page and replaces it on navigation', async () => {
        const root = { current: { dataset: { view: 'homes' } } };
        const { views, mounted, disposed } = host(root);
        await views.mount();
        await views.mount();
        expect(mounted).toEqual([['./Pages/HomesPage.razor.js', undefined]]);
        root.current = { dataset: { view: 'listing', key: 'zillow:1' } };
        await views.mount();
        expect(mounted.at(-1)).toEqual(['./Pages/ListingPage.razor.js', 'zillow:1']);
        expect(disposed).toEqual([undefined]);
        root.current = null;
        await views.mount();
        expect(disposed).toEqual([undefined, 'zillow:1']);
    });

    it('names views by kind and key', () => {
        expect(viewId(null)).toBeNull();
        expect(viewId({ dataset: { view: 'listing', key: 'zillow:1' } })).toBe('listing|zillow:1');
    });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { buildListings, findListing, matches, newestFirst, oldestFirst, timestampOf } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/wwwroot/js/merge.js';
import { fixture } from './fixtures.js';

const scenario = fixture('listings');

function shape(listing) {
    return {
        key: listing.key,
        keys: listing.keys,
        links: listing.links.map(link => link.url),
        fields: listing.fields,
        comments: listing.comments.map(comment => comment.id),
        updated: listing.updated,
        title: listing.title,
    };
}

describe('buildListings', () => {
    it('merges entries that share any key', () => {
        expect(buildListings(scenario.entries).map(shape)).toEqual(scenario.listings);
    });

    it('does not depend on entry order', () => {
        const reversed = [...scenario.entries].reverse();
        expect(buildListings(reversed).map(shape)).toEqual(scenario.listings);
        const shuffled = [...scenario.entries].sort((a, b) => (a.text ?? a.kind).localeCompare(b.text ?? b.kind));
        expect(buildListings(shuffled).map(shape)).toEqual(scenario.listings);
    });

    it('keeps field history and ownership', () => {
        const entries = scenario.entries.map(entry => (entry.kind === 'comment' ? { ...entry, mine: true } : entry));
        const [home] = buildListings(entries);
        expect(home.history.beds.map(item => item.value)).toEqual(['3', '4']);
        expect(home.mine).toBe(true);
        expect(home.ids).toHaveLength(8);
    });

    it('skips entries without keys', () => {
        expect(buildListings([null, { id: 'x', keys: [] }])).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('finds and filters listings', () => {
        const listings = buildListings(scenario.entries);
        expect(findListing(listings, 'address:13777-2893-state-rte-26').key).toBe('zillow:29747113');
        expect(findListing(listings, 'zillow:1')).toBeNull();
        expect(matches(listings[0], '')).toBe(true);
        expect(matches(listings[0], '2893 route')).toBe(true);
        expect(matches(listings[0], '13777')).toBe(true);
        expect(matches(listings[0], 'redfin.com')).toBe(true);
        expect(matches(listings[0], 'miami')).toBe(false);
    });
});

describe('ids', () => {
    it('sorts and reads timestamps', () => {
        const ids = [{ id: '0195aaaa-0000-7000-8000-000000000000' }, { id: '0195bbbb-0000-7000-8000-000000000000' }];
        expect([...ids].sort(newestFirst)[0].id).toBe('0195bbbb-0000-7000-8000-000000000000');
        expect([...ids].sort(oldestFirst)[0].id).toBe('0195aaaa-0000-7000-8000-000000000000');
        expect(timestampOf('016f5e66-e800-7000-8000-000000000001')).toBe(Date.UTC(2020, 0, 1));
    });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { DRAFT_PREFIX, EntryStore, LOCAL_CAP, deleteDatabase, draftKeys, excessOf, migrations, readDraft, upgrade, writeDraft } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/wwwroot/js/store.js';

class MemoryStorage {
    constructor() {
        this.map = new Map();
    }

    get length() {
        return this.map.size;
    }

    key(index) {
        return [...this.map.keys()][index] ?? null;
    }

    getItem(key) {
        return this.map.get(key) ?? null;
    }

    setItem(key, value) {
        this.map.set(key, String(value));
    }

    removeItem(key) {
        this.map.delete(key);
    }
}

describe('store', () => {
    it('caps local history', () => {
        expect(excessOf(LOCAL_CAP)).toBe(0);
        expect(excessOf(LOCAL_CAP + 5)).toBe(5);
    });

    it('runs every migration from the stored version', () => {
        const created = [];
        const db = { createObjectStore: (name, options) => created.push([name, options]) };
        upgrade(db, 0, migrations.length);
        expect(created).toEqual([['entries', { keyPath: 'id' }]]);
        created.length = 0;
        upgrade(db, 1, 1);
        expect(created).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('keeps comment drafts per home', () => {
        const storage = new MemoryStorage();
        writeDraft(storage, 'zillow:1', 'hello');
        storage.setItem('nest-theme', 'dark');
        expect(readDraft(storage, 'zillow:1')).toBe('hello');
        expect(draftKeys(storage)).toEqual([`${DRAFT_PREFIX}zillow:1`]);
        writeDraft(storage, 'zillow:1', '');
        expect(readDraft(storage, 'zillow:1')).toBe('');
        expect(readDraft(null, 'x')).toBe('');
    });

    it('works without IndexedDB', async () => {
        const store = new EntryStore(undefined);
        expect(await store.all()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await store.save([{ id: 'a' }])).toEqual([]);
        expect(await deleteDatabase(undefined)).toBe('deleted');
    });
});

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { Nest, chunk, chunkBySize, missingIds, needsResync, offerCandidates, wire } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/wwwroot/js/sync.js';

const id = n => `0195${n.toString(16).padStart(4, '0')}-0000-7000-8000-${n.toString(16).padStart(12, '0')}`;
const comment = (n, text = 'hi') => ({ id: id(n), kind: 'comment', keys: ['zillow:1'], text });

class MemoryStore {
    constructor(records = []) {
        this.records = new Map(records.map(record => [record.id, record]));
    }

    async all() {
        return [...this.records.values()];
    }

    async save(records) {
        for (const record of records) {
            this.records.set(record.id, record);
        }
        return [];
    }
}

function fakeWindow() {
    return {
        setTimeout: () => 1,
        clearTimeout: () => {},
        setInterval: () => 1,
        clearInterval: () => {},
        addEventListener: () => {},
    };
}

function fakeServer(entries, capacity = 1000) {
    const calls = [];
    const known = new Map(entries.map(entry => [entry.id, entry]));
    return {
        calls,
        known,
        invokeMethodAsync: vi.fn(async (method, ...args) => {
            calls.push([method, ...args]);
            if (method === 'Fetch') {
                return args[0].map(value => known.get(value)).filter(Boolean);
            }
            if (method === 'Offer') {
                return args[0].length;
            }
            if (method === 'Post') {
                const entry = comment(900, args[0].text);
                return { result: 'accepted', entry, key: 'zillow:1' };
            }
            if (method === 'Ping') {
                return true;
            }
            return undefined;
        }),
        capacity,
    };
}

describe('helpers', () => {
    it('detects version gaps', () => {
        expect(needsResync(3, { previous: 3 })).toBe(false);
        expect(needsResync(3, { previous: 2 })).toBe(true);
    });

    it('wires entries without local fields', () => {
        expect(wire({ ...comment(1), mine: true })).toEqual(comment(1));
        expect(wire({ id: id(1), kind: 'link', keys: ['zillow:1'], url: 'u' })).toEqual({ id: id(1), kind: 'link', keys: ['zillow:1'], url: 'u' });
        expect(wire({ id: id(1), kind: 'fact', keys: ['zillow:1'], fields: [] })).toEqual({ id: id(1), kind: 'fact', keys: ['zillow:1'], fields: [] });
    });

    it('finds missing ids', () => {
        expect(missingIds(['a', 'b'], new Map([['a', {}]]))).toEqual(['b']);
    });

    it('offers only what the server lacks, newest first, within its capacity', () => {
        const local = [comment(1), comment(2), comment(3), comment(4)];
        expect(offerCandidates(local, new Set([id(2)]), 10).map(entry => entry.id)).toEqual([id(4), id(3), id(1)]);
        expect(offerCandidates(local, new Set([id(2), id(3)]), 2).map(entry => entry.id)).toEqual([id(4)]);
        expect(offerCandidates(local, new Set(), 2).map(entry => entry.id)).toEqual([id(4), id(3)]);
    });

    it('chunks by size and count', () => {
        const items = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => comment(index, 'x'.repeat(400)));
        const chunks = chunkBySize(items, 1000);
        expect(chunks.flat()).toEqual(items);
        expect(chunks.every(part => part.length >= 1)).toBe(true);
        expect(chunkBySize([comment(1, 'x'.repeat(2000))], 1000)).toEqual([]);
        expect(chunk([1, 2, 3], 2)).toEqual([[1, 2], [3]]);
    });
});

describe('Nest', () => {
    it('fetches what it lacks and offers what the server lacks', async () => {
        const server = fakeServer([comment(2), comment(3)]);
        const shared = new Nest(fakeWindow(), new MemoryStore([comment(1)]));
        await shared.connect(server);
        expect(server.calls[0]).toEqual(['Join']);
        await shared.apply([{ kind: 'snapshot', version: 1, previous: 1, capacity: 1000, ids: [id(3), id(2)], added: [], removed: [] }], server);
        await shared.reconciling;
        expect(server.calls.find(call => call[0] === 'Fetch')[1]).toEqual([id(3), id(2)]);
        expect(server.calls.find(call => call[0] === 'Offer')[1].map(entry => entry.id)).toEqual([id(1)]);
        expect([...shared.entries.keys()].sort()).toEqual([id(1), id(2), id(3)]);
        expect(shared.status).toBe('live');
        expect(shared.ready).toBe(true);
        expect(shared.isLive(id(1))).toBe(false);
        expect(shared.listings()).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it('applies deltas and resyncs on a gap', async () => {
        const server = fakeServer([]);
        const shared = new Nest(fakeWindow(), new MemoryStore());
        await shared.connect(server);
        await shared.apply([{ kind: 'snapshot', version: 1, previous: 1, capacity: 1000, ids: [], added: [], removed: [] }], server);
        await shared.apply([{ kind: 'delta', version: 2, previous: 1, capacity: 0, ids: [], added: [comment(5)], removed: [] }], server);
        expect(shared.isLive(id(5))).toBe(true);
        await shared.apply([{ kind: 'delta', version: 3, previous: 2, capacity: 0, ids: [], added: [], removed: [id(5)] }], server);
        expect(shared.isLive(id(5))).toBe(false);
        expect(shared.entries.has(id(5))).toBe(true);
        const joins = server.calls.filter(call => call[0] === 'Join').length;
        await shared.apply([{ kind: 'delta', version: 9, previous: 7, capacity: 0, ids: [], added: [], removed: [] }], server);
        expect(server.calls.filter(call => call[0] === 'Join').length).toBe(joins + 1);
    });

    it('ignores updates from a detached island', async () => {
        const server = fakeServer([]);
        const shared = new Nest(fakeWindow(), new MemoryStore());
        await shared.connect(server);
        shared.disconnect(server);
        await shared.apply([{ kind: 'snapshot', version: 1, previous: 1, capacity: 1000, ids: [id(1)], added: [], removed: [] }], server);
        expect(shared.status).toBe('local');
        expect(shared.server.size).toBe(0);
    });

    it('posts only while live and marks its own entries', async () => {
        const server = fakeServer([]);
        const store = new MemoryStore();
        const shared = new Nest(fakeWindow(), store);
        expect((await shared.post({ kind: 'comment', anchors: ['zillow:1'], text: 'x' })).result).toBe('offline');
        await shared.connect(server);
        await shared.apply([{ kind: 'snapshot', version: 1, previous: 1, capacity: 1000, ids: [], added: [], removed: [] }], server);
        const outcome = await shared.post({ kind: 'comment', anchors: ['zillow:1'], text: 'mine' });
        expect(outcome.result).toBe('accepted');
        expect(shared.entries.get(id(900)).mine).toBe(true);
        expect(store.records.get(id(900)).mine).toBe(true);
        expect(shared.isLive(id(900))).toBe(true);
    });

    it('notifies listeners once per burst', async () => {
        const shared = new Nest(fakeWindow(), new MemoryStore([comment(1)]));
        const listener = vi.fn();
        shared.listen(listener);
        await shared.loaded;
        await Promise.resolve();
        expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        await shared.clear();
        await Promise.resolve();
        expect(shared.entries.size).toBe(0);
    });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { RESULT_TEXT, STATUS_TEXT, commentsLabel, isoOf, previewText, readMineOnly, timeLabel, visibleListings, writeMineOnly } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/Components/Pages/HomesPage.razor.js';
import { addressSuggestion, anchorsOf, countText, previousValue } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/Components/Pages/ListingPage.razor.js';
import { parseLink } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/wwwroot/js/keys.js';
import { buildListings } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/wwwroot/js/merge.js';
import { fixture } from './fixtures.js';

const listings = buildListings(fixture('listings').entries);
const ID = '016f5e66-e800-7000-8000-000000000001';

describe('homes view helpers', () => {
    it('describes a pasted link', () => {
        expect(previewText(null, null)).toBe('');
        expect(previewText(parseLink('https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/1_zpid/'), null)).toBe('Zillow home 1.');
        expect(previewText(parseLink('https://example.com/a'), listings[1])).toBe(`A link from another site. Already here: ${listings[1].title}.`);
    });

    it('filters by text and ownership', () => {
        expect(visibleListings(listings, '', false)).toHaveLength(2);
        expect(visibleListings(listings, 'miami', false)).toHaveLength(0);
        expect(visibleListings(listings, '2893', false)).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(visibleListings(listings, '', true)).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('formats counts and times', () => {
        expect(commentsLabel(1)).toBe('1 comment');
        expect(commentsLabel(0)).toBe('0 comments');
        expect(isoOf(ID)).toBe('2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
        expect(timeLabel(ID, null)).toBe('2020-01-01 00:00');
        expect(timeLabel(ID, { format: () => 'formatted' })).toBe('formatted');
        expect(timeLabel(ID, { format: () => { throw new Error('x'); } })).toBe('2020-01-01 00:00');
        expect(STATUS_TEXT.live).toBe('Live');
        expect(RESULT_TEXT.offline).toMatch(/Not connected/);
    });

    it('remembers the ownership filter', () => {
        const map = new Map();
        const storage = { getItem: key => map.get(key) ?? null, setItem: (key, value) => map.set(key, value), removeItem: key => map.delete(key) };
        writeMineOnly(storage, true);
        expect(readMineOnly(storage)).toBe(true);
        writeMineOnly(storage, false);
        expect(readMineOnly(storage)).toBe(false);
        expect(readMineOnly(null)).toBe(false);
    });
});

describe('listing view helpers', () => {
    it('anchors new entries to the known keys', () => {
        expect(anchorsOf(listings[0], 'zillow:29747113')).toEqual(listings[0].keys);
        expect(anchorsOf(null, 'zillow:5')).toEqual(['zillow:5']);
    });

    it('shows the previous value of a field', () => {
        expect(previousValue(listings[0].history, 'beds', '4')).toBe('3');
        expect(previousValue(listings[0].history, 'street', '2893 State Route 26')).toBeNull();
        expect(previousValue(undefined, 'beds', '4')).toBeNull();
    });

    it('suggests an address from a link only when none is known', () => {
        expect(addressSuggestion(listings[0])).toBeNull();
        const [fresh] = buildListings([{ id: ID, kind: 'link', keys: ['realtor:m1-2'], url: 'https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-detail/1-Main-St_Glen-Aubrey_NY_13777_M1-2' }]);
        expect(addressSuggestion(fresh)).toMatchObject({ street: '1 Main St', city: 'Glen Aubrey', state: 'NY', zip: '13777' });
        expect(addressSuggestion(null)).toBeNull();
    });

    it('counts characters', () => {
        expect(countText(3, 4000)).toBe('3 / 4000');
    });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { isWebUrl, markdownFor, pastedName, tidy } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/wwwroot/work/editor.js';
import { targetStatus } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/wwwroot/work/board.js';
import { ENHANCERS, enhance } from '../../../src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/Components/App.razor.js';

describe('isWebUrl', () => {
    it('accepts web and mail links only', () => {
        expect(isWebUrl('https://example.com/a')).toBe(true);
        expect(isWebUrl('http://example.com')).toBe(true);
        expect(isWebUrl('mailto:someone@example.com')).toBe(true);
        expect(isWebUrl('javascript:alert(1)')).toBe(false);
        expect(isWebUrl('data:text/html,hi')).toBe(false);
        expect(isWebUrl('/relative')).toBe(false);
    });
});

describe('tidy', () => {
    it('collapses blank runs and trailing spaces', () => {
        expect(tidy('  a  \n\n\n\nb \n')).toBe('a\n\nb');
    });
});

describe('markdownFor', () => {
    it('embeds images and links other files', () => {
        expect(markdownFor({ name: 'shot.png', url: '/work/files/1/shot.png', image: true })).toBe('![shot.png](/work/files/1/shot.png)');
        expect(markdownFor({ name: 'notes [v2].pdf', url: '/work/files/2/notes.pdf', image: false })).toBe('[notes v2.pdf](/work/files/2/notes.pdf)');
    });
});

describe('pastedName', () => {
    const now = new Date('2026-11-19T10:24:05Z');

    it('keeps real file names', () => {
        expect(pastedName({ name: 'diagram.png', type: 'image/png' }, now)).toBe('diagram.png');
    });

    it('names clipboard screenshots by time', () => {
        expect(pastedName({ name: 'image.png', type: 'image/png' }, now)).toBe('screenshot-20261119-102405.png');
        expect(pastedName({ name: '', type: 'image/jpeg' }, now)).toBe('screenshot-20261119-102405.jpg');
    });
});

describe('board', () => {
    it('reads the status of a column', () => {
        expect(targetStatus({ dataset: { status: 'done' } })).toBe('done');
        expect(targetStatus(null)).toBeNull();
    });
});

describe('enhance', () => {
    it('mounts each element once per module', async () => {
        const editor = { id: 'editor' };
        const board = { id: 'board' };
        const win = {
            document: {
                querySelectorAll: selector => (selector === '[data-editor]' ? [editor] : selector === '[data-board]' ? [board] : []),
            },
        };
        const mounted = [];
        const load = async path => ({ mount: element => mounted.push([path, element.id]) });
        const seen = new WeakSet();
        await enhance(win, load, seen);
        await enhance(win, load, seen);
        expect(mounted).toEqual([
            [ENHANCERS[0].path, 'editor'],
            [ENHANCERS[1].path, 'board'],
        ]);
    });
});
